with site_context as (
    -- Keep operating sites and expose map attributes as columns.
    select
        site_id,
        site_name,
        region,
        capacity_mw,
        element_at(operational_tags, 'owner') as owner,
        element_at(operational_tags, 'tracking_mode') as tracking_mode
    from solar_sites
    where coalesce(element_at(operational_tags, 'status'), 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE'
),
metric_rows as (
    -- Explode metric structs and derive report-level quality signals.
    select
        r.report_id,
        r.site_id,
        r.report_date,
        item.metric,
        item.metric_value,
        size(filter(r.daily_metrics, x -> x.metric_value is not null)) as reported_metric_count,
        array_join(
            transform(
                filter(r.daily_metrics, x -> x.metric_value is not null),
                x -> x.metric
            ),
            ','
        ) as reported_metrics,
        exists(
            r.daily_metrics,
            x -> x.metric = 'AC_MWH' and x.metric_value > cast(30 as decimal(12,3))
        ) as high_output_day,
        from_json(
            r.telemetry_json,
            'struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>'
        ).curtailment_mwh as curtailment_mwh,
        from_json(
            r.telemetry_json,
            'struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>'
        ).grid_frequency_hz as grid_frequency_hz,
        from_json(
            r.telemetry_json,
            'struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>'
        ).data_quality as data_quality
    from generation_reports r
    lateral view explode(r.daily_metrics) as item
    where r.report_date between date '2025-03-01' and date '2025-03-03'
),
daily_metrics as (
    -- Pivot the long metric series into one row per daily report.
    select
        report_id,
        site_id,
        report_date,
        reported_metric_count,
        reported_metrics,
        high_output_day,
        curtailment_mwh,
        grid_frequency_hz,
        data_quality,
        ac_mwh,
        poa_irradiance,
        availability_pct
    from metric_rows
    pivot (
        max(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'AC_MWH' as ac_mwh,
            'POA_IRRADIANCE' as poa_irradiance,
            'AVAILABILITY_PCT' as availability_pct
        )
    )
),
outage_snapshots as (
    -- Retain the latest outage started on each site and day.
    select
        site_id,
        to_date(started_at) as outage_date,
        outage_id,
        cause_code,
        round(
            (unix_timestamp(ended_at) - unix_timestamp(started_at)) / 3600.0,
            1
        ) as duration_hours,
        cast(get_json_object(event_json, '$.lost_mwh') as decimal(10,2)) as lost_mwh,
        get_json_object(event_json, '$.severity') as severity
    from outage_events
    where to_date(started_at) between date '2025-03-01' and date '2025-03-03'
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by site_id, to_date(started_at)
        order by started_at desc, outage_id desc
    ) = 1
),
latest_inspection as (
    -- Choose the newest deterministic inspection record for every site.
    select
        site_id,
        inspected_at,
        inspection_score,
        passed
    from field_inspections
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by site_id
        order by inspected_at desc, inspection_id desc
    ) = 1
),
scored_days as (
    -- Enrich daily production with site, outage, and inspection context.
    select
        a.*,
        s.site_name,
        s.region,
        s.owner,
        s.tracking_mode,
        s.capacity_mw,
        o.outage_id,
        o.cause_code,
        o.duration_hours,
        o.lost_mwh,
        o.severity,
        i.inspected_at,
        i.inspection_score,
        i.passed,
        round(a.ac_mwh / s.capacity_mw, 3) as specific_yield,
        case
            when a.data_quality <> 'OK' then 'REVIEW'
            when o.severity = 'HIGH' then 'OUTAGE'
            when coalesce(i.passed, false) = false then 'INSPECT'
            when a.availability_pct < 95 then 'LOW_AVAILABILITY'
            else 'NORMAL'
        end as performance_flag
    from daily_metrics a
    join site_context s
        on s.site_id = a.site_id
    left join outage_snapshots o
        on o.site_id = a.site_id
       and o.outage_date = a.report_date
    left join latest_inspection i
        on i.site_id = a.site_id
)
select *
from scored_days
where reported_metric_count >= 2
order by
    performance_flag asc,
    report_date desc,
    specific_yield desc nulls last,
    site_id asc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

site_context = (
    df_solar_sites
    .filter(F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("operational_tags"), "status"), F.lit("ACTIVE")) == "ACTIVE")
    .select(
        "site_id",
        "site_name",
        "region",
        "capacity_mw",
        F.element_at(F.col("operational_tags"), "owner").alias("owner"),
        F.element_at(F.col("operational_tags"), "tracking_mode").alias("tracking_mode"),
    )
)

telemetry_schema = "struct<curtailment_mwh:decimal(10,2),grid_frequency_hz:double,data_quality:string>"
metric_rows = (
    df_generation_reports
    .select(
        "report_id",
        "site_id",
        "report_date",
        "daily_metrics",
        "telemetry_json",
        F.explode(F.col("daily_metrics")).alias("item"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("report_date").between(F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-03-03").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "report_id",
        "site_id",
        "report_date",
        F.col("item.metric").alias("metric"),
        F.col("item.metric_value").alias("metric_value"),
        F.size(F.filter(F.col("daily_metrics"), lambda x: x.getField("metric_value").isNotNull())).alias("reported_metric_count"),
        F.array_join(
            F.transform(
                F.filter(F.col("daily_metrics"), lambda x: x.getField("metric_value").isNotNull()),
                lambda x: x.getField("metric"),
            ),
            ",",
        ).alias("reported_metrics"),
        F.exists(
            F.col("daily_metrics"),
            lambda x: (x.getField("metric") == "AC_MWH") & (x.getField("metric_value") > F.lit(30).cast("decimal(12,3)")),
        ).alias("high_output_day"),
        F.from_json(F.col("telemetry_json"), telemetry_schema).getField("curtailment_mwh").alias("curtailment_mwh"),
        F.from_json(F.col("telemetry_json"), telemetry_schema).getField("grid_frequency_hz").alias("grid_frequency_hz"),
        F.from_json(F.col("telemetry_json"), telemetry_schema).getField("data_quality").alias("data_quality"),
    )
)

daily_metrics = (
    metric_rows
    .groupBy(
        "report_id",
        "site_id",
        "report_date",
        "reported_metric_count",
        "reported_metrics",
        "high_output_day",
        "curtailment_mwh",
        "grid_frequency_hz",
        "data_quality",
    )
    .pivot("metric", ["AC_MWH", "POA_IRRADIANCE", "AVAILABILITY_PCT"])
    .agg(F.max(F.col("metric_value")))
    .select(
        "report_id",
        "site_id",
        "report_date",
        "reported_metric_count",
        "reported_metrics",
        "high_output_day",
        "curtailment_mwh",
        "grid_frequency_hz",
        "data_quality",
        F.col("AC_MWH").alias("ac_mwh"),
        F.col("POA_IRRADIANCE").alias("poa_irradiance"),
        F.col("AVAILABILITY_PCT").alias("availability_pct"),
    )
)

w_outage = Window.partitionBy("site_id", "outage_date").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), F.col("outage_id").desc())
outage_snapshots = (
    df_outage_events
    .select(
        "site_id",
        F.to_date(F.col("started_at")).alias("outage_date"),
        "outage_id",
        "cause_code",
        "started_at",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("ended_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("started_at"))) / F.lit(3600.0), 1).alias("duration_hours"),
        F.get_json_object(F.col("event_json"), "$.lost_mwh").cast("decimal(10,2)").alias("lost_mwh"),
        F.get_json_object(F.col("event_json"), "$.severity").alias("severity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("outage_date").between(F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-03-03").cast("date")))
    .withColumn("outage_rn", F.row_number().over(w_outage))
    .filter(F.col("outage_rn") == 1)
    .drop("outage_rn", "started_at")
)

w_inspection = Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy(F.col("inspected_at").desc(), F.col("inspection_id").desc())
latest_inspection = (
    df_field_inspections
    .withColumn("inspection_rn", F.row_number().over(w_inspection))
    .filter(F.col("inspection_rn") == 1)
    .select("site_id", "inspected_at", "inspection_score", "passed")
)

scored_days = (
    daily_metrics.alias("a")
    .join(site_context.alias("s"), F.col("s.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"), "inner")
    .join(
        outage_snapshots.alias("o"),
        (F.col("o.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id")) & (F.col("o.outage_date") == F.col("a.report_date")),
        "left",
    )
    .join(latest_inspection.alias("i"), F.col("i.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("s.site_name"),
        F.col("s.region"),
        F.col("s.owner"),
        F.col("s.tracking_mode"),
        F.col("s.capacity_mw"),
        F.col("o.outage_id"),
        F.col("o.cause_code"),
        F.col("o.duration_hours"),
        F.col("o.lost_mwh"),
        F.col("o.severity"),
        F.col("i.inspected_at"),
        F.col("i.inspection_score"),
        F.col("i.passed"),
        F.round(F.col("a.ac_mwh") / F.col("s.capacity_mw"), 3).alias("specific_yield"),
        F.when(F.col("a.data_quality") != "OK", F.lit("REVIEW"))
        .when(F.col("o.severity") == "HIGH", F.lit("OUTAGE"))
        .when(F.coalesce(F.col("i.passed"), F.lit(False)) == F.lit(False), F.lit("INSPECT"))
        .when(F.col("a.availability_pct") < 95, F.lit("LOW_AVAILABILITY"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("NORMAL"))
        .alias("performance_flag"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_days
    .filter(F.col("reported_metric_count") >= 2)
    .orderBy(
        F.col("performance_flag").asc(),
        F.col("report_date").desc(),
        F.col("specific_yield").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("site_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

normalized_events = (
    df_feature_usage
    .filter((F.col("occurred_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("qty") > 0))
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "acct_id",
        "actor_id",
        "occurred_at",
        "feature_nm",
        "qty",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("properties_json"),
            "struct<client:string,source:string,billable:boolean>",
        ).alias("event_props"),
    )
)

flagged_events = (
    normalized_events.alias("u")
    .join(
        df_flag_windows.alias("fw"),
        (F.col("u.acct_id") == F.col("fw.acct_id"))
        & (F.col("u.feature_nm") == F.col("fw.feature_nm"))
        & F.col("u.occurred_at").between(
            F.col("fw.starts_at"),
            F.col("fw.ends_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR"),
        ),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "u.*",
        "fw.window_id",
        F.element_at(F.col("fw.targeting"), F.lit("cohort")).alias("matched_cohort"),
        F.when(F.col("fw.window_id").isNull(), F.lit("BASELINE"))
        .when(F.coalesce(F.col("u.event_props.billable"), F.lit(True)) == F.lit(False), F.lit("TRIAL"))
        .when(F.element_at(F.col("fw.targeting"), F.lit("cohort")) == F.lit("enterprise"), F.lit("CONTROLLED"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("ROLLED_OUT"))
        .alias("rollout_state"),
    )
)

entitlement_grants = (
    df_entitlement_bundles
    .select("acct_id", F.explode(F.col("entitlements")).alias("item"))
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        F.col("item.feature_nm").alias("feature_nm"),
        F.col("item.state").alias("entitlement_state"),
        F.col("item.seat_cap").alias("seat_cap"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("entitlement_state").isin("ENABLED", "LIMITED"))
)

pivot_raw = (
    normalized_events
    .select("acct_id", "feature_nm", "qty")
    .groupBy("acct_id")
    .pivot("feature_nm", ["DASHBOARD", "BOARD", "API_CALL"])
    .agg(F.sum("qty").alias("qty"))
)

feature_totals = (
    pivot_raw
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        F.col("DASHBOARD").alias("dashboard_qty"),
        F.col("BOARD").alias("board_qty"),
        F.col("API_CALL").alias("api_call_qty"),
    )
)

result = (
    flagged_events.alias("fe")
    .join(df_acct_subscriptions.alias("a"), F.col("fe.acct_id") == F.col("a.acct_id"), "left")
    .join(feature_totals.alias("p"), F.col("fe.acct_id") == F.col("p.acct_id"), "left")
    .join(
        entitlement_grants.alias("eg"),
        (F.col("fe.acct_id") == F.col("eg.acct_id"))
        & (F.col("fe.feature_nm") == F.col("eg.feature_nm")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "fe.*",
        "a.acct_nm",
        "a.plan_nm",
        F.col("a.billing_profile.country").alias("billing_country"),
        F.col("a.billing_profile.segment").alias("customer_segment"),
        F.element_at(F.col("a.quotas"), F.lit("API_CALL")).alias("api_quota"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("eg.entitlement_state"), F.lit("MISSING")).alias("entitlement_state"),
        F.col("eg.seat_cap").alias("seat_cap"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.dashboard_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("dashboard_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.board_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("board_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.api_call_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("api_call_qty"),
        F.when(F.col("eg.entitlement_state").isNull(), F.lit("NO_ENTITLEMENT"))
        .when(F.col("eg.entitlement_state") == F.lit("LIMITED"), F.lit("CAPPED"))
        .when(F.col("fe.qty") > F.coalesce(F.col("eg.seat_cap"), F.lit(0)), F.lit("OVER_CAP"))
        .when(F.nullif(F.col("fe.matched_cohort"), F.lit("")).isNull(), F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("ENTITLED"))
        .alias("access_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("occurred_at").desc(), F.col("event_id").desc())
)
case.sql:
WITH normalized_events AS (
    -- Keep billable-period activity and decode the client-supplied JSON payload.
    SELECT
        event_id,
        acct_id,
        actor_id,
        occurred_at,
        feature_nm,
        qty,
        from_json(
            properties_json,
            'struct<client:string,source:string,billable:boolean>'
        ) AS event_props
    FROM feature_usage
    WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND qty > 0
),
flagged_events AS (
    -- Attach at most one rollout window, allowing a 36-hour observation grace period.
    SELECT
        u.*,
        fw.window_id,
        element_at(fw.targeting, 'cohort') AS matched_cohort,
        CASE
            WHEN fw.window_id IS NULL THEN 'BASELINE'
            WHEN coalesce(u.event_props.billable, TRUE) = FALSE THEN 'TRIAL'
            WHEN element_at(fw.targeting, 'cohort') = 'enterprise' THEN 'CONTROLLED'
            ELSE 'ROLLED_OUT'
        END AS rollout_state
    FROM normalized_events u
    LEFT JOIN flag_windows fw
      ON u.acct_id = fw.acct_id
     AND u.feature_nm = fw.feature_nm
     AND u.occurred_at BETWEEN fw.starts_at
                           AND fw.ends_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR
),
entitlement_grants AS (
    -- Flatten each account bundle and remove disabled feature grants.
    SELECT
        b.acct_id,
        item.feature_nm,
        item.state AS entitlement_state,
        item.seat_cap
    FROM entitlement_bundles b
    LATERAL VIEW explode(b.entitlements) AS item
    WHERE item.state IN ('ENABLED', 'LIMITED')
),
feature_totals AS (
    -- Create one usage column per product surface for account-level comparisons.
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT acct_id, feature_nm, qty
        FROM normalized_events
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        sum(qty) AS qty
        FOR feature_nm IN (
            'DASHBOARD' AS dashboard,
            'BOARD' AS board,
            'API_CALL' AS api_call
        )
    )
)
-- Enrich each usage event with subscription, entitlement, and account total context.
SELECT
    fe.*,
    a.acct_nm,
    a.plan_nm,
    a.billing_profile.country AS billing_country,
    a.billing_profile.segment AS customer_segment,
    element_at(a.quotas, 'API_CALL') AS api_quota,
    coalesce(eg.entitlement_state, 'MISSING') AS entitlement_state,
    eg.seat_cap,
    coalesce(p.dashboard, 0) AS dashboard_qty,
    coalesce(p.board, 0) AS board_qty,
    coalesce(p.api_call, 0) AS api_call_qty,
    CASE
        WHEN eg.entitlement_state IS NULL THEN 'NO_ENTITLEMENT'
        WHEN eg.entitlement_state = 'LIMITED' THEN 'CAPPED'
        WHEN fe.qty > coalesce(eg.seat_cap, 0) THEN 'OVER_CAP'
        WHEN nullif(fe.matched_cohort, '') IS NULL THEN 'STANDARD'
        ELSE 'ENTITLED'
    END AS access_label
FROM flagged_events fe
LEFT JOIN acct_subscriptions a
  ON fe.acct_id = a.acct_id
LEFT JOIN feature_totals p
  ON fe.acct_id = p.acct_id
LEFT JOIN entitlement_grants eg
  ON fe.acct_id = eg.acct_id
 AND fe.feature_nm = eg.feature_nm
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, event_id DESC

case.sql:
with charge_rows as (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes the missing optional fees.
    select pnr, acct_id, booked_ts, origin, destination, cabin,
           booking_status, distance_miles, charge_type, charge_amt
    from flight_bookings
    unpivot (
        charge_amt for charge_type in (
            base_fare as BASE, tax_amt as TAX, fee_amt as FEE
        )
    )
    where booking_status in ('CONFIRMED', 'FLOWN')
),
booking_rollup as (
    select pnr, acct_id, booked_ts, origin, destination, cabin,
           booking_status, distance_miles,
           cast(coalesce(sum(charge_amt) filter (where charge_type = 'BASE'), 0)
                as decimal(12,2)) as base_paid,
           cast(coalesce(sum(charge_amt) filter (where charge_type = 'FEE'), 0)
                as decimal(12,2)) as fee_paid,
           cast(sum(charge_amt) as decimal(12,2)) as total_paid,
           round(sum(charge_amt) / nullif(distance_miles, 0), 4) as cost_per_mile
    from charge_rows
    group by pnr, acct_id, booked_ts, origin, destination, cabin,
             booking_status, distance_miles
),
points_pivot as (
    select acct_id,
           coalesce(base_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as base_points,
           coalesce(bonus_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as bonus_points,
           coalesce(redeem_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2))) as redeem_points
    from (
        select acct_id, metric, points
        from loyalty_txn
        where txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    ) txn
    pivot (
        sum(points) for metric in (
            'BASE' as base_points, 'BONUS' as bonus_points,
            'REDEEM' as redeem_points
        )
    )
),
enriched as (
    select bk.*, acct.cust_name, acct.tier,
           acct.contact.home_city as home_city,
           coalesce(nullif(acct.contact.email, ''), 'not-on-file') as contact_email,
           coalesce(element_at(acct.profile_map, 'vip_flag'), 'NO') as vip_flag,
           case
               when bk.cost_per_mile is null then 'UNRATED'
               when bk.cost_per_mile >= 0.18 then 'PREMIUM_YIELD'
               when bk.cost_per_mile >= 0.12 then 'STANDARD_YIELD'
               else 'VALUE_YIELD'
           end as yield_band
    from booking_rollup bk
    join loyalty_accounts acct
      on acct.acct_id = bk.acct_id
     and acct.acct_status = 'ACTIVE'
),
account_summary as (
    select e.acct_id, e.cust_name, e.tier, e.home_city, e.contact_email, e.vip_flag,
           count(*) as booking_qty,
           count(*) filter (where e.booking_status = 'FLOWN') as flown_qty,
           cast(round(sum(e.total_paid), 2) as decimal(12,2)) as total_spend,
           round(avg(e.cost_per_mile), 4) as avg_cost_per_mile,
           array_sort(collect_list(distinct e.cabin)) as cabins,
           size(collect_set(e.origin)) as origin_qty,
           max(coalesce(pp.base_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) as base_points,
           max(coalesce(pp.bonus_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) as bonus_points,
           max(coalesce(pp.redeem_points, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))) as redeem_points,
           floor(max(coalesce(pp.base_points, 0)) / 1000) as base_point_thousands,
           ceil(sum(e.distance_miles) / 1000) as distance_thousands,
           max(coalesce(pp.base_points, 0))
             + max(coalesce(pp.bonus_points, 0))
             + max(coalesce(pp.redeem_points, 0)) as net_points
    from enriched e
    left join points_pivot pp on pp.acct_id = e.acct_id
    group by e.acct_id, e.cust_name, e.tier, e.home_city, e.contact_email, e.vip_flag
)
select s.acct_id, s.cust_name, s.tier, s.home_city, s.contact_email, s.vip_flag,
       s.booking_qty, s.flown_qty, s.cabins, s.origin_qty,
       s.total_spend, s.avg_cost_per_mile,
       round(s.total_spend / nullif(s.booking_qty, 0), 2) as avg_booking_spend,
       s.base_points, s.bonus_points, s.redeem_points, s.net_points,
       s.base_point_thousands, s.distance_thousands,
       case
           when s.net_points >= 12000 and s.total_spend >= 1200 then 'ANCHOR'
           when s.net_points >= 8000 or s.total_spend >= 800 then 'GROWTH'
           when s.net_points >= 1500 and s.total_spend >= 150 then 'STEADY'
           else 'NURTURE'
       end as loyalty_segment,
       -- Numeric RANGE deliberately uses spend rather than a row-count frame.
       sum(s.total_spend) over (
           order by s.total_spend range between 300 preceding and current row
       ) as nearby_spend,
       ntile(3) over (order by s.total_spend desc, s.acct_id) as spend_tercile,
       round(percent_rank() over (order by s.net_points desc, s.acct_id), 3)
           as points_percent_rank,
       round(cume_dist() over (order by s.total_spend desc, s.acct_id), 3)
           as spend_cume_dist,
       dense_rank() over (order by s.total_spend desc) as spend_rank
from account_summary s
order by s.total_spend desc, s.acct_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

charge_rows = (
    df_flight_bookings
    .unpivot(
        ["pnr", "acct_id", "booked_ts", "origin", "destination", "cabin", "booking_status", "distance_miles"],
        ["base_fare", "tax_amt", "fee_amt"],
        "charge_type_raw",
        "charge_amt",
    )
    .select(
        "pnr",
        "acct_id",
        "booked_ts",
        "origin",
        "destination",
        "cabin",
        "booking_status",
        "distance_miles",
        F.when(F.col("charge_type_raw") == "base_fare", "BASE")
        .when(F.col("charge_type_raw") == "tax_amt", "TAX")
        .otherwise("FEE")
        .alias("charge_type"),
        "charge_amt",
    )
    .filter(F.col("charge_amt").isNotNull() & F.col("booking_status").isin("CONFIRMED", "FLOWN"))
)

booking_rollup = (
    charge_rows
    .groupBy("pnr", "acct_id", "booked_ts", "origin", "destination", "cabin", "booking_status", "distance_miles")
    .agg(
        F.coalesce(F.sum(F.when(F.col("charge_type") == "BASE", F.col("charge_amt"))), F.lit(0))
        .cast("decimal(12,2)")
        .alias("base_paid"),
        F.coalesce(F.sum(F.when(F.col("charge_type") == "FEE", F.col("charge_amt"))), F.lit(0))
        .cast("decimal(12,2)")
        .alias("fee_paid"),
        F.sum("charge_amt").cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("total_paid"),
        F.round(F.sum("charge_amt") / F.nullif(F.col("distance_miles"), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("cost_per_mile"),
    )
)

points_pivot = (
    df_loyalty_txn
    .filter(F.col("txn_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .groupBy("acct_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["BASE", "BONUS", "REDEEM"])
    .agg(F.sum("points"))
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        F.coalesce(F.col("BASE"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")).alias("base_points"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("BONUS"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")).alias("bonus_points"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("REDEEM"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")).alias("redeem_points"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    booking_rollup.alias("bk")
    .join(
        df_loyalty_accounts.alias("acct"),
        (F.col("acct.acct_id") == F.col("bk.acct_id")) & (F.col("acct.acct_status") == "ACTIVE"),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "bk.*",
        F.col("acct.cust_name").alias("cust_name"),
        F.col("acct.tier").alias("tier"),
        F.col("acct.contact.home_city").alias("home_city"),
        F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("acct.contact.email"), F.lit("")), F.lit("not-on-file")).alias("contact_email"),
        F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("acct.profile_map"), F.lit("vip_flag")), F.lit("NO")).alias("vip_flag"),
        F.when(F.col("bk.cost_per_mile").isNull(), "UNRATED")
        .when(F.col("bk.cost_per_mile") >= 0.18, "PREMIUM_YIELD")
        .when(F.col("bk.cost_per_mile") >= 0.12, "STANDARD_YIELD")
        .otherwise("VALUE_YIELD")
        .alias("yield_band"),
    )
)

account_summary = (
    enriched.alias("e")
    .join(points_pivot.alias("pp"), F.col("pp.acct_id") == F.col("e.acct_id"), "left")
    .groupBy("e.acct_id", "e.cust_name", "e.tier", "e.home_city", "e.contact_email", "e.vip_flag")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("booking_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("booking_status") == "FLOWN", F.lit(1))).alias("flown_qty"),
        F.round(F.sum("total_paid"), 2).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("total_spend"),
        F.round(F.avg("cost_per_mile"), 4).alias("avg_cost_per_mile"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("cabin")).alias("cabins"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("origin")).alias("origin_qty"),
        F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("base_points"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))).alias("base_points"),
        F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("bonus_points"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))).alias("bonus_points"),
        F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("redeem_points"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))).alias("redeem_points"),
        F.floor(F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("base_points"), F.lit(0))) / 1000).alias("base_point_thousands"),
        F.ceil(F.sum("distance_miles") / 1000).alias("distance_thousands"),
        (
            F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("base_points"), F.lit(0)))
            + F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("bonus_points"), F.lit(0)))
            + F.max(F.coalesce(F.col("redeem_points"), F.lit(0)))
        ).alias("net_points"),
    )
)

w_nearby_spend = Window.orderBy("total_spend").rangeBetween(-300, Window.currentRow)
w_spend = Window.orderBy(F.col("total_spend").desc(), F.col("acct_id"))
w_points = Window.orderBy(F.col("net_points").desc(), F.col("acct_id"))
w_spend_rank = Window.orderBy(F.col("total_spend").desc())

result = (
    account_summary.alias("s")
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "cust_name",
        "tier",
        "home_city",
        "contact_email",
        "vip_flag",
        "booking_qty",
        "flown_qty",
        "cabins",
        "origin_qty",
        "total_spend",
        "avg_cost_per_mile",
        F.round(F.col("total_spend") / F.nullif(F.col("booking_qty"), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("avg_booking_spend"),
        "base_points",
        "bonus_points",
        "redeem_points",
        "net_points",
        "base_point_thousands",
        "distance_thousands",
        F.when((F.col("net_points") >= 12000) & (F.col("total_spend") >= 1200), "ANCHOR")
        .when((F.col("net_points") >= 8000) | (F.col("total_spend") >= 800), "GROWTH")
        .when((F.col("net_points") >= 1500) & (F.col("total_spend") >= 150), "STEADY")
        .otherwise("NURTURE")
        .alias("loyalty_segment"),
        F.sum("total_spend").over(w_nearby_spend).alias("nearby_spend"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_spend).alias("spend_tercile"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_points), 3).alias("points_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_spend), 3).alias("spend_cume_dist"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_spend_rank).alias("spend_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("total_spend").desc(), F.col("acct_id"))
)

WITH normalized_leases AS (
    SELECT
        l.lease_id,
        l.property_id,
        l.unit_number,
        l.tenant_id,
        l.lease_start_date,
        l.lease_end_date,
        l.monthly_rent,
        l.deposit_amount,
        l.status,
        FROM_JSON(
            l.preferences_json,
            'STRUCT<autopay:BOOLEAN,insurance_required:BOOLEAN,pet_count:INT>'
        ) AS lease_preferences,
        -- Zero-value lines and credits do not belong in the charge schedule.
        FILTER(l.charge_schedule, charge -> charge.amount > 0) AS billable_charges,
        t.contact.primary_email AS primary_email,
        t.contact.emergency_phone AS emergency_phone,
        t.risk_tier,
        p.city,
        p.management_tier
    FROM lease_contracts l
    LEFT JOIN tenants t
        ON t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id
    JOIN properties p
        ON p.property_id = l.property_id
       AND p.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE l.lease_end_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND l.status <> 'draft'
),
charge_rows AS (
    SELECT
        nl.lease_id,
        nl.property_id,
        item.charge_type,
        item.amount,
        item.due_date,
        CASE
            WHEN item.due_date < nl.lease_start_date THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
            ELSE item.amount
        END AS recognized_amount
    FROM normalized_leases nl
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(nl.billable_charges) charges AS item
),
lease_charge_summary AS (
    SELECT
        lease_id,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(charge_type)) AS charge_types,
        SUM(recognized_amount) AS scheduled_charge_total,
        COUNT(*) AS charge_line_count
    FROM charge_rows
    GROUP BY lease_id
),
utility_long AS (
    SELECT
        property_id,
        billing_month,
        utility_type,
        utility_amount
    FROM utility_statements
    UNPIVOT (
        utility_amount FOR utility_type IN (
            water_amount,
            common_area_amount,
            parking_amount
        )
    )
),
utility_summary AS (
    SELECT
        property_id,
        SUM(utility_amount) AS property_utility_total,
        COUNT(*) AS reported_utility_lines,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN utility_type = 'water_amount' THEN utility_amount ELSE 0 END
        ) AS water_total
    FROM utility_long
    WHERE billing_month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    GROUP BY property_id
),
reporting_rows AS (
    SELECT
        nl.*,
        cs.charge_types,
        cs.scheduled_charge_total,
        cs.charge_line_count,
        us.property_utility_total,
        us.reported_utility_lines
    FROM normalized_leases nl
    LEFT JOIN lease_charge_summary cs
        ON cs.lease_id = nl.lease_id
    LEFT JOIN utility_summary us
        ON us.property_id = nl.property_id
)
SELECT
    lease_id,
    property_id,
    unit_number,
    city,
    primary_email,
    emergency_phone,
    status,
    monthly_rent,
    COALESCE(lease_preferences.autopay, FALSE) AS autopay_enabled,
    CASE
        WHEN lease_preferences.pet_count IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
        WHEN lease_preferences.pet_count = 0 THEN 'no_pets'
        ELSE 'pets'
    END AS pet_policy,
    charge_types,
    COALESCE(scheduled_charge_total, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS scheduled_charge_total,
    COALESCE(property_utility_total, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS property_utility_total,
    -- Rent bands include every lease within 250 dollars on either side.
    ROUND(
        AVG(monthly_rent) OVER (
            PARTITION BY property_id
            ORDER BY monthly_rent
            RANGE BETWEEN 250 PRECEDING AND 250 FOLLOWING
        ),
        2
    ) AS nearby_rent_avg,
    ROUND(
        monthly_rent - AVG(monthly_rent) OVER (
            PARTITION BY property_id
            ORDER BY monthly_rent
            RANGE BETWEEN 250 PRECEDING AND 250 FOLLOWING
        ),
        2
    ) AS rent_vs_nearby_avg,
    COALESCE(charge_line_count, 0) AS charge_line_count
FROM reporting_rows
ORDER BY property_id, lease_id

case.sql:
with send_blocks as (
    -- flatten creative blocks before rolling each send back up
    select
        s.send_id,
        s.subscriber_id,
        s.newsletter_id,
        s.sent_at,
        s.delivery_context.region as delivery_region,
        coalesce(element_at(s.experiment_tags, 'variant'), 'unassigned') as variant,
        blk.block_code,
        blk.block_weight,
        blk.is_primary
    from newsletter_send_log s
    lateral view explode(s.content_blocks) as blk
    where s.send_status = 'delivered'
      and s.sent_at >= timestamp '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
      and s.sent_at < timestamp '2025-04-16 00:00:00'
      and s.delivery_context.region in ('US', 'CA')
),
send_rollup as (
    select
        send_id,
        subscriber_id,
        newsletter_id,
        sent_at,
        delivery_region,
        variant,
        count(distinct block_code) as creative_block_count,
        sum(block_weight) as block_weight_total,
        max(case when is_primary then block_code end) as primary_block_code
    from send_blocks
    group by
        send_id,
        subscriber_id,
        newsletter_id,
        sent_at,
        delivery_region,
        variant
),
send_enriched as (
    select
        sr.*,
        nc.newsletter_title,
        sd.email
    from send_rollup sr
    join newsletter_catalog nc
      on nc.newsletter_id = sr.newsletter_id
     and nc.is_active = true
    join subscriber_directory sd
      on sd.subscriber_id = sr.subscriber_id
     and sd.consent_status = 'subscribed'
),
open_steps as (
    select
        oe.open_id,
        oe.send_id,
        oe.subscriber_id,
        oe.opened_at,
        from_json(
            oe.payload_json,
            'event_type string, engaged_seconds int, client string'
        ).engaged_seconds as engaged_seconds,
        lag(oe.opened_at) over (
            partition by oe.subscriber_id
            order by oe.opened_at, oe.open_id
        ) as prior_opened_at
    from newsletter_open_events oe
    join send_enriched se
      on se.send_id = oe.send_id
     and se.subscriber_id = oe.subscriber_id
    where from_json(
              oe.payload_json,
              'event_type string, engaged_seconds int, client string'
          ).event_type = 'open'
      and lower(oe.user_agent) not like '%bot%'
),
open_sessions as (
    select
        flagged.*,
        sum(flagged.new_session_flag) over (
            partition by flagged.subscriber_id
            order by flagged.opened_at, flagged.open_id
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row
        ) as session_id
    from (
        -- a thirty-minute quiet period starts a new reading session
        select
            open_steps.*,
            case
                when prior_opened_at is null then 1
                when unix_timestamp(opened_at) - unix_timestamp(prior_opened_at) > 1800 then 1
                else 0
            end as new_session_flag
        from open_steps
    ) flagged
),
session_metrics as (
    select
        se.newsletter_id,
        se.newsletter_title,
        os.subscriber_id,
        se.email,
        os.session_id,
        min(os.opened_at) as session_start_at,
        max(os.opened_at) as session_end_at,
        count(distinct os.open_id) as open_count,
        count(distinct os.send_id) as opened_send_count,
        sum(distinct os.engaged_seconds) as distinct_engaged_seconds,
        max(se.variant) as experiment_variant
    from open_sessions os
    join send_enriched se
      on se.send_id = os.send_id
     and se.subscriber_id = os.subscriber_id
    group by
        se.newsletter_id,
        se.newsletter_title,
        os.subscriber_id,
        se.email,
        os.session_id
)
select
    newsletter_id,
    newsletter_title,
    subscriber_id,
    email,
    session_id,
    session_start_at,
    session_end_at,
    open_count,
    opened_send_count,
    distinct_engaged_seconds,
    experiment_variant,
    cast(
        (unix_timestamp(session_end_at) - unix_timestamp(session_start_at)) / 60
        as int
    ) as session_duration_minutes,
    case
        when coalesce(distinct_engaged_seconds, 0) >= 40
             and open_count >= 2 then 'high'
        when coalesce(distinct_engaged_seconds, 0) > 0 then 'medium'
        else 'low'
    end as engagement_band,
    (select count(distinct send_id) from send_enriched) as eligible_send_count
from session_metrics
order by session_start_at, subscriber_id, newsletter_id, session_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

send_blocks = (
    df_newsletter_send_log.alias("s")
    .filter(
        (F.col("s.send_status") == "delivered")
        & (F.col("s.sent_at") >= F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("s.sent_at") < F.lit("2025-04-16 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("s.delivery_context.region").isin("US", "CA"))
    )
    .select(
        F.col("s.send_id").alias("send_id"),
        F.col("s.subscriber_id").alias("subscriber_id"),
        F.col("s.newsletter_id").alias("newsletter_id"),
        F.col("s.sent_at").alias("sent_at"),
        F.col("s.delivery_context.region").alias("delivery_region"),
        F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("s.experiment_tags"), F.lit("variant")), F.lit("unassigned")).alias("variant"),
        F.explode(F.col("s.content_blocks")).alias("blk"),
    )
    .select(
        "send_id",
        "subscriber_id",
        "newsletter_id",
        "sent_at",
        "delivery_region",
        "variant",
        F.col("blk.block_code").alias("block_code"),
        F.col("blk.block_weight").alias("block_weight"),
        F.col("blk.is_primary").alias("is_primary"),
    )
)

send_rollup = (
    send_blocks
    .groupBy(
        "send_id",
        "subscriber_id",
        "newsletter_id",
        "sent_at",
        "delivery_region",
        "variant",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("block_code").alias("creative_block_count"),
        F.sum("block_weight").alias("block_weight_total"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("is_primary"), F.col("block_code"))).alias("primary_block_code"),
    )
)

send_enriched = (
    send_rollup.alias("sr")
    .join(
        df_newsletter_catalog.alias("nc"),
        (F.col("nc.newsletter_id") == F.col("sr.newsletter_id")) & F.col("nc.is_active"),
    )
    .join(
        df_subscriber_directory.alias("sd"),
        (F.col("sd.subscriber_id") == F.col("sr.subscriber_id"))
        & (F.col("sd.consent_status") == "subscribed"),
    )
    .select(
        "sr.*",
        F.col("nc.newsletter_title"),
        F.col("sd.email"),
    )
)

w_open_order = Window.partitionBy("oe.subscriber_id").orderBy("oe.opened_at", "oe.open_id")
payload_schema = "event_type string, engaged_seconds int, client string"
open_steps = (
    df_newsletter_open_events.alias("oe")
    .join(
        send_enriched.alias("se"),
        (F.col("se.send_id") == F.col("oe.send_id"))
        & (F.col("se.subscriber_id") == F.col("oe.subscriber_id")),
    )
    .filter(
        (F.from_json(F.col("oe.payload_json"), payload_schema).getField("event_type") == "open")
        & (~F.lower(F.col("oe.user_agent")).like("%bot%"))
    )
    .select(
        F.col("oe.open_id").alias("open_id"),
        F.col("oe.send_id").alias("send_id"),
        F.col("oe.subscriber_id").alias("subscriber_id"),
        F.col("oe.opened_at").alias("opened_at"),
        F.from_json(F.col("oe.payload_json"), payload_schema).getField("engaged_seconds").alias("engaged_seconds"),
        F.lag(F.col("oe.opened_at")).over(w_open_order).alias("prior_opened_at"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    open_steps
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("prior_opened_at").isNull(), F.lit(1))
        .when((F.unix_timestamp("opened_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prior_opened_at")) > 1800, F.lit(1))
        .otherwise(F.lit(0))
        .alias("new_session_flag"),
    )
)
w_session = (
    Window.partitionBy("flagged.subscriber_id")
    .orderBy("flagged.opened_at", "flagged.open_id")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
)
open_sessions = (
    flagged.alias("flagged")
    .select(
        "flagged.*",
        F.sum(F.col("flagged.new_session_flag")).over(w_session).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

session_metrics = (
    open_sessions.alias("os")
    .join(
        send_enriched.alias("se"),
        (F.col("se.send_id") == F.col("os.send_id"))
        & (F.col("se.subscriber_id") == F.col("os.subscriber_id")),
    )
    .groupBy(
        F.col("se.newsletter_id").alias("newsletter_id"),
        F.col("se.newsletter_title").alias("newsletter_title"),
        F.col("os.subscriber_id").alias("subscriber_id"),
        F.col("se.email").alias("email"),
        F.col("os.session_id").alias("session_id"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min(F.col("os.opened_at")).alias("session_start_at"),
        F.max(F.col("os.opened_at")).alias("session_end_at"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("os.open_id")).alias("open_count"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("os.send_id")).alias("opened_send_count"),
        F.sumDistinct(F.col("os.engaged_seconds")).alias("distinct_engaged_seconds"),
        F.max(F.col("se.variant")).alias("experiment_variant"),
    )
)

eligible_send_totals = send_enriched.agg(F.countDistinct("send_id").alias("eligible_send_count"))
result = (
    session_metrics
    .crossJoin(eligible_send_totals)
    .select(
        "newsletter_id",
        "newsletter_title",
        "subscriber_id",
        "email",
        "session_id",
        "session_start_at",
        "session_end_at",
        "open_count",
        "opened_send_count",
        "distinct_engaged_seconds",
        "experiment_variant",
        ((F.unix_timestamp("session_end_at") - F.unix_timestamp("session_start_at")) / 60).cast("int").alias("session_duration_minutes"),
        F.when(
            (F.coalesce(F.col("distinct_engaged_seconds"), F.lit(0)) >= 40) & (F.col("open_count") >= 2),
            F.lit("high"),
        )
        .when(F.coalesce(F.col("distinct_engaged_seconds"), F.lit(0)) > 0, F.lit("medium"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("low"))
        .alias("engagement_band"),
        "eligible_send_count",
    )
    .orderBy("session_start_at", "subscriber_id", "newsletter_id", "session_id")
)

with scoped as (
    select
        p.permit_id,
        p.applicant_ref,
        p.permit_status,
        p.start_ts,
        p.end_ts,
        p.attendee_qty,
        p.fee_usd,
        p.site.park_id as park_id,
        p.site.zone as zone_code,
        p.site.district as site_district,
        p.amenity_tags as raw_tags,
        transform(p.amenity_tags, x -> upper(x)) as normalized_tags,
        filter(
            p.amenity_tags,
            x -> x is not null and x <> 'GLASS'
        ) as allowed_tags,
        coalesce(
            exists(p.amenity_tags, x -> x = 'AMPLIFIED_SOUND'),
            false
        ) as has_amplified_sound,
        coalesce(
            aggregate(
                filter(p.amenity_tags, x -> x is not null),
                0,
                (acc, x) -> acc + length(x)
            ),
            0
        ) as tag_char_qty,
        date_trunc('WEEK', p.start_ts) as week_start,
        datediff(p.end_ts, p.start_ts) + 1 as permit_days,
        timestampdiff(HOUR, p.start_ts, p.end_ts) as duration_hours,
        p.start_ts - interval '36' hour as review_due_ts,
        p.end_ts + interval '7' day as closeout_due_ts,
        case
            when p.permit_status = 'DENIED' then 'REJECTED'
            when coalesce(
                exists(p.amenity_tags, x -> x = 'AMPLIFIED_SOUND'),
                false
            ) and p.attendee_qty >= 100 then 'LARGE_AMPLIFIED'
            when coalesce(
                exists(p.amenity_tags, x -> x = 'AMPLIFIED_SOUND'),
                false
            ) then 'AMPLIFIED'
            when timestampdiff(HOUR, p.start_ts, p.end_ts) >= 24
                then 'MULTIDAY'
            else 'STANDARD'
        end as permit_class
    from permit_txn p
    where p.permit_status <> 'DRAFT'
),
event_rollup as (
    -- Match logs by park and an asymmetric operating window.
    select
        p.permit_id,
        count(e.event_id) as event_cnt,
        coalesce(sum(e.actual_qty), 0) as actual_qty
    from scoped p
    left join event_log e
        on e.park_id = p.park_id
        and e.checkin_ts >= p.start_ts - interval '2' hour
        and e.checkin_ts < p.end_ts + interval '1' day
    group by p.permit_id
),
obs_wide as (
    select *
    from (
        select park_id, metric, metric_value
        from env_obs
    ) o
    pivot (
        round(avg(metric_value), 2)
        for metric in (
            'TEMPERATURE' as temperature,
            'NOISE_DB' as noise_db,
            'CROWD_IDX' as crowd_idx
        )
    )
),
permit_detail as (
    select
        p.*,
        e.event_cnt,
        e.actual_qty,
        o.temperature,
        o.noise_db,
        o.crowd_idx,
        r.park_name,
        r.capacity_qty,
        coalesce(r.district, p.site_district) as district
    from scoped p
    join event_rollup e
        on e.permit_id = p.permit_id
    left join obs_wide o
        on o.park_id = p.park_id
    left join park_ref r
        on r.park_id = p.park_id
),
rolled as (
    select
        case grouping_id(d.week_start, d.district)
            when 0 then 'WEEK_DISTRICT'
            when 1 then 'WEEK'
            else 'ALL'
        end as grain_label,
        d.week_start,
        d.district,
        count(*) filter (
            where d.permit_status = 'APPROVED'
        ) as approved_permits,
        count(*) filter (
            where d.permit_status = 'DENIED'
        ) as denied_permits,
        sum(d.attendee_qty) filter (
            where d.has_amplified_sound
        ) as amplified_attendees,
        round(avg(d.fee_usd), 2) as avg_fee_usd,
        sum(d.event_cnt) as matched_event_cnt,
        round(avg(coalesce(d.noise_db, 40.0)), 2) as avg_noise_db,
        max(
            case
                when array_contains(d.allowed_tags, 'WATER')
                    then d.closeout_due_ts
            end
        ) as last_water_closeout
    from permit_detail d
    group by rollup(d.week_start, d.district)
)
select
    grain_label,
    week_start,
    district,
    approved_permits,
    denied_permits,
    amplified_attendees,
    avg_fee_usd,
    matched_event_cnt,
    avg_noise_db,
    last_water_closeout
from rolled
order by
    week_start nulls last,
    district nulls last,
    grain_label

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

scoped = (
    df_permit_txn.alias("p")
    .filter(F.col("p.permit_status") != "DRAFT")
    .select(
        F.col("p.permit_id"),
        F.col("p.applicant_ref"),
        F.col("p.permit_status"),
        F.col("p.start_ts"),
        F.col("p.end_ts"),
        F.col("p.attendee_qty"),
        F.col("p.fee_usd"),
        F.col("p.site.park_id").alias("park_id"),
        F.col("p.site.zone").alias("zone_code"),
        F.col("p.site.district").alias("site_district"),
        F.col("p.amenity_tags").alias("raw_tags"),
        F.transform(F.col("p.amenity_tags"), lambda x: F.upper(x)).alias("normalized_tags"),
        F.filter(
            F.col("p.amenity_tags"),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x != "GLASS"),
        ).alias("allowed_tags"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.exists(F.col("p.amenity_tags"), lambda x: x == "AMPLIFIED_SOUND"),
            F.lit(False),
        ).alias("has_amplified_sound"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.aggregate(
                F.filter(F.col("p.amenity_tags"), lambda x: x.isNotNull()),
                F.lit(0),
                lambda acc, x: acc + F.length(x),
            ),
            F.lit(0),
        ).alias("tag_char_qty"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", F.col("p.start_ts")).alias("week_start"),
        (F.datediff(F.col("p.end_ts"), F.col("p.start_ts")) + 1).alias("permit_days"),
        F.expr("timestampdiff(HOUR, p.start_ts, p.end_ts)").alias("duration_hours"),
        (F.col("p.start_ts") - F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("review_due_ts"),
        (F.col("p.end_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY")).alias("closeout_due_ts"),
        F.when(F.col("p.permit_status") == "DENIED", F.lit("REJECTED"))
        .when(
            F.coalesce(
                F.exists(F.col("p.amenity_tags"), lambda x: x == "AMPLIFIED_SOUND"),
                F.lit(False),
            ) & (F.col("p.attendee_qty") >= 100),
            F.lit("LARGE_AMPLIFIED"),
        )
        .when(
            F.coalesce(
                F.exists(F.col("p.amenity_tags"), lambda x: x == "AMPLIFIED_SOUND"),
                F.lit(False),
            ),
            F.lit("AMPLIFIED"),
        )
        .when(
            F.expr("timestampdiff(HOUR, p.start_ts, p.end_ts)") >= 24,
            F.lit("MULTIDAY"),
        )
        .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .alias("permit_class"),
    )
)

event_rollup = (
    scoped.alias("p")
    .join(
        df_event_log.alias("e"),
        (F.col("e.park_id") == F.col("p.park_id"))
        & (F.col("e.checkin_ts") >= F.col("p.start_ts") - F.expr("INTERVAL '2' HOUR"))
        & (F.col("e.checkin_ts") < F.col("p.end_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("p.permit_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("e.event_id").alias("event_cnt"),
        F.coalesce(F.sum("e.actual_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("actual_qty"),
    )
)

obs_wide = (
    df_env_obs
    .select("park_id", "metric", "metric_value")
    .groupBy("park_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["TEMPERATURE", "NOISE_DB", "CROWD_IDX"])
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("metric_value"), 2))
    .select(
        "park_id",
        F.col("TEMPERATURE").alias("temperature"),
        F.col("NOISE_DB").alias("noise_db"),
        F.col("CROWD_IDX").alias("crowd_idx"),
    )
)

permit_detail = (
    scoped.alias("p")
    .join(event_rollup.alias("e"), F.col("e.permit_id") == F.col("p.permit_id"))
    .join(obs_wide.alias("o"), F.col("o.park_id") == F.col("p.park_id"), "left")
    .join(df_park_ref.alias("r"), F.col("r.park_id") == F.col("p.park_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "p.*",
        "e.event_cnt",
        "e.actual_qty",
        "o.temperature",
        "o.noise_db",
        "o.crowd_idx",
        "r.park_name",
        "r.capacity_qty",
        F.coalesce(F.col("r.district"), F.col("p.site_district")).alias("district"),
    )
)

rolled = (
    permit_detail.alias("d")
    .rollup("week_start", "district")
    .agg(
        F.when(F.grouping_id("week_start", "district") == 0, F.lit("WEEK_DISTRICT"))
        .when(F.grouping_id("week_start", "district") == 1, F.lit("WEEK"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("ALL"))
        .alias("grain_label"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("permit_status") == "APPROVED", F.lit(1))).alias("approved_permits"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("permit_status") == "DENIED", F.lit(1))).alias("denied_permits"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("has_amplified_sound"), F.col("attendee_qty"))).alias("amplified_attendees"),
        F.round(F.avg("fee_usd"), 2).alias("avg_fee_usd"),
        F.sum("event_cnt").alias("matched_event_cnt"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.coalesce(F.col("noise_db"), F.lit(40.0))), 2).alias("avg_noise_db"),
        F.max(
            F.when(F.array_contains(F.col("allowed_tags"), "WATER"), F.col("closeout_due_ts"))
        ).alias("last_water_closeout"),
    )
)

result = (
    rolled
    .select(
        "grain_label",
        "week_start",
        "district",
        "approved_permits",
        "denied_permits",
        "amplified_attendees",
        "avg_fee_usd",
        "matched_event_cnt",
        "avg_noise_db",
        "last_water_closeout",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("week_start").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("district").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("grain_label"),
    )
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

coverage_baseline = (
    df_stg_pipeline_runs
    .filter(F.col("run_status") == "SUCCESS")
    .agg(F.avg("code_coverage").alias("baseline_coverage"))
)

effective_finished_at = F.coalesce(
    F.col("finished_at"),
    F.col("triggered_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '2' HOUR"),
)

staged_runs = (
    df_stg_pipeline_runs
    .filter(F.col("triggered_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .crossJoin(coverage_baseline)
    .select(
        "run_id",
        "service_id",
        "commit_sha",
        "branch_name",
        "run_status",
        "triggered_at",
        effective_finished_at.alias("effective_finished_at"),
        F.expr("TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, triggered_at, COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR))").alias("duration_minutes"),
        F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("triggered_at")).alias("run_day"),
        F.datediff(F.to_date(effective_finished_at), F.to_date(F.col("triggered_at"))).alias("calendar_days_spanned"),
        F.element_at(F.col("runner_labels"), F.lit("runner_pool")).alias("runner_pool"),
        "code_coverage",
        (F.col("code_coverage") >= F.col("baseline_coverage")).alias("coverage_above_baseline"),
    )
)

run_context = (
    staged_runs.alias("r")
    .join(
        df_dim_release_windows.alias("w"),
        (F.col("r.service_id") == F.col("w.service_id"))
        & F.col("r.triggered_at").between(
            F.col("w.window_start"),
            F.col("w.window_end") + F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"),
        ),
        "left",
    )
    .select("r.*", "w.window_name", "w.risk_weight")
)

test_metrics = (
    df_stg_test_executions
    .groupBy("run_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("test_id").alias("total_tests"),
        F.countDistinct("suite_name").alias("suite_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("result_status") == "FAILED", F.lit(1))).alias("failed_tests"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("result_status") == "FLAKY", F.lit(1))).alias("flaky_tests"),
        F.sumDistinct("duration_ms").alias("distinct_runtime_ms_total"),
    )
)

w_nearby_duration = (
    Window
    .partitionBy(F.col("rc.service_id"))
    .orderBy(F.col("rc.duration_minutes"))
    .rangeBetween(-15, Window.currentRow)
)

scored_runs = (
    run_context.alias("rc")
    .join(test_metrics.alias("tm"), F.col("rc.run_id") == F.col("tm.run_id"), "left")
    .join(df_dim_service_catalog.alias("sc"), F.col("rc.service_id") == F.col("sc.service_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "rc.*",
        "tm.total_tests",
        "tm.suite_count",
        "tm.failed_tests",
        "tm.flaky_tests",
        "tm.distinct_runtime_ms_total",
        "sc.service_name",
        "sc.owning_team",
        F.round(
            F.col("rc.duration_minutes") * F.coalesce(F.col("rc.risk_weight"), F.lit(1.00).cast("decimal(4,2)")),
            2,
        ).alias("risk_adjusted_duration"),
        F.sum("rc.duration_minutes").over(w_nearby_duration).alias("nearby_duration_minutes"),
    )
)

unpivot_ids = [
    "run_id",
    "service_id",
    "service_name",
    "owning_team",
    "branch_name",
    "run_day",
    "runner_pool",
    "window_name",
    "duration_minutes",
    "calendar_days_spanned",
    "coverage_above_baseline",
    "nearby_duration_minutes",
    "risk_adjusted_duration",
]

metric_long = (
    scored_runs
    .select(*(unpivot_ids + ["total_tests", "failed_tests", "distinct_runtime_ms_total"]))
    .unpivot(
        ids=unpivot_ids,
        values=["total_tests", "failed_tests", "distinct_runtime_ms_total"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

result = (
    metric_long
    .select(
        "run_id",
        "service_id",
        "service_name",
        "owning_team",
        "branch_name",
        "run_day",
        "runner_pool",
        "window_name",
        "duration_minutes",
        "calendar_days_spanned",
        "coverage_above_baseline",
        "nearby_duration_minutes",
        "risk_adjusted_duration",
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .orderBy("run_id", "metric_name")
)

/*
  CI/CD reliability snapshot.
  Normalizes run-level test metrics and compares runs with similar durations.
  Release windows include a one-day grace period for late-running pipelines.
*/
WITH staged_runs AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        service_id,
        commit_sha,
        branch_name,
        run_status,
        triggered_at,
        COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS effective_finished_at,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            MINUTE,
            triggered_at,
            COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR)
        ) AS duration_minutes,
        date_trunc('DAY', triggered_at) AS run_day,
        DATEDIFF(
            CAST(COALESCE(finished_at, triggered_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS DATE),
            CAST(triggered_at AS DATE)
        ) AS calendar_days_spanned,
        element_at(runner_labels, 'runner_pool') AS runner_pool,
        code_coverage,
        code_coverage >= (
            SELECT AVG(code_coverage)
            FROM stg_pipeline_runs
            WHERE run_status = 'SUCCESS'
        ) AS coverage_above_baseline
    FROM stg_pipeline_runs
    WHERE triggered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
),
run_context AS (
    -- The non-equi join also catches runs just after a release window closes.
    SELECT r.*, w.window_name, w.risk_weight
    FROM staged_runs r
    LEFT JOIN dim_release_windows w
      ON r.service_id = w.service_id
     AND r.triggered_at BETWEEN w.window_start
                            AND w.window_end + INTERVAL '1' DAY
),
test_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT test_id) AS total_tests,
        COUNT(DISTINCT suite_name) AS suite_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result_status = 'FAILED') AS failed_tests,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result_status = 'FLAKY') AS flaky_tests,
        SUM(DISTINCT duration_ms) AS distinct_runtime_ms_total
    FROM stg_test_executions
    GROUP BY run_id
),
scored_runs AS (
    SELECT
        rc.*,
        tm.total_tests,
        tm.suite_count,
        tm.failed_tests,
        tm.flaky_tests,
        tm.distinct_runtime_ms_total,
        sc.service_name,
        sc.owning_team,
        ROUND(
            rc.duration_minutes * COALESCE(rc.risk_weight, CAST(1.00 AS DECIMAL(4,2))),
            2
        ) AS risk_adjusted_duration,
        SUM(rc.duration_minutes) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rc.service_id
            ORDER BY rc.duration_minutes
            RANGE BETWEEN 15 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_duration_minutes
    FROM run_context rc
    LEFT JOIN test_metrics tm ON tm.run_id = rc.run_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_service_catalog sc ON sc.service_id = rc.service_id
),
metric_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL metrics for runs without test executions.
    SELECT
        run_id,
        service_id,
        service_name,
        owning_team,
        branch_name,
        run_day,
        runner_pool,
        window_name,
        duration_minutes,
        calendar_days_spanned,
        coverage_above_baseline,
        nearby_duration_minutes,
        risk_adjusted_duration,
        metric_name,
        metric_value
    FROM scored_runs
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            total_tests,
            failed_tests,
            distinct_runtime_ms_total
        )
    )
)
SELECT
    run_id,
    service_id,
    service_name,
    owning_team,
    branch_name,
    run_day,
    runner_pool,
    window_name,
    duration_minutes,
    calendar_days_spanned,
    coverage_above_baseline,
    nearby_duration_minutes,
    risk_adjusted_duration,
    metric_name,
    metric_value
FROM metric_long
ORDER BY run_id, metric_name

/*
  March charging-session audit.
  Produces long-form operational metrics with component charges and site context.
*/
WITH parsed_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        s.session_id,
        s.station_id,
        s.driver_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.energy_kwh,
        s.session_status,
        s.charge_items,
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', s.started_at) AS usage_hour,
        s.started_at + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE AS grace_ends_at,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            MINUTE,
            s.started_at,
            COALESCE(s.ended_at, s.started_at + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE)
        ) AS billed_minutes,
        DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(s.ended_at), TO_DATE(s.started_at)) AS calendar_span_days,
        CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(s.vehicle_json, '$.battery_kwh') AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS battery_kwh,
        ELEMENT_AT(s.session_tags, 'membership') AS membership_tier,
        -- Discounts and non-positive components are excluded from this control total.
        AGGREGATE(
            FILTER(
                s.charge_items,
                item -> item.amount > CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
                    AND item.component <> 'discount'
            ),
            CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
            (acc, item) -> acc + CAST(item.amount AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS positive_item_total
    FROM charging_sessions s
    WHERE s.started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
),
component_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.session_id,
        ROUND(SUM(
            CASE WHEN item.component = 'discount' THEN -item.amount ELSE item.amount END
        ), 2) AS net_component_total,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(item.component)) AS component_names
    FROM parsed_sessions p
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(p.charge_items) AS item
    GROUP BY p.session_id
),
session_options AS (
    SELECT p.*, c.net_component_total, c.component_names
    FROM parsed_sessions p
    LEFT JOIN component_totals c ON c.session_id = p.session_id
),
selected_sessions AS (
    -- Normal billable sessions use the best available component control total.
    SELECT
        session_id, station_id, driver_id, usage_hour, grace_ends_at,
        session_status, membership_tier, battery_kwh, calendar_span_days,
        component_names,
        CAST(energy_kwh AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(billed_minutes AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS billed_minutes,
        CAST(COALESCE(net_component_total, positive_item_total, 0) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS extra_charges,
        'STANDARD' AS audit_lane
    FROM session_options
    WHERE session_status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND energy_kwh >= CAST(12 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
    UNION ALL
    -- Non-completed sessions are retained only when they consumed time or energy.
    SELECT
        session_id, station_id, driver_id, usage_hour, grace_ends_at,
        session_status, membership_tier, battery_kwh, calendar_span_days,
        component_names,
        CAST(energy_kwh AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(billed_minutes AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS billed_minutes,
        CAST(net_component_total AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS extra_charges,
        'ATTENTION' AS audit_lane
    FROM session_options
    WHERE session_status <> 'COMPLETED'
      AND (billed_minutes >= 30 OR energy_kwh > CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
),
metric_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM selected_sessions
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (energy_kwh, billed_minutes, extra_charges)
    )
)
SELECT
    m.*,
    st.site_name,
    st.city,
    COALESCE(da.driver_name, 'Unregistered driver') AS driver_label,
    CASE
        WHEN m.metric_name = 'energy_kwh' THEN ROUND(
            m.metric_value - (
                SELECT AVG(CAST(energy_kwh AS DECIMAL(12,2)))
                FROM parsed_sessions
                WHERE session_status = 'COMPLETED'
            ), 2
        )
    END AS energy_vs_completed_avg,
    CASE
        WHEN st.station_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_SITE'
        WHEN m.metric_name = 'energy_kwh' AND m.metric_value >= 30 THEN 'HIGH_ENERGY'
        WHEN m.metric_name = 'billed_minutes' AND m.metric_value >= 45 THEN 'LONG_SESSION'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS review_bucket
FROM metric_rows m
LEFT JOIN charging_stations st ON st.station_id = m.station_id
LEFT JOIN driver_accounts da
    ON da.driver_id = m.driver_id AND da.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY m.station_id, m.session_id, m.metric_name

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

parsed_sessions = (
    df_charging_sessions.alias("s")
    .filter(
        (F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("started_at") < F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        F.col("session_id"),
        F.col("station_id"),
        F.col("driver_id"),
        F.col("started_at"),
        F.col("ended_at"),
        F.col("energy_kwh"),
        F.col("session_status"),
        F.col("charge_items"),
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", F.col("started_at")).alias("usage_hour"),
        (F.col("started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '30' MINUTE")).alias("grace_ends_at"),
        F.expr("TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, started_at, COALESCE(ended_at, started_at + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE))").alias("billed_minutes"),
        F.datediff(F.to_date("ended_at"), F.to_date("started_at")).alias("calendar_span_days"),
        F.get_json_object(F.col("vehicle_json"), "$.battery_kwh").cast("decimal(10,2)").alias("battery_kwh"),
        F.element_at(F.col("session_tags"), F.lit("membership")).alias("membership_tier"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter(
                F.col("charge_items"),
                lambda item: (item.getField("amount") > F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
                & (item.getField("component") != F.lit("discount")),
            ),
            F.lit(0).cast("double"),
            lambda acc, item: acc + item.getField("amount").cast("double"),
        ).alias("positive_item_total"),
    )
)

component_totals = (
    parsed_sessions.alias("p")
    .select(F.col("session_id"), F.explode(F.col("charge_items")).alias("item"))
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(
            F.sum(
                F.when(F.col("item.component") == "discount", -F.col("item.amount"))
                .otherwise(F.col("item.amount"))
            ),
            2,
        ).alias("net_component_total"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set(F.col("item.component"))).alias("component_names"),
    )
)

session_options = (
    parsed_sessions.alias("p")
    .join(
        component_totals.alias("c"),
        F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("p.session_id"),
        "left",
    )
    .select("p.*", "c.net_component_total", "c.component_names")
)

common_columns = [
    "session_id",
    "station_id",
    "driver_id",
    "usage_hour",
    "grace_ends_at",
    "session_status",
    "membership_tier",
    "battery_kwh",
    "calendar_span_days",
    "component_names",
]
completed_sessions = (
    session_options
    .filter(
        (F.col("session_status") == "COMPLETED")
        & (F.col("energy_kwh") >= F.lit(12).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
    )
    .select(
        *common_columns,
        F.col("energy_kwh").cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("energy_kwh"),
        F.col("billed_minutes").cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("billed_minutes"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.col("net_component_total"),
            F.col("positive_item_total"),
            F.lit(0),
        ).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("extra_charges"),
        F.lit("STANDARD").alias("audit_lane"),
    )
)
attention_sessions = (
    session_options
    .filter(
        (F.col("session_status") != "COMPLETED")
        & (
            (F.col("billed_minutes") >= 30)
            | (F.col("energy_kwh") > F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
        )
    )
    .select(
        *common_columns,
        F.col("energy_kwh").cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("energy_kwh"),
        F.col("billed_minutes").cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("billed_minutes"),
        F.col("net_component_total").cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("extra_charges"),
        F.lit("ATTENTION").alias("audit_lane"),
    )
)
selected_sessions = completed_sessions.union(attention_sessions)

metric_rows = (
    selected_sessions
    .unpivot(
        common_columns + ["audit_lane"],
        ["energy_kwh", "billed_minutes", "extra_charges"],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    # SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL values by default; DataFrame.unpivot does not.
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

completed_energy_average = (
    parsed_sessions
    .filter(F.col("session_status") == "COMPLETED")
    .agg(F.avg(F.col("energy_kwh").cast("decimal(12,2)")).alias("completed_avg_energy"))
)

result = (
    metric_rows.alias("m")
    .join(
        df_charging_stations.alias("st"),
        F.col("st.station_id") == F.col("m.station_id"),
        "left",
    )
    .join(
        df_driver_accounts.alias("da"),
        (F.col("da.driver_id") == F.col("m.driver_id"))
        & (F.col("da.account_status") == "ACTIVE"),
        "left",
    )
    .crossJoin(completed_energy_average)
    .select(
        "m.*",
        "st.site_name",
        "st.city",
        F.coalesce(F.col("da.driver_name"), F.lit("Unregistered driver")).alias("driver_label"),
        F.when(
            F.col("m.metric_name") == "energy_kwh",
            F.round(F.col("m.metric_value") - F.col("completed_avg_energy"), 2),
        ).alias("energy_vs_completed_avg"),
        F.when(F.col("st.station_id").isNull(), F.lit("UNKNOWN_SITE"))
        .when(
            (F.col("m.metric_name") == "energy_kwh") & (F.col("m.metric_value") >= 30),
            F.lit("HIGH_ENERGY"),
        )
        .when(
            (F.col("m.metric_name") == "billed_minutes") & (F.col("m.metric_value") >= 45),
            F.lit("LONG_SESSION"),
        )
        .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .alias("review_bucket"),
    )
    .orderBy("station_id", "session_id", "metric_name")
)

with parsed_students as (
    -- Decode advising JSON and expose the student's notification channels.
    select student_id,
           student_name,
           program_code,
           acct_status,
           from_json(attrs_json, 'advisor string, scholarship boolean, prior_failures int') as profile,
           element_at(contact_prefs, 'email') as preferred_email,
           map_keys(contact_prefs) as contact_channels
    from student_accts
),
current_enrollments as (
    -- Keep active, unheld registrations and choose each student's latest course txn.
    select e.*,
           sec.course_code,
           sec.course_title,
           sec.dept_code,
           sec.term_code,
           ps.student_name,
           ps.profile.advisor as advisor_name,
           ps.profile.scholarship as scholarship,
           ps.preferred_email,
           ps.contact_channels,
           aggregate(
               transform(
                   filter(e.assessments, x -> x.item_type = 'lab'),
                   x -> cast(x.score as double) / cast(x.max_score as double)
               ),
               cast(0 as double),
               (acc, x) -> acc + x
           ) as lab_score_sum,
           exists(e.assessments, x -> cast(x.score as double) < cast(x.max_score as double) * 0.6) as has_low_assessment
    from enrollment_txns e
    join course_sections sec
      on sec.section_id = e.section_id
    join parsed_students ps
      on ps.student_id = e.student_id
    left join registration_holds h
      on h.student_id = e.student_id
     and h.section_id = e.section_id
     and h.is_active = true
    where h.hold_id is null
      and e.status in ('enrolled', 'completed')
      and ps.acct_status = 'active'
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by e.student_id, sec.course_code
        order by e.enrolled_at desc, e.txn_id desc
    ) = 1
),
component_scores as (
    -- Unpivot the three grade columns; SQL unpivot removes null scores.
    select txn_id,
           avg(score_value) as avg_component_score,
           count(score_value) filter (where score_value >= 70) as passing_component_qty
    from current_enrollments
    unpivot (
        score_value for score_component in (midterm_score, final_score, project_score)
    ) as u
    group by txn_id
),
assessment_stats as (
    -- Explode rubric structs and summarize the individual assessment items.
    select txn_id,
           count(*) as assessment_qty,
           round(avg(cast(item.score as double) / cast(item.max_score as double) * 100), 2) as assessment_avg_pct,
           count(*) filter (where item.item_type = 'lab') as lab_qty
    from enrollment_txns
    lateral view explode(assessments) as item
    group by txn_id
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach component and rubric metrics without losing missing assessments.
    select ce.*,
           cs.avg_component_score,
           coalesce(cs.passing_component_qty, 0) as passing_component_qty,
           ast.assessment_qty,
           coalesce(ast.assessment_avg_pct, 0.0) as assessment_avg_pct,
           coalesce(ast.lab_qty, 0) as lab_qty
    from current_enrollments ce
    left join component_scores cs on cs.txn_id = ce.txn_id
    left join assessment_stats ast on ast.txn_id = ce.txn_id
)
-- Produce section, department, and campus totals in one rollup.
select grouping_id(dept_code, section_id) as grouping_id,
       case grouping_id(dept_code, section_id)
           when 0 then 'section'
           when 1 then 'department'
           else 'campus'
       end as group_level,
       dept_code,
       section_id,
       max(course_code) as course_code,
       count(*) as enrollment_qty,
       count(*) filter (where status = 'completed') as completed_qty,
       count(*) filter (where scholarship) as scholarship_qty,
       count(*) filter (where has_low_assessment) as low_assessment_qty,
       sum(passing_component_qty) as passing_component_qty,
       round(avg(avg_component_score), 2) as avg_component_score,
       round(avg(assessment_avg_pct), 2) as avg_assessment_pct,
       round(sum(lab_score_sum), 2) as total_lab_score,
       sum(attempted_credits) as total_credits
from enriched
group by rollup (dept_code, section_id)
order by grouping_id, dept_code nulls last, section_id nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

parsed_students = (
    df_student_accts
    .select(
        "student_id",
        "student_name",
        "program_code",
        "acct_status",
        F.from_json(F.col("attrs_json"), "advisor string, scholarship boolean, prior_failures int").alias("profile"),
        F.element_at(F.col("contact_prefs"), F.lit("email")).alias("preferred_email"),
        F.map_keys(F.col("contact_prefs")).alias("contact_channels"),
    )
)

w_latest_enrollment = Window.partitionBy("e.student_id", "sec.course_code").orderBy(F.col("e.enrolled_at").desc(), F.col("e.txn_id").desc())
current_enrollments = (
    df_enrollment_txns.alias("e")
    .join(df_course_sections.alias("sec"), F.col("sec.section_id") == F.col("e.section_id"))
    .join(parsed_students.alias("ps"), F.col("ps.student_id") == F.col("e.student_id"))
    .join(
        df_registration_holds.alias("h"),
        (F.col("h.student_id") == F.col("e.student_id"))
        & (F.col("h.section_id") == F.col("e.section_id"))
        & (F.col("h.is_active") == F.lit(True)),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("h.hold_id").isNull()
        & F.col("e.status").isin("enrolled", "completed")
        & (F.col("ps.acct_status") == "active")
    )
    .select(
        "e.*",
        "sec.course_code",
        "sec.course_title",
        "sec.dept_code",
        "sec.term_code",
        "ps.student_name",
        F.col("ps.profile.advisor").alias("advisor_name"),
        F.col("ps.profile.scholarship").alias("scholarship"),
        "ps.preferred_email",
        "ps.contact_channels",
        F.expr("aggregate(transform(filter(e.assessments, x -> x.item_type = 'lab'), x -> CAST(x.score AS DOUBLE) / CAST(x.max_score AS DOUBLE)), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x)").alias("lab_score_sum"),
        F.expr("exists(e.assessments, x -> CAST(x.score AS DOUBLE) < CAST(x.max_score AS DOUBLE) * 0.6)").alias("has_low_assessment"),
        F.row_number().over(w_latest_enrollment).alias("enrollment_recency"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("enrollment_recency") == 1)
    .drop("enrollment_recency")
)

component_scores = (
    current_enrollments
    .unpivot(
        ["txn_id"],
        ["midterm_score", "final_score", "project_score"],
        "score_component",
        "score_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("score_value").isNotNull())
    .groupBy("txn_id")
    .agg(
        F.avg("score_value").alias("avg_component_score"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("score_value") >= 70, F.col("score_value"))).alias("passing_component_qty"),
    )
)

assessment_stats = (
    df_enrollment_txns
    .select("txn_id", F.explode("assessments").alias("item"))
    .groupBy("txn_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("assessment_qty"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("item.score").cast("double") / F.col("item.max_score").cast("double") * 100), 2).alias("assessment_avg_pct"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("item.item_type") == "lab", F.lit(1))).alias("lab_qty"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    current_enrollments.alias("ce")
    .join(component_scores.alias("cs"), F.col("cs.txn_id") == F.col("ce.txn_id"), "left")
    .join(assessment_stats.alias("ast"), F.col("ast.txn_id") == F.col("ce.txn_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "ce.*",
        "cs.avg_component_score",
        F.coalesce(F.col("cs.passing_component_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("passing_component_qty"),
        "ast.assessment_qty",
        F.coalesce(F.col("ast.assessment_avg_pct"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("assessment_avg_pct"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ast.lab_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("lab_qty"),
    )
)

grouping_id = F.grouping_id("dept_code", "section_id")
result = (
    enriched
    .rollup("dept_code", "section_id")
    .agg(
        grouping_id.alias("grouping_id"),
        F.max("course_code").alias("course_code"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("enrollment_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "completed", F.lit(1))).alias("completed_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("scholarship"), F.lit(1))).alias("scholarship_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("has_low_assessment"), F.lit(1))).alias("low_assessment_qty"),
        F.sum("passing_component_qty").alias("passing_component_qty"),
        F.round(F.avg("avg_component_score"), 2).alias("avg_component_score"),
        F.round(F.avg("assessment_avg_pct"), 2).alias("avg_assessment_pct"),
        F.round(F.sum("lab_score_sum"), 2).alias("total_lab_score"),
        F.sum("attempted_credits").alias("total_credits"),
    )
    .select(
        "grouping_id",
        F.when(F.col("grouping_id") == 0, F.lit("section"))
        .when(F.col("grouping_id") == 1, F.lit("department"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("campus"))
        .alias("group_level"),
        "dept_code",
        "section_id",
        "course_code",
        "enrollment_qty",
        "completed_qty",
        "scholarship_qty",
        "low_assessment_qty",
        "passing_component_qty",
        "avg_component_score",
        "avg_assessment_pct",
        "total_lab_score",
        "total_credits",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("grouping_id").asc(),
        F.col("dept_code").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("section_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
