from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

adjusted_line_amounts = F.transform(
    F.col("invoice_lines"),
    lambda x: x["net_amount"].cast("double")
    * F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("category_multipliers"), x["category"]), F.lit(1.0)),
)

stg_invoice_base = (
    df_fct_invoice_headers.alias("h")
    .filter(
        F.col("issue_date").between(F.lit("2025-01-01").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-03-31").cast("date"))
        & F.col("status").isin("OPEN", "PAID", "SENT")
    )
    .select(
        "h.*",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("remittance_json"),
            "struct<po_reference:string,payment_terms:string,early_pay_discount:double>",
        ).alias("remittance"),
        adjusted_line_amounts.alias("adjusted_line_amounts"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter(adjusted_line_amounts, lambda amount: amount >= 100.0),
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, amount: acc + amount,
        ).alias("large_line_total"),
        F.exists(
            F.col("invoice_lines"),
            lambda x: (x["category"] == "SERVICES") & (x["net_amount"] > 0),
        ).alias("has_service_lines"),
        F.element_at(F.col("category_multipliers"), F.lit("SERVICES")).alias("service_multiplier"),
        F.map_keys(F.col("category_multipliers")).alias("multiplier_categories"),
    )
)

stg_line_items = (
    stg_invoice_base.alias("inv")
    .select("invoice_id", "category_multipliers", F.explode("invoice_lines").alias("item"))
    .select(
        "invoice_id",
        F.col("item.line_id").alias("line_id"),
        F.col("item.category").alias("category"),
        F.col("item.tax_code").alias("tax_code"),
        F.col("item.net_amount").alias("net_amount"),
        (
            F.col("item.net_amount").cast("double")
            * F.coalesce(
                F.element_at(F.col("category_multipliers"), F.col("item.category")),
                F.lit(1.0),
            )
        ).alias("adjusted_net_amount"),
    )
)

line_rollup = (
    stg_line_items.groupBy("invoice_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("line_id").alias("line_count"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100.0)
            * F.sum(F.when(F.col("category") == "SERVICES", F.col("adjusted_net_amount")).otherwise(0.0))
            / F.nullif(F.sum("adjusted_net_amount"), F.lit(0.0)),
            2,
        ).alias("service_line_pct"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("tax_code") == "STANDARD", F.col("adjusted_net_amount")).otherwise(0.0)).alias("standard_tax_line_total"),
    )
)

payment_rollup = (
    df_fct_payments.filter(F.col("status") == "POSTED")
    .groupBy("invoice_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("payment_id").alias("payment_count"),
        F.avg(F.col("amount")).alias("avg_distinct_payment"),
        F.sum("amount").alias("paid_amount"),
    )
)

payment_pivot = (
    df_fct_payments.filter(F.col("status") == "POSTED")
    .select("invoice_id", "method", "amount")
    .groupBy("invoice_id")
    .pivot("method", ["ACH", "CARD", "WIRE"])
    .sum("amount")
    .select(
        "invoice_id",
        F.col("ACH").alias("ach_paid"),
        F.col("CARD").alias("card_paid"),
        F.col("WIRE").alias("wire_paid"),
    )
)

enriched_invoices = (
    stg_invoice_base.alias("inv")
    .join(
        df_dim_customers.alias("cust"),
        (F.col("cust.customer_id") == F.col("inv.customer_id")) & F.col("cust.is_active"),
        "inner",
    )
    .join(line_rollup.alias("lr"), F.col("lr.invoice_id") == F.col("inv.invoice_id"), "inner")
    .join(payment_rollup.alias("pr"), F.col("pr.invoice_id") == F.col("inv.invoice_id"), "left")
    .join(payment_pivot.alias("pp"), F.col("pp.invoice_id") == F.col("inv.invoice_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "inv.*",
        "cust.customer_name",
        "cust.segment",
        "cust.region",
        "lr.line_count",
        "lr.service_line_pct",
        "lr.standard_tax_line_total",
        "pr.payment_count",
        "pr.avg_distinct_payment",
        "pr.paid_amount",
        "pp.ach_paid",
        "pp.card_paid",
        "pp.wire_paid",
    )
)

void_invoices = df_fct_payments.filter(F.col("status") == "VOID").select("invoice_id").distinct()
filtered_invoices = enriched_invoices.alias("e").join(
    void_invoices.alias("void_pmt"),
    F.col("void_pmt.invoice_id") == F.col("e.invoice_id"),
    "left_anti",
)

w_nearby = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("invoice_total").rangeBetween(-2000, 0)
w_prior_two = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("issue_date", "invoice_id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

result = (
    filtered_invoices.alias("e")
    .select(
        "invoice_id",
        "customer_id",
        "customer_name",
        "segment",
        "issue_date",
        "due_date",
        "status",
        "invoice_total",
        F.col("remittance.po_reference").alias("po_reference"),
        F.col("remittance.payment_terms").alias("payment_terms"),
        "service_multiplier",
        "large_line_total",
        "service_line_pct",
        F.coalesce(F.col("paid_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")).alias("paid_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("payment_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("payment_count"),
        "avg_distinct_payment",
        "ach_paid",
        "card_paid",
        "wire_paid",
        F.round(
            F.col("invoice_total") - F.coalesce(F.col("paid_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")),
            2,
        ).alias("outstanding_amount"),
        F.sum("invoice_total").over(w_nearby).alias("nearby_invoice_volume"),
        F.avg("invoice_total").over(w_prior_two).alias("prior_two_invoice_avg"),
        F.when(F.coalesce(F.col("payment_count"), F.lit(0)) == 0, "NO_PAYMENTS")
        .when(
            (F.col("invoice_total") - F.coalesce(F.col("paid_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)")) > 2500)
            & (F.col("due_date") < F.lit("2025-04-01").cast("date")),
            "HIGH",
        )
        .otherwise("STANDARD")
        .alias("collection_priority"),
    )
    .orderBy("customer_id", "issue_date", "invoice_id")
)

/*
  Restaurant POS closeout: reconcile checks, posted tips and shift pools.
  One output row per rollup scope for the finance and service dashboards.
*/
WITH parsed_checks AS (
    -- Keep settled checks and parse operational payloads once.
    SELECT
        c.check_id,
        c.location_id,
        c.server_id,
        c.closed_at,
        c.subtotal,
        c.items,
        c.guest_profile.loyalty_tier AS loyalty_tier,
        ELEMENT_AT(c.payment_mix, 'GIFT_CARD') AS gift_card_amount,
        FROM_JSON(
            c.ops_json,
            'STRUCT<discount_code:STRING,kitchen_delay_min:INT>'
        ) AS ops_doc
    FROM restaurant_checks c
    WHERE c.status = 'CLOSED'
      AND c.closed_at IS NOT NULL
),
latest_tips AS (
    -- Deduplicate reposted card tips, retaining the latest posted event.
    SELECT check_id, tip_amount, captured_at
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.check_id
                ORDER BY t.captured_at DESC, t.tip_event_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM tip_events t
        WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
item_rollup AS (
    -- Flatten the check lines and retain a distinct SKU audit list.
    SELECT
        p.check_id,
        SUM(item.qty * item.unit_price) FILTER (
            WHERE NOT item.comped
        ) AS item_sales,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item.comped) AS comped_items,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(item.sku)) AS sku_list
    FROM parsed_checks p
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(p.items) exploded AS item
    GROUP BY p.check_id
),
tip_pool_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL tender amounts by default.
    SELECT location_id, service_date, channel, amount
    FROM daily_tip_pool
    UNPIVOT (
        amount FOR channel IN (cash_tips, card_tips, kiosk_tips)
    )
),
tip_pool_daily AS (
    SELECT
        location_id,
        service_date,
        SUM(amount) AS pooled_tip_total,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS pool_channels
    FROM tip_pool_long
    GROUP BY location_id, service_date
),
check_base AS (
    -- The grace period deliberately makes this an interval join.
    SELECT
        p.check_id,
        p.location_id,
        p.server_id,
        p.closed_at,
        p.subtotal AS net_sales,
        COALESCE(t.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS tip_amount,
        COALESCE(i.item_sales, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS item_sales,
        COALESCE(i.comped_items, 0) AS comped_items,
        i.sku_list,
        p.loyalty_tier,
        COALESCE(p.ops_doc.kitchen_delay_min, 0) AS kitchen_delay_min,
        COALESCE(p.gift_card_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS gift_card_amount,
        s.shift_id,
        s.target_sales,
        d.pooled_tip_total,
        d.pool_channels,
        SUM(COALESCE(t.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))) OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.location_id
            ORDER BY COALESCE(t.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
            RANGE BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_tip_total
    FROM parsed_checks p
    LEFT JOIN latest_tips t
        ON t.check_id = p.check_id
    LEFT JOIN item_rollup i
        ON i.check_id = p.check_id
    LEFT JOIN shift_windows s
        ON s.location_id = p.location_id
       AND s.server_id = p.server_id
       AND p.closed_at BETWEEN s.start_time
                           AND s.end_time + INTERVAL '2' HOUR
    LEFT JOIN tip_pool_daily d
        ON d.location_id = p.location_id
       AND d.service_date = TO_DATE(p.closed_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(b.location_id, 'ALL_LOCATIONS') AS location_scope,
    COALESCE(b.server_id, 'ALL_SERVERS') AS server_scope,
    COALESCE(b.shift_id, 'UNASSIGNED') AS shift_scope,
    GROUPING(b.location_id) AS location_grouping,
    GROUPING_ID(b.location_id, b.server_id, b.shift_id) AS scope_id,
    COUNT(*) AS check_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.tip_amount > 0) AS tipped_checks,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.kitchen_delay_min >= 15) AS delayed_checks,
    ROUND(SUM(b.net_sales), 2) AS gross_sales,
    ROUND(SUM(b.tip_amount), 2) AS posted_tips,
    ROUND(SUM(b.gift_card_amount), 2) AS gift_card_tender,
    ROUND(
        SUM(b.tip_amount) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(b.net_sales), 0),
        2
    ) AS tip_pct,
    SUM(b.comped_items) AS comped_items,
    MAX(b.pooled_tip_total) AS daily_pool_tips,
    MAX(b.nearby_tip_total) AS max_nearby_tip_total,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(b.loyalty_tier)) AS loyalty_tiers,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(sw.target_sales), 2) FROM shift_windows sw)
        AS fleet_avg_shift_target
FROM check_base b
GROUP BY ROLLUP (b.location_id, b.server_id, b.shift_id)
ORDER BY location_scope, scope_id, server_scope, shift_scope

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

parsed_checks = (
    df_restaurant_checks
    .filter((F.col("status") == "CLOSED") & F.col("closed_at").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "check_id",
        "location_id",
        "server_id",
        "closed_at",
        "subtotal",
        "items",
        F.col("guest_profile.loyalty_tier").alias("loyalty_tier"),
        F.element_at(F.col("payment_mix"), F.lit("GIFT_CARD")).alias("gift_card_amount"),
        F.from_json(
            F.col("ops_json"),
            "STRUCT<discount_code:STRING,kitchen_delay_min:INT>",
        ).alias("ops_doc"),
    )
)

w_latest_tip = Window.partitionBy("check_id").orderBy(
    F.col("captured_at").desc(),
    F.col("tip_event_id").desc(),
)
latest_tips = (
    df_tip_events
    .filter(F.col("status") == "POSTED")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w_latest_tip))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("check_id", "tip_amount", "captured_at")
)

item_rollup = (
    parsed_checks
    .select("check_id", F.explode("items").alias("item"))
    .groupBy("check_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(
            F.when(~F.col("item.comped"), F.col("item.qty") * F.col("item.unit_price"))
        ).alias("item_sales"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("item.comped"), F.lit(1))).alias("comped_items"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set(F.col("item.sku"))).alias("sku_list"),
    )
)

tip_pool_long = (
    df_daily_tip_pool
    .unpivot(
        ["location_id", "service_date"],
        ["cash_tips", "card_tips", "kiosk_tips"],
        "channel",
        "amount",
    )
    .filter(F.col("amount").isNotNull())
    .select("location_id", "service_date", "channel", "amount")
)

tip_pool_daily = (
    tip_pool_long
    .groupBy("location_id", "service_date")
    .agg(
        F.sum("amount").alias("pooled_tip_total"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("pool_channels"),
    )
)

w_nearby_tips = (
    Window.partitionBy("location_id")
    .orderBy("tip_amount")
    .rangeBetween(-5, 0)
)
check_base = (
    parsed_checks.alias("p")
    .join(latest_tips.alias("t"), F.col("t.check_id") == F.col("p.check_id"), "left")
    .join(item_rollup.alias("i"), F.col("i.check_id") == F.col("p.check_id"), "left")
    .join(
        df_shift_windows.alias("s"),
        (F.col("s.location_id") == F.col("p.location_id"))
        & (F.col("s.server_id") == F.col("p.server_id"))
        & F.col("p.closed_at").between(
            F.col("s.start_time"),
            F.col("s.end_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL '2' HOUR"),
        ),
        "left",
    )
    .join(
        tip_pool_daily.alias("d"),
        (F.col("d.location_id") == F.col("p.location_id"))
        & (F.col("d.service_date") == F.to_date(F.col("p.closed_at"))),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("p.check_id").alias("check_id"),
        F.col("p.location_id").alias("location_id"),
        F.col("p.server_id").alias("server_id"),
        F.col("p.closed_at").alias("closed_at"),
        F.col("p.subtotal").alias("net_sales"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.tip_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")).alias("tip_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("i.item_sales"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")).alias("item_sales"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("i.comped_items"), F.lit(0)).alias("comped_items"),
        F.col("i.sku_list").alias("sku_list"),
        F.col("p.loyalty_tier").alias("loyalty_tier"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.ops_doc.kitchen_delay_min"), F.lit(0)).alias("kitchen_delay_min"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.gift_card_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")).alias("gift_card_amount"),
        F.col("s.shift_id").alias("shift_id"),
        F.col("s.target_sales").alias("target_sales"),
        F.col("d.pooled_tip_total").alias("pooled_tip_total"),
        F.col("d.pool_channels").alias("pool_channels"),
    )
    .withColumn("nearby_tip_total", F.sum("tip_amount").over(w_nearby_tips))
)

fleet_avg_shift_target = (
    df_shift_windows
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("target_sales"), 2).alias("fleet_avg_shift_target"))
    .head()[0]
)
result = (
    check_base
    .rollup("location_id", "server_id", "shift_id")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("location_id").alias("location_grouping"),
        F.grouping_id("location_id", "server_id", "shift_id").alias("scope_id"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("check_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("tip_amount") > 0, F.lit(1))).alias("tipped_checks"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("kitchen_delay_min") >= 15, F.lit(1))).alias("delayed_checks"),
        F.round(F.sum("net_sales"), 2).alias("gross_sales"),
        F.round(F.sum("tip_amount"), 2).alias("posted_tips"),
        F.round(F.sum("gift_card_amount"), 2).alias("gift_card_tender"),
        F.round(F.sum("tip_amount") * 100 / F.when(F.sum("net_sales") != 0, F.sum("net_sales")), 2).alias("tip_pct"),
        F.sum("comped_items").alias("comped_items"),
        F.max("pooled_tip_total").alias("daily_pool_tips"),
        F.max("nearby_tip_total").alias("max_nearby_tip_total"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("loyalty_tier")).alias("loyalty_tiers"),
    )
    .withColumn("fleet_avg_shift_target", F.lit(fleet_avg_shift_target))
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("location_id"), F.lit("ALL_LOCATIONS")).alias("location_scope"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("server_id"), F.lit("ALL_SERVERS")).alias("server_scope"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("shift_id"), F.lit("UNASSIGNED")).alias("shift_scope"),
        "location_grouping",
        "scope_id",
        "check_count",
        "tipped_checks",
        "delayed_checks",
        "gross_sales",
        "posted_tips",
        "gift_card_tender",
        "tip_pct",
        "comped_items",
        "daily_pool_tips",
        "max_nearby_tip_total",
        "loyalty_tiers",
        "fleet_avg_shift_target",
    )
    .orderBy("location_scope", "scope_id", "server_scope", "shift_scope")
)

case.sql:
with stg_reservations as (
    -- parse guest extras and normalize the operational reservation feed
    select
        reservation_id,
        property_code,
        guest_id,
        upper(regexp_replace(confirmation_code, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '')) as confirmation_key,
        booked_at,
        checked_in_at,
        checkin_date,
        checkout_date,
        stay_status,
        lower(booking_channel) as booking_channel,
        guest_profile,
        from_json(
            extras_json,
            'struct<corporate_code:string,package_code:string,comp_nights:int>'
        ) as extras,
        night_breakdown,
        room_revenue,
        tax_revenue,
        fee_revenue,
        date_trunc('day', booked_at) as booked_day,
        booked_at + interval '36' hour as rate_lock_expires_at,
        datediff(checkout_date, checkin_date) as booked_nights,
        timestampdiff(hour, booked_at, checked_in_at) as hours_booked_to_checkin
    from fct_reservation_stays
    where booked_at >= timestamp '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
      and checkout_date > checkin_date
      and stay_status in ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_OUT', 'PENDING')
),
stg_eligible as (
    -- remove audit-held reservations using an anti-join written with a left join
    select a.*
    from stg_reservations a
    left join fct_reservation_exclusions e
      on e.reservation_id = a.reservation_id
     and e.effective_date <= a.checkin_date
    where e.reservation_id is null
),
stg_enriched as (
    -- attach property attributes and classify the booking source
    select
        a.*,
        p.property_name,
        p.market_code,
        a.guest_profile.home_country as home_country,
        a.extras.package_code as package_code,
        regexp_extract(a.confirmation_key, '([0-9]+)$', 1) as confirmation_sequence,
        coalesce(a.extras.corporate_code, 'RETAIL') as corporate_code,
        case
            when a.booking_channel rlike '^(web|mobile)$' then 'DIRECT_DIGITAL'
            when a.extras.corporate_code is not null then 'CORPORATE_OFFLINE'
            else 'OTHER'
        end as channel_category
    from stg_eligible a
    join dim_property p
      on p.property_code = a.property_code
     and p.open_date <= a.checkin_date
    where a.booked_nights between 1 and 14
      and (
          a.guest_profile.home_country is not null
          or a.stay_status = 'CHECKED_OUT'
      )
),
stg_night_lines as (
    -- explode the nightly array and retain only revenue-bearing in-stay nights
    select
        e.reservation_id,
        e.property_code,
        e.market_code,
        e.confirmation_key,
        night.stay_date,
        night.rate_plan,
        night.nightly_revenue,
        date_trunc('month', night.stay_date) as stay_month,
        datediff(night.stay_date, e.booked_at) as advance_days,
        row_number() over (
            partition by e.reservation_id
            order by night.stay_date, night.rate_plan, night.nightly_revenue
        ) as night_sequence
    from stg_enriched e
    lateral view explode(e.night_breakdown) nightly as night
    where night.stay_date >= e.checkin_date
      and night.stay_date < e.checkout_date
      and night.nightly_revenue > cast(0 as decimal(10,2))
),
stg_revenue_pivot as (
    -- unpivot folio revenue components, aggregate them, then pivot by market
    select *
    from (
        select
            market_code,
            metric,
            count(distinct reservation_id) as reservation_count,
            avg(metric_value) as average_metric_value
        from stg_enriched
        unpivot (
            metric_value for metric in (
                room_revenue as ROOM,
                tax_revenue as TAX,
                fee_revenue as FEE
            )
        ) as revenue_items
        group by market_code, metric
    ) metric_totals
    pivot (
        first(reservation_count) as reservation_count,
        first(average_metric_value) as average_metric_value
        for metric in ('ROOM' as room, 'TAX' as tax, 'FEE' as fee)
    )
)
select
    n.market_code,
    n.reservation_count,
    n.exploded_nights,
    n.nightly_revenue_total,
    n.distinct_nightly_revenue_total,
    n.earliest_stay_month,
    rp.room_reservation_count,
    rp.room_average_metric_value,
    rp.tax_reservation_count,
    rp.tax_average_metric_value,
    rp.fee_reservation_count,
    rp.fee_average_metric_value
from (
    select
        market_code,
        count(distinct reservation_id) as reservation_count,
        count(*) as exploded_nights,
        sum(nightly_revenue) as nightly_revenue_total,
        sum(distinct nightly_revenue) as distinct_nightly_revenue_total,
        min(stay_month) as earliest_stay_month
    from stg_night_lines
    group by market_code
) n
join stg_revenue_pivot rp
  on rp.market_code = n.market_code
order by n.market_code
case.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

stg_reservations = (
    df_fct_reservation_stays
    .filter(
        (F.col("booked_at") >= F.lit("2024-01-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("checkout_date") > F.col("checkin_date"))
        & F.col("stay_status").isin("CONFIRMED", "CHECKED_OUT", "PENDING")
    )
    .select(
        "reservation_id",
        "property_code",
        "guest_id",
        F.upper(F.regexp_replace(F.col("confirmation_code"), "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "")).alias("confirmation_key"),
        "booked_at",
        "checked_in_at",
        "checkin_date",
        "checkout_date",
        "stay_status",
        F.lower("booking_channel").alias("booking_channel"),
        "guest_profile",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("extras_json"),
            "struct<corporate_code:string,package_code:string,comp_nights:int>",
        ).alias("extras"),
        "night_breakdown",
        "room_revenue",
        "tax_revenue",
        "fee_revenue",
        F.date_trunc("day", F.col("booked_at")).alias("booked_day"),
        (F.col("booked_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("rate_lock_expires_at"),
        F.datediff(F.col("checkout_date"), F.col("checkin_date")).alias("booked_nights"),
        F.expr("timestampdiff(HOUR, booked_at, checked_in_at)").alias("hours_booked_to_checkin"),
    )
)

stg_eligible = (
    stg_reservations.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_fct_reservation_exclusions.alias("e"),
        (F.col("e.reservation_id") == F.col("a.reservation_id"))
        & (F.col("e.effective_date") <= F.col("a.checkin_date")),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("e.reservation_id").isNull())
    .select("a.*")
)

stg_enriched = (
    stg_eligible.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_dim_property.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.property_code") == F.col("a.property_code"))
        & (F.col("p.open_date") <= F.col("a.checkin_date")),
        "inner",
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("a.booked_nights").between(1, 14)
        & (
            F.col("a.guest_profile.home_country").isNotNull()
            | (F.col("a.stay_status") == "CHECKED_OUT")
        )
    )
    .select(
        "a.*",
        "p.property_name",
        "p.market_code",
        F.col("a.guest_profile.home_country").alias("home_country"),
        F.col("a.extras.package_code").alias("package_code"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("a.confirmation_key"), "([0-9]+)$", 1).alias("confirmation_sequence"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.extras.corporate_code"), F.lit("RETAIL")).alias("corporate_code"),
        F.when(F.col("a.booking_channel").rlike("^(web|mobile)$"), "DIRECT_DIGITAL")
        .when(F.col("a.extras.corporate_code").isNotNull(), "CORPORATE_OFFLINE")
        .otherwise("OTHER")
        .alias("channel_category"),
    )
)

w_night = Window.partitionBy("e.reservation_id").orderBy(
    "night.stay_date", "night.rate_plan", "night.nightly_revenue"
)
stg_night_lines = (
    stg_enriched.alias("e")
    .select("e.*", F.explode("e.night_breakdown").alias("night"))
    .filter(
        (F.col("night.stay_date") >= F.col("e.checkin_date"))
        & (F.col("night.stay_date") < F.col("e.checkout_date"))
        & (F.col("night.nightly_revenue") > F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
    )
    .select(
        "e.reservation_id",
        "e.property_code",
        "e.market_code",
        "e.confirmation_key",
        F.col("night.stay_date").alias("stay_date"),
        F.col("night.rate_plan").alias("rate_plan"),
        F.col("night.nightly_revenue").alias("nightly_revenue"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("night.stay_date")).alias("stay_month"),
        F.datediff(F.col("night.stay_date"), F.col("e.booked_at")).alias("advance_days"),
        F.row_number().over(w_night).alias("night_sequence"),
    )
)

revenue_items = (
    stg_enriched
    .unpivot(
        ["reservation_id", "market_code"],
        ["room_revenue", "tax_revenue", "fee_revenue"],
        "metric",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
    .withColumn(
        "metric",
        F.when(F.col("metric") == "room_revenue", "ROOM")
        .when(F.col("metric") == "tax_revenue", "TAX")
        .when(F.col("metric") == "fee_revenue", "FEE"),
    )
)
metric_totals = revenue_items.groupBy("market_code", "metric").agg(
    F.countDistinct("reservation_id").alias("reservation_count"),
    F.avg("metric_value").alias("average_metric_value"),
)
stg_revenue_pivot = (
    metric_totals
    .groupBy("market_code")
    .pivot("metric", ["ROOM", "TAX", "FEE"])
    .agg(
        F.first("reservation_count").alias("reservation_count"),
        F.first("average_metric_value").alias("average_metric_value"),
    )
)

night_summary = stg_night_lines.groupBy("market_code").agg(
    F.countDistinct("reservation_id").alias("reservation_count"),
    F.count("*").alias("exploded_nights"),
    F.sum("nightly_revenue").alias("nightly_revenue_total"),
    F.sumDistinct("nightly_revenue").alias("distinct_nightly_revenue_total"),
    F.min("stay_month").alias("earliest_stay_month"),
)

result = (
    night_summary.alias("n")
    .join(stg_revenue_pivot.alias("rp"), F.col("rp.market_code") == F.col("n.market_code"), "inner")
    .select(
        "n.market_code",
        "n.reservation_count",
        "n.exploded_nights",
        "n.nightly_revenue_total",
        "n.distinct_nightly_revenue_total",
        "n.earliest_stay_month",
        "rp.room_reservation_count",
        "rp.room_average_metric_value",
        "rp.tax_reservation_count",
        "rp.tax_average_metric_value",
        "rp.fee_reservation_count",
        "rp.fee_average_metric_value",
    )
    .orderBy("n.market_code")
)

/*
  Daily card-account risk snapshot.
  Keep the newest version of each authorization, remove transactions with
  unresolved/won disputes, then summarize spend and channel mix by account.
*/
WITH ranked_txn AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        txn_id,
        acct_id,
        card_id,
        merchant_id,
        txn_ts,
        amount,
        currency,
        channel,
        status,
        location,
        from_json(
            raw_payload,
            'trace_id STRING, installments INT, tip_amount DECIMAL(10,2)'
        ) AS auth_payload,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY txn_id
            ORDER BY version_ts DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM card_txn_versions
),
latest_txn AS (
    -- Version one is the current authorization state.
    SELECT
        txn_id, acct_id, card_id, merchant_id, txn_ts, amount,
        currency, channel, status, location, auth_payload
    FROM ranked_txn
    WHERE rn = 1
),
enriched_txn AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        a.customer_segment,
        a.home_country,
        a.risk_limit,
        m.merchant_name,
        m.category,
        m.risk_tier,
        t.location.country AS txn_country,
        coalesce(nullif(t.auth_payload.trace_id, ''), 'NO_TRACE') AS trace_id,
        coalesce(t.auth_payload.tip_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS tip_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN t.status = 'DECLINED' THEN 'DECLINED'
            WHEN t.status = 'REVERSED' THEN 'REVERSED'
            WHEN t.location.country IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_GEO'
            WHEN t.location.country <> a.home_country THEN 'CROSS_BORDER'
            WHEN t.amount > a.risk_limit THEN 'HIGH_VALUE'
            ELSE 'STANDARD'
        END AS txn_label,
        (
            SELECT round(avg(a2.risk_limit), 2)
            FROM acct_profile a2
            WHERE a2.status = 'ACTIVE'
        ) AS active_avg_limit
    FROM latest_txn t
    JOIN acct_profile a
      ON a.acct_id = t.acct_id
     AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
    LEFT JOIN merchant_profile m
      ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
),
eligible_txn AS (
    -- Anti-join: closed and rejected disputes do not suppress a transaction.
    SELECT e.*
    FROM enriched_txn e
    LEFT JOIN dispute_cases d
      ON d.txn_id = e.txn_id
     AND d.case_status IN ('OPEN', 'WON')
    WHERE d.txn_id IS NULL
),
acct_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        max(customer_segment) AS customer_segment,
        max(active_avg_limit) AS active_avg_limit,
        count(DISTINCT txn_id) AS txn_cnt,
        count(DISTINCT merchant_id) AS merchant_cnt,
        round(sum(amount), 2) AS gross_amount,
        round(sum(DISTINCT amount), 2) AS distinct_amount_total,
        round(sum(
            CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN amount
                 ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END
        ), 2) AS approved_amount,
        round(
            100 * sum(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN amount
                           ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END)
            / nullif(sum(amount), 0),
            2
        ) AS approval_rate_pct,
        array_sort(collect_set(coalesce(category, 'UNMAPPED'))) AS merchant_categories,
        size(collect_set(coalesce(txn_country, 'UNKNOWN'))) AS country_cnt
    FROM eligible_txn
    GROUP BY acct_id
),
channel_pivot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT acct_id, channel, amount
        FROM eligible_txn
    )
    PIVOT (
        round(sum(amount), 2)
        FOR channel IN (
            'ECOM' AS ecom_amount,
            'POS' AS pos_amount,
            'ATM' AS atm_amount
        )
    )
)
SELECT
    r.acct_id,
    r.customer_segment,
    r.txn_cnt,
    r.merchant_cnt,
    r.gross_amount,
    r.distinct_amount_total,
    r.approved_amount,
    r.approval_rate_pct,
    r.merchant_categories,
    r.country_cnt,
    p.ecom_amount,
    p.pos_amount,
    p.atm_amount,
    r.active_avg_limit
FROM acct_rollup r
LEFT JOIN channel_pivot p
  ON p.acct_id = r.acct_id
ORDER BY
    approval_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST,
    gross_amount DESC,
    r.acct_id ASC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_txn_latest = Window.partitionBy("txn_id").orderBy(
    F.col("version_ts").desc(),
    F.col("event_id").desc(),
)

ranked_txn = (
    df_card_txn_versions
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "txn_id",
        "acct_id",
        "card_id",
        "merchant_id",
        "txn_ts",
        "amount",
        "currency",
        "channel",
        "status",
        "location",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("raw_payload"),
            "trace_id STRING, installments INT, tip_amount DECIMAL(10,2)",
        ).alias("auth_payload"),
        F.row_number().over(w_txn_latest).alias("rn"),
    )
)

latest_txn = (
    ranked_txn
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "txn_id",
        "acct_id",
        "card_id",
        "merchant_id",
        "txn_ts",
        "amount",
        "currency",
        "channel",
        "status",
        "location",
        "auth_payload",
    )
)

active_avg_limit = (
    df_acct_profile
    .filter(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE")
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("risk_limit"), 2).alias("active_avg_limit"))
)

enriched_txn = (
    latest_txn.alias("t")
    .join(
        df_acct_profile.alias("a"),
        (F.col("a.acct_id") == F.col("t.acct_id")) & (F.col("a.status") == "ACTIVE"),
    )
    .join(
        df_merchant_profile.alias("m"),
        F.col("m.merchant_id") == F.col("t.merchant_id"),
        "left",
    )
    .crossJoin(active_avg_limit)
    .select(
        "t.*",
        F.col("a.customer_segment").alias("customer_segment"),
        F.col("a.home_country").alias("home_country"),
        F.col("a.risk_limit").alias("risk_limit"),
        F.col("m.merchant_name").alias("merchant_name"),
        F.col("m.category").alias("category"),
        F.col("m.risk_tier").alias("risk_tier"),
        F.col("t.location.country").alias("txn_country"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.when(F.col("t.auth_payload.trace_id") != "", F.col("t.auth_payload.trace_id")),
            F.lit("NO_TRACE"),
        ).alias("trace_id"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.col("t.auth_payload.tip_amount"),
            F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"),
        ).alias("tip_amount"),
        F.when(F.col("t.status") == "DECLINED", F.lit("DECLINED"))
        .when(F.col("t.status") == "REVERSED", F.lit("REVERSED"))
        .when(F.col("t.location.country").isNull(), F.lit("UNKNOWN_GEO"))
        .when(F.col("t.location.country") != F.col("a.home_country"), F.lit("CROSS_BORDER"))
        .when(F.col("t.amount") > F.col("a.risk_limit"), F.lit("HIGH_VALUE"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .alias("txn_label"),
        F.col("active_avg_limit"),
    )
)

eligible_txn = (
    enriched_txn.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_dispute_cases.alias("d"),
        (F.col("d.txn_id") == F.col("e.txn_id"))
        & F.col("d.case_status").isin("OPEN", "WON"),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("d.txn_id").isNull())
    .select("e.*")
)

gross_amount = F.sum("amount")
approved_amount = F.sum(
    F.when(F.col("status") == "APPROVED", F.col("amount"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
)

acct_rollup = (
    eligible_txn
    .groupBy("acct_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("customer_segment").alias("customer_segment"),
        F.max("active_avg_limit").alias("active_avg_limit"),
        F.countDistinct("txn_id").alias("txn_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("merchant_id").alias("merchant_cnt"),
        F.round(gross_amount, 2).alias("gross_amount"),
        F.round(F.sum_distinct("amount"), 2).alias("distinct_amount_total"),
        F.round(approved_amount, 2).alias("approved_amount"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100) * approved_amount
            / F.when(gross_amount != F.lit(0), gross_amount),
            2,
        ).alias("approval_rate_pct"),
        F.array_sort(
            F.collect_set(F.coalesce(F.col("category"), F.lit("UNMAPPED")))
        ).alias("merchant_categories"),
        F.size(
            F.collect_set(F.coalesce(F.col("txn_country"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
        ).alias("country_cnt"),
    )
)

channel_pivot = (
    eligible_txn
    .select("acct_id", "channel", "amount")
    .groupBy("acct_id")
    .pivot("channel", ["ECOM", "POS", "ATM"])
    .agg(F.round(F.sum("amount"), 2))
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        F.col("ECOM").alias("ecom_amount"),
        F.col("POS").alias("pos_amount"),
        F.col("ATM").alias("atm_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    acct_rollup.alias("r")
    .join(channel_pivot.alias("p"), F.col("p.acct_id") == F.col("r.acct_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("r.acct_id").alias("acct_id"),
        "r.customer_segment",
        "r.txn_cnt",
        "r.merchant_cnt",
        "r.gross_amount",
        "r.distinct_amount_total",
        "r.approved_amount",
        "r.approval_rate_pct",
        "r.merchant_categories",
        "r.country_cnt",
        "p.ecom_amount",
        "p.pos_amount",
        "p.atm_amount",
        "r.active_avg_limit",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("approval_rate_pct").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("gross_amount").desc(),
        F.col("r.acct_id").asc(),
    )
)

        r.review_id,
        li.seller_id,
        r.reviewer_id,
        r.review_ts,
        DATE_TRUNC('day', r.review_ts) AS review_day,
        r.rating,
        r.status,
        COALESCE(r.helpful_votes, 0) AS helpful_votes,
        DATEDIFF(DATE_TRUNC('day', r.review_ts), s.seller_since) AS seller_age_days,
        r.review_ts + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS response_due_ts
    FROM review_events r
    JOIN product_listings li
        ON li.listing_id = r.listing_id
    JOIN seller_accounts s
        ON s.seller_id = li.seller_id
        AND s.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE r.review_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
        AND r.review_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06 00:00:00'
        AND r.status <> 'REMOVED'
),
scoped_reviews AS (
    -- Map reviews into service windows extended by a seven-day grace period.
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.window_id AS service_window_id,
        COALESCE(b.service_level, 'UNMAPPED') AS service_level
    FROM prepared_reviews a
    LEFT JOIN seller_service_windows b
        ON b.seller_id = a.seller_id
        AND a.review_ts BETWEEN b.window_start
            AND b.window_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
),
lagged_reviews AS (
    -- Find each reviewer's previous retained review in strict time order.
    SELECT
        sc.*,
        LAG(sc.review_ts) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.reviewer_id
            ORDER BY sc.review_ts, sc.review_id
        ) AS previous_review_ts
    FROM scoped_reviews sc
),
session_flags AS (
    -- Start a new session after the first review or a gap over ninety minutes.
    SELECT
        lr.*,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, lr.previous_review_ts, lr.review_ts) AS minutes_since_previous,
        CASE
            WHEN lr.previous_review_ts IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, lr.previous_review_ts, lr.review_ts) > 90 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM lagged_reviews lr
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Turn gap flags into reviewer-local session sequence numbers.
    SELECT
        sf.*,
        SUM(sf.new_session_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY sf.reviewer_id
            ORDER BY sf.review_ts, sf.review_id

        review_day,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_review_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE service_window_id IS NOT NULL) AS window_mapped_review_count,
        AVG(rating) AS avg_rating,
        AVG(DISTINCT rating) AS avg_distinct_rating,
        SUM(DISTINCT helpful_votes) AS distinct_helpful_votes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT reviewer_id) AS distinct_reviewers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(reviewer_id, '-', session_seq)) AS distinct_sessions,
        MAX(seller_age_days) AS seller_age_days,
        MIN(response_due_ts) AS first_response_due_ts

    d.review_day,
    d.review_count,
    d.published_review_count,
    d.window_mapped_review_count,
    ROUND(d.avg_rating, 2) AS avg_rating,
    ROUND(d.avg_distinct_rating, 2) AS avg_distinct_rating,
    d.distinct_helpful_votes,
    d.distinct_reviewers,
    d.distinct_sessions,
    ROUND(
        AVG(d.published_review_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.seller_id
            ORDER BY d.review_day
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ),
        2
    ) AS prior_two_day_published_avg,
    d.seller_age_days,
    d.first_response_due_ts
FROM daily_metrics d
JOIN seller_accounts s
    ON s.seller_id = d.seller_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY d.seller_id
    ORDER BY d.review_day DESC
) <= 2

WITH stg_shipment_base AS (
    -- Parse route metadata once and provide safe defaults for malformed JSON.
    SELECT
        shipment_id,
        customer_id,
        carrier_code,
        shipment_ts,
        destination_region,
        status,
        declared_value,
        temp_excursion_minutes,
        damaged_bottles,
        returned_bottles,
        items,
        COALESCE(parsed_route.depot_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS depot_code,
        COALESCE(parsed_route.distance_km, 0.0D) AS distance_km,
        COALESCE(parsed_route.signature_required, FALSE) AS signature_required
    FROM (
        SELECT
            shp.*,
            FROM_JSON(
                route_notes,
                'STRUCT<depot_code: STRING, distance_km: DOUBLE, signature_required: BOOLEAN>'
            ) AS parsed_route
        FROM stg_wine_shipments shp
    ) parsed
),
stg_item_rollup AS (
    -- Explode bottle lines and audit both physical and distinct line quantities.
    SELECT
        shp.shipment_id,
        SUM(item.bottles) AS shipped_bottles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT item.sku) AS distinct_skus,
        SUM(DISTINCT item.bottles) AS distinct_bottle_quantity_sum,
        SUM(item.bottles * item.unit_price) AS merchandise_value,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(item.sku)) AS sku_list
    FROM stg_shipment_base shp
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(shp.items) AS item
    GROUP BY shp.shipment_id
),
stg_quality_long AS (
    -- Convert quality measures to rows; SQL UNPIVOT excludes NULL measurements.
    SELECT shipment_id, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM stg_shipment_base
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            temp_excursion_minutes,
            damaged_bottles,
            returned_bottles
        )
    )
),
stg_quality_rollup AS (
    -- Summarize exceptions while retaining separate temperature and bottle KPIs.
    SELECT
        shipment_id,
        COUNT(*) AS observed_metric_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE metric_name = 'temp_excursion_minutes' AND metric_value >= 20
        ) AS heat_excursion_flags,
        SUM(metric_value) FILTER (
            WHERE metric_name <> 'temp_excursion_minutes'
        ) AS bottle_issue_total,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(
            CASE WHEN metric_value > 0 THEN metric_name END
        )) AS metrics_with_issues
    FROM stg_quality_long
    GROUP BY shipment_id
),
stg_window_matched AS (
    -- Match shipments to carrier lane windows with a 36-hour grace interval.
    SELECT shp.*, win.window_id
    FROM stg_shipment_base shp
    LEFT JOIN dim_carrier_windows win
        ON shp.carrier_code = win.carrier_code
       AND shp.destination_region = win.lane_code
       AND shp.shipment_ts BETWEEN win.window_open
                              AND win.window_close + INTERVAL '36' HOUR
),
fct_shipment_summary AS (
    -- Build the shipment fact and remove cancellations from operational reporting.
    SELECT
        shp.shipment_id,
        shp.customer_id,
        shp.shipment_ts,
        cust.account_name,
        cust.service_tier,
        shp.destination_region,
        shp.carrier_code,
        shp.status,
        CASE
            WHEN shp.status = 'DELIVERED' AND shp.window_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ON_SCHEDULE'
            WHEN shp.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 'UNSCHEDULED_DELIVERY'
            WHEN shp.status = 'DELAYED' THEN 'EXCEPTION'
            ELSE 'OPEN'
        END AS delivery_disposition,
        COALESCE(shp.window_id, 'UNSCHEDULED') AS window_id,
        shp.depot_code,
        shp.distance_km,
        shp.signature_required,
        itm.shipped_bottles,
        itm.distinct_skus,
        itm.merchandise_value,
        itm.distinct_bottle_quantity_sum,
        itm.sku_list,
        COALESCE(qlt.observed_metric_count, 0) AS observed_metric_count,
        COALESCE(qlt.heat_excursion_flags, 0) AS heat_excursion_flags,
        COALESCE(qlt.bottle_issue_total, 0) AS bottle_issue_total,
        COALESCE(qlt.metrics_with_issues, ARRAY()) AS metrics_with_issues,
        ROUND(shp.declared_value - itm.merchandise_value, 2) AS valuation_variance
    FROM stg_window_matched shp
    JOIN stg_item_rollup itm ON itm.shipment_id = shp.shipment_id
    LEFT JOIN stg_quality_rollup qlt ON qlt.shipment_id = shp.shipment_id
    JOIN dim_customer_accounts cust ON cust.customer_id = shp.customer_id
    WHERE shp.status <> 'CANCELLED'
)
SELECT
    shipment_id,
    shipment_ts,
    account_name,
    service_tier,
    destination_region,
    carrier_code,
    status,
    delivery_disposition,
    window_id,
    depot_code,
    distance_km,
    signature_required,
    shipped_bottles,
    distinct_skus,
    merchandise_value,
    distinct_bottle_quantity_sum,
    observed_metric_count,
    heat_excursion_flags,
    bottle_issue_total,
    metrics_with_issues,
    sku_list,
    valuation_variance,
    ROUND(AVG(merchandise_value) OVER (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY shipment_ts, shipment_id
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 2) AS prior_two_shipments_avg_value,
    SUM(shipped_bottles) OVER (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY shipment_ts, shipment_id
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ) AS prior_two_shipments_bottles

case.sql:
with active_stations as (
    select s.station_id, s.station_name, s.region,
           s.site.country as site_country,
           s.site.elevation_m as elevation_m,
           s.site.climate_zone as climate_zone
    from station_registry s
    left join station_review_holds h
      on h.station_id = s.station_id
     and h.resolved_at is null
    where s.is_active
      and s.site.country in ('US', 'CA', 'UK')
      and h.station_id is null
),
readings_enriched as (
    select r.reading_id, r.station_id, r.observed_at,
           r.temp_c, r.feels_like_c, r.wind_kph, r.precip_mm,
           s.station_name, s.region, s.site_country, s.climate_zone,
           transform(coalesce(r.quality_flags, array()),
                     flag -> upper(flag)) as normalized_flags
    from weather_readings r
    join active_stations s on s.station_id = r.station_id
),
reading_gaps as (
    select *,
           filter(normalized_flags, flag -> flag <> 'OK') as issue_flags,
           exists(normalized_flags,
                  flag -> flag in ('OUTLIER', 'OFFLINE')) as has_blocking_flag,
           aggregate(normalized_flags, 0,
                     (acc, flag) -> acc + case when flag = 'ESTIMATED' then 1 else 2 end
           ) as quality_penalty,
           lag(observed_at) over (
               partition by station_id
               order by observed_at, reading_id
           ) as prev_observed_at
    from readings_enriched
),
sessionized as (
    -- a three-hour silence starts a new observation session
    select *,
           sum(case when prev_observed_at is null
                      or observed_at > prev_observed_at + interval '3' hour
                    then 1 else 0 end) over (
               partition by station_id
               order by observed_at, reading_id
               rows between unbounded preceding and current row
           ) as session_seq,
           avg(temp_c) over (
               partition by station_id
               order by observed_at, reading_id
               rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
           ) as recent_temp_avg,
           case when size(issue_flags) = 0 then 'nominal'
                else array_join(array_sort(issue_flags), ',') end as flag_label
    from reading_gaps
),
metric_long as (
    -- sql unpivot removes null measurements, as intended for the median
    select *
    from (
        select sessionized.*,
               concat(station_id, '-', lpad(session_seq, 2, '0')) as session_id
        from sessionized
        where not has_blocking_flag
    )
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric_name in
            (temp_c, feels_like_c, wind_kph, precip_mm)
    )
),
latest_forecast as (
    select station_id, model_code, predicted_temp_c, confidence
    from (
        select f.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by station_id
                   order by issued_at desc, forecast_id desc
               ) as forecast_seq
        from forecast_guidance f
    )
    where forecast_seq = 1
)
select m.station_id, m.station_name, m.region, m.site_country,
       m.session_id, m.metric_name,
       count(*) as reading_metric_rows,
       count(distinct m.reading_id) as reading_count,
       round(avg(distinct m.metric_value), 2) as avg_distinct_value,
       percentile_approx(m.metric_value, 0.5) as median_value,
       array_sort(collect_set(m.flag_label)) as quality_labels,
       max(m.quality_penalty) as max_quality_penalty,
       round(max(m.recent_temp_avg), 2) as prior_temp_avg,
       f.model_code, f.predicted_temp_c, f.confidence
from metric_long m
left join latest_forecast f on f.station_id = m.station_id
group by m.station_id, m.station_name, m.region, m.site_country,
         m.session_id, m.metric_name,
         f.model_code, f.predicted_temp_c, f.confidence
order by m.station_id, m.session_id, m.metric_name

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

active_stations = (
    df_station_registry.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_station_review_holds.alias("h"),
        (F.col("h.station_id") == F.col("s.station_id")) & F.col("h.resolved_at").isNull(),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(
        F.col("s.is_active")
        & F.col("s.site.country").isin("US", "CA", "UK")
        & F.col("h.station_id").isNull()
    )
    .select(
        F.col("s.station_id").alias("station_id"),
        "s.station_name",
        "s.region",
        F.col("s.site.country").alias("site_country"),
        F.col("s.site.elevation_m").alias("elevation_m"),
        F.col("s.site.climate_zone").alias("climate_zone"),
    )
)

readings_enriched = (
    df_weather_readings.alias("r")
    .join(active_stations.alias("s"), F.col("s.station_id") == F.col("r.station_id"))
    .select(
        "r.reading_id",
        "r.station_id",
        "r.observed_at",
        "r.temp_c",
        "r.feels_like_c",
        "r.wind_kph",
        "r.precip_mm",
        "s.station_name",
        "s.region",
        "s.site_country",
        "s.climate_zone",
        F.transform(
            F.coalesce(F.col("r.quality_flags"), F.array()),
            lambda flag: F.upper(flag),
        ).alias("normalized_flags"),
    )
)

w_reading = Window.partitionBy("station_id").orderBy("observed_at", "reading_id")
reading_gaps = (
    readings_enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.filter(F.col("normalized_flags"), lambda flag: flag != F.lit("OK")).alias("issue_flags"),
        F.exists(
            F.col("normalized_flags"),
            lambda flag: flag.isin("OUTLIER", "OFFLINE"),
        ).alias("has_blocking_flag"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("normalized_flags"),
            F.lit(0),
            lambda acc, flag: acc + F.when(flag == "ESTIMATED", 1).otherwise(2),
        ).alias("quality_penalty"),
        F.lag("observed_at").over(w_reading).alias("prev_observed_at"),
    )
)

w_session = w_reading.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = w_reading.rowsBetween(-2, -1)
sessionized = (
    reading_gaps
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum(
            F.when(
                F.col("prev_observed_at").isNull()
                | (F.col("observed_at") > F.col("prev_observed_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '3' HOUR")),
                1,
            ).otherwise(0)
        ).over(w_session).alias("session_seq"),
        F.avg("temp_c").over(w_recent).alias("recent_temp_avg"),
        F.when(F.size("issue_flags") == 0, F.lit("nominal"))
        .otherwise(F.array_join(F.array_sort("issue_flags"), ","))
        .alias("flag_label"),
    )
)

metric_base = (
    sessionized
    .filter(~F.col("has_blocking_flag"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat(
            F.col("station_id"),
            F.lit("-"),
            F.lpad(F.col("session_seq"), 2, "0"),
        ).alias("session_id"),
    )
)
metric_names = ["temp_c", "feels_like_c", "wind_kph", "precip_mm"]
metric_long = (
    metric_base
    .unpivot(
        [c for c in metric_base.columns if c not in metric_names],
        metric_names,
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

w_forecast = Window.partitionBy("station_id").orderBy(
    F.col("issued_at").desc(), F.col("forecast_id").desc()
)
latest_forecast = (

/*
  App-store quality digest: normalize download receipts, attach featuring
  windows (including a 36-hour grace period), and unfold app KPIs for BI.
  String pivot values retain a compact operating-system download summary.
*/
with app_base as (
    select
        a.app_id,
        a.app_name,
        a.category,
        coalesce(element_at(a.app_meta, 'content_tier'), 'UNSET') as content_tier,
        size(map_keys(a.app_meta)) as meta_key_cnt,
        concat_ws(
            ':', upper(a.store_region),
            lpad(coalesce(element_at(a.app_meta, 'build_track'), 'x'), 3, '0'),
            array_join(slice(split(a.developer_ref, '\\|'), 1, 2), '~')
        ) as app_ref
    from app_catalog a
),
normalized_downloads as (
    select
        d.txn_id, d.app_id, d.acct_id, d.downloaded_at, d.qty, d.status,
        lower(regexp_replace(d.device_os, '[^A-Za-z]', '')) as os_norm,
        cast(regexp_extract(d.receipt_ref, '^DL-([0-9]{4})$', 1) as int) as receipt_seq,
        w.window_id,
        w.window_label
    from download_txn d
    left join feature_windows w
      on w.app_id = d.app_id
     and d.downloaded_at between w.start_time and w.end_time + interval '36' hour
    -- malformed receipts and void transactions never enter the digest
    where d.receipt_ref rlike '^DL-[0-9]{4}$'
      and d.status <> 'VOID'
),
download_metrics as (
    select
        n.app_id,
        count(distinct n.txn_id) as valid_txn_cnt,
        count(distinct n.acct_id) as distinct_acct_cnt,
        sum(distinct n.qty) as distinct_qty_sum,
        size(collect_set(n.os_norm)) as os_variety_cnt,
        array_join(
            array_sort(collect_set(coalesce(n.window_label, 'ORGANIC'))), ','
        ) as window_labels
    from normalized_downloads n
    group by n.app_id
),
os_pivot as (
    select app_id, ios_summary, android_summary
    from (
        select n.app_id, n.os_norm, n.qty, n.window_label
        from normalized_downloads n
    ) s
    pivot (
        max(concat_ws(':', coalesce(window_label, 'ORGANIC'), lpad(cast(qty as string), 2, '0')))
        for os_norm in ('ios' as ios_summary, 'android' as android_summary)
    )
),
rating_metrics as (
    select
        r.app_id,
        count(*) as rating_cnt,
        count(*) filter (where r.sentiment = 'POSITIVE') as positive_rating_cnt,
        count(*) filter (where r.sentiment = 'NEGATIVE') as negative_rating_cnt,
        percentile_approx(r.rating, 0.5) as median_rating
    from (
        select
            f.app_id, f.rating,
            regexp_replace(coalesce(f.review_txt, ''), '\\s+', ' ') as review_clean,
            case
                when f.review_txt rlike '(?i)great|love|smooth' then 'POSITIVE'
                when f.review_txt rlike '(?i)crash|bad|slow' then 'NEGATIVE'
                else 'NEUTRAL'
            end as sentiment
        from rating_feedback f
    ) r
    group by r.app_id
),
app_metrics as (
    select
        b.app_id,
        b.app_ref,
        b.category,
        b.content_tier,
        b.meta_key_cnt,
        d.window_labels,
        d.os_variety_cnt,
        concat_ws(
            '/', cast(coalesce(r.positive_rating_cnt, 0) as string),
            cast(coalesce(r.negative_rating_cnt, 0) as string)
        ) as review_outcome_mix,
        p.ios_summary,
        p.android_summary,
        cast(coalesce(d.valid_txn_cnt, 0) as double) as valid_txn_cnt,
        cast(coalesce(d.distinct_acct_cnt, 0) as double) as distinct_acct_cnt,
        cast(coalesce(d.distinct_qty_sum, 0) as double) as distinct_qty_sum,
        cast(coalesce(r.positive_rating_cnt, 0) as double) as positive_rating_cnt,
        cast(r.median_rating as double) as median_rating,
        lag(coalesce(r.median_rating, 0.0), 1, 0.0)
            over (order by b.app_id) as prev_median_rating,
        lead(coalesce(r.median_rating, 0.0), 2, 0.0)
            over (order by b.app_id) as next2_median_rating
    from app_base b
    left join download_metrics d on d.app_id = b.app_id
    left join rating_metrics r on r.app_id = b.app_id
    left join os_pivot p on p.app_id = b.app_id
)
select
    app_id, app_ref, category, content_tier, meta_key_cnt,
    window_labels, os_variety_cnt, review_outcome_mix,
    ios_summary, android_summary, metric_name, metric_value
from app_metrics
unpivot (
    metric_value for metric_name in (
        valid_txn_cnt,
        distinct_acct_cnt,
        distinct_qty_sum,
        positive_rating_cnt,
        median_rating,
        prev_median_rating,
        next2_median_rating
    )
)
order by app_id, metric_name

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

app_base = (
    df_app_catalog.alias("a")
    .select(
        F.col("a.app_id").alias("app_id"),
        F.col("a.app_name").alias("app_name"),
        F.col("a.category").alias("category"),
        F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("a.app_meta"), F.lit("content_tier")), F.lit("UNSET")).alias("content_tier"),
        F.size(F.map_keys(F.col("a.app_meta"))).alias("meta_key_cnt"),
        F.concat_ws(
            ":",
            F.upper(F.col("a.store_region")),
            F.lpad(F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("a.app_meta"), F.lit("build_track")), F.lit("x")), 3, "0"),
            F.array_join(F.slice(F.split(F.col("a.developer_ref"), r"\|"), 1, 2), "~"),
        ).alias("app_ref"),
    )
)

normalized_downloads = (
    df_download_txn.alias("d")
    .join(
        df_feature_windows.alias("w"),
        (F.col("w.app_id") == F.col("d.app_id"))
        & F.col("d.downloaded_at").between(
            F.col("w.start_time"),
            F.col("w.end_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR"),
        ),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("d.receipt_ref").rlike("^DL-[0-9]{4}$") & (F.col("d.status") != "VOID"))
    .select(
        F.col("d.txn_id").alias("txn_id"),
        F.col("d.app_id").alias("app_id"),
        F.col("d.acct_id").alias("acct_id"),
        F.col("d.downloaded_at").alias("downloaded_at"),
        F.col("d.qty").alias("qty"),
        F.col("d.status").alias("status"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.col("d.device_os"), "[^A-Za-z]", "")).alias("os_norm"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("d.receipt_ref"), "^DL-([0-9]{4})$", 1).cast("int").alias("receipt_seq"),
        F.col("w.window_id").alias("window_id"),
        F.col("w.window_label").alias("window_label"),
    )
)

download_metrics = (
    normalized_downloads.alias("n")
    .groupBy("n.app_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("n.txn_id").alias("valid_txn_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("n.acct_id").alias("distinct_acct_cnt"),
        F.sumDistinct("n.qty").alias("distinct_qty_sum"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("n.os_norm")).alias("os_variety_cnt"),
        F.array_join(
            F.array_sort(F.collect_set(F.coalesce(F.col("n.window_label"), F.lit("ORGANIC")))), ","
        ).alias("window_labels"),
    )
)

os_pivot = (
    normalized_downloads
    .select("app_id", "os_norm", "qty", "window_label")
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .pivot("os_norm", ["ios", "android"])
    .agg(
        F.max(
            F.concat_ws(
                ":",
                F.coalesce(F.col("window_label"), F.lit("ORGANIC")),
                F.lpad(F.col("qty").cast("string"), 2, "0"),
            )
        )
    )
    .withColumnRenamed("ios", "ios_summary")
    .withColumnRenamed("android", "android_summary")
)

rating_scored = (
    df_rating_feedback.alias("f")
    .select(
        F.col("f.app_id").alias("app_id"),
        F.col("f.rating").alias("rating"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.coalesce(F.col("f.review_txt"), F.lit("")), r"\s+", " ").alias("review_clean"),
        F.when(F.col("f.review_txt").rlike("(?i)great|love|smooth"), F.lit("POSITIVE"))
        .when(F.col("f.review_txt").rlike("(?i)crash|bad|slow"), F.lit("NEGATIVE"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("NEUTRAL"))
        .alias("sentiment"),
    )
)

rating_metrics = (
    rating_scored.alias("r")
    .groupBy("r.app_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("rating_cnt"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("r.sentiment") == "POSITIVE", F.lit(1))).alias("positive_rating_cnt"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("r.sentiment") == "NEGATIVE", F.lit(1))).alias("negative_rating_cnt"),
        F.percentile_approx(F.col("r.rating"), 0.5).alias("median_rating"),
    )
)

w_app_order = Window.orderBy(F.col("b.app_id"))
app_metrics = (
    app_base.alias("b")
    .join(download_metrics.alias("d"), F.col("d.app_id") == F.col("b.app_id"), "left")
    .join(rating_metrics.alias("r"), F.col("r.app_id") == F.col("b.app_id"), "left")
    .join(os_pivot.alias("p"), F.col("p.app_id") == F.col("b.app_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("b.app_id").alias("app_id"),
        F.col("b.app_ref").alias("app_ref"),
        F.col("b.category").alias("category"),
        F.col("b.content_tier").alias("content_tier"),
        F.col("b.meta_key_cnt").alias("meta_key_cnt"),
        F.col("d.window_labels").alias("window_labels"),
        F.col("d.os_variety_cnt").alias("os_variety_cnt"),
        F.concat_ws(
            "/",
            F.coalesce(F.col("r.positive_rating_cnt"), F.lit(0)).cast("string"),
            F.coalesce(F.col("r.negative_rating_cnt"), F.lit(0)).cast("string"),
        ).alias("review_outcome_mix"),
        F.col("p.ios_summary").alias("ios_summary"),
        F.col("p.android_summary").alias("android_summary"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("d.valid_txn_cnt"), F.lit(0)).cast("double").alias("valid_txn_cnt"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("d.distinct_acct_cnt"), F.lit(0)).cast("double").alias("distinct_acct_cnt"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("d.distinct_qty_sum"), F.lit(0)).cast("double").alias("distinct_qty_sum"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("r.positive_rating_cnt"), F.lit(0)).cast("double").alias("positive_rating_cnt"),
        F.col("r.median_rating").cast("double").alias("median_rating"),
        F.lag(F.coalesce(F.col("r.median_rating"), F.lit(0.0)), 1, 0.0).over(w_app_order).alias("prev_median_rating"),
        F.lead(F.coalesce(F.col("r.median_rating"), F.lit(0.0)), 2, 0.0).over(w_app_order).alias("next2_median_rating"),
    )
)

result = (
    app_metrics
    .unpivot(
        [
            "app_id", "app_ref", "category", "content_tier", "meta_key_cnt",
            "window_labels", "os_variety_cnt", "review_outcome_mix",
            "ios_summary", "android_summary",
        ],
        [
            "valid_txn_cnt", "distinct_acct_cnt", "distinct_qty_sum",
            "positive_rating_cnt", "median_rating", "prev_median_rating", "next2_median_rating",
        ],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "app_id", "app_ref", "category", "content_tier", "meta_key_cnt",
        "window_labels", "os_variety_cnt", "review_outcome_mix",
        "ios_summary", "android_summary", "metric_name", "metric_value",
    )
    .orderBy("app_id", "metric_name")
)

WITH lagged_scans AS (
    SELECT scan_id,
           tracking_no,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(courier_id, ''), 'UNASSIGNED') AS courier_id,
           facility_id,
           scan_ts,
           UPPER(scan_type) AS scan_type,
           dwell_minutes,
           temperature_c,
           humidity_pct,
           damage_flag,
           LAG(scan_ts) OVER (
               PARTITION BY tracking_no ORDER BY scan_ts, scan_id
           ) AS prev_scan_ts,
           LAG(COALESCE(NULLIF(courier_id, ''), 'UNASSIGNED')) OVER (
               PARTITION BY tracking_no ORDER BY scan_ts, scan_id
           ) AS prev_courier_id
    FROM stg_parcel_scans
    WHERE tracking_no IS NOT NULL
      AND scan_ts IS NOT NULL
      AND scan_type <> 'CANCELLED'
),
sessionized_scans AS (
    -- A courier change or a gap over 90 minutes starts a new work session.
    SELECT *,
           SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN prev_scan_ts IS NULL THEN 1
                   WHEN prev_courier_id <> courier_id THEN 1
                   WHEN scan_ts > prev_scan_ts + INTERVAL '90' MINUTE THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) OVER (
               PARTITION BY tracking_no
               ORDER BY scan_ts, scan_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_no
    FROM lagged_scans
),
session_rollup AS (
    SELECT tracking_no,
           session_no,
           courier_id,
           MIN(scan_ts) AS session_start,
           MAX(scan_ts) AS session_end,
           UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(scan_ts)) AS session_start_epoch,
           COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT scan_type) AS distinct_scan_types,
           SUM(DISTINCT dwell_minutes) AS distinct_dwell_minutes,
           ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT temperature_c), 2) AS avg_temperature_c,
           MAX(CASE WHEN damage_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS damaged_flag,
           COALESCE(
               MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'PICKUP' THEN 'CAPTURED' END),
               'NOT_SEEN'
           ) AS pickup_state,
           CASE
               WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'EXCEPTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                   THEN 'EXCEPTION'
               WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'DEPART' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                   THEN 'IN_TRANSIT'
               WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'ARRIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                   THEN 'ARRIVED'
               ELSE 'NO_LINEHAUL'
           END AS transit_state,
           COALESCE(
               MAX(CASE WHEN scan_type = 'DELIVER' THEN 'COMPLETED' END),
               'PENDING'
           ) AS delivery_state
    FROM sessionized_scans
    GROUP BY tracking_no, session_no, courier_id
),
status_long AS (
    SELECT tracking_no, session_no, metric, status_value
    FROM session_rollup
    UNPIVOT (
        status_value FOR metric IN (
            pickup_state AS PICKUP,
            transit_state AS TRANSIT,
            delivery_state AS DELIVERY

    )
),
status_pivot AS (
    SELECT tracking_no,
           session_no,
           pickup_state,
           transit_state,
           delivery_state
    FROM status_long
    PIVOT (
        MAX(status_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'PICKUP' AS pickup_state,
            'TRANSIT' AS transit_state,
            'DELIVERY' AS delivery_state
        )
    )
),
session_enriched AS (
    SELECT sr.*,
           sp.pickup_state AS pivoted_pickup_state,
           sp.transit_state AS pivoted_transit_state,
           sp.delivery_state AS pivoted_delivery_state
    FROM session_rollup sr
    JOIN status_pivot sp
      ON sp.tracking_no = sr.tracking_no
     AND sp.session_no = sr.session_no
)

       c.home_region,

       CASE
           WHEN se.courier_id = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN 'UNASSIGNED'
           WHEN c.courier_id IS NULL THEN 'ROSTER_GAP'
           WHEN c.active_flag = FALSE THEN 'INACTIVE_COURIER'
           WHEN se.damaged_flag = 1 THEN 'DAMAGE_REVIEW'
           WHEN se.delivery_state = 'COMPLETED'
            AND COALESCE(r.actual_leg_minutes, 0) <= COALESCE(r.planned_leg_minutes, 0)
               THEN 'ON_TIME'
           WHEN se.delivery_state = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'LATE'
           ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS'
       END AS operations_label,
       ROUND(
           AVG(se.scan_count) OVER (
               PARTITION BY se.courier_id
               ORDER BY se.session_start_epoch
               RANGE BETWEEN 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ),
           2
       ) AS trailing_24h_avg_scans,
       (SELECT PERCENTILE_APPROX(actual_minutes, 0.5)
        FROM stg_route_legs) AS network_median_leg_minutes
FROM session_enriched se
LEFT JOIN dim_couriers c
  ON c.courier_id = se.courier_id

           PERCENTILE_APPROX(actual_minutes, 0.5) AS median_leg_minutes
    FROM stg_route_legs
    GROUP BY tracking_no
) r
  ON r.tracking_no = se.tracking_no
ORDER BY se.session_start, se.tracking_no, se.session_no

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_scan_order = Window.partitionBy("tracking_no").orderBy("scan_ts", "scan_id")
normalized_courier = F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("courier_id"), F.lit("")), F.lit("UNASSIGNED"))
lagged_scans = (
    df_stg_parcel_scans
    .filter(
        F.col("tracking_no").isNotNull()
        & F.col("scan_ts").isNotNull()
        & (F.col("scan_type") != "CANCELLED")
    )
    .select(
        "scan_id",
        "tracking_no",
        normalized_courier.alias("courier_id"),
        "facility_id",
        "scan_ts",
        F.upper("scan_type").alias("scan_type"),
        "dwell_minutes",
        "temperature_c",
        "humidity_pct",
        "damage_flag",
        F.lag("scan_ts").over(w_scan_order).alias("prev_scan_ts"),
        F.lag(normalized_courier).over(w_scan_order).alias("prev_courier_id"),
    )
)

new_session_flag = (
    F.when(F.col("prev_scan_ts").isNull(), 1)
    .when(F.col("prev_courier_id") != F.col("courier_id"), 1)
    .when(F.col("scan_ts") > F.col("prev_scan_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '90' MINUTE"), 1)
    .otherwise(0)
)
w_session = w_scan_order.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
sessionized_scans = (
    lagged_scans
    .select("*", F.sum(new_session_flag).over(w_session).alias("session_no"))
)

session_rollup = (
    sessionized_scans
    .groupBy("tracking_no", "session_no", "courier_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("scan_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("scan_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.unix_timestamp(F.min("scan_ts")).alias("session_start_epoch"),
        F.count("*").alias("scan_count"),
        F.countDistinct("scan_type").alias("distinct_scan_types"),
        F.sum_distinct("dwell_minutes").alias("distinct_dwell_minutes"),
        F.round(F.expr("AVG(DISTINCT temperature_c)"), 2).alias("avg_temperature_c"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("damage_flag"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("damaged_flag"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.max(F.when(F.col("scan_type") == "PICKUP", "CAPTURED")),
            F.lit("NOT_SEEN"),
        ).alias("pickup_state"),
        F.when(F.max(F.when(F.col("scan_type") == "EXCEPTION", 1).otherwise(0)) == 1, "EXCEPTION")
        .when(F.max(F.when(F.col("scan_type") == "DEPART", 1).otherwise(0)) == 1, "IN_TRANSIT")
        .when(F.max(F.when(F.col("scan_type") == "ARRIVE", 1).otherwise(0)) == 1, "ARRIVED")
        .otherwise("NO_LINEHAUL")
        .alias("transit_state"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.max(F.when(F.col("scan_type") == "DELIVER", "COMPLETED")),
            F.lit("PENDING"),
        ).alias("delivery_state"),
    )
)

status_long = (
    session_rollup
    .unpivot(
        ["tracking_no", "session_no"],
        [
            F.col("pickup_state").alias("PICKUP"),
            F.col("transit_state").alias("TRANSIT"),
            F.col("delivery_state").alias("DELIVERY"),
        ],
        "metric",
        "status_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("status_value").isNotNull())
)
status_pivot = (
    status_long
    .groupBy("tracking_no", "session_no")
    .pivot("metric", ["PICKUP", "TRANSIT", "DELIVERY"])
    .agg(F.max("status_value"))
    .select(
        "tracking_no",
        "session_no",
        F.col("PICKUP").alias("pickup_state"),
        F.col("TRANSIT").alias("transit_state"),
        F.col("DELIVERY").alias("delivery_state"),
    )
)

session_enriched = (
    session_rollup.alias("sr")
    .join(
        status_pivot.alias("sp"),
        (F.col("sp.tracking_no") == F.col("sr.tracking_no"))
        & (F.col("sp.session_no") == F.col("sr.session_no")),
    )
    .select(
        "sr.*",
        F.col("sp.pickup_state").alias("pivoted_pickup_state"),
        F.col("sp.transit_state").alias("pivoted_transit_state"),
        F.col("sp.delivery_state").alias("pivoted_delivery_state"),
    )
)

route_rollup = (
    df_stg_route_legs
    .groupBy("tracking_no")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("leg_id").alias("leg_count"),
        F.sum("planned_minutes").alias("planned_leg_minutes"),
        F.sum("actual_minutes").alias("actual_leg_minutes"),
        F.round(F.sum("distance_km"), 2).alias("distance_km"),
        F.percentile_approx("actual_minutes", 0.5).alias("median_leg_minutes"),
    )
)
network_stats = df_stg_route_legs.agg(
    F.percentile_approx("actual_minutes", 0.5).alias("network_median_leg_minutes")
)
w_trailing_24h = (
    Window.partitionBy("se.courier_id")
    .orderBy("se.session_start_epoch")
    .rangeBetween(-86400, Window.currentRow)
)
result = (
    session_enriched.alias("se")
    .join(df_dim_couriers.alias("c"), F.col("c.courier_id") == F.col("se.courier_id"), "left")
    .join(route_rollup.alias("r"), F.col("r.tracking_no") == F.col("se.tracking_no"), "left")
    .crossJoin(network_stats.alias("n"))
    .select(
        "se.*",
        "c.courier_name",
        "c.home_region",
        "r.leg_count",
        "r.distance_km",
        "r.actual_leg_minutes",
        "r.planned_leg_minutes",
        "r.median_leg_minutes",
        F.when(F.col("se.courier_id") == "UNASSIGNED", "UNASSIGNED")
        .when(F.col("c.courier_id").isNull(), "ROSTER_GAP")
        .when(F.col("c.active_flag") == False, "INACTIVE_COURIER")
        .when(F.col("se.damaged_flag") == 1, "DAMAGE_REVIEW")
        .when(
            (F.col("se.delivery_state") == "COMPLETED")
            & (F.coalesce(F.col("r.actual_leg_minutes"), F.lit(0)) <= F.coalesce(F.col("r.planned_leg_minutes"), F.lit(0))),
            "ON_TIME",
        )
        .when(F.col("se.delivery_state") == "COMPLETED", "LATE")
        .otherwise("IN_PROGRESS")
        .alias("operations_label"),
        F.round(F.avg("se.scan_count").over(w_trailing_24h), 2).alias("trailing_24h_avg_scans"),
        "n.network_median_leg_minutes",
    )
    .orderBy("se.session_start", "se.tracking_no", "se.session_no")
)

WITH latest_impressions AS (
    -- Keep only the newest version of each impression for delivery reporting.
    SELECT li.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY impression_id
               ORDER BY event_ts DESC, event_version DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM fct_ad_impression_events li
),
valid_clicks AS (
    -- Count usable clicks; suspicious and unknown-review clicks are not usable.
    SELECT impression_id,
           COUNT(*) AS click_count
    FROM fct_ad_click_events
    WHERE COALESCE(is_suspicious, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY impression_id
),
delivery_base AS (
    -- Enrich clean impressions, parse consent JSON, and classify engagement.
    SELECT li.*,
           COALESCE(c.campaign_name, 'Unassigned campaign') AS campaign_name,
           COALESCE(c.channel, 'unknown') AS channel,
           COALESCE(clk.click_count, 0) AS click_count,
           q.quality_score,
           CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.consent') AS BOOLEAN) AS consent_flag,
           CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.viewability') AS DOUBLE) AS viewability,
           TRANSFORM(
               FILTER(li.context_tags, tag -> tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> 'internal'),
               tag -> UPPER(tag)
           ) AS audience_tags,
           EXISTS(li.context_tags, tag -> tag = 'premium') AS premium_context,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(li.placement, ''), 'unknown') AS placement_name,
           CASE
               WHEN CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.consent') AS BOOLEAN) = FALSE
                   THEN 'consent_blocked'
               WHEN COALESCE(li.engaged_seconds, 0) >= 20
                    AND COALESCE(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.viewability') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) >= 0.7
                   THEN 'deep_engagement'
               WHEN COALESCE(CAST(GET_JSON_OBJECT(li.event_payload, '$.viewability') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) >= 0.5
                   THEN 'light_engagement'
               ELSE 'unclassified'
           END AS engagement_label,
           AVG(li.media_cost) OVER (
               PARTITION BY COALESCE(c.channel, 'unknown')
               ORDER BY q.quality_score
               RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_quality_avg_cost
    FROM latest_impressions li
    LEFT JOIN valid_clicks clk
        ON clk.impression_id = li.impression_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_ad_campaigns c
        ON c.campaign_id = li.campaign_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_creative_quality q
        ON q.creative_id = li.creative_id
    WHERE li.rn = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_ad_click_events sc
          WHERE sc.impression_id = li.impression_id
            AND sc.is_suspicious = TRUE
      )
),
daily_metrics AS (
    -- Build campaign, placement, and engagement delivery segments by day.
    SELECT DATE(event_ts) AS delivery_date,
           campaign_id,
           campaign_name,
           channel,
           engagement_label,
           placement_name,
           COUNT(*) AS impression_count,
           SUM(click_count) AS click_count,
           SUM(media_cost) AS media_spend,
           AVG(nearby_quality_avg_cost) AS quality_peer_cost
    FROM delivery_base
    GROUP BY DATE(event_ts), campaign_id, campaign_name, channel,
             engagement_label, placement_name
),
delivery_with_trend AS (
    -- Add a strictly trailing two-row impression baseline within each segment.
    SELECT dm.*,
           COALESCE(
               SUM(impression_count) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY campaign_id, engagement_label, placement_name
                   ORDER BY delivery_date
                   ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
               ),
               0
           ) AS prior_two_period_impressions
    FROM daily_metrics dm
),
unpivoted_metrics AS (
    -- Turn delivery measures into a long metric table; null measures are omitted.
    SELECT delivery_date,
           campaign_id,
           campaign_name,
           channel,
           engagement_label,
           placement_name,
           prior_two_period_impressions,
           metric_name,
           metric_value
    FROM delivery_with_trend
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            impression_count AS impressions,
            click_count AS clicks,
            media_spend AS media_spend
        )
    )
)
-- Roll up the long metrics from campaign detail through the network total.
SELECT metric_name,
       COALESCE(channel, 'ALL_CHANNELS') AS channel_label,
       COALESCE(campaign_name, 'ALL_CAMPAIGNS') AS campaign_label,
       GROUPING_ID(metric_name, channel, campaign_name) AS grouping_id,
       CASE GROUPING_ID(metric_name, channel, campaign_name)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'campaign_metric'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'channel_metric'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'metric_total'
           ELSE 'network_total'
       END AS aggregation_grain,
       ROUND(SUM(metric_value), 2) AS metric_value,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE
           WHEN metric_name = 'impressions'
               THEN CAST(prior_two_period_impressions AS DECIMAL(20,2))
       END), 2) AS avg_prior_two_period_impressions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT placement_name) AS placement_count,
       MAX(delivery_date) AS last_delivery_date
FROM unpivoted_metrics
GROUP BY ROLLUP(metric_name, channel, campaign_name)
ORDER BY metric_name, grouping_id, channel_label, campaign_label

w_quality_range = (
    Window.partitionBy(F.coalesce(F.col("c.channel"), F.lit("unknown")))
    .orderBy(F.col("q.quality_score"))
    .rangeBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
)
