    latest_impressions.alias("li")
    .join(
        suspicious_impressions.alias("sc"),
        F.col("sc.impression_id") == F.col("li.impression_id"),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .join(valid_clicks.alias("clk"), F.col("clk.impression_id") == F.col("li.impression_id"), "left")
    .join(df_dim_ad_campaigns.alias("c"), F.col("c.campaign_id") == F.col("li.campaign_id"), "left")
    .join(df_dim_creative_quality.alias("q"), F.col("q.creative_id") == F.col("li.creative_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("li.rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "li.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.campaign_name"), F.lit("Unassigned campaign")).alias("campaign_name"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.channel"), F.lit("unknown")).alias("channel"),

        F.col("q.quality_score"),

        "campaign_name",
        "channel",
        "engagement_label",

        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("impression_count"),
        F.sum("click_count").alias("click_count"),
        F.sum("media_cost").alias("media_spend"),

w_trailing = (
    Window.partitionBy("campaign_id", "engagement_label", "placement_name")

    .rowsBetween(-2, -1)

    daily_metrics.alias("dm")
    .select(

        F.coalesce(F.sum("impression_count").over(w_trailing), F.lit(0)).alias("prior_two_period_impressions"),

    delivery_with_trend
    .select(
        "delivery_date",
        "campaign_id",
        "campaign_name",
        "channel",
        "engagement_label",
        "placement_name",
        "prior_two_period_impressions",
        F.col("impression_count").alias("impressions"),
        F.col("click_count").alias("clicks"),
        "media_spend",

    .unpivot(
        ids=[
            "delivery_date",
            "campaign_id",
            "campaign_name",
            "channel",
            "engagement_label",
            "placement_name",
            "prior_two_period_impressions",
        ],
        values=["impressions", "clicks", "media_spend"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

rollup_cols = ["metric_name", "channel", "campaign_name"]
rolled_metrics = (
    unpivoted_metrics
    .rollup(*rollup_cols)
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id(*rollup_cols).alias("grouping_id"),
        F.round(F.sum("metric_value"), 2).alias("metric_value"),
        F.round(
            F.avg(
                F.when(
                    F.col("metric_name") == "impressions",
                    F.col("prior_two_period_impressions").cast("decimal(20,2)"),
                ).otherwise(F.lit(None).cast("decimal(20,2)"))
            ),
            2,
        ).alias("avg_prior_two_period_impressions"),
        F.countDistinct("placement_name").alias("placement_count"),
        F.max("delivery_date").alias("last_delivery_date"),
    )
)
result = (
    rolled_metrics
    .select(
        "metric_name",
        F.coalesce(F.col("channel"), F.lit("ALL_CHANNELS")).alias("channel_label"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("campaign_name"), F.lit("ALL_CAMPAIGNS")).alias("campaign_label"),
        "grouping_id",
        F.when(F.col("grouping_id") == 0, F.lit("campaign_metric"))
        .when(F.col("grouping_id") == 1, F.lit("channel_metric"))
        .when(F.col("grouping_id") == 3, F.lit("metric_total"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("network_total"))
        .alias("aggregation_grain"),
        "metric_value",
        "avg_prior_two_period_impressions",
        "placement_count",
        "last_delivery_date",
    )
    .orderBy("metric_name", "grouping_id", "channel_label", "campaign_label")
)

WITH parsed_usage AS (
    SELECT
        usage_id,
        acct_id,
        resource_id,
        service,
        region,
        usage_ts,
        qty,
        from_json(
            attributes_json,
            'STRUCT<environment:STRING, instance_family:STRING, committed:BOOLEAN>'
        ) AS parsed_attrs,
        transform(labels, x -> upper(x)) AS normalized_labels,
        filter(labels, x -> startswith(x, 'cost:')) AS cost_labels,
        exists(labels, x -> x = 'prod') AS has_prod_label
    FROM usage_metering
    WHERE acct_id IS NOT NULL
),
rated_usage AS (
    -- The seven-day grace period covers usage between rate versions.
    SELECT
        u.*,
        r.sku,
        r.unit_price,
        r.discount_pct,
        u.qty * r.unit_price * (1 - coalesce(r.discount_pct, 0) / 100) AS extended_cost
    FROM parsed_usage u
    JOIN rate_cards r
      ON u.service = r.service
     AND u.region = r.region
     AND u.usage_ts BETWEEN r.effective_start
                        AND r.effective_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
),
usage_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        CAST(date_trunc('MM', usage_ts) AS DATE) AS billing_month,
        service,
        sum(qty) AS usage_qty,
        round(sum(extended_cost), 2) AS gross_cost,
        sum(DISTINCT qty) AS distinct_qty_sum,
        avg(DISTINCT qty) AS avg_distinct_qty,
        count(DISTINCT resource_id) AS resource_count,
        array_sort(collect_set(resource_id)) AS resource_ids,
        array_sort(collect_set(parsed_attrs.environment)) AS environments,
        array_sort(collect_set(sku)) AS skus,
        max(has_prod_label) AS has_prod_usage,
        max(size(cost_labels)) AS max_cost_labels
    FROM rated_usage
    GROUP BY
        acct_id,
        CAST(date_trunc('MM', usage_ts) AS DATE),
        service
),
invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        usage_month,
        sum(compute_amt) AS compute_amt,
        sum(storage_amt) AS storage_amt,
        sum(network_amt) AS network_amt
    FROM invoice_charges
    WHERE status = 'POSTED'
    GROUP BY acct_id, usage_month
),
invoice_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT omits the NULL network charge.
    SELECT
        acct_id,
        usage_month,
        replace(charge_type, '_amt', '') AS charge_type,
        charge_amount
    FROM invoice_totals
    UNPIVOT (
        charge_amount FOR charge_type
        IN (compute_amt, storage_amt, network_amt)
    )
)
SELECT
    u.acct_id,
    a.acct_name,
    u.billing_month,
    u.service AS charge_type,
    a.billing_profile.currency AS currency,
    a.billing_profile.country AS billing_country,
    coalesce(a.billing_profile.cost_center, 'UNASSIGNED') AS cost_center,
    element_at(a.budget_map, 'monthly_budget') AS monthly_budget,
    round(u.usage_qty, 2) AS usage_qty,
    u.gross_cost,
    i.charge_amount AS invoice_amount,
    round(i.charge_amount - u.gross_cost, 2) AS billing_variance,
    u.distinct_qty_sum,
    round(u.avg_distinct_qty, 4) AS avg_distinct_qty,
    u.resource_count,
    u.resource_ids,
    u.environments,
    u.skus,
    CASE
        WHEN u.has_prod_usage THEN 'PROD'
        ELSE 'NON_PROD'
    END AS usage_class,
    u.max_cost_labels
FROM usage_rollup u
JOIN invoice_long i
  ON i.acct_id = u.acct_id
 AND i.usage_month = u.billing_month
 AND i.charge_type = u.service
JOIN cloud_accounts a
  ON a.acct_id = u.acct_id
 AND a.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY u.acct_id, u.service

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

parsed_usage = (
    df_usage_metering
    .filter(F.col("acct_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "usage_id",
        "acct_id",
        "resource_id",
        "service",
        "region",
        "usage_ts",
        "qty",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("attributes_json"),
            "STRUCT<environment:STRING, instance_family:STRING, committed:BOOLEAN>",
        ).alias("parsed_attrs"),
        F.transform(F.col("labels"), lambda x: F.upper(x)).alias("normalized_labels"),
        F.filter(F.col("labels"), lambda x: x.startswith("cost:")).alias("cost_labels"),
        F.exists(F.col("labels"), lambda x: x == F.lit("prod")).alias("has_prod_label"),
    )
)

rated_usage = (
    parsed_usage.alias("u")
    .join(
        df_rate_cards.alias("r"),
        (F.col("u.service") == F.col("r.service"))
        & (F.col("u.region") == F.col("r.region"))
        & F.col("u.usage_ts").between(
            F.col("r.effective_start"),
            F.col("r.effective_end") + F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY"),
        ),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "u.*",
        "r.sku",
        "r.unit_price",
        "r.discount_pct",
        (
            F.col("u.qty")
            * F.col("r.unit_price")
            * (F.lit(1) - F.coalesce(F.col("r.discount_pct"), F.lit(0)) / F.lit(100))
        ).alias("extended_cost"),
    )
)

usage_rollup = (
    rated_usage
    .groupBy(
        "acct_id",
        F.date_trunc("MM", F.col("usage_ts")).cast("date").alias("billing_month"),
        "service",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("qty").alias("usage_qty"),
        F.round(F.sum("extended_cost"), 2).alias("gross_cost"),
        F.sum_distinct("qty").alias("distinct_qty_sum"),
        F.expr("avg(DISTINCT qty)").alias("avg_distinct_qty"),
        F.count_distinct("resource_id").alias("resource_count"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("resource_id")).alias("resource_ids"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set(F.col("parsed_attrs.environment"))).alias("environments"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("sku")).alias("skus"),
        F.max("has_prod_label").alias("has_prod_usage"),
        F.max(F.size("cost_labels")).alias("max_cost_labels"),
    )
)

invoice_totals = (
    df_invoice_charges
    .filter(F.col("status") == "POSTED")
    .groupBy("acct_id", "usage_month")
    .agg(
        F.sum("compute_amt").alias("compute_amt"),
        F.sum("storage_amt").alias("storage_amt"),
        F.sum("network_amt").alias("network_amt"),
    )
)

invoice_long = (
    invoice_totals
    .unpivot(
        ["acct_id", "usage_month"],
        ["compute_amt", "storage_amt", "network_amt"],
        "charge_type",
        "charge_amount",
    )
    .filter(F.col("charge_amount").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "usage_month",
        F.replace(F.col("charge_type"), F.lit("_amt"), F.lit("")).alias("charge_type"),
        "charge_amount",
    )
)

result = (
    usage_rollup.alias("u")
    .join(
        invoice_long.alias("i"),
        (F.col("i.acct_id") == F.col("u.acct_id"))
        & (F.col("i.usage_month") == F.col("u.billing_month"))
        & (F.col("i.charge_type") == F.col("u.service")),
        "inner",
    )
    .join(
        df_cloud_accounts.alias("a"),
        (F.col("a.acct_id") == F.col("u.acct_id")) & F.col("a.is_active"),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("u.acct_id").alias("acct_id"),
        F.col("a.acct_name").alias("acct_name"),
        F.col("u.billing_month").alias("billing_month"),
        F.col("u.service").alias("charge_type"),
        F.col("a.billing_profile.currency").alias("currency"),
        F.col("a.billing_profile.country").alias("billing_country"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.billing_profile.cost_center"), F.lit("UNASSIGNED")).alias("cost_center"),
        F.element_at(F.col("a.budget_map"), F.lit("monthly_budget")).alias("monthly_budget"),
        F.round(F.col("u.usage_qty"), 2).alias("usage_qty"),
        F.col("u.gross_cost").alias("gross_cost"),

        F.round(F.col("i.charge_amount") - F.col("u.gross_cost"), 2).alias("billing_variance"),

with flattened_events as (
    select
        le.event_id,
        le.user_id,
        le.session_id,
        le.event_ts,
        cast(le.event_ts as date) as login_day,
        le.status,
        le.device.platform as device_platform,
        le.device.is_managed as is_managed,
        signal.signal_code,
        signal.severity as signal_severity,
        signal.weight as signal_weight,
        lag(le.status, 1, 'NO_PRIOR_EVENT') over (
            partition by le.user_id
            order by le.event_ts, le.event_id
        ) as prior_status,
        lead(le.status, 2, 'NO_FUTURE_EVENT') over (
            partition by le.user_id
            order by le.event_ts, le.event_id
        ) as following_status
    from login_events le
    lateral view explode(le.risk_signals) exploded as signal
    where le.event_ts >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and le.event_ts < timestamp '2025-03-05 00:00:00'
),
daily_activity as (
    select
        user_id,
        login_day,
        count(distinct event_id) as total_events,
        count(distinct event_id) filter (where status = 'FAILURE') as failed_events,
        count(*) filter (
            where status = 'SUCCESS' and signal_severity >= 3
        ) as high_severity_success_rows,
        count(distinct session_id) as session_count,
        array_sort(collect_set(signal_code)) as signal_codes,
        array_sort(collect_set(device_platform)) as device_platforms,
        -- Explosion can repeat weights, so only distinct weights contribute.
        sum(distinct signal_weight) as distinct_signal_weight,
        count(distinct event_id) filter (
            where prior_status = 'FAILURE' and status = 'SUCCESS'
        ) as recovery_events,
        max(case when following_status = 'NO_FUTURE_EVENT' then 1 else 0 end) as tail_event_flag
    from flattened_events
    group by user_id, login_day
),
alert_daily as (
    select
        user_id,
        cast(opened_at as date) as login_day,
        count(*) filter (where status <> 'CLOSED') as open_alerts,
        count(distinct alert_id) as total_alerts,
        array_sort(collect_set(severity)) as alert_severities,
        max(case when owner is null then 1 else 0 end) as unassigned_alert_flag,
        max(alert_score) as max_alert_score
    from alert_records
    group by user_id, cast(opened_at as date)
),
joined_metrics as (
    select
        da.*,
        ud.department,
        coalesce(ad.open_alerts, 0) as open_alerts,
        coalesce(ad.total_alerts, 0) as total_alerts,
        ad.alert_severities,
        coalesce(ad.unassigned_alert_flag, 0) as unassigned_alert_flag,
        ad.max_alert_score,
        (select threshold_value
         from policy_thresholds
         where metric_name = 'failed_logins') as failed_login_threshold,
        case
            when da.failed_events > (
                select threshold_value
                from policy_thresholds
                where metric_name = 'failed_logins'
            ) then 'ESCALATE'
            when da.high_severity_success_rows > 0
              or coalesce(ad.max_alert_score, 0) >= 70 then 'REVIEW'
            else 'MONITOR'
        end as triage_state
    from daily_activity da
    join user_directory ud
      on ud.user_id = da.user_id
     and ud.is_active = true
    left join alert_daily ad
      on ad.user_id = da.user_id
     and ad.login_day = da.login_day
)
select
    user_id,
    login_day,
    department,
    total_events,
    failed_events,
    high_severity_success_rows,
    session_count,
    signal_codes,
    device_platforms,
    distinct_signal_weight,
    recovery_events,
    tail_event_flag,
    open_alerts,
    total_alerts,
    alert_severities,
    unassigned_alert_flag,
    max_alert_score,
    failed_login_threshold,
    triage_state,
    sum(failed_events) over (
        partition by user_id
        order by datediff(login_day, date '2025-03-01')
        range between 2 preceding and current row
    ) as rolling_failed_events
from joined_metrics
order by rolling_failed_events desc nulls last,
         max_alert_score desc nulls last,
         login_day desc,
         user_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_event = Window.partitionBy("user_id").orderBy("event_ts", "event_id")

flattened_events = (
    df_login_events
    .filter(
        (F.col("event_ts") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("event_ts") < F.lit("2025-03-05 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "user_id",
        "session_id",
        "event_ts",
        F.to_date("event_ts").alias("login_day"),
        "status",
        F.col("device.platform").alias("device_platform"),
        F.col("device.is_managed").alias("is_managed"),
        F.explode("risk_signals").alias("signal"),
    )
    .withColumn("prior_status", F.lag("status", 1, "NO_PRIOR_EVENT").over(w_event))
    .withColumn("following_status", F.lead("status", 2, "NO_FUTURE_EVENT").over(w_event))
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "user_id",
        "session_id",
        "event_ts",
        "login_day",
        "status",
        "device_platform",
        "is_managed",
        F.col("signal.signal_code").alias("signal_code"),
        F.col("signal.severity").alias("signal_severity"),
        F.col("signal.weight").alias("signal_weight"),
        "prior_status",
        "following_status",
    )
)

daily_activity = (
    flattened_events
    .groupBy("user_id", "login_day")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("event_id").alias("total_events"),
        F.countDistinct(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILURE", F.col("event_id"))).alias("failed_events"),
        F.sum(
            F.when((F.col("status") == "SUCCESS") & (F.col("signal_severity") >= 3), 1).otherwise(0)
        ).alias("high_severity_success_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("session_count"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("signal_code")).alias("signal_codes"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("device_platform")).alias("device_platforms"),
        F.sumDistinct("signal_weight").alias("distinct_signal_weight"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when((F.col("prior_status") == "FAILURE") & (F.col("status") == "SUCCESS"), F.col("event_id"))
        ).alias("recovery_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("following_status") == "NO_FUTURE_EVENT", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("tail_event_flag"),
    )
)

alert_daily = (
    df_alert_records
    .groupBy("user_id", F.to_date("opened_at").alias("login_day"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") != "CLOSED", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("open_alerts"),
        F.countDistinct("alert_id").alias("total_alerts"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("severity")).alias("alert_severities"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("owner").isNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("unassigned_alert_flag"),
        F.max("alert_score").alias("max_alert_score"),
    )
)

failed_threshold = (
    df_policy_thresholds
    .filter(F.col("metric_name") == "failed_logins")
    .select(F.col("threshold_value").alias("failed_login_threshold"))
)

joined_base = (
    daily_activity.alias("da")
    .join(
        df_user_directory.alias("ud"),
        (F.col("ud.user_id") == F.col("da.user_id")) & F.col("ud.is_active"),
        "inner",
    )
    .join(
        alert_daily.alias("ad"),
        (F.col("ad.user_id") == F.col("da.user_id")) & (F.col("ad.login_day") == F.col("da.login_day")),
        "left",
    )
    .crossJoin(failed_threshold)
)

joined_metrics = (
    joined_base
    .select(
        "da.*",
        "ud.department",
        F.coalesce("ad.open_alerts", F.lit(0)).alias("open_alerts"),
        F.coalesce("ad.total_alerts", F.lit(0)).alias("total_alerts"),
        "ad.alert_severities",
        F.coalesce("ad.unassigned_alert_flag", F.lit(0)).alias("unassigned_alert_flag"),
        "ad.max_alert_score",
        "failed_login_threshold",
        F.when(F.col("da.failed_events") > F.col("failed_login_threshold"), F.lit("ESCALATE"))
        .when(
            (F.col("da.high_severity_success_rows") > 0)
            | (F.coalesce("ad.max_alert_score", F.lit(0)) >= F.lit(70)),
            F.lit("REVIEW"),
        )
        .otherwise(F.lit("MONITOR"))
        .alias("triage_state"),
    )
)

w_rolling = (
    Window.partitionBy("user_id")
    .orderBy(F.datediff(F.col("login_day"), F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date")))
    .rangeBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
)

result = (
    joined_metrics
    .select(
        "user_id",
        "login_day",
        "department",
        "total_events",
        "failed_events",
        "high_severity_success_rows",
        "session_count",
        "signal_codes",
        "device_platforms",
        "distinct_signal_weight",
        "recovery_events",
        "tail_event_flag",
        "open_alerts",
        "total_alerts",
        "alert_severities",
        "unassigned_alert_flag",
        "max_alert_score",
        "failed_login_threshold",
        "triage_state",
        F.sum("failed_events").over(w_rolling).alias("rolling_failed_events"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("rolling_failed_events").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("max_alert_score").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("login_day").desc(),
        F.col("user_id"),
    )
)

with stg_latest_admissions as (
    select
        admission_id,
        event_id,
        patient_id,
        facility_code,
        event_ts,
        event_type,
        from_json(details_json, 'discharge_ts timestamp, attending_department string, review_required boolean').discharge_ts as discharge_ts,
        from_json(details_json, 'discharge_ts timestamp, attending_department string, review_required boolean').attending_department as attending_department,
        from_json(details_json, 'discharge_ts timestamp, attending_department string, review_required boolean').review_required as review_required
    from stg_admission_events
    -- Event id breaks any timestamp ties while retaining the latest snapshot.
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by admission_id
        order by event_ts desc, event_id desc
    ) = 1
),
stg_adjustment_rows as (
    select
        b.admission_id,
        b.line_id,
        b.service_ts,
        b.department,
        b.line_status,
        b.gross_amount,
        item.adjustment_type,
        item.amount as adjustment_amount
    from fct_billing_lines b
    lateral view explode(adjustments) adj as item
),
stg_admission_totals as (
    select
        admission_id,
        sum(distinct gross_amount) as distinct_gross_amount,
        count(distinct line_id) as billed_line_count,
        count(*) filter (where line_status = 'DENIED') as denied_adjustment_rows,
        sum(adjustment_amount) filter (where adjustment_type = 'DISCOUNT') as discount_amount
    from stg_adjustment_rows
    group by admission_id
),
stg_enriched_admissions as (
    select
        a.*,
        p.patient_name,
        p.profile.coverage_type as coverage_type,
        p.profile.region as region,
        p.profile.risk_score as risk_score,
        f.facility_name,
        f.cost_per_day,
        coalesce(a.discharge_ts, a.event_ts + interval '36' hour) as resolved_discharge_ts,
        datediff(
            date_trunc('day', coalesce(a.discharge_ts, a.event_ts + interval '36' hour)),
            date_trunc('day', a.event_ts)
        ) + 1 as calendar_days,
        timestampdiff(
            hour,
            a.event_ts,
            coalesce(a.discharge_ts, a.event_ts + interval '36' hour)
        ) as los_hours
    from stg_latest_admissions a
    join dim_patients p on p.patient_id = a.patient_id
    left join dim_facilities f on f.facility_code = a.facility_code
    where exists (
        select 1
        from fct_billing_lines b
        where b.admission_id = a.admission_id
          and b.line_status <> 'VOID'
    )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from stg_admission_events x
        where x.admission_id = a.admission_id
          and x.event_type = 'CANCELLED'
    )
),
fct_admission_financials as (
    select
        e.admission_id,
        e.patient_id,
        e.patient_name,
        e.facility_code,
        e.facility_name,
        e.region,
        e.coverage_type,
        e.attending_department,
        e.event_ts as admission_ts,
        e.resolved_discharge_ts,
        cast(e.event_ts as date) as admission_date,
        e.calendar_days,
        e.los_hours,
        e.review_required,
        coalesce(t.billed_line_count, 0) as billed_line_count,
        coalesce(t.denied_adjustment_rows, 0) as denied_adjustment_rows,
        coalesce(t.distinct_gross_amount, cast(0 as decimal(10,2))) as gross_amount,
        coalesce(t.discount_amount, cast(0 as decimal(10,2))) as discount_amount,
        round(
            cast(coalesce(t.distinct_gross_amount, 0) - coalesce(t.discount_amount, 0) as decimal(18,2)),
            2
        ) as net_amount,
        ceil(e.los_hours / 24.0) as billable_days,
        floor(coalesce(t.discount_amount, 0) / 100.0) as discount_hundreds,
        round(
            cast(
                ceil(e.los_hours / 24.0) * coalesce(e.cost_per_day, cast(0 as decimal(10,2)))
                * coalesce(e.risk_score, cast(1 as decimal(4,2)))
                as decimal(18,2)
            ),
            2
        ) as risk_adjusted_cost
    from stg_enriched_admissions e
    left join stg_admission_totals t on t.admission_id = e.admission_id
)
select
    admission_id,
    patient_name,
    facility_name,
    region,
    coverage_type,
    attending_department,
    admission_date,
    calendar_days,
    los_hours,
    billed_line_count,
    denied_adjustment_rows,
    gross_amount,
    discount_amount,
    net_amount,
    billable_days,
    discount_hundreds,
    risk_adjusted_cost,
    review_required,
    round(
        avg(net_amount) over (
            partition by region
            order by admission_date, admission_id
            rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
        ),
        2
    ) as prior_two_admission_net_avg
from fct_admission_financials
order by region, admission_date, admission_id
case.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

json_schema = "discharge_ts timestamp, attending_department string, review_required boolean"
parsed_details = F.from_json(F.col("details_json"), json_schema)
w_latest = Window.partitionBy("admission_id").orderBy(F.col("event_ts").desc(), F.col("event_id").desc())
stg_latest_admissions = (
    df_stg_admission_events
    .withColumn("parsed_details", parsed_details)
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w_latest))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "admission_id",
        "event_id",
        "patient_id",
        "facility_code",
        "event_ts",
        "event_type",
        F.col("parsed_details.discharge_ts").alias("discharge_ts"),
        F.col("parsed_details.attending_department").alias("attending_department"),
        F.col("parsed_details.review_required").alias("review_required"),
    )
)

stg_adjustment_rows = (
    df_fct_billing_lines.alias("b")
    .select(
        "b.admission_id",
        "b.line_id",
        "b.service_ts",
        "b.department",
        "b.line_status",
        "b.gross_amount",
        F.explode(F.col("b.adjustments")).alias("item"),
    )
    .select(
        "admission_id",
        "line_id",
        "service_ts",
        "department",
        "line_status",
        "gross_amount",
        F.col("item.adjustment_type").alias("adjustment_type"),
        F.col("item.amount").alias("adjustment_amount"),
    )
)

stg_admission_totals = (
    stg_adjustment_rows
    .groupBy("admission_id")
    .agg(
        F.sumDistinct("gross_amount").alias("distinct_gross_amount"),
        F.countDistinct("line_id").alias("billed_line_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("line_status") == "DENIED", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("denied_adjustment_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("adjustment_type") == "DISCOUNT", F.col("adjustment_amount"))).alias("discount_amount"),
    )
)

resolved_discharge = F.coalesce(F.col("a.discharge_ts"), F.col("a.event_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR"))
nonvoid_billing = (
    df_fct_billing_lines
    .filter(F.col("line_status") != "VOID")
    .select("admission_id")
    .distinct()
)
cancelled_admissions = (
    df_stg_admission_events
    .filter(F.col("event_type") == "CANCELLED")
    .select("admission_id")
    .distinct()
)
stg_enriched_admissions = (
    stg_latest_admissions.alias("a")
    .join(df_dim_patients.alias("p"), F.col("p.patient_id") == F.col("a.patient_id"))
    .join(df_dim_facilities.alias("f"), F.col("f.facility_code") == F.col("a.facility_code"), "left")
    .join(nonvoid_billing.alias("b"), F.col("b.admission_id") == F.col("a.admission_id"), "left_semi")
    .join(cancelled_admissions.alias("x"), F.col("x.admission_id") == F.col("a.admission_id"), "left_anti")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("p.patient_name").alias("patient_name"),
        F.col("p.profile.coverage_type").alias("coverage_type"),
        F.col("p.profile.region").alias("region"),
        F.col("p.profile.risk_score").alias("risk_score"),
        "f.facility_name",
        "f.cost_per_day",
        resolved_discharge.alias("resolved_discharge_ts"),
        (F.datediff(F.date_trunc("day", resolved_discharge), F.date_trunc("day", F.col("a.event_ts"))) + 1).alias("calendar_days"),
        F.expr("timestampdiff(HOUR, a.event_ts, coalesce(a.discharge_ts, a.event_ts + INTERVAL '36' HOUR))").alias("los_hours"),
    )
)

zero_money = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")
gross_amount = F.coalesce(F.col("t.distinct_gross_amount"), zero_money)
discount_amount = F.coalesce(F.col("t.discount_amount"), zero_money)
billable_days = F.ceil(F.col("e.los_hours") / 24.0)
fct_admission_financials = (
    stg_enriched_admissions.alias("e")
    .join(stg_admission_totals.alias("t"), F.col("t.admission_id") == F.col("e.admission_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.admission_id",
        "e.patient_id",
        "e.patient_name",
        "e.facility_code",
        "e.facility_name",
        "e.region",
        "e.coverage_type",
        "e.attending_department",
        F.col("e.event_ts").alias("admission_ts"),
        "e.resolved_discharge_ts",
        F.col("e.event_ts").cast("date").alias("admission_date"),
        "e.calendar_days",
        "e.los_hours",
        "e.review_required",
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.billed_line_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("billed_line_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.denied_adjustment_rows"), F.lit(0)).alias("denied_adjustment_rows"),
        gross_amount.alias("gross_amount"),
        discount_amount.alias("discount_amount"),
        F.round((gross_amount - discount_amount).cast("decimal(18,2)"), 2).alias("net_amount"),
        billable_days.alias("billable_days"),
        F.floor(F.coalesce(F.col("t.discount_amount"), F.lit(0)) / 100.0).alias("discount_hundreds"),
        F.round(
            (billable_days * F.coalesce(F.col("e.cost_per_day"), zero_money) * F.coalesce(F.col("e.risk_score"), F.lit(1).cast("decimal(4,2)"))).cast("decimal(18,2)"),
            2,
        ).alias("risk_adjusted_cost"),
    )
)

w_prior_two = (
    Window.partitionBy("region")
    .orderBy("admission_date", "admission_id")
    .rowsBetween(-2, -1)
)
result = (
    fct_admission_financials
    .select(
        "admission_id",
        "patient_name",
        "facility_name",
        "region",
        "coverage_type",
        "attending_department",
        "admission_date",
        "calendar_days",
        "los_hours",
        "billed_line_count",
        "denied_adjustment_rows",
        "gross_amount",
        "discount_amount",
        "net_amount",
        "billable_days",
        "discount_hundreds",
        "risk_adjusted_cost",
        "review_required",
        F.round(F.avg("net_amount").over(w_prior_two), 2).alias("prior_two_admission_net_avg"),
    )
    .orderBy("region", "admission_date", "admission_id")
)

WITH scoped_projects AS (
    SELECT prj.project_id,
           prj.region,
           prj.status,
           prj.contract_value,
           prj.contingency_rate,
           FLOOR(CAST(prj.contract_value AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 100000) AS contract_100k_floor,
           CEIL(prj.contingency_rate * 100) AS contingency_pct_ceil
    FROM project_master prj
    WHERE prj.contract_value >= CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL(14,2))
      AND prj.status <> 'ARCHIVED'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM change_order_txn ex
          WHERE ex.project_id = prj.project_id
            AND ex.status = 'APPROVED'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM project_compliance_review nx
          WHERE nx.project_id = prj.project_id
            AND nx.review_type = 'STOP_WORK'
            AND nx.cleared_ts IS NULL
      )
),
metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT project_id, actual_cost, budget_cost, forecast_cost
    FROM project_cost_metric
    PIVOT (
        SUM(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'ACTUAL' AS actual_cost,
            'BUDGET' AS budget_cost,
            'FORECAST' AS forecast_cost
        )
    )
),
co_enriched AS (
    SELECT priced.*,
           FILTER(normalized_risks, x -> x IN ('PERMIT', 'WEATHER', 'DESIGN')) AS active_risks,
           AVG(co_amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id
               ORDER BY submitted_ts, co_id
               ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ) AS prior_two_avg,
           SUM(co_amount) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id
               ORDER BY qty
               RANGE BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS range_exposure
    FROM (
        SELECT txn.*,
               ROUND(
                   CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))
                   * (1 + tax_rate),
                   2
               ) AS co_amount,
               TRANSFORM(COALESCE(risk_codes, ARRAY()), x -> UPPER(x)) AS normalized_risks
        FROM change_order_txn txn
    ) priced
),
co_ledger AS (
    -- Approved value carries related-quantity exposure and a risk allowance.
    SELECT project_id,
           'APPROVED' AS component,
           ROUND(
               co_amount + (range_exposure - co_amount) * 0.02
               + CASE WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(active_risks) > 0 THEN 250 ELSE 0 END,
               2
           ) AS component_value
    FROM co_enriched
    WHERE status = 'APPROVED'
    UNION ALL
    -- Pipeline value is incremental to the previous two submissions.
    SELECT project_id,
           'PIPELINE' AS component,
           ROUND(
               GREATEST(co_amount - COALESCE(prior_two_avg, 0), 0)
               + range_exposure * 0.01,
               2
           ) AS component_value
    FROM co_enriched
    WHERE status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW')
),
co_pivot AS (
    SELECT project_id, approved_change_value, pipeline_change_value
    FROM co_ledger
    PIVOT (
        SUM(component_value)
        FOR component IN (
            'APPROVED' AS approved_change_value,
            'PIPELINE' AS pipeline_change_value
        )
    )
),
regional_rollup AS (
    SELECT prj.region,
           prj.status,
           GROUPING_ID(prj.region, prj.status) AS grouping_id,
           COUNT(*) AS project_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prj.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_project_count,
           ROUND(SUM(met.actual_cost), 2) AS actual_cost,
           ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(co.approved_change_value, 0)), 2) AS approved_change_value,
           ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(co.pipeline_change_value, 0)), 2) AS pipeline_change_value,
           FLOOR(SUM(met.budget_cost) / 1000) AS budget_k_floor,
           CEIL(SUM(met.forecast_cost - met.actual_cost) / 1000) AS remaining_k_ceil,
           ROUND(SUM(prj.contract_value * prj.contingency_rate), 2) AS contingency_value,
           ROUND(AVG(prj.contingency_pct_ceil), 2) AS avg_contingency_pct,
           MAX(prj.contract_100k_floor) AS max_contract_100k_floor
    FROM scoped_projects prj
    JOIN metric_pivot met
      ON met.project_id = prj.project_id
    LEFT JOIN co_pivot co
      ON co.project_id = prj.project_id
    -- Unresolved environmental reviews are excluded via an anti-join pattern.
    LEFT JOIN project_compliance_review rev
      ON rev.project_id = prj.project_id
     AND rev.review_type = 'ENVIRONMENTAL'
     AND rev.cleared_ts IS NULL
    WHERE rev.review_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (prj.region, prj.status),
        (prj.region),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT CASE
           WHEN grouping_id = 3 THEN 'ALL_REGIONS'
           ELSE region
       END AS region_label,
       CASE
           WHEN grouping_id >= 1 THEN 'ALL_STATUSES'
           ELSE status
       END AS status_label,
       grouping_id,
       project_count,
       active_project_count,
       actual_cost,
       approved_change_value,
       pipeline_change_value,
       budget_k_floor,
       remaining_k_ceil,
       contingency_value,
       avg_contingency_pct,
       max_contract_100k_floor
FROM regional_rollup
ORDER BY grouping_id DESC, region_label, status_label

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_projects = (
    df_project_master.alias("prj")
    .filter(
        (F.col("prj.contract_value") >= F.lit(1000000).cast("decimal(14,2)"))
        & (F.col("prj.status") != "ARCHIVED")
    )
    .join(
        df_change_order_txn.alias("ex").filter(F.col("ex.status") == "APPROVED"),
        F.col("prj.project_id") == F.col("ex.project_id"),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .join(
        df_project_compliance_review.alias("nx").filter(
            (F.col("nx.review_type") == "STOP_WORK") & F.col("nx.cleared_ts").isNull()
        ),
        F.col("prj.project_id") == F.col("nx.project_id"),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("prj.project_id").alias("project_id"),
        F.col("prj.region").alias("region"),
        F.col("prj.status").alias("status"),
        F.col("prj.contract_value").alias("contract_value"),
        F.col("prj.contingency_rate").alias("contingency_rate"),
        F.floor(F.col("prj.contract_value").cast("decimal(18,2)") / F.lit(100000)).alias("contract_100k_floor"),
        F.ceil(F.col("prj.contingency_rate") * F.lit(100)).alias("contingency_pct_ceil"),
    )
)

metric_pivot = (
    df_project_cost_metric
    .groupBy("project_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["ACTUAL", "BUDGET", "FORECAST"])
    .agg(F.sum("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "project_id",
        F.col("ACTUAL").alias("actual_cost"),
        F.col("BUDGET").alias("budget_cost"),
        F.col("FORECAST").alias("forecast_cost"),
    )
)

w_prior_two = (
    Window.partitionBy("project_id")
    .orderBy("submitted_ts", "co_id")
    .rowsBetween(-2, -1)
)
w_qty_range = (
    Window.partitionBy("project_id")
    .orderBy("qty")
    .rangeBetween(-100, Window.currentRow)
)

co_priced = (
    df_change_order_txn
    .withColumn(
        "co_amount",
        F.round(
            F.col("qty").cast("decimal(18,4)")
            * F.col("unit_price").cast("decimal(18,4)")
            * (F.lit(1) + F.col("tax_rate")),
            2,
        ),
    )
    .withColumn(
        "normalized_risks",
        F.transform(F.coalesce(F.col("risk_codes"), F.array()), lambda x: F.upper(x)),
    )
)

co_enriched = (
    co_priced
    .withColumn(
        "active_risks",
        F.filter(F.col("normalized_risks"), lambda x: x.isin("PERMIT", "WEATHER", "DESIGN")),
    )
    .withColumn("prior_two_avg", F.avg("co_amount").over(w_prior_two))
    .withColumn("range_exposure", F.sum("co_amount").over(w_qty_range))
)

approved_ledger = (
    co_enriched
    .filter(F.col("status") == "APPROVED")
    .select(
        "project_id",
        F.lit("APPROVED").alias("component"),
        F.round(
            F.col("co_amount")
            + (F.col("range_exposure") - F.col("co_amount")) * F.lit(0.02)
            + F.when(F.size("active_risks") > 0, F.lit(250)).otherwise(F.lit(0)),
            2,
        ).alias("component_value"),
    )
)

pipeline_ledger = (
    co_enriched
    .filter(F.col("status").isin("SUBMITTED", "UNDER_REVIEW"))
    .select(
        "project_id",
        F.lit("PIPELINE").alias("component"),
        F.round(
            F.greatest(F.col("co_amount") - F.coalesce(F.col("prior_two_avg"), F.lit(0)), F.lit(0))
            + F.col("range_exposure") * F.lit(0.01),
            2,
        ).alias("component_value"),
    )
)

co_ledger = approved_ledger.union(pipeline_ledger)

co_pivot = (
    co_ledger
    .groupBy("project_id")
    .pivot("component", ["APPROVED", "PIPELINE"])
    .agg(F.sum("component_value"))
    .select(
        "project_id",
        F.col("APPROVED").alias("approved_change_value"),
        F.col("PIPELINE").alias("pipeline_change_value"),
    )
)

regional_source = (
    scoped_projects.alias("prj")
    .join(metric_pivot.alias("met"), F.col("met.project_id") == F.col("prj.project_id"))
    .join(co_pivot.alias("co"), F.col("co.project_id") == F.col("prj.project_id"), "left")
    .join(
        df_project_compliance_review.alias("rev").filter(
            (F.col("rev.review_type") == "ENVIRONMENTAL") & F.col("rev.cleared_ts").isNull()
        ),
        F.col("rev.project_id") == F.col("prj.project_id"),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("rev.review_id").isNull())
)


def regional_measures():
    return [
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("project_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("prj.status") == "ACTIVE", F.lit(1))).alias("active_project_count"),
        F.round(F.sum("met.actual_cost"), 2).alias("actual_cost"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.coalesce(F.col("co.approved_change_value"), F.lit(0))), 2).alias("approved_change_value"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.coalesce(F.col("co.pipeline_change_value"), F.lit(0))), 2).alias("pipeline_change_value"),
        F.floor(F.sum("met.budget_cost") / F.lit(1000)).alias("budget_k_floor"),
        F.ceil(F.sum(F.col("met.forecast_cost") - F.col("met.actual_cost")) / F.lit(1000)).alias("remaining_k_ceil"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.col("prj.contract_value") * F.col("prj.contingency_rate")), 2).alias("contingency_value"),
        F.round(F.avg("prj.contingency_pct_ceil"), 2).alias("avg_contingency_pct"),
        F.max("prj.contract_100k_floor").alias("max_contract_100k_floor"),
    ]


rollup_cols = [
    "region",
    "status",
    "grouping_id",
    "project_count",
    "active_project_count",
    "actual_cost",
    "approved_change_value",
    "pipeline_change_value",
    "budget_k_floor",
    "remaining_k_ceil",
    "contingency_value",
    "avg_contingency_pct",
    "max_contract_100k_floor",
]

detail_rollup = (
    regional_source
    .groupBy(F.col("prj.region").alias("region"), F.col("prj.status").alias("status"))
    .agg(*regional_measures())
    .withColumn("grouping_id", F.lit(0))
    .select(*rollup_cols)
)

region_rollup = (
    regional_source
    .groupBy(F.col("prj.region").alias("region"))
    .agg(*regional_measures())
    .withColumn("status", F.lit(None).cast("string"))
    .withColumn("grouping_id", F.lit(1))
    .select(*rollup_cols)
)

global_rollup = (
    regional_source
    .agg(*regional_measures())
    .withColumn("region", F.lit(None).cast("string"))
    .withColumn("status", F.lit(None).cast("string"))
    .withColumn("grouping_id", F.lit(3))
    .select(*rollup_cols)
)

regional_rollup = detail_rollup.union(region_rollup).union(global_rollup)

result = (
    regional_rollup
    .select(
        F.when(F.col("grouping_id") == 3, F.lit("ALL_REGIONS"))
        .otherwise(F.col("region"))
        .alias("region_label"),
        F.when(F.col("grouping_id") >= 1, F.lit("ALL_STATUSES"))
        .otherwise(F.col("status"))
        .alias("status_label"),
        "grouping_id",
        "project_count",
        "active_project_count",
        "actual_cost",
        "approved_change_value",
        "pipeline_change_value",
        "budget_k_floor",
        "remaining_k_ceil",
        "contingency_value",
        "avg_contingency_pct",
        "max_contract_100k_floor",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("grouping_id").desc(), "region_label", "status_label")
)

with prepared as (
    -- normalize authentication text, derive weak-method flags, and apply account policy
    select e.event_id,
           e.acct_id,
           e.occurred_at,
           e.auth_channel,
           e.status,
           regexp_extract(e.source_ip, r'^(\d+\.\d+)\.', 1) as subnet,
           lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(e.device_id, 'unknown'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '')) as device_norm,
           e.latency_ms,
           transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> upper(x)) as methods_upper,
           filter(transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> upper(x)), x -> x in ('PASSWORD', 'LEGACY')) as weak_methods,
           aggregate(transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> length(x)), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x) as method_name_chars,
           exists(e.attempted_methods, x -> x = 'push') as used_push,
           element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up') as step_up_points,
           from_json(p.policy_json, 'struct<required_factor:string,alert_floor:int>').required_factor as required_factor,
           cast(round(coalesce(e.latency_ms, 0) * p.risk_multiplier
                + coalesce(element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up'), 0) / 10.0, 2) as decimal(12,2)) as weighted_risk,
           floor((coalesce(e.latency_ms, 0) * p.risk_multiplier
                + coalesce(element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up'), 0) / 10.0) * 1.10) as risk_floor,
           ceil((coalesce(e.latency_ms, 0) * p.risk_multiplier
                + coalesce(element_at(p.risk_controls, 'step_up'), 0) / 10.0) + 0.5) as risk_ceiling,
           case
               when e.status = 'FAILURE'
                    and size(filter(transform(e.attempted_methods, x -> upper(x)), x -> x in ('PASSWORD', 'LEGACY'))) > 0
                   then 'WEAK_AUTH_FAILURE'
               when e.status = 'FAILURE' then 'FAILURE'
               when e.geo_country <> p.home_country then 'TRAVEL'
               else 'STANDARD'
           end as event_class
    from auth_login_events e
    join acct_security_profiles p on p.acct_id = e.acct_id
    where e.occurred_at >= timestamp '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
      and e.source_ip rlike '^[0-9]{1,3}(\\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$'
),
rollup_stats as (
    -- calculate detail, subnet subtotal, and grand-total security measures
    select subnet,
           auth_channel,
           grouping_id(subnet, auth_channel) as grp_id,
           count(*) as login_qty,
           count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILURE') as failed_qty,
           count(*) filter (where event_class = 'TRAVEL') as travel_qty,
           percentile_approx(coalesce(latency_ms, 0), 0.5) as p50_latency_ms,
           array_sort(collect_set(device_norm)) as device_ids,
           max(weighted_risk) as max_weighted_risk,
           sum(step_up_points) filter (where used_push) as push_step_up_points,
           max(case when required_factor = 'mfa' and not used_push then 1 else 0 end) as mfa_gap_flag
    from prepared
    group by grouping sets ((subnet, auth_channel), (subnet), ())
),
metric_wide as (
    -- pivot the snapshot metric names into typed decimal columns
    select *
    from login_metric_snapshots
    pivot (
        max(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'FAILED_LOGINS' as failed_logins,
            'MEDIAN_LATENCY_MS' as median_latency_ms,

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

methods_upper = F.transform(F.col("e.attempted_methods"), lambda x: F.upper(x))
weak_methods = F.filter(methods_upper, lambda x: x.isin("PASSWORD", "LEGACY"))
step_up_points = F.element_at(F.col("p.risk_controls"), F.lit("step_up"))
raw_risk = (
    F.coalesce(F.col("e.latency_ms"), F.lit(0)) * F.col("p.risk_multiplier")
    + F.coalesce(step_up_points, F.lit(0)) / F.lit(10.0)
)
event_class = (
    F.when((F.col("e.status") == "FAILURE") & (F.size(weak_methods) > 0), "WEAK_AUTH_FAILURE")
    .when(F.col("e.status") == "FAILURE", "FAILURE")
    .when(F.col("e.geo_country") != F.col("p.home_country"), "TRAVEL")
    .otherwise("STANDARD")
)
prepared = (
    df_auth_login_events.alias("e")
    .join(df_acct_security_profiles.alias("p"), F.col("p.acct_id") == F.col("e.acct_id"))
    .filter(
        (F.col("e.occurred_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-10 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & F.col("e.source_ip").rlike(r"^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$")
    )
    .select(
        F.col("e.event_id").alias("event_id"),
        F.col("e.acct_id").alias("acct_id"),
        F.col("e.occurred_at").alias("occurred_at"),
        F.col("e.auth_channel").alias("auth_channel"),
        F.col("e.status").alias("status"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("e.source_ip"), r"^(\d+\.\d+)\.", 1).alias("subnet"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.coalesce(F.col("e.device_id"), F.lit("unknown")), "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "")).alias("device_norm"),
        F.col("e.latency_ms").alias("latency_ms"),
        methods_upper.alias("methods_upper"),
        weak_methods.alias("weak_methods"),
        F.aggregate(F.transform(F.col("e.attempted_methods"), lambda x: F.length(x)), F.lit(0), lambda acc, x: acc + x).alias("method_name_chars"),
        F.exists(F.col("e.attempted_methods"), lambda x: x == "push").alias("used_push"),
        step_up_points.alias("step_up_points"),
        F.from_json(F.col("p.policy_json"), "struct<required_factor:string,alert_floor:int>").getField("required_factor").alias("required_factor"),
        F.round(raw_risk, 2).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("weighted_risk"),
        F.floor(raw_risk * F.lit(1.10)).alias("risk_floor"),
        F.ceil(raw_risk + F.lit(0.5)).alias("risk_ceiling"),
        event_class.alias("event_class"),
    )
)

def aggregate_stats(group_cols):
    return prepared.groupBy(*group_cols).agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("login_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILURE", F.lit(1))).alias("failed_qty"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_class") == "TRAVEL", F.lit(1))).alias("travel_qty"),
        F.percentile_approx(F.coalesce(F.col("latency_ms"), F.lit(0)), 0.5).alias("p50_latency_ms"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("device_norm")).alias("device_ids"),
        F.max("weighted_risk").alias("max_weighted_risk"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("used_push"), F.col("step_up_points"))).alias("push_step_up_points"),
        F.max(F.when((F.col("required_factor") == "mfa") & (~F.col("used_push")), F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))).alias("mfa_gap_flag"),
    )

def shape_stats(frame, subnet_expr, channel_expr, grp_id):
    return frame.select(
        subnet_expr.alias("subnet"),
        channel_expr.alias("auth_channel"),
        F.lit(grp_id).alias("grp_id"),
        "login_qty",
        "failed_qty",
        "travel_qty",
        "p50_latency_ms",
        "device_ids",
        "max_weighted_risk",
        "push_step_up_points",
        "mfa_gap_flag",
    )

rollup_stats = (
    shape_stats(aggregate_stats(["subnet", "auth_channel"]), F.col("subnet"), F.col("auth_channel"), 0)
    .unionByName(shape_stats(aggregate_stats(["subnet"]), F.col("subnet"), F.lit(None).cast("string"), 1))
    .unionByName(shape_stats(aggregate_stats([]), F.lit(None).cast("string"), F.lit(None).cast("string"), 3))
)

metric_wide = (
    df_login_metric_snapshots
    .groupBy("subnet", "auth_channel")
    .pivot("metric", ["FAILED_LOGINS", "MEDIAN_LATENCY_MS", "UNIQUE_DEVICES"])
    .agg(F.max("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "subnet",
        "auth_channel",
        F.col("FAILED_LOGINS").alias("failed_logins"),
        F.col("MEDIAN_LATENCY_MS").alias("median_latency_ms"),
        F.col("UNIQUE_DEVICES").alias("unique_devices"),
    )
)
metric_long = (
    metric_wide
    .unpivot(
        ["subnet", "auth_channel"],
        ["failed_logins", "median_latency_ms", "unique_devices"],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)
scored = (
    rollup_stats.alias("r")
    .join(
        metric_long.alias("m"),
        (F.col("r.grp_id") == 0)
        & (F.col("m.subnet") == F.col("r.subnet"))
        & (F.col("m.auth_channel") == F.col("r.auth_channel")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(F.col("r.*"), F.col("m.metric_name"), F.col("m.metric_value"))
)
result = (
    scored
    .orderBy(
        F.col("grp_id"),
        F.col("subnet").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("auth_channel").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("metric_name"),
    )
    .select(
        "subnet",
        F.coalesce(F.col("auth_channel"), F.lit("ALL_CHANNELS")).alias("auth_channel"),
        "grp_id",
        F.when(F.col("grp_id") == 0, "SUBNET_CHANNEL")
        .when(F.col("grp_id") == 1, "SUBNET_TOTAL")
        .otherwise("GRAND_TOTAL")
        .alias("auth_scope"),
        "login_qty",
        "failed_qty",
        "travel_qty",
        F.round(
            F.col("failed_qty").cast("decimal(12,4)") * F.lit(100)
            / F.when(F.col("login_qty") != 0, F.col("login_qty")),
            2,
        ).alias("failure_pct"),
        "p50_latency_ms",
        F.concat_ws(",", F.col("device_ids")).alias("device_list"),
        "max_weighted_risk",
        "push_step_up_points",
        "mfa_gap_flag",
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
)

with po_base as (
    -- clean purchase orders and derive timing and nested payload fields
    select
        po_id,
        vendor_id,
        buyer_acct,
        status,
        total_amt,
        txn_ts,
        actual_receipt_ts,
        date_trunc('month', txn_ts) as txn_month,
        txn_ts + interval '36' hour as ack_due_ts,
        coalesce(actual_receipt_ts, txn_ts + interval '240' hour) as effective_receipt_ts,
        datediff(promised_date, cast(txn_ts as date)) as promise_days,
        timestampdiff(
            hour,
            txn_ts,
            coalesce(actual_receipt_ts, txn_ts + interval '240' hour)
        ) as receipt_hours,
        shipping_address.country as ship_country,
        from_json(payload_json, 'source STRING, expedited BOOLEAN, priority INT') as po_meta,
        case
            when actual_receipt_ts is null then 'PENDING'
            when actual_receipt_ts <= cast(promised_date as timestamp) + interval '1' day
                then 'ON_TIME'
            else 'LATE'
        end as delivery_health
    from purchase_order_headers
    where txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      and status <> 'CANCELLED'
),
line_totals as (
    -- collapse line-item quantities and amounts to one row per po
    select
        po_id,
        sum(qty * unit_price) as line_amt,
        sum(receipt_qty) as received_qty,
        count(distinct sku) as sku_count
    from purchase_order_lines
    group by po_id
),
po_activity as (
    -- attach commercial line measures and flatten JSON attributes
    select
        h.*,
        coalesce(l.line_amt, 0) as line_amt,
        coalesce(l.received_qty, 0) as received_qty,
        l.sku_count,
        coalesce(h.po_meta.expedited, false) as expedited_flag,
        coalesce(h.po_meta.priority, 9) as priority
    from po_base h
    join line_totals l on l.po_id = h.po_id
),
po_timeline as (
    -- compare each txn with neighboring vendor activity and nearby promises
    select
        a.*,
        lag(txn_ts, 1, timestamp '2024-12-31 00:00:00') over (
            partition by vendor_id order by txn_ts, po_id
        ) as prev_txn_ts,
        lead(status, 2, 'END_OF_QUEUE') over (
            partition by vendor_id order by txn_ts, po_id
        ) as status_two_pos_ahead,
        sum(total_amt) over (
            partition by vendor_id
            order by promise_days
            range between 2 preceding and current row
        ) as nearby_promise_spend
    from po_activity a
),
vendor_quality as (
    -- pivot the current monthly vendor scorecard into quality measures
    select *
    from (
        select vendor_id, metric, score_value
        from vendor_scorecards
        where metric_month = date '2025-03-01'
    )
    pivot (
        avg(score_value)
        for metric in (
            'OTD' as otd,
            'DEFECT' as defect_rate,
            'RESPONSE' as response_score
        )
    )
),
enriched as (
    -- retain the po star while adding active vendor maps and quality scores
    select
        a.*,
        v.vendor_name,
        v.region,
        element_at(v.vendor_attributes, 'tier') as vendor_tier,
        size(map_keys(v.vendor_attributes)) as attribute_count,
        q.otd,
        q.defect_rate,
        q.response_score
    from po_timeline a
    join vendor_master v
      on v.vendor_id = a.vendor_id
     and v.active_flag = true
    left join vendor_quality q on q.vendor_id = a.vendor_id
)
-- summarize detail months, vendor subtotals, and one enterprise total
select
    coalesce(vendor_name, 'ALL_VENDORS') as vendor_label,
    txn_month,
    grouping_id(vendor_name, txn_month) as grp_level,
    count(distinct po_id) as po_count,
    sum(distinct total_amt) as distinct_po_spend,
    round(avg(line_amt), 2) as avg_line_amt,
    sum(case when delivery_health = 'LATE' then 1 else 0 end) as late_pos,
    sum(case when expedited_flag then 1 else 0 end) as expedited_pos,
    round(avg(priority), 2) as avg_priority,
    round(avg(receipt_hours), 1) as avg_receipt_hours,
    max(datediff(txn_ts, prev_txn_ts)) as max_gap_days,
    sum(case when status_two_pos_ahead = 'END_OF_QUEUE' then 1 else 0 end) as queue_tail_pos,
    max(nearby_promise_spend) as peak_nearby_promise_spend,
    max(vendor_tier) as vendor_tier,
    max(attribute_count) as attribute_count,

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

po_base = (
    df_purchase_order_headers
    .filter(
        (F.col("txn_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("status") != "CANCELLED")
    )
    .select(
        "po_id",
        "vendor_id",
        "buyer_acct",
        "status",
        "total_amt",
        "txn_ts",
        "actual_receipt_ts",
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("txn_ts")).alias("txn_month"),
        (F.col("txn_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("ack_due_ts"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.col("actual_receipt_ts"),
            F.col("txn_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '240' HOUR"),
        ).alias("effective_receipt_ts"),
        F.datediff(F.col("promised_date"), F.col("txn_ts").cast("date")).alias("promise_days"),
        F.expr(
            "timestampdiff(hour, txn_ts, "
            "coalesce(actual_receipt_ts, txn_ts + interval '240' hour))"
        ).alias("receipt_hours"),
        F.col("shipping_address.country").alias("ship_country"),
        F.from_json(
            F.col("payload_json"),
            "source STRING, expedited BOOLEAN, priority INT",
        ).alias("po_meta"),
        F.when(F.col("actual_receipt_ts").isNull(), F.lit("PENDING"))
        .when(
            F.col("actual_receipt_ts")
            <= F.col("promised_date").cast("timestamp") + F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"),
            F.lit("ON_TIME"),
        )
        .otherwise(F.lit("LATE"))
        .alias("delivery_health"),
    )
)

line_totals = (
    df_purchase_order_lines
    .groupBy("po_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.col("qty") * F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_amt"),
        F.sum("receipt_qty").alias("received_qty"),
        F.countDistinct("sku").alias("sku_count"),
    )
)

po_activity = (
    po_base.alias("h")
    .join(line_totals.alias("l"), F.col("l.po_id") == F.col("h.po_id"))
    .select(
        "h.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("l.line_amt"), F.lit(0)).alias("line_amt"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("l.received_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("received_qty"),
        F.col("l.sku_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("h.po_meta.expedited"), F.lit(False)).alias("expedited_flag"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("h.po_meta.priority"), F.lit(9)).alias("priority"),
    )
)

w_vendor_txn = Window.partitionBy("vendor_id").orderBy("txn_ts", "po_id")
w_promise_range = (
    Window.partitionBy("vendor_id")
    .orderBy("promise_days")
    .rangeBetween(-2, 0)
)

po_timeline = (
    po_activity.alias("a")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.lag("txn_ts", 1, "2024-12-31 00:00:00")
        .over(w_vendor_txn)
        .alias("prev_txn_ts"),
        F.lead("status", 2, "END_OF_QUEUE")
        .over(w_vendor_txn)
        .alias("status_two_pos_ahead"),
        F.sum("total_amt")
        .over(w_promise_range)
        .alias("nearby_promise_spend"),
    )
)

vendor_quality = (
    df_vendor_scorecards
    .filter(F.col("metric_month") == F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date"))
    .select("vendor_id", "metric", "score_value")
    .groupBy("vendor_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["OTD", "DEFECT", "RESPONSE"])
    .agg(F.avg("score_value"))
    .withColumnRenamed("OTD", "otd")
    .withColumnRenamed("DEFECT", "defect_rate")
    .withColumnRenamed("RESPONSE", "response_score")
)

enriched = (
    po_timeline.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_vendor_master.alias("v"),
        (F.col("v.vendor_id") == F.col("a.vendor_id")) & F.col("v.active_flag"),
    )
    .join(
        vendor_quality.alias("q"),
        F.col("q.vendor_id") == F.col("a.vendor_id"),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "a.*",
        "v.vendor_name",
        "v.region",
        F.element_at(F.col("v.vendor_attributes"), F.lit("tier")).alias("vendor_tier"),
        F.size(F.map_keys(F.col("v.vendor_attributes"))).alias("attribute_count"),
        "q.otd",
        "q.defect_rate",
        "q.response_score",
    )
)

rolled_up = (
    enriched
    .rollup("vendor_name", "txn_month")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id("vendor_name", "txn_month").alias("grp_level"),
        F.countDistinct("po_id").alias("po_count"),
        F.sumDistinct("total_amt").alias("distinct_po_spend"),
        F.round(F.avg("line_amt"), 2).alias("avg_line_amt"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("delivery_health") == "LATE", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("late_pos"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("expedited_flag"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("expedited_pos"),
        F.round(F.avg("priority"), 2).alias("avg_priority"),
        F.round(F.avg("receipt_hours"), 1).alias("avg_receipt_hours"),
        F.max(F.datediff(F.col("txn_ts"), F.col("prev_txn_ts"))).alias("max_gap_days"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("status_two_pos_ahead") == "END_OF_QUEUE", 1).otherwise(0)
        ).alias("queue_tail_pos"),
        F.max("nearby_promise_spend").alias("peak_nearby_promise_spend"),
        F.max("vendor_tier").alias("vendor_tier"),
        F.max("attribute_count").alias("attribute_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("otd"), 1).alias("avg_otd"),
        F.round(F.avg("defect_rate"), 2).alias("avg_defect_rate"),
    )
)

result = (
    rolled_up
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("vendor_name"), F.lit("ALL_VENDORS")).alias("vendor_label"),
        "txn_month",
        "grp_level",
        "po_count",
        "distinct_po_spend",
        "avg_line_amt",
        "late_pos",
        "expedited_pos",
        "avg_priority",
        "avg_receipt_hours",
        "max_gap_days",
        "queue_tail_pos",
        "peak_nearby_promise_spend",
        "vendor_tier",
        "attribute_count",
        "avg_otd",
        "avg_defect_rate",
    )
    .orderBy(
        "grp_level",
        "vendor_label",
        F.col("txn_month").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

/*
  Learning-session quality report.
  Explodes quiz responses, summarizes attempt bands, and joins them to
  gap-based study sessions for course coaches.
*/
with answer_detail as (
    -- one row per response; retain only attempts in the reporting window
    select
        a.attempt_id, a.learner_id, a.course_id, a.status, a.score,
        concat(
            get_json_object(a.device_info_json, '$.device'), '-v',
            regexp_extract(get_json_object(a.device_info_json, '$.app_version'), '^(\\d+)', 1)
        ) as device_label,
        item.question_id, item.awarded_points,
        case when item.question_id rlike '^(MCQ|CODE)-' then 'auto' else 'manual' end as grading_kind,
        transform(filter(item.tags, x -> x is not null), x -> upper(x)) as clean_tags,
        exists(item.tags, x -> x = 'critical') as has_critical
    from quiz_attempts a
    lateral view explode(a.answer_reviews) ans as item
    where a.started_at >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
),
attempt_rollup as (
    select
        learner_id, course_id, attempt_id, status, score,
        max(device_label) as device_label,
        count(*) as answer_count,
        count(*) filter (where grading_kind = 'auto') as auto_answers,
        sum(
            awarded_points + size(clean_tags)
            + case when has_critical then 5 else 0 end
        ) as weighted_points,
        case
            when score >= 85 then 'gold'
            when score >= 70 then 'silver'
            else 'bronze'
        end as score_band
    from answer_detail
    group by learner_id, course_id, attempt_id, status, score
),
band_pivot as (
    -- string bands and numeric response metrics in one pivot
    select
        learner_id, course_id,
        coalesce(graded_band, 'none') as graded_band,
        coalesce(review_band, 'none') as review_band,
        coalesce(abandoned_band, 'none') as abandoned_band,
        graded_points, review_points, abandoned_points,
        graded_auto_answers, review_auto_answers, abandoned_auto_answers,
        graded_device, review_device, abandoned_device
    from (
        select learner_id, course_id, status, score_band, weighted_points,
               auto_answers, device_label
        from attempt_rollup
    )
    pivot (
        max(score_band) as band,
        sum(weighted_points) as points,
        sum(auto_answers) as auto_answers,
        max(device_label) as device
        for status in (
            'graded' as graded, 'review' as review, 'abandoned' as abandoned
        )
    )
),
activity_gaps as (
    -- exactly thirty minutes stays in the same session
    select
        event_id, learner_id, course_id, event_ts, event_type, minutes_spent,
        lag(event_ts, 1, event_ts) over w as prev_event_ts,
        case
            when event_ts > lag(event_ts, 1, event_ts) over w + interval '30' minute
            then 1 else 0
        end as gap_flag
    from learning_activity
    where learner_id is not null
      and event_type rlike '^(video|quiz|note)$'
    window w as (
        partition by learner_id, course_id order by event_ts, event_id
    )
),
sessionized as (
    select
        activity_gaps.*,
        sum(gap_flag) over (
            partition by learner_id, course_id
            order by event_ts, event_id
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row
        ) as session_seq
    from activity_gaps
),
session_stats as (
    select
        learner_id, course_id, session_seq,
        min(event_ts) as session_start,
        max(event_ts) as session_end,
        count(*) as event_count,
        count(*) filter (where event_type = 'quiz') as quiz_events,
        sum(minutes_spent) as active_minutes
    from sessionized
    group by learner_id, course_id, session_seq
)
select
    s.*,
    regexp_replace(c.course_title, '\\s+', ' ') as course_title,
    element_at(c.attrs, 'level') as course_level,
    size(map_keys(c.attrs)) as attr_count,
    array_contains(map_values(c.attrs), 'yes') as hands_on,
    b.graded_band, b.review_band, b.abandoned_band,
    coalesce(b.graded_points, 0) + coalesce(b.review_points, 0)
        + coalesce(b.abandoned_points, 0) as weighted_points,
    coalesce(b.graded_auto_answers, 0) + coalesce(b.review_auto_answers, 0)
        + coalesce(b.abandoned_auto_answers, 0) as auto_answers,
    coalesce(b.graded_device, b.review_device, b.abandoned_device) as device_label,
    lag(s.active_minutes, 1, cast(0 as bigint)) over learner_sessions as prev_session_minutes,
    lead(s.active_minutes, 1, cast(0 as bigint)) over learner_sessions as next_session_minutes
from session_stats s
join course_catalog c on c.course_id = s.course_id
left join band_pivot b
  on b.learner_id = s.learner_id and b.course_id = s.course_id
window learner_sessions as (
    partition by s.learner_id
    order by s.session_start, s.course_id, s.session_seq
)
order by
    s.active_minutes desc nulls last,
    b.graded_band desc nulls last,
    s.session_start desc nulls last,
    s.learner_id, s.course_id, s.session_seq

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

answer_detail = (
    df_quiz_attempts.alias("a")
    .filter(F.col("a.started_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        F.col("a.attempt_id").alias("attempt_id"),
        F.col("a.learner_id").alias("learner_id"),
        F.col("a.course_id").alias("course_id"),
        F.col("a.status").alias("status"),
        F.col("a.score").alias("score"),
        F.concat(
            F.get_json_object(F.col("a.device_info_json"), "$.device"),
            F.lit("-v"),
            F.regexp_extract(
                F.get_json_object(F.col("a.device_info_json"), "$.app_version"),
                r"^(\d+)",
                1,
            ),
        ).alias("device_label"),
        F.explode(F.col("a.answer_reviews")).alias("ans"),
    )
    .select(
        "attempt_id",
        "learner_id",
        "course_id",
        "status",
        "score",
        "device_label",
        F.col("ans.question_id").alias("question_id"),
        F.col("ans.awarded_points").alias("awarded_points"),
        F.when(F.col("ans.question_id").rlike("^(MCQ|CODE)-"), "auto")
        .otherwise("manual")
        .alias("grading_kind"),
        F.transform(
            F.filter(F.col("ans.tags"), lambda x: x.isNotNull()),
            lambda x: F.upper(x),
        ).alias("clean_tags"),
        F.exists(F.col("ans.tags"), lambda x: x == "critical").alias("has_critical"),
    )
)

attempt_rollup = (
    answer_detail
    .groupBy("learner_id", "course_id", "attempt_id", "status", "score")
    .agg(
        F.max("device_label").alias("device_label"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("answer_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("grading_kind") == "auto", F.lit(1))).alias("auto_answers"),
        F.sum(
            F.col("awarded_points")
            + F.size("clean_tags")
            + F.when(F.col("has_critical"), 5).otherwise(0)
        ).alias("weighted_points"),
        F.when(F.col("score") >= 85, "gold")
        .when(F.col("score") >= 70, "silver")
        .otherwise("bronze")
        .alias("score_band"),
    )
)

band_pivot = (
    attempt_rollup
    .select(
        "learner_id",
        "course_id",
        "status",
        "score_band",
        "weighted_points",
        "auto_answers",
        "device_label",
    )
    .groupBy("learner_id", "course_id")
    .pivot("status", ["graded", "review", "abandoned"])
    .agg(
        F.max("score_band").alias("band"),
        F.sum("weighted_points").alias("points"),
        F.sum("auto_answers").alias("auto_answers"),
        F.max("device_label").alias("device"),
    )
    .select(
        "learner_id",
        "course_id",
        F.coalesce(F.col("graded_band"), F.lit("none")).alias("graded_band"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("review_band"), F.lit("none")).alias("review_band"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("abandoned_band"), F.lit("none")).alias("abandoned_band"),
        "graded_points",
        "review_points",
        "abandoned_points",
        "graded_auto_answers",
        "review_auto_answers",
        "abandoned_auto_answers",
        "graded_device",
        "review_device",
        "abandoned_device",
    )
)

w_activity = Window.partitionBy("learner_id", "course_id").orderBy("event_ts", "event_id")
activity_gaps = (
    df_learning_activity
    .filter(F.col("learner_id").isNotNull() & F.col("event_type").rlike("^(video|quiz|note)$"))
    .withColumn(
        "prev_event_ts",
        F.coalesce(F.lag("event_ts", 1).over(w_activity), F.col("event_ts")),
    )
    .withColumn(
        "gap_flag",
        F.when(
            F.col("event_ts") > F.col("prev_event_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '30' MINUTE"),
            1,
        ).otherwise(0),
    )
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "learner_id",
        "course_id",
        "event_ts",
        "event_type",
        "minutes_spent",
        "prev_event_ts",
        "gap_flag",
    )
)

w_session_rows = w_activity.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
sessionized = (
    activity_gaps
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("gap_flag").over(w_session_rows).alias("session_seq"),
    )
)

session_stats = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("learner_id", "course_id", "session_seq")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("event_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "quiz", F.lit(1))).alias("quiz_events"),
        F.sum("minutes_spent").alias("active_minutes"),
    )
)

w_learner_sessions = Window.partitionBy("s.learner_id").orderBy(
    "s.session_start", "s.course_id", "s.session_seq"
)
result = (
    session_stats.alias("s")
    .join(df_course_catalog.alias("c"), F.col("c.course_id") == F.col("s.course_id"))
    .join(
        band_pivot.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.learner_id") == F.col("s.learner_id"))
        & (F.col("b.course_id") == F.col("s.course_id")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.regexp_replace(F.col("c.course_title"), r"\s+", " ").alias("course_title"),
        F.element_at(F.col("c.attrs"), F.lit("level")).alias("course_level"),
        F.size(F.map_keys(F.col("c.attrs"))).alias("attr_count"),
        F.array_contains(F.map_values(F.col("c.attrs")), "yes").alias("hands_on"),
        F.col("b.graded_band").alias("graded_band"),
        F.col("b.review_band").alias("review_band"),
        F.col("b.abandoned_band").alias("abandoned_band"),
        (
            F.coalesce(F.col("b.graded_points"), F.lit(0))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("b.review_points"), F.lit(0))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("b.abandoned_points"), F.lit(0))
        ).alias("weighted_points"),
        (
            F.coalesce(F.col("b.graded_auto_answers"), F.lit(0))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("b.review_auto_answers"), F.lit(0))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("b.abandoned_auto_answers"), F.lit(0))
        ).alias("auto_answers"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.graded_device"), F.col("b.review_device"), F.col("b.abandoned_device")).alias("device_label"),
        F.lag(F.col("s.active_minutes"), 1, 0).over(w_learner_sessions).alias("prev_session_minutes"),

    )

/*
  Monthly review of exceptional circulation activity.
  Open/renewed loans and notable March returns are eligible only when a
  related hold exists and the checkout did not overlap a patron suspension.
*/
WITH branch_metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT branch_id, metric, metric_value
        FROM branch_metrics
        WHERE snapshot_date = DATE '2025-03-31'
    ) metric_src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'CIRCULATION' AS circulation,
            'HOLDS_FILLED' AS holds_filled,
            'OVERDUE_ITEMS' AS overdue_items
        )
    )
),
loan_base AS (
    -- Branch one: unresolved late loans plus renewed open loans.
    SELECT loan_id, item_barcode, member_id, branch_id,
           checked_out_at, due_at, returned_at, renewal_count,
           fine_amount, loan_attributes, 'OPEN_OR_RENEWED' AS selection_branch
    FROM loan_ledger
    WHERE returned_at IS NULL
      AND (due_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' OR renewal_count > 0)
    UNION ALL
    -- Branch two: returned loans still need review for fines or heavy renewal.
    SELECT loan_id, item_barcode, member_id, branch_id,
           checked_out_at, due_at, returned_at, renewal_count,
           fine_amount, loan_attributes, 'RECENT_RETURN' AS selection_branch
    FROM loan_ledger
    WHERE returned_at IS NOT NULL
      AND returned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND (fine_amount > 0 OR renewal_count >= 2)
),
flagged_loans AS (
    SELECT l.*,
           coalesce(nullif(element_at(l.loan_attributes, 'format'), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS loan_format,
           concat_ws(':', l.branch_id, lpad(CAST(l.member_id AS STRING), 4, '0'),
                     upper(array_join(slice(split(element_at(l.loan_attributes, 'call_number'), '\\.'), 1, 2), '-')),
                     l.selection_branch) AS audit_label,
           array_join(array_sort(map_keys(l.loan_attributes)), ',') AS attribute_keys,
           date_trunc('DAY', l.checked_out_at) AS checkout_day,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, l.checked_out_at, l.due_at) AS scheduled_hours,
           datediff(coalesce(l.returned_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'), l.checked_out_at) AS days_out,
           l.due_at + INTERVAL '3' DAY AS grace_deadline,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00', l.checked_out_at) AS checkout_hour_seq
    FROM loan_base l
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM hold_requests h
        WHERE h.member_id = l.member_id
          AND h.branch_id = l.branch_id
          AND h.status IN ('READY', 'QUEUED')
          AND h.requested_at <= l.due_at + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM patron_suspensions s
        WHERE s.member_id = l.member_id
          AND l.checked_out_at BETWEEN s.starts_at
              AND coalesce(s.ends_at + INTERVAL '1' DAY, l.checked_out_at + INTERVAL '1' DAY)
    )
),
scored_loans AS (
    SELECT f.*,
           b.branch_name,
           b.contact_info.email AS support_email,
           p.circulation, p.holds_filled, p.overdue_items,
           CASE
               WHEN f.returned_at IS NULL AND coalesce(f.fine_amount, 0) >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_FINE'
               WHEN f.returned_at IS NULL AND TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' > f.grace_deadline THEN 'OVERDUE'
               WHEN p.overdue_items >= 4 THEN 'BRANCH_WATCH'
               WHEN f.renewal_count >= 2 THEN 'RENEWAL_HEAVY'
               ELSE 'STANDARD'
           END AS risk_label,
           SUM(coalesce(f.fine_amount, 0)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY f.member_id
               ORDER BY f.checkout_hour_seq
               RANGE BETWEEN 168 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS rolling_week_fines
    FROM flagged_loans f
    JOIN branch_directory b ON b.branch_id = f.branch_id
    JOIN branch_metric_pivot p ON p.branch_id = f.branch_id
)
SELECT branch_id,
       max(branch_name) AS branch_name,
       loan_format,
       risk_label,
       GROUPING_ID(branch_id, loan_format, risk_label) AS grouping_level,
       CASE
           WHEN GROUPING(branch_id) = 1 THEN 'NETWORK'
           WHEN GROUPING(loan_format) = 1 THEN 'BRANCH_TOTAL'
           WHEN GROUPING(risk_label) = 1 THEN 'FORMAT_TOTAL'
           ELSE 'DETAIL'
       END AS summary_scope,
       count(*) AS loan_count,
       count(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN returned_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_loans,
       round(SUM(coalesce(fine_amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))), 2) AS fine_total,
       round(avg(coalesce(rolling_week_fines, 0)), 2) AS avg_rolling_member_fines,
       round(avg(scheduled_hours), 1) AS avg_scheduled_hours,
       round(avg(days_out), 1) AS avg_days_out,
       max(audit_label) AS sample_audit_label,
       max(support_email) AS support_email,
       max(attribute_keys) AS sample_attribute_keys
FROM scored_loans
GROUP BY ROLLUP (branch_id, loan_format, risk_label)
ORDER BY grouping_level, branch_id NULLS LAST, loan_format NULLS LAST, risk_label NULLS LAST
