from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

branch_metric_pivot = (
    df_branch_metrics
    .filter(F.col("snapshot_date") == F.lit("2025-03-31").cast("date"))
    .groupBy("branch_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["CIRCULATION", "HOLDS_FILLED", "OVERDUE_ITEMS"])
    .agg(F.sum("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "branch_id",
        F.col("CIRCULATION").alias("circulation"),
        F.col("HOLDS_FILLED").alias("holds_filled"),
        F.col("OVERDUE_ITEMS").alias("overdue_items"),
    )
)

open_or_renewed = (
    df_loan_ledger
    .filter(
        F.col("returned_at").isNull()
        & ((F.col("due_at") < F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")) | (F.col("renewal_count") > 0))
    )
    .select(
        "loan_id", "item_barcode", "member_id", "branch_id",
        "checked_out_at", "due_at", "returned_at", "renewal_count",
        "fine_amount", "loan_attributes", F.lit("OPEN_OR_RENEWED").alias("selection_branch"),
    )
)
recent_returns = (
    df_loan_ledger
    .filter(
        F.col("returned_at").isNotNull()
        & (F.col("returned_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & ((F.col("fine_amount") > 0) | (F.col("renewal_count") >= 2))
    )
    .select(
        "loan_id", "item_barcode", "member_id", "branch_id",
        "checked_out_at", "due_at", "returned_at", "renewal_count",
        "fine_amount", "loan_attributes", F.lit("RECENT_RETURN").alias("selection_branch"),
    )
)
loan_base = open_or_renewed.union(recent_returns)

hold_match = (
    (F.col("h.member_id") == F.col("l.member_id"))
    & (F.col("h.branch_id") == F.col("l.branch_id"))
    & F.col("h.status").isin("READY", "QUEUED")
    & (F.col("h.requested_at") <= F.col("l.due_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY"))
)
suspension_overlap = (
    (F.col("s.member_id") == F.col("l.member_id"))
    & F.col("l.checked_out_at").between(
        F.col("s.starts_at"),
        F.coalesce(
            F.col("s.ends_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"),
            F.col("l.checked_out_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY"),
        ),
    )
)
flagged_loans = (
    loan_base.alias("l")
    .join(df_hold_requests.alias("h"), hold_match, "left_semi")
    .join(df_patron_suspensions.alias("s"), suspension_overlap, "left_anti")
    .select(
        "l.*",
        F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.element_at(F.col("l.loan_attributes"), "format"), F.lit("")), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("loan_format"),
        F.concat_ws(
            ":",
            F.col("l.branch_id"),
            F.lpad(F.col("l.member_id").cast("string"), 4, "0"),
            F.upper(F.array_join(F.slice(F.split(F.element_at(F.col("l.loan_attributes"), "call_number"), r"\."), 1, 2), "-")),
            F.col("l.selection_branch"),
        ).alias("audit_label"),
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.map_keys(F.col("l.loan_attributes"))), ",").alias("attribute_keys"),
        F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("l.checked_out_at")).alias("checkout_day"),
        F.expr("TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, l.checked_out_at, l.due_at)").alias("scheduled_hours"),
        F.datediff(
            F.coalesce(F.col("l.returned_at"), F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")),
            F.col("l.checked_out_at"),
        ).alias("days_out"),
        (F.col("l.due_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '3' DAY")).alias("grace_deadline"),
        F.expr("TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00', l.checked_out_at)").alias("checkout_hour_seq"),
    )
)

w_rolling_fines = Window.partitionBy("f.member_id").orderBy("f.checkout_hour_seq").rangeBetween(-168, 0)
risk_label = (
    F.when(F.col("f.returned_at").isNull() & (F.coalesce(F.col("f.fine_amount"), F.lit(0)) >= 10), F.lit("HIGH_FINE"))
    .when(
        F.col("f.returned_at").isNull()
        & (F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp") > F.col("f.grace_deadline")),
        F.lit("OVERDUE"),
    )
    .when(F.col("p.overdue_items") >= 4, F.lit("BRANCH_WATCH"))
    .when(F.col("f.renewal_count") >= 2, F.lit("RENEWAL_HEAVY"))
    .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
)
scored_loans = (
    flagged_loans.alias("f")
    .join(df_branch_directory.alias("b"), F.col("b.branch_id") == F.col("f.branch_id"))
    .join(branch_metric_pivot.alias("p"), F.col("p.branch_id") == F.col("f.branch_id"))
    .select(
        "f.*",
        F.col("b.branch_name"),
        F.col("b.contact_info.email").alias("support_email"),
        F.col("p.circulation"),
        F.col("p.holds_filled"),
        F.col("p.overdue_items"),
        risk_label.alias("risk_label"),
        F.sum(F.coalesce(F.col("f.fine_amount"), F.lit(0))).over(w_rolling_fines).alias("rolling_week_fines"),
    )
)

zero_fine = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")
result = (
    scored_loans
    .rollup("branch_id", "loan_format", "risk_label")
    .agg(
        F.max("branch_name").alias("branch_name"),
        F.grouping_id("branch_id", "loan_format", "risk_label").alias("grouping_level"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("loan_count"),
        F.countDistinct("member_id").alias("member_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("returned_at").isNull(), F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))).alias("open_loans"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.coalesce(F.col("fine_amount"), zero_fine)), 2).alias("fine_total"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.coalesce(F.col("rolling_week_fines"), F.lit(0))), 2).alias("avg_rolling_member_fines"),
        F.round(F.avg("scheduled_hours"), 1).alias("avg_scheduled_hours"),
        F.round(F.avg("days_out"), 1).alias("avg_days_out"),
        F.max("audit_label").alias("sample_audit_label"),
        F.max("support_email").alias("support_email"),
        F.max("attribute_keys").alias("sample_attribute_keys"),
    )
    .select(
        "branch_id", "branch_name", "loan_format", "risk_label", "grouping_level",
        F.when(F.col("grouping_level") == 7, F.lit("NETWORK"))

with shipment_context as (
    select
        c.container_id,
        c.vessel_code,
        c.cargo_owner,
        c.cargo_class,
        c.declared_weight_kg,
        c.handling_profile.destination.country as destination_country,
        c.handling_profile.priority as priority,
        from_json(c.profile_json, 'customs_lane string, fragile boolean') as parsed_profile,
        element_at(c.charge_adjustments, 'security') as security_adjustment,
        p.call_id,
        p.terminal_code,
        p.scheduled_arrival,
        p.scheduled_departure
    from container_registry c
    join port_call_schedule p
      on c.vessel_code = p.vessel_code
     and c.eta_ts between p.scheduled_arrival - interval '12' hour
                     and p.scheduled_departure + interval '6' hour
    where c.cargo_owner is not null
),
event_metrics as (
    select
        e.*,
        sum(e.fee_amount) over (
            partition by e.container_id
            order by e.handling_minutes
            range between 15 preceding and current row
        ) as local_fee_total
    from container_events e
    where e.event_ts >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and e.handling_minutes is not null
),
event_context as (
    select
        a.*,
        b.terminal_code,
        b.cargo_class,
        b.destination_country,
        b.priority,
        b.parsed_profile.customs_lane as customs_lane,
        b.security_adjustment
    from event_metrics a
    join shipment_context b
      on b.container_id = a.container_id
),
event_rollup as (
    -- Level 0 is terminal/event type, level 1 is terminal, level 3 is grand total.
    select
        terminal_code,
        event_type,
        grouping_id(terminal_code, event_type) as rollup_level,
        sum(distinct fee_amount) as distinct_fee_total,
        count(distinct event_id) as distinct_events,
        array_sort(collect_set(outcome)) as outcomes
    from event_context
    group by grouping sets (
        (terminal_code, event_type),
        (terminal_code),
        ()
    )
),
event_pivot as (
    select
        terminal_code,
        gate_in_outcome,
        load_outcome,
        customs_outcome
    from (
        select terminal_code, event_type, outcome
        from event_context
    ) pivot_source
    pivot (
        max(outcome)
        for event_type in (
            'GATE_IN' as gate_in_outcome,
            'LOAD' as load_outcome,
            'CUSTOMS' as customs_outcome
        )
    )
),
container_metrics as (
    select
        terminal_code,
        container_id,
        cargo_class,
        destination_country,
        priority,
        customs_lane,
        count(distinct event_id) as event_count,
        sum(fee_amount + coalesce(security_adjustment, 0)) as adjusted_fee_total,
        sum(handling_minutes) as handling_minutes_total,
        max(local_fee_total) as peak_local_fee_total
    from event_context
    group by
        terminal_code,
        container_id,
        cargo_class,
        destination_country,
        priority,
        customs_lane
)
select
    cm.terminal_code,
    cm.container_id,
    cm.cargo_class,
    cm.destination_country,
    cm.priority,
    cm.customs_lane,
    cm.metric_name,
    cm.metric_value,
    cm.adjusted_fee_total,
    cm.peak_local_fee_total,
    ep.gate_in_outcome,
    ep.load_outcome,
    ep.customs_outcome,
    er.distinct_fee_total as terminal_distinct_fee_total,
    er.distinct_events as terminal_distinct_events,
    er.outcomes as terminal_outcomes,
    ntile(3) over (
        partition by cm.metric_name
        order by cm.metric_value desc, cm.container_id
    ) as value_band,
    dense_rank() over (
        partition by cm.metric_name
        order by cm.metric_value desc, cm.container_id
    ) as value_rank
from container_metrics
unpivot (
    metric_value for metric_name in (event_count, handling_minutes_total)
) cm
join event_pivot ep
  on ep.terminal_code = cm.terminal_code
join event_rollup er
  on er.terminal_code = cm.terminal_code
 and er.rollup_level = 1
order by metric_name, value_band, container_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

shipment_context = (
    df_container_registry.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_port_call_schedule.alias("p"),
        (F.col("c.vessel_code") == F.col("p.vessel_code"))
        & (F.col("c.eta_ts") >= F.col("p.scheduled_arrival") - F.expr("INTERVAL '12' HOUR"))
        & (F.col("c.eta_ts") <= F.col("p.scheduled_departure") + F.expr("INTERVAL '6' HOUR")),
        "inner",
    )
    .filter(F.col("c.cargo_owner").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "c.container_id",
        "c.vessel_code",
        "c.cargo_owner",
        "c.cargo_class",
        "c.declared_weight_kg",
        F.col("c.handling_profile").getField("destination").getField("country").alias("destination_country"),
        F.col("c.handling_profile").getField("priority").alias("priority"),
        F.from_json(F.col("c.profile_json"), "customs_lane string, fragile boolean").alias("parsed_profile"),
        F.element_at(F.col("c.charge_adjustments"), F.lit("security")).alias("security_adjustment"),
        "p.call_id",
        "p.terminal_code",
        "p.scheduled_arrival",
        "p.scheduled_departure",
    )
)

w_local_fee = (
    Window.partitionBy("container_id")
    .orderBy("handling_minutes")
    .rangeBetween(-15, Window.currentRow)
)
event_metrics = (
    df_container_events.alias("e")
    .filter(
        (F.col("event_ts") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & F.col("handling_minutes").isNotNull()
    )
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.sum("fee_amount").over(w_local_fee).alias("local_fee_total"),
    )
)

event_context = (
    event_metrics.alias("a")
    .join(shipment_context.alias("b"), F.col("a.container_id") == F.col("b.container_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        "b.terminal_code",
        "b.cargo_class",
        "b.destination_country",
        "b.priority",
        F.col("b.parsed_profile").getField("customs_lane").alias("customs_lane"),
        "b.security_adjustment",
    )
)

event_rollup_by_type = (
    event_context
    .groupBy("terminal_code", "event_type")
    .agg(
        F.sumDistinct("fee_amount").alias("distinct_fee_total"),
        F.countDistinct("event_id").alias("distinct_events"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("outcome")).alias("outcomes"),
    )
    .withColumn("rollup_level", F.lit(0))
    .select("terminal_code", "event_type", "rollup_level", "distinct_fee_total", "distinct_events", "outcomes")
)
event_rollup_by_terminal = (
    event_context
    .groupBy("terminal_code")
    .agg(
        F.sumDistinct("fee_amount").alias("distinct_fee_total"),
        F.countDistinct("event_id").alias("distinct_events"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("outcome")).alias("outcomes"),
    )
    .withColumn("event_type", F.lit(None).cast("string"))
    .withColumn("rollup_level", F.lit(1))
    .select("terminal_code", "event_type", "rollup_level", "distinct_fee_total", "distinct_events", "outcomes")
)
event_rollup_total = (
    event_context
    .agg(
        F.sumDistinct("fee_amount").alias("distinct_fee_total"),
        F.countDistinct("event_id").alias("distinct_events"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("outcome")).alias("outcomes"),
    )
    .withColumn("terminal_code", F.lit(None).cast("string"))
    .withColumn("event_type", F.lit(None).cast("string"))
    .withColumn("rollup_level", F.lit(3))
    .select("terminal_code", "event_type", "rollup_level", "distinct_fee_total", "distinct_events", "outcomes")
)
event_rollup = (
    event_rollup_by_type
    .unionByName(event_rollup_by_terminal)
    .unionByName(event_rollup_total)
)

event_pivot = (
    event_context
    .groupBy("terminal_code")
    .pivot("event_type", ["GATE_IN", "LOAD", "CUSTOMS"])
    .agg(F.max("outcome"))
    .select(
        "terminal_code",
        F.col("GATE_IN").alias("gate_in_outcome"),
        F.col("LOAD").alias("load_outcome"),
        F.col("CUSTOMS").alias("customs_outcome"),
    )
)

container_metrics = (
    event_context
    .groupBy(
        "terminal_code",
        "container_id",
        "cargo_class",
        "destination_country",
        "priority",
        "customs_lane",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("event_id").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum(F.col("fee_amount") + F.coalesce(F.col("security_adjustment"), F.lit(0))).alias("adjusted_fee_total"),
        F.sum("handling_minutes").alias("handling_minutes_total"),
        F.max("local_fee_total").alias("peak_local_fee_total"),
    )
)

# SQL UNPIVOT excludes null values, so make that default explicit.
metric_rows = (
    container_metrics
    .unpivot(
        [
            "terminal_code",
            "container_id",
            "cargo_class",
            "destination_country",
            "priority",
            "customs_lane",
            "adjusted_fee_total",
            "peak_local_fee_total",
        ],
        [F.col("event_count"), F.col("handling_minutes_total")],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
    .alias("cm")
)

w_metric = Window.partitionBy("cm.metric_name").orderBy(F.col("cm.metric_value").desc(), F.col("cm.container_id"))
result = (
    metric_rows
    .join(event_pivot.alias("ep"), F.col("ep.terminal_code") == F.col("cm.terminal_code"), "inner")
    .join(
        event_rollup.alias("er"),
        (F.col("er.terminal_code") == F.col("cm.terminal_code")) & (F.col("er.rollup_level") == 1),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "cm.terminal_code",
        "cm.container_id",
        "cm.cargo_class",
        "cm.destination_country",
        "cm.priority",
        "cm.customs_lane",
        "cm.metric_name",
        "cm.metric_value",
        "cm.adjusted_fee_total",
        "cm.peak_local_fee_total",
        "ep.gate_in_outcome",
        "ep.load_outcome",
        "ep.customs_outcome",
        F.col("er.distinct_fee_total").alias("terminal_distinct_fee_total"),
        F.col("er.distinct_events").alias("terminal_distinct_events"),
        F.col("er.outcomes").alias("terminal_outcomes"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_metric).alias("value_band"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_metric).alias("value_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy("metric_name", "value_band", "container_id")
)

/*
  Hotel room-revenue mart: pick one representative stay per room segment,
  summarize reservation-change sessions, and roll up daily revenue components.
  NULL adjustment components are intentionally excluded by SQL UNPIVOT.
*/
WITH stay_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        r.reservation_id,
        r.property_code,
        r.room_type,
        r.guest_profile.loyalty_tier AS loyalty_tier,
        r.guest_profile.home_country AS home_country,
        from_json(r.preferences_json,
                  'STRUCT<high_floor:BOOLEAN,accessible_room:BOOLEAN,bed_type:STRING>') AS preference_detail,
        filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0) AS valid_nightly_rates,
        transform(filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0),
                  x -> round(x * 1.10, 2)) AS gross_nightly_rates,
        aggregate(filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0),
                  CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + CAST(x AS DOUBLE)) AS total_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN exists(r.nightly_rates, x -> x >= 300) THEN 'PREMIUM'
            WHEN aggregate(filter(r.nightly_rates, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x > 0),
                           CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + CAST(x AS DOUBLE)) >= 400
                THEN 'EXTENDED_VALUE'
            ELSE 'STANDARD'
        END AS rate_band,
        datediff(r.checkout_at, r.checkin_at) AS stay_nights,
        timestampdiff(HOUR, r.booked_at, r.checkin_at) AS lead_hours,
        r.checkin_at - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS cancellation_deadline,
        date_trunc('MONTH', r.checkin_at) AS stay_month,
        concat_ws(':', r.property_code, r.room_type,
                  upper(coalesce(r.guest_profile.loyalty_tier, 'NONE'))) AS stay_segment_key,
        lpad(split(r.confirmation_code, '-')[1], 4, '0') AS confirmation_seq,
        array_join(transform(r.nightly_rates,
                             x -> coalesce(CAST(x AS STRING), 'NA')), '|') AS rate_audit
    FROM reservation_stays r
    WHERE r.stay_status IN ('CHECKED_OUT', 'CONFIRMED')
      AND r.checkout_at IS NOT NULL
),
activity_sessions AS (
    -- A gap over 24 hours starts a new reservation-working session.
    SELECT
        g.*,
        sum(g.gap_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.guest_id
            ORDER BY g.occurred_at, g.activity_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_seq
    FROM (
        SELECT
            a.*,
            CASE
                WHEN lag(a.occurred_at) OVER (
                         PARTITION BY a.guest_id ORDER BY a.occurred_at, a.activity_id
                     ) IS NULL
                  OR a.occurred_at > lag(a.occurred_at) OVER (
                         PARTITION BY a.guest_id ORDER BY a.occurred_at, a.activity_id
                     ) + INTERVAL '24' HOUR
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END AS gap_flag
        FROM reservation_activity a
    ) g
),
session_stats AS (
    SELECT
        reservation_id,
        count(*) AS activity_events,
        count(DISTINCT concat_ws('-', guest_id, lpad(session_seq, 3, '0'))) AS booking_sessions,
        max(concat_ws('-', guest_id, lpad(session_seq, 3, '0'))) AS last_session_label,
        sum(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'MODIFY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS modification_events
    FROM activity_sessions
    GROUP BY reservation_id
),
revenue_long AS (
    SELECT property_code, business_date, room_type, available_rooms, metric_name, metric_amount
    FROM daily_room_revenue
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_amount FOR metric_name IN (room_revenue, fee_revenue, adjustment_revenue)
    )
),
revenue_scored AS (
    SELECT
        rl.*,
        sum(rl.metric_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rl.property_code, rl.room_type, rl.metric_name
            ORDER BY rl.business_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_two_day_revenue,
        avg(rl.metric_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rl.property_code, rl.room_type, rl.metric_name
            ORDER BY datediff(rl.business_date, DATE '2025-03-01')
            RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS two_calendar_day_avg
    FROM revenue_long rl
),
ranked_stays AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        coalesce(ss.activity_events, 0) AS activity_events,
        coalesce(ss.booking_sessions, 0) AS booking_sessions,
        coalesce(ss.last_session_label, 'NO_ACTIVITY') AS last_session_label,
        coalesce(ss.modification_events, 0) AS modification_events,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY se.property_code, se.room_type
            ORDER BY se.total_rate DESC, se.lead_hours DESC, se.reservation_id
        ) AS segment_rank
    FROM stay_enriched se
    LEFT JOIN session_stats ss ON ss.reservation_id = se.reservation_id
    QUALIFY segment_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) = 0 THEN 'DETAIL'
        WHEN grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) = 1 THEN 'ROOM_TYPE_TOTAL'
        WHEN grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) = 3 THEN 'PROPERTY_TOTAL'
        ELSE 'GRAND_TOTAL'
    END AS aggregation_scope,
    concat_ws(' / ', coalesce(rs.property_code, 'ALL PROPERTIES'),
              coalesce(rs.room_type, 'ALL ROOM TYPES'),
              coalesce(rl.metric_name, 'ALL METRICS')) AS revenue_group,
    rs.property_code,
    rs.room_type,
    rl.metric_name,
    grouping_id(rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name) AS rollup_level,
    count(DISTINCT rs.reservation_id) AS stay_count,
    round(sum(rl.metric_amount), 2) AS total_revenue,
    round(avg(rl.prior_two_day_revenue), 2) AS avg_prior_two_day_revenue,
    round(max(rl.two_calendar_day_avg), 2) AS peak_two_day_avg,
    max(rs.stay_nights) AS max_stay_nights,
    max(rs.booking_sessions) AS max_booking_sessions
FROM revenue_scored rl
JOIN ranked_stays rs
  ON rs.property_code = rl.property_code
 AND rs.room_type = rl.room_type
GROUP BY ROLLUP (rs.property_code, rs.room_type, rl.metric_name)
ORDER BY rollup_level, rs.property_code ASC NULLS LAST,
         rs.room_type ASC NULLS LAST, rl.metric_name ASC NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

stay_enriched = (
    df_reservation_stays.alias("r")
    .filter(F.col("stay_status").isin("CHECKED_OUT", "CONFIRMED") & F.col("checkout_at").isNotNull())
    .select(
        F.col("reservation_id"),
        F.col("property_code"),
        F.col("room_type"),
        F.col("guest_profile.loyalty_tier").alias("loyalty_tier"),
        F.col("guest_profile.home_country").alias("home_country"),
        F.from_json(F.col("preferences_json"), "STRUCT<high_floor:BOOLEAN,accessible_room:BOOLEAN,bed_type:STRING>").alias("preference_detail"),
        F.filter(F.col("nightly_rates"), lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x > F.lit(0))).alias("valid_nightly_rates"),
        F.transform(
            F.filter(F.col("nightly_rates"), lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x > F.lit(0))),
            lambda x: F.round(x * F.lit(1.10), 2),
        ).alias("gross_nightly_rates"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.filter(F.col("nightly_rates"), lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x > F.lit(0))),
            F.lit(0).cast("double"),
            lambda acc, x: acc + x.cast("double"),
        ).alias("total_rate"),
        F.when(F.exists(F.col("nightly_rates"), lambda x: x >= F.lit(300)), F.lit("PREMIUM"))
        .when(
            F.aggregate(
                F.filter(F.col("nightly_rates"), lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x > F.lit(0))),
                F.lit(0).cast("double"),
                lambda acc, x: acc + x.cast("double"),
            ) >= F.lit(400),
            F.lit("EXTENDED_VALUE"),
        )
        .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .alias("rate_band"),
        F.datediff(F.col("checkout_at"), F.col("checkin_at")).alias("stay_nights"),
        F.expr("timestampdiff(HOUR, booked_at, checkin_at)").alias("lead_hours"),
        (F.col("checkin_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL '1' DAY")).alias("cancellation_deadline"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", F.col("checkin_at")).alias("stay_month"),
        F.concat_ws(":", F.col("property_code"), F.col("room_type"), F.upper(F.coalesce(F.col("guest_profile.loyalty_tier"), F.lit("NONE")))).alias("stay_segment_key"),
        F.lpad(F.split(F.col("confirmation_code"), "-")[1], 4, "0").alias("confirmation_seq"),
        F.array_join(
            F.transform(F.col("nightly_rates"), lambda x: F.coalesce(x.cast("string"), F.lit("NA"))),
            "|",
        ).alias("rate_audit"),
    )
)

w_activity_lag = Window.partitionBy("guest_id").orderBy("occurred_at", "activity_id")
activity_with_lag = (
    df_reservation_activity
    .select("*", F.lag("occurred_at").over(w_activity_lag).alias("prev_occurred_at"))
)
activity_gapped = (
    activity_with_lag
    .select(
        "activity_id",
        "reservation_id",
        "guest_id",
        "occurred_at",
        "activity_type",
        F.when(
            F.col("prev_occurred_at").isNull()
            | (F.col("occurred_at") > F.col("prev_occurred_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '24' HOUR")),
            F.lit(1),
        ).otherwise(F.lit(0)).alias("gap_flag"),
    )
)
w_session = (
    Window.partitionBy("guest_id")
    .orderBy("occurred_at", "activity_id")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
)
activity_sessions = (
    activity_gapped
    .select("*", F.sum("gap_flag").over(w_session).alias("session_seq"))
)

session_label = F.concat_ws("-", F.col("guest_id"), F.lpad(F.col("session_seq").cast("string"), 3, "0"))
session_stats = (
    activity_sessions
    .groupBy("reservation_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("activity_events"),
        F.countDistinct(session_label).alias("booking_sessions"),
        F.max(session_label).alias("last_session_label"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("activity_type") == "MODIFY", F.lit(1)).otherwise(F.lit(0))).alias("modification_events"),
    )
)

revenue_long = (
    df_daily_room_revenue
    .unpivot(
        ["property_code", "business_date", "room_type", "available_rooms"],
        ["room_revenue", "fee_revenue", "adjustment_revenue"],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_amount",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_amount").isNotNull())
)

revenue_with_day_offset = (
    revenue_long
    .select("*", F.datediff(F.col("business_date"), F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date")).alias("day_offset"))
)
w_prior_rows = (
    Window.partitionBy("property_code", "room_type", "metric_name")
    .orderBy("business_date")
    .rowsBetween(-2, -1)
)
w_calendar_range = (
    Window.partitionBy("property_code", "room_type", "metric_name")
    .orderBy("day_offset")
    .rangeBetween(-1, 0)
)
revenue_scored = (
    revenue_with_day_offset
    .select(
        "property_code",
        "business_date",
        "room_type",
        "available_rooms",
        "metric_name",
        "metric_amount",
        F.sum("metric_amount").over(w_prior_rows).alias("prior_two_day_revenue"),
        F.avg("metric_amount").over(w_calendar_range).alias("two_calendar_day_avg"),
    )
)

w_stay_rank = Window.partitionBy("se.property_code", "se.room_type").orderBy(
    F.col("total_rate").desc(), F.col("lead_hours").desc(), F.col("se.reservation_id")
)
ranked_stays = (
    stay_enriched.alias("se")
    .join(session_stats.alias("ss"), F.col("ss.reservation_id") == F.col("se.reservation_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "se.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("ss.activity_events"), F.lit(0)).alias("activity_events"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ss.booking_sessions"), F.lit(0)).alias("booking_sessions"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ss.last_session_label"), F.lit("NO_ACTIVITY")).alias("last_session_label"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("ss.modification_events"), F.lit(0)).alias("modification_events"),
        F.row_number().over(w_stay_rank).alias("segment_rank"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("segment_rank") == 1)
)

revenue_for_rollup = (
    revenue_scored.alias("rl")
    .join(
        ranked_stays.alias("rs"),
        (F.col("rs.property_code") == F.col("rl.property_code"))
        & (F.col("rs.room_type") == F.col("rl.room_type")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("rs.property_code").alias("property_code"),
        F.col("rs.room_type").alias("room_type"),
        F.col("rl.metric_name").alias("metric_name"),
        F.col("rs.reservation_id").alias("reservation_id"),
        F.col("rl.metric_amount").alias("metric_amount"),
        F.col("rl.prior_two_day_revenue").alias("prior_two_day_revenue"),
        F.col("rl.two_calendar_day_avg").alias("two_calendar_day_avg"),
        F.col("rs.stay_nights").alias("stay_nights"),
        F.col("rs.booking_sessions").alias("booking_sessions"),
    )
)

revenue_rollup = (
    revenue_for_rollup
    .rollup("property_code", "room_type", "metric_name")
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id("property_code", "room_type", "metric_name").alias("rollup_level"),
        F.countDistinct("reservation_id").alias("stay_count"),
        F.round(F.sum("metric_amount"), 2).alias("total_revenue"),
        F.round(F.avg("prior_two_day_revenue"), 2).alias("avg_prior_two_day_revenue"),
        F.round(F.max("two_calendar_day_avg"), 2).alias("peak_two_day_avg"),
        F.max("stay_nights").alias("max_stay_nights"),
        F.max("booking_sessions").alias("max_booking_sessions"),
    )
)

result = (
    revenue_rollup
    .select(
        F.when(F.col("rollup_level") == 0, F.lit("DETAIL"))
        .when(F.col("rollup_level") == 1, F.lit("ROOM_TYPE_TOTAL"))
        .when(F.col("rollup_level") == 3, F.lit("PROPERTY_TOTAL"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("GRAND_TOTAL"))
        .alias("aggregation_scope"),
        F.concat_ws(
            " / ",
            F.coalesce(F.col("property_code"), F.lit("ALL PROPERTIES")),
            F.coalesce(F.col("room_type"), F.lit("ALL ROOM TYPES")),
            F.coalesce(F.col("metric_name"), F.lit("ALL METRICS")),
        ).alias("revenue_group"),
        "property_code",
        "room_type",
        "metric_name",
        "rollup_level",
        "stay_count",
        "total_revenue",
        "avg_prior_two_day_revenue",
        "peak_two_day_avg",
        "max_stay_nights",
        "max_booking_sessions",
    )
    .orderBy(
        "rollup_level",
        F.col("property_code").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("room_type").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("metric_name").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

app_scope = (
    df_dim_apps.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_stg_download_events.alias("d"),
        (F.col("a.app_id") == F.col("d.app_id")) & (F.col("d.status") == "COMPLETED"),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .join(
        df_stg_rating_events.alias("r"),
        (F.col("a.app_id") == F.col("r.app_id"))
        & (F.col("r.status") == "HIDDEN")
        & (F.col("r.stars") == 1),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .filter(F.col("a.is_active"))
    .select("a.*")
)

exploded_downloads = (
    df_stg_download_events.alias("d")
    .filter(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED")
    .withColumn(
        "device",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("device_json"),
            "STRUCT<device_model:STRING,os_version:STRING,consent:BOOLEAN>",
        ),
    )
    .withColumn("item", F.explode(F.col("install_steps")))
    .select(
        "download_id",
        "app_id",
        "user_id",
        "downloaded_at",
        "country",
        "platform",
        "device",
        F.col("item.step_name").alias("step_name"),
        F.col("item.offset_min").alias("offset_min"),
        F.col("item.step_value").alias("step_value"),
    )
)

download_stats = (
    exploded_downloads
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(F.col("step_name") == "INSTALL", F.col("download_id"))
        ).alias("completed_downloads"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(
                (F.col("step_name") == "OPEN") & F.col("device.consent"),
                F.col("download_id"),
            )
        ).alias("consented_opens"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("step_name") == "INSTALL", F.col("step_value"))
        ).alias("install_units"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(
                F.col("step_name") == "OPEN",
                F.coalesce(F.col("step_value"), F.lit(0)),
            )
        ).alias("open_units"),
    )
)

w_rating_7d = (
    Window.partitionBy("app_id")
    .orderBy(F.unix_timestamp(F.col("rated_at")))
    .rangeBetween(-604800, 0)
)
rating_windowed = (
    df_stg_rating_events.alias("r")
    .filter(F.col("status") == "PUBLISHED")
    .select(
        "app_id",
        "rating_id",
        "stars",
        F.avg(F.col("stars").cast("decimal(10,2)"))
        .over(w_rating_7d)
        .alias("trailing_7d_avg"),
    )
)

rating_stats = (
    rating_windowed
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("published_ratings"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("stars") >= 4, F.lit(1))).alias("positive_ratings"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("stars").cast("decimal(10,2)")), 2).alias("avg_stars"),
        F.percentile_approx(F.col("stars"), 0.5).alias("median_stars"),
        F.max("trailing_7d_avg").alias("peak_7d_avg"),
    )
)

metric_pivot = (
    df_stg_daily_metrics
    .filter(F.col("report_date") == F.lit("2025-03-15").cast("date"))
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["DOWNLOADS", "SESSIONS", "CRASHES"])
    .agg(F.sum("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "app_id",
        F.col("DOWNLOADS").alias("reported_downloads"),
        F.col("SESSIONS").alias("reported_sessions"),
        F.col("CRASHES").alias("reported_crashes"),
    )
)

result = (
    app_scope.alias("a")
    .join(download_stats.alias("d"), F.col("a.app_id") == F.col("d.app_id"), "left")
    .join(rating_stats.alias("r"), F.col("a.app_id") == F.col("r.app_id"), "left")
    .join(metric_pivot.alias("m"), F.col("a.app_id") == F.col("m.app_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        "d.completed_downloads",
        "d.consented_opens",
        F.coalesce(F.col("r.published_ratings"), F.lit(0)).alias("published_ratings"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("r.positive_ratings"), F.lit(0)).alias("positive_ratings"),
        "r.avg_stars",
        "r.median_stars",
        F.round(F.col("r.peak_7d_avg"), 2).alias("peak_7d_avg"),
        "m.reported_downloads",
        "m.reported_sessions",
        "m.reported_crashes",
        F.round(
            F.coalesce(F.col("d.open_units"), F.lit(0))
            / F.nullif(F.col("d.install_units"), F.lit(0)),
            4,
        ).cast("decimal(10,4)").alias("open_rate"),
        F.floor(
            F.coalesce(F.col("r.avg_stars"), F.col("a.target_rating")) * 20
        ).alias("rating_score"),
        F.ceil(F.coalesce(F.col("m.reported_downloads"), F.lit(0)) / 7).alias(
            "weekly_downloads"
        ),
        F.when(F.col("r.app_id").isNull(), "UNRATED")
        .when(F.col("r.median_stars") < 3, "AT_RISK")
        .when(
            (F.col("r.median_stars") >= 4)
            & (F.coalesce(F.col("m.reported_crashes"), F.lit(0)) <= 2),
            "HEALTHY",
        )
        .otherwise("WATCH")
        .alias("quality_label"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_score").desc(), "app_id")
)

WITH app_scope AS (
    -- Active apps with a completed install, excluding apps with hidden one-star abuse.
    SELECT a.*
    FROM dim_apps a
    WHERE a.is_active
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stg_download_events d
          WHERE d.app_id = a.app_id AND d.status = 'COMPLETED'
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM stg_rating_events r
          WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.status = 'HIDDEN' AND r.stars = 1
      )
),
-- Flatten install funnel steps and parse device attributes from the event JSON.
exploded_downloads AS (
    SELECT d.download_id, d.app_id, d.user_id, d.downloaded_at, d.country, d.platform,
           from_json(d.device_json,
               'STRUCT<device_model:STRING,os_version:STRING,consent:BOOLEAN>') AS device,
           item.step_name, item.offset_min, item.step_value
    FROM stg_download_events d
    LATERAL VIEW explode(d.install_steps) AS item
    WHERE d.status = 'COMPLETED'
),
-- Aggregate the funnel, retaining only the relevant step in each FILTER clause.
download_stats AS (
    SELECT app_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT download_id) FILTER (WHERE step_name = 'INSTALL') AS completed_downloads,
           COUNT(DISTINCT download_id) FILTER (
               WHERE step_name = 'OPEN' AND device.consent
           ) AS consented_opens,
           SUM(step_value) FILTER (WHERE step_name = 'INSTALL') AS install_units,
           SUM(COALESCE(step_value, 0)) FILTER (WHERE step_name = 'OPEN') AS open_units
    FROM exploded_downloads
    GROUP BY app_id
),
-- Compute a trailing seven-day rating average using a numeric RANGE frame.
rating_windowed AS (
    SELECT r.app_id, r.rating_id, r.stars,
           AVG(CAST(r.stars AS DECIMAL(10,2))) OVER (
               PARTITION BY r.app_id
               ORDER BY unix_timestamp(r.rated_at)
               RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS trailing_7d_avg
    FROM stg_rating_events r
    WHERE r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
),
-- Summarize published ratings and their approximate median.
rating_stats AS (
    SELECT app_id,
           COUNT(*) AS published_ratings,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stars >= 4) AS positive_ratings,
           ROUND(AVG(CAST(stars AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 2) AS avg_stars,
           percentile_approx(stars, 0.5) AS median_stars,
           MAX(trailing_7d_avg) AS peak_7d_avg
    FROM rating_windowed
    GROUP BY app_id
),
-- Pivot the daily long-form metrics into app-level operational measures.
metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT app_id,
           downloads AS reported_downloads,
           sessions AS reported_sessions,
           crashes AS reported_crashes
    FROM (
        SELECT app_id, metric, metric_value
        FROM stg_daily_metrics
        WHERE report_date = DATE '2025-03-15'
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        SUM(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'DOWNLOADS' AS downloads,
            'SESSIONS' AS sessions,
            'CRASHES' AS crashes
        )
    )
)
-- Produce the app health scorecard with null-safe rates and labels.
SELECT a.*,
       d.completed_downloads,
       d.consented_opens,
       COALESCE(r.published_ratings, 0) AS published_ratings,
       COALESCE(r.positive_ratings, 0) AS positive_ratings,
       r.avg_stars,
       r.median_stars,
       ROUND(r.peak_7d_avg, 2) AS peak_7d_avg,
       m.reported_downloads,
       m.reported_sessions,
       m.reported_crashes,
       CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(d.open_units, 0) / NULLIF(d.install_units, 0), 4)
            AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS open_rate,
       FLOOR(COALESCE(r.avg_stars, a.target_rating) * 20) AS rating_score,
       CEIL(COALESCE(m.reported_downloads, 0) / 7) AS weekly_downloads,
       CASE
           WHEN r.app_id IS NULL THEN 'UNRATED'
           WHEN r.median_stars < 3 THEN 'AT_RISK'
           WHEN r.median_stars >= 4 AND COALESCE(m.reported_crashes, 0) <= 2 THEN 'HEALTHY'
           ELSE 'WATCH'
       END AS quality_label
FROM app_scope a
LEFT JOIN download_stats d ON d.app_id = a.app_id
LEFT JOIN rating_stats r ON r.app_id = a.app_id
LEFT JOIN metric_pivot m ON m.app_id = a.app_id
ORDER BY rating_score DESC, app_id

/*
  Construction portfolio review: change exposure, field sessions and direct costs.
  Activity gaps over four hours start a new session; only twelve recent activities
  per project feed this weekly operations extract.
*/
WITH change_parsed AS (
    SELECT event_id, project_id, contractor_id, change_ref, submitted_at,
           status, amount,
           from_json(metrics_json,
               'STRUCT<delay_days:INT,risk_score:DOUBLE,inspection_passed:BOOLEAN>') AS metrics,
           transform(action_codes, x -> upper(x)) AS normalized_actions,
           filter(action_codes, x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x <> 'SKIP') AS actionable_codes,
           exists(action_codes, x -> x = 'FIELD_CHECK') AS needs_field_check
    FROM change_order_events
),
change_scoped AS (
    -- The seven-day grace period models crew coverage after the formal window.
    SELECT cp.*, ps.region, ps.project_name, ps.baseline_budget,
           ps.site_profile.site_class AS site_class,
           cw.crew_label
    FROM change_parsed cp
    JOIN project_sites ps
      ON ps.project_id = cp.project_id
    LEFT JOIN contractor_windows cw
      ON cw.contractor_id = cp.contractor_id
     AND cp.submitted_at BETWEEN cw.coverage_start
                             AND cw.coverage_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    WHERE ps.is_active = TRUE
      AND cp.status <> 'VOID'
),
activity_flagged AS (
    SELECT project_id, activity_id, happened_at, activity_type, crew_qty,
           LAG(happened_at) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at, activity_id
           ) AS prev_happened_at
    FROM site_activity
    WHERE activity_type <> 'CANCELLED'
),
activity_sessions AS (
    SELECT project_id, activity_id, happened_at, activity_type, crew_qty,
           SUM(CASE WHEN prev_happened_at IS NULL
                     OR happened_at > prev_happened_at + INTERVAL '4' HOUR
                    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at, activity_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_seq,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at DESC, activity_id DESC
           ) AS recency_rn
    FROM activity_flagged
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY happened_at DESC, activity_id DESC
            ) <= 12
),
cost_long AS (
    -- SQL UNPIVOT excludes the null equipment bucket, as intended here.
    SELECT project_id, cost_type, cost_value
    FROM project_cost_buckets
    UNPIVOT (
        cost_value FOR cost_type IN (
            labor_cost AS LABOR,
            material_cost AS MATERIAL,
            equipment_cost AS EQUIPMENT
        )
    )
),
project_metrics AS (
    SELECT ps.project_id, ps.project_name, ps.region, ps.baseline_budget,
           coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN cs.status = 'APPROVED'
                             THEN coalesce(cs.amount, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
                             ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END),
                    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS approved_change_amount,
           count(DISTINCT cs.event_id) AS change_events,
           max(cs.metrics.risk_score) AS max_risk_score,
           sum(CASE WHEN cs.needs_field_check THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS field_check_events,
           sum(CASE WHEN cs.event_id IS NOT NULL
                    THEN size(cs.actionable_codes) ELSE 0 END) AS actionable_steps,
           coalesce(max(sa.retained_sessions), 0) AS retained_sessions,
           coalesce(max(sa.session_crew_qty), 0) AS session_crew_qty,
           max(ct.labor_cost) AS labor_cost,
           max(ct.material_cost) AS material_cost,
           max(ct.equipment_cost) AS equipment_cost,
           max(CASE WHEN cs.site_class = 'REMOTE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS remote_change_flag
    FROM project_sites ps
    LEFT JOIN change_scoped cs ON cs.project_id = ps.project_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT project_id, count(DISTINCT session_seq) AS retained_sessions,
               sum(crew_qty) AS session_crew_qty
        FROM activity_sessions
        GROUP BY project_id
    ) sa ON sa.project_id = ps.project_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM cost_long
        PIVOT (
            sum(cost_value) FOR cost_type IN (
                'LABOR' AS labor_cost,
                'MATERIAL' AS material_cost,
                'EQUIPMENT' AS equipment_cost
            )
        )
    ) ct ON ct.project_id = ps.project_id
    WHERE ps.is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY ps.project_id, ps.project_name, ps.region, ps.baseline_budget
)
SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(region) = 1 THEN 'ALL REGIONS' ELSE region END AS region_label,
       CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'ALL PROJECTS' ELSE project_id END AS project_key,
       CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'ALL PROJECTS' ELSE max(project_name) END AS project_name,
       sum(approved_change_amount) AS approved_change_amount,
       sum(baseline_budget) AS baseline_budget,
       sum(change_events) AS change_events,
       sum(retained_sessions) AS retained_sessions,
       sum(session_crew_qty) AS session_crew_qty,
       sum(coalesce(labor_cost, 0) + coalesce(material_cost, 0)
           + coalesce(equipment_cost, 0)) AS direct_cost,
       round(sum(approved_change_amount) /
             nullif(sum(coalesce(labor_cost, 0) + coalesce(material_cost, 0)
                        + coalesce(equipment_cost, 0)), 0), 3) AS approved_to_cost_ratio,
       max(max_risk_score) AS max_risk_score,
       sum(field_check_events) AS field_check_events,
       sum(actionable_steps) AS actionable_steps,
       max(remote_change_flag) AS remote_change_flag,
       GROUPING_ID(region, project_id) AS grouping_level,
       (SELECT max(baseline_budget) FROM project_sites WHERE is_active = TRUE)
           AS portfolio_budget_ceiling
FROM project_metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region, project_id), (region), ())
ORDER BY grouping_level DESC, approved_change_amount DESC NULLS LAST,
         region_label ASC, project_key ASC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

change_parsed = (
    df_change_order_events
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "project_id",
        "contractor_id",
        "change_ref",
        "submitted_at",
        "status",
        "amount",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("metrics_json"),
            "STRUCT<delay_days:INT,risk_score:DOUBLE,inspection_passed:BOOLEAN>",
        ).alias("metrics"),
        F.transform(F.col("action_codes"), lambda x: F.upper(x)).alias("normalized_actions"),
        F.filter(
            F.col("action_codes"),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & (x != "SKIP"),
        ).alias("actionable_codes"),
        F.exists(F.col("action_codes"), lambda x: x == "FIELD_CHECK").alias("needs_field_check"),
    )
)

change_scoped = (
    change_parsed.alias("cp")
    .join(
        df_project_sites.alias("ps"),
        F.col("ps.project_id") == F.col("cp.project_id"),
        "inner",
    )
    .join(
        df_contractor_windows.alias("cw"),
        (F.col("cw.contractor_id") == F.col("cp.contractor_id"))
        & F.col("cp.submitted_at").between(
            F.col("cw.coverage_start"),
            F.col("cw.coverage_end") + F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY"),
        ),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("ps.is_active") & (F.col("cp.status") != "VOID"))
    .select(
        F.col("cp.*"),
        F.col("ps.region"),
        F.col("ps.project_name"),
        F.col("ps.baseline_budget"),
        F.col("ps.site_profile.site_class").alias("site_class"),
        F.col("cw.crew_label"),
    )
)

w_activity = Window.partitionBy("project_id").orderBy("happened_at", "activity_id")
w_session = w_activity.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recency = Window.partitionBy("project_id").orderBy(
    F.col("happened_at").desc(), F.col("activity_id").desc()
)

activity_flagged = (
    df_site_activity
    .filter(F.col("activity_type") != "CANCELLED")
    .select(
        "project_id",
        "activity_id",
        "happened_at",
        "activity_type",
        "crew_qty",
        F.lag("happened_at").over(w_activity).alias("prev_happened_at"),
    )
)

activity_sessions = (
    activity_flagged
    .withColumn(
        "session_seq",
        F.sum(
            F.when(
                F.col("prev_happened_at").isNull()
                | (
                    F.col("happened_at")
                    > F.col("prev_happened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '4' HOUR")
                ),
                1,
            ).otherwise(0)
        ).over(w_session),
    )
    .withColumn("recency_rn", F.row_number().over(w_recency))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rn") <= 12)
    .select(
        "project_id",
        "activity_id",
        "happened_at",
        "activity_type",
        "crew_qty",
        "session_seq",
        "recency_rn",
    )
)

cost_long = (
    df_project_cost_buckets
    .select(
        "project_id",
        F.col("labor_cost").alias("LABOR"),
        F.col("material_cost").alias("MATERIAL"),
        F.col("equipment_cost").alias("EQUIPMENT"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ["project_id"],
        ["LABOR", "MATERIAL", "EQUIPMENT"],
        "cost_type",
        "cost_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("cost_value").isNotNull())
)

session_totals = (
    activity_sessions
    .groupBy("project_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("session_seq").alias("retained_sessions"),
        F.sum("crew_qty").alias("session_crew_qty"),
    )
)

cost_totals = (
    cost_long
    .groupBy("project_id")
    .pivot("cost_type", ["LABOR", "MATERIAL", "EQUIPMENT"])
    .agg(F.sum("cost_value"))
    .select(
        "project_id",
        F.col("LABOR").alias("labor_cost"),
        F.col("MATERIAL").alias("material_cost"),
        F.col("EQUIPMENT").alias("equipment_cost"),
    )
)

zero_amount = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")
project_metrics = (
    df_project_sites.alias("ps")
    .join(change_scoped.alias("cs"), F.col("cs.project_id") == F.col("ps.project_id"), "left")
    .join(session_totals.alias("sa"), F.col("sa.project_id") == F.col("ps.project_id"), "left")
    .join(cost_totals.alias("ct"), F.col("ct.project_id") == F.col("ps.project_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("ps.is_active"))
    .groupBy("ps.project_id", "ps.project_name", "ps.region", "ps.baseline_budget")
    .agg(
        F.coalesce(
            F.sum(
                F.when(
                    F.col("cs.status") == "APPROVED",
                    F.coalesce(F.col("cs.amount"), zero_amount),
                ).otherwise(zero_amount)
            ),
            zero_amount,
        ).alias("approved_change_amount"),
        F.countDistinct("cs.event_id").alias("change_events"),
        F.max(F.col("cs.metrics.risk_score")).alias("max_risk_score"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("cs.needs_field_check"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("field_check_events"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("cs.event_id").isNotNull(), F.size(F.col("cs.actionable_codes"))).otherwise(0)
        ).alias("actionable_steps"),
        F.coalesce(F.max("sa.retained_sessions"), F.lit(0)).alias("retained_sessions"),
        F.coalesce(F.max("sa.session_crew_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("session_crew_qty"),
        F.max("ct.labor_cost").alias("labor_cost"),
        F.max("ct.material_cost").alias("material_cost"),
        F.max("ct.equipment_cost").alias("equipment_cost"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("cs.site_class") == "REMOTE", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("remote_change_flag"),
    )
)

rolled = (
    project_metrics
    .rollup("region", "project_id")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("region").alias("region_grouping"),
        F.grouping("project_id").alias("project_grouping"),
        F.grouping_id("region", "project_id").alias("grouping_level"),
        F.max("project_name").alias("project_name"),
        F.sum("approved_change_amount").alias("approved_change_amount"),
        F.sum("baseline_budget").alias("baseline_budget"),
        F.sum("change_events").alias("change_events"),
        F.sum("retained_sessions").alias("retained_sessions"),
        F.sum("session_crew_qty").alias("session_crew_qty"),
        F.sum(
            F.coalesce(F.col("labor_cost"), F.lit(0))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("material_cost"), F.lit(0))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("equipment_cost"), F.lit(0))
        ).alias("direct_cost"),
        F.max("max_risk_score").alias("max_risk_score"),
        F.sum("field_check_events").alias("field_check_events"),
        F.sum("actionable_steps").alias("actionable_steps"),
        F.max("remote_change_flag").alias("remote_change_flag"),
    )
)

budget_ceiling = (
    df_project_sites
    .filter(F.col("is_active"))
    .agg(F.max("baseline_budget").alias("portfolio_budget_ceiling"))
)

result = (
    rolled
    .select(
        F.when(F.col("region_grouping") == 1, F.lit("ALL REGIONS"))
        .otherwise(F.col("region"))
        .alias("region_label"),
        F.when(F.col("project_grouping") == 1, F.lit("ALL PROJECTS"))
        .otherwise(F.col("project_id"))
        .alias("project_key"),
        F.when(F.col("project_grouping") == 1, F.lit("ALL PROJECTS"))
        .otherwise(F.col("project_name"))
        .alias("project_name"),
        "approved_change_amount",
        "baseline_budget",
        "change_events",
        "retained_sessions",
        "session_crew_qty",
        "direct_cost",
        F.round(
            F.col("approved_change_amount")
            / F.when(F.col("direct_cost") != 0, F.col("direct_cost")),
            3,
        ).alias("approved_to_cost_ratio"),
        "max_risk_score",
        "field_check_events",
        "actionable_steps",
        "remote_change_flag",
        "grouping_level",
    )
    .crossJoin(budget_ceiling)
    .orderBy(
        F.col("grouping_level").desc(),
        F.col("approved_change_amount").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("region_label").asc(),
        F.col("project_key").asc(),
    )
)

WITH claim_base AS (
    SELECT
        cl.claim_id,
        cl.policy_id,
        pc.holder_name,
        pc.region,
        pc.risk_tier,
        cl.reported_at,
        date_trunc('month', cl.reported_at) AS report_month,
        cl.reported_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS review_due_at,
        datediff(to_date(cl.reported_at), cl.loss_date) AS days_to_report,
        cl.status,
        cl.peril,
        cl.incurred_amount,
        -- Ignore small and missing recoveries before summing the material ones.
        aggregate(
            filter(
                transform(
                    cl.recovery_amounts,
                    x -> coalesce(x, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)))
                ),
                x -> x >= CAST(500 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
            ),
            CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)),
            (acc, x) -> CAST(acc + x AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        ) AS large_recovery_total
    FROM claim_ledger cl
    JOIN policy_contracts pc
      ON pc.policy_id = cl.policy_id
     AND pc.policy_active = TRUE
),
activity_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        ca.claim_id,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.activity_type = 'INSPECTION') AS inspection_count,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE ca.activity_type = 'PAYMENT') AS payment_count,
        max(ca.activity_at) AS last_activity_at,
        array_sort(collect_set(ca.activity_type)) AS activity_types
    FROM claim_activity ca
    GROUP BY ca.claim_id
),
metric_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        claim_id,
        damage_band,
        repair_route,
        fraud_flag
    FROM (
        SELECT claim_id, metric, metric_value
        FROM claim_measurements
    ) m
    PIVOT (
        max(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN (
            'DAMAGE_BAND' AS damage_band,
            'REPAIR_ROUTE' AS repair_route,
            'FRAUD_FLAG' AS fraud_flag
        )
    )
),
ranked_claims AS (
    SELECT
        cb.*,
        coalesce(mp.damage_band, 'UNSCORED') AS damage_band,
        mp.repair_route,
        coalesce(mp.fraud_flag, 'UNSCORED') AS fraud_flag,
        ntile(2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.region
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS region_amount_bucket,
        percent_rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.region
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS region_percent_rank,
        cume_dist() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.report_month
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS month_cume_dist,
        dense_rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cb.risk_tier
            ORDER BY cb.incurred_amount DESC, cb.claim_id
        ) AS tier_amount_rank
    FROM claim_base cb
    LEFT JOIN metric_pivot mp
      ON mp.claim_id = cb.claim_id
),
eligible_claims AS (
    SELECT rc.*
    FROM ranked_claims rc
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM claim_activity ca
        WHERE ca.claim_id = rc.claim_id
          AND ca.activity_type = 'COVERAGE_CONFIRMED'
          AND ca.activity_at <= rc.reported_at + INTERVAL '48' HOUR
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM claim_activity blocked
        WHERE blocked.claim_id = rc.claim_id
          AND blocked.activity_type = 'FRAUD_HOLD'
    )
)
SELECT
    rc.*,
    ar.inspection_count,
    ar.payment_count,
    ar.last_activity_at,
    ar.activity_types,
    CASE
        WHEN rc.status = 'OPEN' AND rc.fraud_flag = 'REVIEW'
            THEN 'FRAUD_REVIEW'
        WHEN rc.status = 'OPEN' AND rc.large_recovery_total >= 1500
            THEN 'ESCALATE_RECOVERY'
        WHEN rc.status = 'OPEN'
            THEN 'STANDARD_REVIEW'
        WHEN coalesce(ar.payment_count, 0) > 0
            THEN 'PAID_CLOSED'
        ELSE 'ARCHIVE'
    END AS handling_path,
    CASE
        WHEN ar.last_activity_at > rc.review_due_at THEN 'LATE'
        ELSE 'ON_TIME'
    END AS review_timeliness
FROM eligible_claims rc
LEFT JOIN activity_rollup ar
  ON ar.claim_id = rc.claim_id
ORDER BY rc.region, rc.region_amount_bucket, rc.claim_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recovery_zero = F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")
clean_recoveries = F.transform(
    F.col("cl.recovery_amounts"),
    lambda x: F.coalesce(x, recovery_zero),
)
material_recoveries = F.filter(
    clean_recoveries,
    lambda x: x >= F.lit(500).cast("decimal(10,2)"),
)
claim_base = (
    df_claim_ledger.alias("cl")
    .join(
        df_policy_contracts.alias("pc"),
        (F.col("pc.policy_id") == F.col("cl.policy_id")) & F.col("pc.policy_active"),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("cl.claim_id").alias("claim_id"),
        F.col("cl.policy_id").alias("policy_id"),
        F.col("pc.holder_name").alias("holder_name"),
        F.col("pc.region").alias("region"),
        F.col("pc.risk_tier").alias("risk_tier"),
        F.col("cl.reported_at").alias("reported_at"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("cl.reported_at")).alias("report_month"),
        (F.col("cl.reported_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("review_due_at"),
        F.datediff(F.to_date(F.col("cl.reported_at")), F.col("cl.loss_date")).alias("days_to_report"),
        F.col("cl.status").alias("status"),
        F.col("cl.peril").alias("peril"),
        F.col("cl.incurred_amount").alias("incurred_amount"),
        F.aggregate(
            material_recoveries,
            recovery_zero,
            lambda acc, x: (acc + x).cast("decimal(10,2)"),
        ).alias("large_recovery_total"),
    )
)

activity_rollup = (
    df_claim_activity.alias("ca")
    .groupBy(F.col("ca.claim_id").alias("claim_id"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("ca.activity_type") == "INSPECTION", F.col("ca.activity_id"))).alias("inspection_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("ca.activity_type") == "PAYMENT", F.col("ca.activity_id"))).alias("payment_count"),
        F.max("ca.activity_at").alias("last_activity_at"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("ca.activity_type")).alias("activity_types"),
    )
)

metric_pivot = (
    df_claim_measurements
    .select("claim_id", "metric", "metric_value")
    .groupBy("claim_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["DAMAGE_BAND", "REPAIR_ROUTE", "FRAUD_FLAG"])
    .agg(F.max("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "claim_id",
        F.col("DAMAGE_BAND").alias("damage_band"),
        F.col("REPAIR_ROUTE").alias("repair_route"),
        F.col("FRAUD_FLAG").alias("fraud_flag"),
    )
)

w_region = Window.partitionBy("cb.region").orderBy(F.col("cb.incurred_amount").desc(), F.col("cb.claim_id"))
w_month = Window.partitionBy("cb.report_month").orderBy(F.col("cb.incurred_amount").desc(), F.col("cb.claim_id"))
w_tier = Window.partitionBy("cb.risk_tier").orderBy(F.col("cb.incurred_amount").desc(), F.col("cb.claim_id"))
ranked_claims = (
    claim_base.alias("cb")
    .join(metric_pivot.alias("mp"), F.col("mp.claim_id") == F.col("cb.claim_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "cb.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("mp.damage_band"), F.lit("UNSCORED")).alias("damage_band"),
        F.col("mp.repair_route").alias("repair_route"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("mp.fraud_flag"), F.lit("UNSCORED")).alias("fraud_flag"),
        F.ntile(2).over(w_region).alias("region_amount_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_region).alias("region_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_month).alias("month_cume_dist"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_tier).alias("tier_amount_rank"),
    )
)

eligible_claims = (
    ranked_claims.alias("rc")
    .join(
        df_claim_activity.alias("ca"),
        (F.col("ca.claim_id") == F.col("rc.claim_id"))
        & (F.col("ca.activity_type") == "COVERAGE_CONFIRMED")
        & (F.col("ca.activity_at") <= F.col("rc.reported_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '48' HOUR")),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .join(
        df_claim_activity.alias("blocked"),
        (F.col("blocked.claim_id") == F.col("rc.claim_id"))
        & (F.col("blocked.activity_type") == "FRAUD_HOLD"),
        "left_anti",
    )
)

result = (
    eligible_claims.alias("rc")
    .join(activity_rollup.alias("ar"), F.col("ar.claim_id") == F.col("rc.claim_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "rc.*",
        F.col("ar.inspection_count").alias("inspection_count"),
        F.col("ar.payment_count").alias("payment_count"),
        F.col("ar.last_activity_at").alias("last_activity_at"),
        F.col("ar.activity_types").alias("activity_types"),
        F.when((F.col("rc.status") == "OPEN") & (F.col("rc.fraud_flag") == "REVIEW"), F.lit("FRAUD_REVIEW"))
        .when((F.col("rc.status") == "OPEN") & (F.col("rc.large_recovery_total") >= 1500), F.lit("ESCALATE_RECOVERY"))
        .when(F.col("rc.status") == "OPEN", F.lit("STANDARD_REVIEW"))
        .when(F.coalesce(F.col("ar.payment_count"), F.lit(0)) > 0, F.lit("PAID_CLOSED"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("ARCHIVE"))
        .alias("handling_path"),
        F.when(F.col("ar.last_activity_at") > F.col("rc.review_due_at"), F.lit("LATE"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("ON_TIME"))
        .alias("review_timeliness"),
    )
    .orderBy("region", "region_amount_bucket", "claim_id")
)

/*
  Listing negotiation pulse as of 2025-04-01.
  Builds listing attributes, buyer activity sessions, and latest-offer diagnostics.
  The fixed cutoff keeps the report reproducible for daily batch validation.
*/
WITH listing_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        pl.*,
        FROM_JSON(details_json,
                  'STRUCT<sqft:INT, hoa_monthly:DECIMAL(10,2), energy_rating:STRING>') AS parsed_details,
        ELEMENT_AT(features, 'parking') AS parking_type,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(MAP_KEYS(features), 'garden') AS has_garden_key,
        SIZE(MAP_VALUES(features)) AS feature_value_count,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', listed_at) AS listing_month,
        listed_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS first_review_due,
        DATEDIFF(TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00', listed_at) AS days_on_market,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' AND ELEMENT_AT(features, 'garden') = 'yes' THEN 'ACTIVE_GARDEN'
            WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ACTIVE_NO_GARDEN'
            ELSE 'NON_ACTIVE'
        END AS listing_segment
    FROM property_listings pl
    -- Remove stale and withdrawn inventory before joining negotiations.
    WHERE status <> 'WITHDRAWN'
      AND listed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '14' DAY
),
activity_marked AS (
    SELECT
        oe.*,
        LAG(event_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS previous_event_at,
        LAG(offer_amount, 1, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS previous_offer_amount,
        LEAD(offer_amount, 1, offer_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS next_offer_amount,
        LEAD(event_at, 1, event_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at, event_id
        ) AS next_event_at
    FROM offer_activity oe
),
activity_flagged AS (
    SELECT
        am.*,
        -- More than 36 idle hours starts a separate negotiation session.
        CASE
            WHEN previous_event_at IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, previous_event_at, event_at) > 36 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS new_session_flag
    FROM activity_marked am
),
activity_sessioned AS (
    SELECT
        af.*,
        SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id
            ORDER BY event_at, event_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_id
    FROM activity_flagged af
),
listing_offer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        listing_id,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) AS distinct_buyers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count,
        SUM(DISTINCT offer_amount) AS distinct_offer_sum,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_types,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(buyer_id)) AS buyer_footprint
    FROM activity_sessioned
    GROUP BY listing_id
),
latest_activity AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY listing_id ORDER BY event_at DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM activity_sessioned s
)
SELECT
    l.*,
    l.address.postal_code AS postal_code,
    l.parsed_details.sqft AS square_feet,
    l.parsed_details.energy_rating AS energy_rating,
    COALESCE(a.agent_name, 'UNASSIGNED') AS agent_name,
    COALESCE(bp.financing_type, 'UNVERIFIED') AS buyer_financing,
    s.event_count,
    s.distinct_buyers,
    s.session_count,
    s.distinct_offer_sum,
    s.event_types,
    s.buyer_footprint,
    la.event_id AS latest_event_id,
    la.event_at AS latest_event_at,
    la.buyer_id AS latest_buyer_id,
    la.offer_amount AS latest_offer_amount,
    la.previous_offer_amount,
    la.next_offer_amount,
    la.session_id AS latest_session_id,
    CASE
        WHEN la.offer_amount IS NULL THEN 'NO_AMOUNT'
        WHEN la.offer_amount >= l.list_price THEN 'AT_OR_ABOVE_ASK'
        WHEN la.offer_amount >= l.list_price * 0.90 THEN 'NEAR_ASK'
        ELSE 'BELOW_ASK'
    END AS offer_position,
    ROUND(la.offer_amount - l.list_price, 2) AS latest_offer_delta,
    la.event_at + INTERVAL '12' HOUR AS response_due_at,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, l.listed_at, la.event_at) AS hours_listed_to_latest,
    (SELECT AVG(list_price)
       FROM property_listings
      WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_market_average
FROM listing_enriched l
JOIN listing_offer_stats s ON s.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN latest_activity la
  ON la.listing_id = l.listing_id AND la.recency_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN agent_directory a
  ON a.agent_id = l.agent_id AND a.is_active = TRUE
LEFT JOIN buyer_profiles bp
  ON bp.buyer_id = la.buyer_id
 AND bp.preapproval_expires >= DATE '2025-04-01'

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

details_schema = "STRUCT<sqft:INT, hoa_monthly:DECIMAL(10,2), energy_rating:STRING>"
listing_enriched = (
    df_property_listings.alias("pl")
    .filter(
        (F.col("status") != "WITHDRAWN")
        & (F.col("listed_at") >= F.lit("2025-02-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp") - F.expr("INTERVAL '14' DAY"))
    )
    .select(
        "pl.*",
        F.from_json(F.col("details_json"), details_schema).alias("parsed_details"),
        F.element_at(F.col("features"), "parking").alias("parking_type"),
        F.array_contains(F.map_keys(F.col("features")), "garden").alias("has_garden_key"),
        F.size(F.map_values(F.col("features"))).alias("feature_value_count"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("listed_at")).alias("listing_month"),
        (F.col("listed_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("first_review_due"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"), F.col("listed_at")).alias("days_on_market"),
        F.when(
            (F.col("status") == "ACTIVE") & (F.element_at(F.col("features"), "garden") == "yes"),
            "ACTIVE_GARDEN",
        )
        .when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", "ACTIVE_NO_GARDEN")
        .otherwise("NON_ACTIVE")
        .alias("listing_segment"),
    )
)

w_activity = Window.partitionBy("listing_id").orderBy("event_at", "event_id")
activity_marked = (
    df_offer_activity.alias("oe")
    .select(
        "oe.*",
        F.lag("event_at", 1).over(w_activity).alias("previous_event_at"),
        F.expr("LAG(offer_amount, 1, CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(12,2)))").over(w_activity).alias("previous_offer_amount"),
        F.expr("LEAD(offer_amount, 1, offer_amount)").over(w_activity).alias("next_offer_amount"),
        F.coalesce(F.lead("event_at", 1).over(w_activity), F.col("event_at")).alias("next_event_at"),
    )
)

activity_flagged = (
    activity_marked.alias("am")
    .select(
        "am.*",
        F.when(F.col("previous_event_at").isNull(), 1)
        .when(F.timestamp_diff("HOUR", F.col("previous_event_at"), F.col("event_at")) > 36, 1)
        .otherwise(0)
        .alias("new_session_flag"),
    )
)

w_session = w_activity.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
activity_sessioned = (
    activity_flagged.alias("af")
    .select("af.*", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(w_session).alias("session_id"))
)

listing_offer_stats = (
    activity_sessioned
    .groupBy("listing_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.countDistinct("buyer_id").alias("distinct_buyers"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("session_count"),
        F.sumDistinct("offer_amount").alias("distinct_offer_sum"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("event_types"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("buyer_id")).alias("buyer_footprint"),
    )
)

w_recency = Window.partitionBy("listing_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), F.col("event_id").desc())
latest_activity = (
    activity_sessioned.alias("s")
    .select("s.*", F.row_number().over(w_recency).alias("recency_rank"))
)

active_market_average = (
    df_property_listings
    .filter(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE")
    .agg(F.avg("list_price").alias("active_market_average"))
)

result = (
    listing_enriched.alias("l")
    .join(listing_offer_stats.alias("s"), F.col("s.listing_id") == F.col("l.listing_id"))
    .join(
        latest_activity.alias("la"),
        (F.col("la.listing_id") == F.col("l.listing_id")) & (F.col("la.recency_rank") == 1),
    )
    .join(
        df_agent_directory.alias("a"),
        (F.col("a.agent_id") == F.col("l.agent_id")) & (F.col("a.is_active") == True),
        "left",
    )
    .join(
        df_buyer_profiles.alias("bp"),
        (F.col("bp.buyer_id") == F.col("la.buyer_id"))
        & (F.col("bp.preapproval_expires") >= F.lit("2025-04-01").cast("date")),
        "left",
    )
    .crossJoin(active_market_average)
    .select(
        "l.*",
        F.col("l.address.postal_code").alias("postal_code"),
        F.col("l.parsed_details.sqft").alias("square_feet"),
        F.col("l.parsed_details.energy_rating").alias("energy_rating"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.agent_name"), F.lit("UNASSIGNED")).alias("agent_name"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("bp.financing_type"), F.lit("UNVERIFIED")).alias("buyer_financing"),
        "s.event_count",
        "s.distinct_buyers",
        "s.session_count",
        "s.distinct_offer_sum",
        "s.event_types",
        "s.buyer_footprint",
        F.col("la.event_id").alias("latest_event_id"),
        F.col("la.event_at").alias("latest_event_at"),
        F.col("la.buyer_id").alias("latest_buyer_id"),
        F.col("la.offer_amount").alias("latest_offer_amount"),
        "la.previous_offer_amount",
        "la.next_offer_amount",
        F.col("la.session_id").alias("latest_session_id"),
        F.when(F.col("la.offer_amount").isNull(), "NO_AMOUNT")
        .when(F.col("la.offer_amount") >= F.col("l.list_price"), "AT_OR_ABOVE_ASK")
        .when(F.col("la.offer_amount") >= F.col("l.list_price") * F.lit(0.9), "NEAR_ASK")
        .otherwise("BELOW_ASK")
        .alias("offer_position"),
        F.round(F.col("la.offer_amount") - F.col("l.list_price"), 2).alias("latest_offer_delta"),
        (F.col("la.event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '12' HOUR")).alias("response_due_at"),
        F.timestamp_diff("HOUR", F.col("l.listed_at"), F.col("la.event_at")).alias("hours_listed_to_latest"),
        "active_market_average",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("latest_event_at").desc(), F.col("listing_id"))
)

    )
    .join(

    .filter(

WITH stg_delivery AS (
    SELECT i.impression_id,
           i.campaign_id,
           camp.channel,
           i.placement,
           i.served_at,
           DATE(i.served_at) AS report_date,
           i.viewable_seconds,
           i.cost,
           element_at(i.delivery_attributes, 'consent_tier') AS consent_tier,
           SIZE(map_keys(i.delivery_attributes)) AS attribute_count,
           TRANSFORM(
               FILTER(i.creative_variant_ids, variant_id -> variant_id > 0),
               variant_id -> CONCAT('v', CAST(variant_id AS STRING))
           ) AS creative_variant_labels,
           AGGREGATE(
               FILTER(i.creative_variant_ids, variant_id -> variant_id > 0),
               0,
               (acc, variant_id) -> acc + variant_id
           ) AS variant_load,
           (SELECT MAX(daily_budget)
            FROM dim_campaign
            WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS max_active_budget
    FROM stg_impression_delivery i
    JOIN dim_campaign camp
      ON camp.campaign_id = i.campaign_id
     AND camp.is_active = TRUE
     -- The seven-day grace window deliberately admits late deliveries.
     AND i.served_at BETWEEN camp.flight_start
                         AND camp.flight_end + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    WHERE i.viewable_seconds IS NOT NULL
      AND (element_at(i.delivery_attributes, 'consent_tier') IN ('GRANTED', 'LIMITED')
           OR i.cost < 5.00)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM stg_policy_exclusions x
          WHERE x.impression_id = i.impression_id
            AND x.reason = 'BOT'
      )
),
stg_click_rollup AS (
    SELECT d.impression_id,
           COUNT(c.click_id) FILTER (
               WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE AND c.click_type <> 'INVALID'
           ) AS valid_click_count,
           COUNT(c.click_id) FILTER (
               WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE AND c.click_type = 'PRIMARY'
           ) AS primary_click_count,
           COUNT(c.click_id) FILTER (
               WHERE c.click_type = 'INVALID'
           ) AS invalid_click_count,
           COALESCE(
               SUM(c.revenue) FILTER (
                   WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE AND c.click_type <> 'INVALID'
               ),
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
           ) AS accepted_revenue
    FROM stg_delivery d
    LEFT JOIN stg_click_activity c
      ON c.impression_id = d.impression_id
     AND c.clicked_at BETWEEN d.served_at AND d.served_at + INTERVAL '2' DAY
    GROUP BY d.impression_id
),
stg_click_labels AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, report_date, primary_click_label, secondary_click_label
    FROM (
        SELECT d.campaign_id, d.report_date, c.click_type, c.click_label
        FROM stg_delivery d
        JOIN stg_click_activity c
          ON c.impression_id = d.impression_id
         AND c.clicked_at BETWEEN d.served_at AND d.served_at + INTERVAL '2' DAY
        WHERE c.is_suspect = FALSE
          AND c.click_type IN ('PRIMARY', 'SECONDARY')
    ) labelled_clicks
    PIVOT (
        MAX(click_label)
        FOR click_type IN (
            'PRIMARY' AS primary_click_label,
            'SECONDARY' AS secondary_click_label
        )
    )
),
fct_daily_performance AS (
    SELECT d.campaign_id,
           d.report_date,
           d.channel,
           GROUPING(d.campaign_id) AS campaign_grouping,
           GROUPING(d.channel) AS channel_grouping,
           CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS impression_count,
           CAST(SUM(r.valid_click_count) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS valid_click_count,
           CAST(SUM(r.invalid_click_count) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS invalid_click_count,
           CAST(SUM(d.cost) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS spend,
           CAST(SUM(r.accepted_revenue) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS accepted_revenue,
           CAST(PERCENTILE_APPROX(d.viewable_seconds, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(20,2))
               AS median_viewable_seconds,
           MAX(d.max_active_budget) AS active_budget_ceiling
    FROM stg_delivery d
    LEFT JOIN stg_click_rollup r ON r.impression_id = d.impression_id
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (d.campaign_id, d.report_date, d.channel),
        (d.campaign_id, d.report_date),
        (d.report_date)
    )
),
stg_metric_rows AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, report_date, channel,
           campaign_grouping, channel_grouping, active_budget_ceiling,
           metric_name, metric_value
    FROM fct_daily_performance
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            impression_count AS impressions,
            valid_click_count AS valid_clicks,
            invalid_click_count AS invalid_clicks,
            spend AS spend,
            accepted_revenue AS revenue,
            median_viewable_seconds AS median_view_time
        )
    )
),
stg_ranked_metrics AS (
    SELECT m.*,
           SUM(metric_value) OVER (
               PARTITION BY campaign_id, channel, report_date
               ORDER BY metric_value
               RANGE BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS value_neighborhood_total
    FROM stg_metric_rows m
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY metric_name, report_date
        ORDER BY metric_value DESC NULLS LAST,
                 campaign_id ASC NULLS LAST,
                 channel ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
)
SELECT r.report_date,
       r.metric_name,
       COALESCE(r.campaign_id, 'ALL_CAMPAIGNS') AS campaign_scope,
       COALESCE(r.channel, 'ALL_CHANNELS') AS channel_scope,
       CASE
           WHEN r.campaign_grouping = 1 THEN 'PORTFOLIO'
           WHEN r.channel_grouping = 1 THEN 'CAMPAIGN_TOTAL'
           ELSE 'CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL'
       END AS granularity,
       r.metric_value,
       r.value_neighborhood_total,
       r.active_budget_ceiling,
       l.primary_click_label,
       l.secondary_click_label
FROM stg_ranked_metrics r

higher-order array functions: TRANSFORM, FILTER, AGGREGATE or EXISTS with lambdas
a SQL PIVOT clause with string values (e.g. FOR metric IN ('TEMPERATURE' AS temperature, ...))
