case.sql:
/*
  Daily cloud billback: clean meter readings, pivot usage metrics,
  roll resources up to account/environment, and apply approved credits.
*/
WITH stg_usage_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        m.usage_id,
        m.resource_id,
        c.account_id,
        c.service_name,
        c.environment,
        c.resource_type,
        c.unit_price,
        CAST(m.usage_ts AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        datediff(CAST(m.usage_ts AS DATE), DATE '2025-01-01') AS day_index,
        m.metric,
        m.quantity,
        COALESCE(element_at(m.resource_tags, 'cost_center'), 'unassigned') AS cost_center,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(get_json_object(m.request_context, '$.billing_owner'), ''), 'unowned') AS billing_owner,
        aggregate(
            FILTER(m.hourly_usage, x -> x >= 0),
            CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
            (acc, x) -> acc + x
        ) AS clean_sample_total,
        CASE
            WHEN m.quantity IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
            WHEN m.quantity < 0 THEN 'CORRECTION'
            WHEN aggregate(FILTER(m.hourly_usage, x -> x >= 0), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x) >= 12 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN aggregate(FILTER(m.hourly_usage, x -> x >= 0), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE), (acc, x) -> acc + x) >= 5 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS usage_band
    FROM fct_usage_metering m
    JOIN dim_resource_catalog c
      ON c.resource_id = m.resource_id
     AND c.billing_enabled = TRUE
    WHERE m.usage_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-10 00:00:00'
      AND m.usage_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-12 00:00:00'
),
stg_usage_quality AS (
    -- Reading-level quality indicators remain separate from metric values.
    SELECT
        account_id, resource_id, service_name, environment, resource_type,
        unit_price, usage_date, day_index,
        max(cost_center) AS cost_center,
        max(billing_owner) AS billing_owner,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL) AS valid_readings,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_band = 'CORRECTION') AS correction_readings,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_band = 'HIGH') AS high_usage_readings,
        sum(clean_sample_total) AS sample_total
    FROM stg_usage_enriched
    GROUP BY
        account_id, resource_id, service_name, environment, resource_type,
        unit_price, usage_date, day_index
),
stg_daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        resource_id,
        usage_date,
        COALESCE(vcpu_hours, 0) AS vcpu_hours,
        COALESCE(memory_gb_hours, 0) AS memory_gb_hours,
        COALESCE(egress_gb, 0) AS egress_gb
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, resource_id, usage_date, metric, quantity
        FROM stg_usage_enriched
    ) meter
    PIVOT (
        sum(quantity)
        FOR metric IN (
            'VCPU_HOURS' AS vcpu_hours,
            'MEMORY_GB_HOURS' AS memory_gb_hours,
            'EGRESS_GB' AS egress_gb
        )
    )
),
stg_resource_daily AS (
    SELECT
        q.*,
        p.vcpu_hours,
        p.memory_gb_hours,
        p.egress_gb,
        p.vcpu_hours * q.unit_price
            + p.memory_gb_hours * q.unit_price * CAST(0.15 AS DOUBLE)
            + p.egress_gb * q.unit_price * CAST(0.05 AS DOUBLE) AS daily_charge,
        sum(p.vcpu_hours) OVER (
            PARTITION BY q.account_id, q.resource_id
            ORDER BY q.day_index
            RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS trailing_2d_vcpu_hours
    FROM stg_usage_quality q
    JOIN stg_daily_metrics p
      ON p.account_id = q.account_id
     AND p.resource_id = q.resource_id
     AND p.usage_date = q.usage_date
),
stg_adjustment_daily AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CAST(adjustment_ts AS DATE) AS usage_date,
        sum(adjustment_amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_credit
    FROM stg_billing_adjustments
    WHERE adjustment_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-10 00:00:00'
      AND adjustment_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-12 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY account_id, CAST(adjustment_ts AS DATE)
),
stg_account_rollup AS (
    -- Environment detail plus an all-environments row for each account/day.
    SELECT
        account_id,
        usage_date,
        day_index,
        CASE WHEN GROUPING(environment) = 1 THEN 'ALL_ENVIRONMENTS' ELSE environment END AS environment,
        GROUPING(environment) AS environment_grouping,
        sum(daily_charge) AS gross_charge,
        sum(vcpu_hours) AS vcpu_hours,
        sum(memory_gb_hours) AS memory_gb_hours,
        sum(egress_gb) AS egress_gb,
        sum(sample_total) AS sample_total,
        sum(valid_readings) AS valid_readings,
        sum(correction_readings) AS correction_readings
    FROM stg_resource_daily
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

clean_samples = F.filter(F.col("hourly_usage"), lambda x: x >= 0)
sample_total = F.aggregate(clean_samples, F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, x: acc + x)

    df_fct_usage_metering.alias("m")
    .join(
        df_dim_resource_catalog.alias("c"),
        (F.col("c.resource_id") == F.col("m.resource_id")) & F.col("c.billing_enabled"),
        "inner",
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("m.usage_ts") >= F.lit("2025-01-10 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("m.usage_ts") < F.lit("2025-01-12 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "m.usage_id",
        "m.resource_id",
        "c.account_id",
        "c.service_name",
        "c.environment",
        "c.resource_type",
        "c.unit_price",
        F.col("m.usage_ts").cast("date").alias("usage_date"),
        F.datediff(F.col("m.usage_ts").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-01-01").cast("date")).alias("day_index"),
        "m.metric",
        "m.quantity",
        F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("m.resource_tags"), F.lit("cost_center")), F.lit("unassigned")).alias("cost_center"),
        F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.get_json_object(F.col("m.request_context"), "$.billing_owner"), F.lit("")), F.lit("unowned")).alias("billing_owner"),
        sample_total.alias("clean_sample_total"),
        F.when(F.col("m.quantity").isNull(), F.lit("MISSING"))
        .when(F.col("m.quantity") < 0, F.lit("CORRECTION"))
        .when(sample_total >= 12, F.lit("HIGH"))
        .when(sample_total >= 5, F.lit("MEDIUM"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("LOW"))
        .alias("usage_band"),
    )
)

stg_usage_quality = (
    stg_usage_enriched
    .groupBy(
        "account_id", "resource_id", "service_name", "environment", "resource_type",
        "unit_price", "usage_date", "day_index",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("cost_center").alias("cost_center"),
        F.max("billing_owner").alias("billing_owner"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("quantity").isNotNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("valid_readings"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("usage_band") == "CORRECTION", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("correction_readings"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("usage_band") == "HIGH", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("high_usage_readings"),
        F.sum("clean_sample_total").alias("sample_total"),
    )
)

stg_daily_metrics = (
    stg_usage_enriched
    .select("account_id", "resource_id", "usage_date", "metric", "quantity")
    .groupBy("account_id", "resource_id", "usage_date")
    .pivot("metric", ["VCPU_HOURS", "MEMORY_GB_HOURS", "EGRESS_GB"])
    .agg(F.sum("quantity"))
    .withColumnRenamed("VCPU_HOURS", "vcpu_hours_raw")
    .withColumnRenamed("MEMORY_GB_HOURS", "memory_gb_hours_raw")
    .withColumnRenamed("EGRESS_GB", "egress_gb_raw")
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "resource_id",
        "usage_date",
        F.coalesce(F.col("vcpu_hours_raw"), F.lit(0)).alias("vcpu_hours"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("memory_gb_hours_raw"), F.lit(0)).alias("memory_gb_hours"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("egress_gb_raw"), F.lit(0)).alias("egress_gb"),
    )
)

w_resource_day = (
    Window.partitionBy(F.col("q.account_id"), F.col("q.resource_id"))
    .orderBy(F.col("q.day_index"))
    .rangeBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)
)
stg_resource_daily = (
    stg_usage_quality.alias("q")
    .join(
        stg_daily_metrics.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.account_id") == F.col("q.account_id"))
        & (F.col("p.resource_id") == F.col("q.resource_id"))
        & (F.col("p.usage_date") == F.col("q.usage_date")),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "q.*",
        "p.vcpu_hours",
        "p.memory_gb_hours",
        "p.egress_gb",

            F.col("p.vcpu_hours") * F.col("q.unit_price")
            + F.col("p.memory_gb_hours") * F.col("q.unit_price") * F.lit(0.15)
            + F.col("p.egress_gb") * F.col("q.unit_price") * F.lit(0.05)
        ).alias("daily_charge"),
        F.sum(F.col("p.vcpu_hours")).over(w_resource_day).alias("trailing_2d_vcpu_hours"),
    )
)

stg_adjustment_daily = (
    df_stg_billing_adjustments
    .filter(

        & (F.col("adjustment_ts") < F.lit("2025-01-12 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .groupBy("account_id", F.col("adjustment_ts").cast("date").alias("usage_date"))

rollup_columns = ["account_id", "usage_date", "day_index", "environment"]
stg_account_rollup = (
    stg_resource_daily
    .rollup(*rollup_columns)
    .agg(
        F.grouping("environment").alias("environment_grouping"),
        F.sum("daily_charge").alias("gross_charge"),
        F.sum("vcpu_hours").alias("vcpu_hours"),
        F.sum("memory_gb_hours").alias("memory_gb_hours"),
        F.sum("egress_gb").alias("egress_gb"),
        F.sum("sample_total").alias("sample_total"),
        F.sum("valid_readings").alias("valid_readings"),

    )
    .filter(F.grouping_id(*rollup_columns) <= 1)
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "usage_date",
        "day_index",
        F.when(F.col("environment_grouping") == 1, F.lit("ALL_ENVIRONMENTS"))
        .otherwise(F.col("environment"))
        .alias("environment"),
        "environment_grouping",
        "gross_charge",
        "vcpu_hours",
        "memory_gb_hours",
        "egress_gb",
        "sample_total",
        "valid_readings",
        "correction_readings",
    )
)

approved_credit = (
    F.when(F.col("roll.environment_grouping") == 1, F.coalesce(F.col("adj.approved_credit"), F.lit(0)))
    .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
)
result = (
    stg_account_rollup.alias("roll")
    .join(df_dim_cloud_accounts.alias("acct"), F.col("acct.account_id") == F.col("roll.account_id"), "left")
    .join(

        (F.col("adj.account_id") == F.col("roll.account_id"))

WITH latest_subs AS (
    -- Keep only the newest profile snapshot for each subscriber.
    SELECT subscriber_id, acct_status, segment_cd, topics
    FROM (
        SELECT s.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY subscriber_id
                   ORDER BY snapshot_ts DESC, snapshot_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM subscriber_snapshots s
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
recipients AS (
    -- Flatten recipient structs and derive send-time attributes.
    SELECT d.batch_id,
           d.newsletter_nm,
           d.subject_txt,
           d.from_email,
           d.sent_at,
           DATE_TRUNC('DAY', d.sent_at) AS send_day,
           d.sent_at + INTERVAL '7' DAY AS open_window_end,
           item.subscriber_id,
           item.email_addr,
           item.variant_cd,
           item.send_status,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(d.from_email, '@(.+)$', 1) AS sender_domain,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(d.subject_txt), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-') AS subject_slug
    FROM send_dispatches d
    LATERAL VIEW explode(d.recipients) r AS item
),
enriched_sends AS (
    -- Add current profile attributes and normalize topic arrays.
    SELECT a.*,
           s.acct_status,
           s.segment_cd,
           TRANSFORM(COALESCE(s.topics, ARRAY()), x -> LOWER(x)) AS topic_tags,
           FILTER(
               COALESCE(s.topics, ARRAY()),
               x -> x IS NOT NULL AND x RLIKE '^(product|news)$'
           ) AS core_topics
    FROM recipients a
    LEFT JOIN latest_subs s
      ON s.subscriber_id = a.subscriber_id
),
open_gaps AS (
    -- Clean valid opens and inspect the prior open per recipient.
    SELECT e.event_id,
           a.batch_id,
           a.subscriber_id,
           a.sent_at,
           e.opened_at,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(COALESCE(e.device_txt, ''), '^([A-Za-z]+)', 1) AS device_family,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(
               LOWER(COALESCE(e.source_txt, 'unknown')), '[^a-z0-9]+', '_'
           ) AS source_key,
           LAG(e.opened_at) OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.batch_id, a.subscriber_id
               ORDER BY e.opened_at, e.event_id
           ) AS prev_opened_at,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.batch_id, a.subscriber_id
               ORDER BY e.opened_at, e.event_id
               ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ) AS prev_2_open_cnt
    FROM enriched_sends a
    JOIN open_events e
      ON e.batch_id = a.batch_id
     AND e.subscriber_id = a.subscriber_id
    WHERE a.send_status = 'SENT'
      AND e.opened_at >= a.sent_at
      AND e.opened_at <= a.open_window_end
      AND (e.device_txt RLIKE '^(Mobile|Desktop|Tablet)' OR e.source_txt IS NOT NULL)
),
open_flags AS (
    -- Mark a new session after a gap of more than thirty minutes.
    SELECT g.*,
           CASE
               WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL
                OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
               THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END AS new_session_flag
    FROM open_gaps g
),
open_sessions AS (
    -- Convert gap flags into per-recipient session numbers.
    SELECT f.*,
           SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
               PARTITION BY batch_id, subscriber_id
               ORDER BY opened_at, event_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_id
    FROM open_flags f
)
-- Combine recipient coverage with open and session quality metrics.
SELECT a.batch_id,
       a.newsletter_nm,
       a.send_day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) AS recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) FILTER (WHERE a.send_status = 'SENT') AS sent_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) FILTER (WHERE a.send_status = 'BOUNCED') AS bounced_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.acct_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN a.subscriber_id END) AS active_recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN EXISTS(a.topic_tags, x -> x = 'product') THEN a.subscriber_id
       END) AS product_topic_recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SIZE(a.core_topics) > 0 THEN a.subscriber_id END) AS core_topic_recipient_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT os.event_id) AS open_event_cnt,
       COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT os.event_id), 0) AS open_event_id_sum,
       COUNT(DISTINCT os.subscriber_id) AS unique_opener_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT os.session_id) AS session_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.sent_at, os.opened_at)), 2) AS avg_distinct_open_delay_min,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.sent_at, os.opened_at), 0.5) AS median_open_delay_min,
       SUM(CASE WHEN os.device_family = 'Mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_open_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN os.source_key = 'direct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS direct_open_cnt,
       COALESCE(MAX(os.prev_2_open_cnt), 0) AS max_prev_2_open_cnt,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT os.subscriber_id)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subscriber_id) FILTER (WHERE a.send_status = 'SENT'), 0),
           2
       ) AS open_rate_pct,
       ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN os.device_family = 'Mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT os.event_id), 0),
           2
       ) AS mobile_open_share_pct
FROM enriched_sends a
LEFT JOIN open_sessions os
  ON os.batch_id = a.batch_id
 AND os.subscriber_id = a.subscriber_id
GROUP BY a.batch_id, a.newsletter_nm, a.send_day
ORDER BY a.send_day, a.batch_id

        F.col("item.email_addr").alias("email_addr"),
        F.col("item.variant_cd").alias("variant_cd"),
        F.col("item.send_status").alias("send_status"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("from_email"), "@(.+)$", 1).alias("sender_domain"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.lower(F.col("subject_txt")), "[^a-z0-9]+", "-").alias("subject_slug"),
    )
)

enriched_sends = (
    recipients.alias("a")
    .join(
        latest_subs.alias("s"),
        F.col("s.subscriber_id") == F.col("a.subscriber_id"),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("s.acct_status").alias("acct_status"),
        F.col("s.segment_cd").alias("segment_cd"),
        F.transform(
            F.coalesce(F.col("s.topics"), F.array()), lambda x: F.lower(x)
        ).alias("topic_tags"),
        F.filter(
            F.coalesce(F.col("s.topics"), F.array()),
            lambda x: x.isNotNull() & x.rlike("^(product|news)$"),
        ).alias("core_topics"),
    )
)

w_open = Window.partitionBy(F.col("a.batch_id"), F.col("a.subscriber_id")).orderBy(
    F.col("e.opened_at"), F.col("e.event_id")
)
open_gaps = (
    enriched_sends.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_open_events.alias("e"),
        (F.col("e.batch_id") == F.col("a.batch_id"))
        & (F.col("e.subscriber_id") == F.col("a.subscriber_id")),
        "inner",
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("a.send_status") == "SENT")
        & (F.col("e.opened_at") >= F.col("a.sent_at"))
        & (F.col("e.opened_at") <= F.col("a.open_window_end"))
        & (
            F.col("e.device_txt").rlike("^(Mobile|Desktop|Tablet)")
            | F.col("e.source_txt").isNotNull()
        )
    )
    .select(
        F.col("e.event_id").alias("event_id"),
        F.col("a.batch_id").alias("batch_id"),
        F.col("a.subscriber_id").alias("subscriber_id"),
        F.col("a.sent_at").alias("sent_at"),
        F.col("e.opened_at").alias("opened_at"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.coalesce(F.col("e.device_txt"), F.lit("")), "^([A-Za-z]+)", 1).alias("device_family"),
        F.regexp_replace(
            F.lower(F.coalesce(F.col("e.source_txt"), F.lit("unknown"))),
            "[^a-z0-9]+",
            "_",
        ).alias("source_key"),
        F.lag(F.col("e.opened_at")).over(w_open).alias("prev_opened_at"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_open.rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("prev_2_open_cnt"),
    )
)

open_flags = (
    open_gaps
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(
            F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull()
            | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '30' MINUTE")),
            1,
        ).otherwise(0).alias("new_session_flag"),
    )
)

w_session = (
    Window.partitionBy("batch_id", "subscriber_id")
    .orderBy("opened_at", "event_id")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
)
open_sessions = (
    open_flags
    .select("*", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(w_session).alias("session_id"))
)

sent_count = F.countDistinct(
    F.when(F.col("a.send_status") == "SENT", F.col("a.subscriber_id"))
)
open_event_count = F.countDistinct(F.col("os.event_id"))
mobile_open_count = F.sum(
    F.when(F.col("os.device_family") == "Mobile", 1).otherwise(0)
)
delay_min = F.timestamp_diff("MINUTE", F.col("a.sent_at"), F.col("os.opened_at"))
result = (
    enriched_sends.alias("a")
    .join(
        open_sessions.alias("os"),
        (F.col("os.batch_id") == F.col("a.batch_id"))
        & (F.col("os.subscriber_id") == F.col("a.subscriber_id")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.batch_id", "a.newsletter_nm", "a.send_day")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct(F.col("a.subscriber_id")).alias("recipient_cnt"),
        sent_count.alias("sent_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(F.col("a.send_status") == "BOUNCED", F.col("a.subscriber_id"))
        ).alias("bounced_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(F.col("a.acct_status") == "ACTIVE", F.col("a.subscriber_id"))
        ).alias("active_recipient_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(
                F.exists(F.col("a.topic_tags"), lambda x: x == "product"),
                F.col("a.subscriber_id"),
            )
        ).alias("product_topic_recipient_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(F.size(F.col("a.core_topics")) > 0, F.col("a.subscriber_id"))
        ).alias("core_topic_recipient_cnt"),
        open_event_count.alias("open_event_cnt"),
        F.coalesce(F.sum_distinct(F.col("os.event_id")), F.lit(0)).alias("open_event_id_sum"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("os.subscriber_id")).alias("unique_opener_cnt"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("os.session_id")).alias("session_cnt"),
        F.round(
            F.expr("avg(DISTINCT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, a.sent_at, os.opened_at))"), 2
        ).alias("avg_distinct_open_delay_min"),
        F.percentile_approx(delay_min, 0.5).alias("median_open_delay_min"),
        mobile_open_count.alias("mobile_open_cnt"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("os.source_key") == "direct", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("direct_open_cnt"),
        F.coalesce(F.max(F.col("os.prev_2_open_cnt")), F.lit(0)).alias("max_prev_2_open_cnt"),
        F.round(
            100.0 * F.countDistinct(F.col("os.subscriber_id")) / F.nullif(sent_count, F.lit(0)),
            2,
        ).alias("open_rate_pct"),
        F.round(
            100.0 * mobile_open_count / F.nullif(open_event_count, F.lit(0)),
            2,
        ).alias("mobile_open_share_pct"),
    )
    .orderBy("send_day", "batch_id")
)

/*
  App-store portfolio health report for March 2025.
  Combines download batches, platform mix, rating sentiment, and locale coverage.
  The final long format is suitable for a metric explorer dashboard.
*/
WITH stg_apps AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        app_name,
        category,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(store_profile.content_rating, ''), 'UNRATED') AS content_rating_label,
        store_profile.supported_locales AS supported_locales
    FROM dim_app_catalog
),
stg_downloads AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        app_id,
        country_code,
        downloaded_at,
        platform,
        download_count,
        gross_revenue,
        refund_count,
        FROM_JSON(event_json, 'STRUCT<channel: STRING, days_since_release: INT>') AS event_details
    FROM fct_app_downloads
    WHERE downloaded_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND downloaded_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
),
stg_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        rating_id,
        app_id,
        rated_at,
        stars,
        CASE
            WHEN stars IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
            WHEN stars >= 4 THEN 'PROMOTER'
            WHEN stars = 3 THEN 'NEUTRAL'
            ELSE 'DETRACTOR'
        END AS rating_band,
        COALESCE(stars, 0) AS stars_scored
    FROM fct_app_ratings
),
app_daily AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        DATE(downloaded_at) AS download_day,
        SUM(download_count) AS day_downloads,
        SUM(gross_revenue) AS day_revenue,
        SUM(refund_count) AS day_refunds,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(event_details.channel)) AS day_channels,
        SUM(SUM(download_count)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY app_id
            ORDER BY DATE(downloaded_at)
            RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 2 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_3d_downloads
    FROM stg_downloads
    GROUP BY app_id, DATE(downloaded_at)
),
platform_mix AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT app_id, platform, download_count
        FROM stg_downloads
    )
    PIVOT (
        SUM(download_count)
        FOR platform IN (
            'ios' AS ios_downloads,
            'android' AS android_downloads,
            'web' AS web_downloads
        )
    )
),
app_summary AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.ios_downloads,
        p.android_downloads,
        p.web_downloads,
        CAST(COALESCE(s.total_downloads, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_downloads,
        CAST(s.gross_revenue AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS gross_revenue,
        s.median_daily_downloads,
        s.peak_3d_downloads,
        s.acquisition_channels,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM stg_ratings r
         WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.rating_band = 'PROMOTER') AS promoter_ratings,
        CAST((SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars)
              FROM stg_ratings r
              WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS median_rating,
        TRANSFORM(
            FILTER(a.supported_locales, locale -> locale LIKE 'en-%'),
            locale -> UPPER(locale)
        ) AS english_locales,
        CASE
            WHEN s.total_downloads IS NULL THEN 'NO ACTIVITY'
            WHEN s.total_downloads >= 100 THEN 'HIGH MOMENTUM'
            WHEN s.total_downloads >= 50 THEN 'STEADY'
            ELSE 'NICHE'
        END AS performance_label,
        CASE
            WHEN (SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars) FROM stg_ratings r
                  WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) IS NULL THEN 'UNRATED'
            WHEN (SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars) FROM stg_ratings r
                  WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) >= 4 THEN 'LOVED'
            WHEN (SELECT MEDIAN(r.stars) FROM stg_ratings r
                  WHERE r.app_id = a.app_id AND r.stars IS NOT NULL) >= 3 THEN 'MIXED'
            ELSE 'CRITICAL'
        END AS rating_health
    FROM stg_apps a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            app_id,
            SUM(day_downloads) AS total_downloads,
            SUM(day_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
            SUM(day_refunds) AS total_refunds,
            PERCENTILE_APPROX(day_downloads, 0.5) AS median_daily_downloads,
            MAX(rolling_3d_downloads) AS peak_3d_downloads,
            ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_DISTINCT(FLATTEN(COLLECT_LIST(day_channels)))) AS acquisition_channels
        FROM app_daily
        GROUP BY app_id
    ) s ON s.app_id = a.app_id
    LEFT JOIN platform_mix p ON p.app_id = a.app_id
)
-- SQL UNPIVOT removes measures whose value is NULL.
SELECT
    app_id,
    app_name,
    category,
    content_rating_label,
    performance_label,
    rating_health,
    english_locales,
    acquisition_channels,
    promoter_ratings,
    metric_name,
    metric_value
FROM app_summary
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR metric_name IN (total_downloads, gross_revenue, median_rating)
)
ORDER BY metric_name, metric_value DESC NULLS LAST, performance_label, app_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

stg_apps = (
    df_dim_app_catalog
    .select(
        "app_id",
        "app_name",
        "category",
        F.coalesce(
            F.nullif(F.col("store_profile.content_rating"), F.lit("")),
            F.lit("UNRATED"),
        ).alias("content_rating_label"),
        F.col("store_profile.supported_locales").alias("supported_locales"),
    )
)

stg_downloads = (
    df_fct_app_downloads
    .filter(
        (F.col("downloaded_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("downloaded_at") < F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "event_id",
        "app_id",
        "country_code",
        "downloaded_at",
        "platform",
        "download_count",
        "gross_revenue",
        "refund_count",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("event_json"),
            "STRUCT<channel: STRING, days_since_release: INT>",
        ).alias("event_details"),
    )
)

stg_ratings = (
    df_fct_app_ratings
    .select(
        "rating_id",
        "app_id",
        "rated_at",
        "stars",
        F.when(F.col("stars").isNull(), F.lit("MISSING"))
        .when(F.col("stars") >= 4, F.lit("PROMOTER"))
        .when(F.col("stars") == 3, F.lit("NEUTRAL"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("DETRACTOR"))
        .alias("rating_band"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("stars"), F.lit(0)).alias("stars_scored"),
    )
)

w_app_day = (
    Window.partitionBy("app_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("download_day").cast("timestamp").cast("long"))
    .rangeBetween(-2 * 86400, 0)
)
app_daily = (
    stg_downloads
    .groupBy("app_id", F.to_date("downloaded_at").alias("download_day"))
    .agg(
        F.sum("download_count").alias("day_downloads"),
        F.sum("gross_revenue").alias("day_revenue"),
        F.sum("refund_count").alias("day_refunds"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set(F.col("event_details.channel"))).alias("day_channels"),
    )
    .withColumn("rolling_3d_downloads", F.sum("day_downloads").over(w_app_day))
)

platform_mix = (
    stg_downloads
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .pivot("platform", ["ios", "android", "web"])
    .agg(F.sum("download_count"))
    .withColumnRenamed("ios", "ios_downloads")
    .withColumnRenamed("android", "android_downloads")
    .withColumnRenamed("web", "web_downloads")
)

daily_totals = (
    app_daily
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("day_downloads").alias("total_downloads"),
        F.sum("day_revenue").alias("gross_revenue"),
        F.sum("day_refunds").alias("total_refunds"),
        F.percentile_approx("day_downloads", 0.5).alias("median_daily_downloads"),
        F.max("rolling_3d_downloads").alias("peak_3d_downloads"),
        F.array_sort(
            F.array_distinct(F.flatten(F.collect_list("day_channels")))
        ).alias("acquisition_channels"),
    )
)

rating_totals = (
    stg_ratings
    .groupBy("app_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("rating_band") == "PROMOTER", F.lit(1))).alias("promoter_ratings"),
        F.median("stars").alias("median_rating_raw"),
    )
)

app_summary = (
    stg_apps.alias("a")
    .join(daily_totals.alias("s"), F.col("s.app_id") == F.col("a.app_id"), "left")
    .join(platform_mix.alias("p"), F.col("p.app_id") == F.col("a.app_id"), "left")
    .join(rating_totals.alias("r"), F.col("r.app_id") == F.col("a.app_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        "p.ios_downloads",
        "p.android_downloads",
        "p.web_downloads",
        F.coalesce(F.col("s.total_downloads"), F.lit(0)).cast("decimal(18,2)").alias("total_downloads"),
        F.col("s.gross_revenue").cast("decimal(18,2)").alias("gross_revenue"),
        "s.median_daily_downloads",
        "s.peak_3d_downloads",
        "s.acquisition_channels",
        F.coalesce(F.col("r.promoter_ratings"), F.lit(0)).alias("promoter_ratings"),
        F.col("r.median_rating_raw").cast("decimal(18,2)").alias("median_rating"),
        F.transform(
            F.filter(F.col("a.supported_locales"), lambda locale: locale.like("en-%")),
            lambda locale: F.upper(locale),
        ).alias("english_locales"),
        F.when(F.col("s.total_downloads").isNull(), F.lit("NO ACTIVITY"))
        .when(F.col("s.total_downloads") >= 100, F.lit("HIGH MOMENTUM"))
        .when(F.col("s.total_downloads") >= 50, F.lit("STEADY"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("NICHE"))
        .alias("performance_label"),
        F.when(F.col("r.median_rating_raw").isNull(), F.lit("UNRATED"))
        .when(F.col("r.median_rating_raw") >= 4, F.lit("LOVED"))
        .when(F.col("r.median_rating_raw") >= 3, F.lit("MIXED"))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_latest_plan = Window.partitionBy("acct_id").orderBy(F.col("effective_ts").desc(), F.col("hist_id").desc())
latest_plan = (
    df_plan_change_history
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w_latest_plan))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("acct_id", "plan_id", "effective_ts")
)

call_enriched = (
    df_call_detail_records.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_subscriber_accounts.alias("a"),
        (F.col("a.acct_id") == F.col("c.acct_id")) & (F.col("a.acct_status") != "CLOSED"),
        "inner",
    )
    .join(latest_plan.alias("lp"), F.col("lp.acct_id") == F.col("c.acct_id"), "left")
    .join(
        df_rate_plans.alias("rp"),
        F.col("rp.plan_id") == F.coalesce(F.col("lp.plan_id"), F.col("a.plan_id")),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("c.call_ts") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("c.call_ts") < F.lit("2025-03-06 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "c.*",
        F.col("a.acct_nm").alias("acct_nm"),
        F.col("a.market_cd").alias("market_cd"),
        F.col("a.acct_status").alias("acct_status"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("lp.plan_id"), F.col("a.plan_id")).alias("plan_id"),
        F.col("rp.plan_nm").alias("plan_nm"),
        F.element_at(F.col("rp.feature_limits"), F.lit("intl_min")).alias("intl_min_limit"),
        F.size(F.map_keys(F.col("rp.feature_limits"))).alias("feature_count"),
        F.col("a.service_address.country").alias("service_country"),
        F.from_json(
            F.col("a.alert_prefs"),
            "struct<data_cap_gb:int,roam_opt_in:boolean,contact_email:string>",
        ).alias("prefs"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("c.dest_number"), r"^\+([0-9]{1,3})", 1).alias("dial_prefix"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.col("c.cell_site"), "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "").alias("normalized_site"),
    )
)

w_duration_range = (
    Window.partitionBy("acct_id")
    .orderBy("duration_sec")
    .rangeBetween(-300, Window.currentRow)
)
call_flags = (
    call_enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("dest_number").rlike(r"^\+(44|33|49|81|61)"), "INTERNATIONAL")
        .otherwise("DOMESTIC")
        .alias("route_type"),
        F.when(
            (F.col("call_status") == "CONNECTED") & (F.col("direction") == "OUTBOUND"),
            F.col("duration_sec"),
        ).otherwise(0).alias("billable_sec"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("prefs.roam_opt_in"), F.lit(False)).alias("roam_opt_in"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("prefs.data_cap_gb"), F.lit(0)).alias("data_cap_gb"),
        F.count("*").over(w_duration_range).alias("nearby_duration_calls"),
    )
)

daily_usage = (
    call_flags
    .groupBy(
        "acct_id",
        "acct_nm",
        "market_cd",
        "plan_id",
        "plan_nm",
        "service_country",
        "intl_min_limit",
        "feature_count",
        "data_cap_gb",
        F.to_date(F.col("call_ts")).alias("usage_day"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("total_calls"),
        F.sum("billable_sec").alias("billable_sec"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("call_status") == "CONNECTED", 1)).alias("connected_calls"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("roaming_ind") & (F.col("call_status") == "CONNECTED"), 1)).alias("roaming_calls"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("route_type") == "INTERNATIONAL", 1)).alias("intl_calls"),
        F.avg("nearby_duration_calls").alias("avg_nearby_duration_calls"),
        F.sum("charge_amt").alias("charge_amt"),
    )
)

w_prior_days = (
    Window.partitionBy("acct_id")
    .orderBy("usage_day")
    .rowsBetween(-2, -1)
)
usage_windows = (
    daily_usage
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.sum("billable_sec").over(w_prior_days), F.lit(0)).alias("prior_two_day_billable_sec"),
    )
)

acct_summary = (
    usage_windows
    .groupBy(
        "acct_id",
        "acct_nm",
        "market_cd",
        "plan_nm",
        "service_country",
        "intl_min_limit",
        "feature_count",
        "data_cap_gb",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("total_calls").alias("total_calls"),
        F.sum("billable_sec").alias("total_billable_sec"),
        F.sum("connected_calls").alias("connected_calls"),
        F.sum("roaming_calls").alias("roaming_calls"),
        F.sum("intl_calls").alias("intl_calls"),
        F.percentile_approx("billable_sec", 0.5).alias("median_daily_billable_sec"),
        F.round(F.avg("avg_nearby_duration_calls"), 2).alias("avg_nearby_duration_calls"),
        F.max("prior_two_day_billable_sec").alias("peak_prior_two_day_billable_sec"),
        F.round(F.sum("charge_amt"), 2).alias("total_charge_amt"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_calls") >= 3)
)

result = (
    acct_summary
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "acct_nm",
        "market_cd",
        "plan_nm",
        "service_country",
        "intl_min_limit",
        "feature_count",
        "data_cap_gb",
        "total_calls",
        "connected_calls",
        "roaming_calls",
        "intl_calls",
        F.round(F.col("total_billable_sec") / F.lit(60.0), 2).alias("billable_minutes"),
        "median_daily_billable_sec",
        "avg_nearby_duration_calls",
        "peak_prior_two_day_billable_sec",
        "total_charge_amt",
        F.ntile(2).over(
            Window.orderBy(F.col("total_billable_sec").desc(), F.col("acct_id"))
        ).alias("usage_half"),
        F.dense_rank().over(
            Window.orderBy(F.col("total_billable_sec").desc())
        ).alias("billable_rank"),
        F.when(
            (F.col("roaming_calls") > 0) & (F.col("data_cap_gb") >= 50),
            "ROAM_REVIEW",
        ).when(F.col("intl_calls") > 0, "INTL_REVIEW").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("review_segment"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("total_billable_sec").desc(), F.col("acct_id"))
)

WITH latest_plan AS (
    -- Keep only the newest plan change for each subscriber.
    SELECT acct_id, plan_id, effective_ts
    FROM (
        SELECT h.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY acct_id
                   ORDER BY effective_ts DESC, hist_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM plan_change_history h
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
call_enriched AS (
    -- Enrich March CDRs with the subscriber, latest plan, map features and text/JSON attributes.
    SELECT c.*,
           a.acct_nm,
           a.market_cd,
           a.acct_status,
           COALESCE(lp.plan_id, a.plan_id) AS plan_id,
           rp.plan_nm,
           ELEMENT_AT(rp.feature_limits, 'intl_min') AS intl_min_limit,
           SIZE(MAP_KEYS(rp.feature_limits)) AS feature_count,
           a.service_address.country AS service_country,
           FROM_JSON(
               a.alert_prefs,
               'STRUCT<data_cap_gb:INT,roam_opt_in:BOOLEAN,contact_email:STRING>'
           ) AS prefs,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(c.dest_number, '^\\+([0-9]{1,3})', 1) AS dial_prefix,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(c.cell_site, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '') AS normalized_site
    FROM call_detail_records c
    JOIN subscriber_accounts a
      ON a.acct_id = c.acct_id
     AND a.acct_status <> 'CLOSED'
    LEFT JOIN latest_plan lp ON lp.acct_id = c.acct_id
    LEFT JOIN rate_plans rp
      ON rp.plan_id = COALESCE(lp.plan_id, a.plan_id)
    WHERE c.call_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      AND c.call_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06 00:00:00'
),
call_flags AS (
    -- Derive routing and billable flags plus a numeric RANGE window over similar call durations.
    SELECT ce.*,
           CASE
               WHEN dest_number RLIKE '^\\+(44|33|49|81|61)' THEN 'INTERNATIONAL'
               ELSE 'DOMESTIC'
           END AS route_type,
           CASE
               WHEN call_status = 'CONNECTED' AND direction = 'OUTBOUND' THEN duration_sec
               ELSE 0
           END AS billable_sec,
           COALESCE(prefs.roam_opt_in, FALSE) AS roam_opt_in,
           COALESCE(prefs.data_cap_gb, 0) AS data_cap_gb,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY acct_id
               ORDER BY duration_sec
               RANGE BETWEEN 300 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_duration_calls
    FROM call_enriched ce
),
daily_usage AS (
    -- Aggregate filtered call measures by subscriber and usage day.
    SELECT acct_id,
           acct_nm,
           market_cd,
           plan_id,
           plan_nm,
           service_country,
           intl_min_limit,
           feature_count,
           data_cap_gb,
           TO_DATE(call_ts) AS usage_day,
           COUNT(*) AS total_calls,
           SUM(billable_sec) AS billable_sec,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE call_status = 'CONNECTED') AS connected_calls,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (
               WHERE roaming_ind AND call_status = 'CONNECTED'
           ) AS roaming_calls,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE route_type = 'INTERNATIONAL') AS intl_calls,
           AVG(nearby_duration_calls) AS avg_nearby_duration_calls,
           SUM(charge_amt) AS charge_amt
    FROM call_flags
    GROUP BY acct_id, acct_nm, market_cd, plan_id, plan_nm, service_country,
             intl_min_limit, feature_count, data_cap_gb, TO_DATE(call_ts)
),
usage_windows AS (
    -- Calculate a moving total over the two rows before the current usage day.
    SELECT du.*,
           COALESCE(
               SUM(billable_sec) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY acct_id
                   ORDER BY usage_day
                   ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
               ),
               0
           ) AS prior_two_day_billable_sec
    FROM daily_usage du
),
acct_summary AS (
    -- Roll daily activity up to subscriber level and retain accounts with at least three calls.
    SELECT acct_id,
           acct_nm,
           market_cd,
           plan_nm,
           service_country,
           intl_min_limit,
           feature_count,
           data_cap_gb,
           SUM(total_calls) AS total_calls,
           SUM(billable_sec) AS total_billable_sec,
           SUM(connected_calls) AS connected_calls,
           SUM(roaming_calls) AS roaming_calls,
           SUM(intl_calls) AS intl_calls,
           PERCENTILE_APPROX(billable_sec, 0.5) AS median_daily_billable_sec,
           ROUND(AVG(avg_nearby_duration_calls), 2) AS avg_nearby_duration_calls,
           MAX(prior_two_day_billable_sec) AS peak_prior_two_day_billable_sec,
           ROUND(SUM(charge_amt), 2) AS total_charge_amt
    FROM usage_windows
    GROUP BY acct_id, acct_nm, market_cd, plan_nm, service_country,
             intl_min_limit, feature_count, data_cap_gb
    HAVING SUM(total_calls) >= 3
)
-- Rank the account summaries and assign an operations review segment.
SELECT acct_id,
       acct_nm,
       market_cd,
       plan_nm,
       service_country,
       intl_min_limit,
       feature_count,
       data_cap_gb,
       total_calls,
       connected_calls,
       roaming_calls,
       intl_calls,
       ROUND(total_billable_sec / 60.0, 2) AS billable_minutes,
       median_daily_billable_sec,
       avg_nearby_duration_calls,
       peak_prior_two_day_billable_sec,
       total_charge_amt,
       NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY total_billable_sec DESC, acct_id) AS usage_half,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_billable_sec DESC) AS billable_rank,
       CASE
           WHEN roaming_calls > 0 AND data_cap_gb >= 50 THEN 'ROAM_REVIEW'
           WHEN intl_calls > 0 THEN 'INTL_REVIEW'
           ELSE 'STANDARD'
       END AS review_segment
FROM acct_summary
ORDER BY total_billable_sec DESC, acct_id

with stg_vendor_profile as (
    -- Parse vendor governance attributes and attach the portfolio-wide PO benchmark.
    select
        vendor_id, vendor_name, region, payment_terms_days,
        coalesce(
            cast(from_json(profile_json, 'struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>').risk_score as decimal(10,2)),
            cast(50 as decimal(10,2))
        ) as risk_score,
        from_json(profile_json, 'struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>').diversity_certified as diversity_certified,
        from_json(profile_json, 'struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>').review_cycle as review_cycle,
        (select cast(avg(subtotal) as decimal(18,4)) from stg_purchase_orders) as portfolio_avg_subtotal
    from stg_vendor_master
    where active_flag = true
),
stg_order_scope as (
    -- Keep approved, unblocked orders for active vendors with a completed approval.
    select
        ord.*,
        ven.vendor_name, ven.region, ven.payment_terms_days,
        ven.risk_score, ven.diversity_certified, ven.review_cycle,
        ven.portfolio_avg_subtotal,
        cast(
            ord.subtotal + coalesce(ord.tax_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))
            + coalesce(ord.freight_amount, cast(0 as decimal(12,2)))
            as decimal(18,2)
        ) as gross_amount
    from stg_purchase_orders ord
    join stg_vendor_profile ven on ven.vendor_id = ord.vendor_id
    where ord.po_status in ('APPROVED', 'CLOSED')
      and exists (
          select 1 from stg_po_approvals app
          where app.po_id = ord.po_id and app.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
      )
      and not exists (
          select 1 from stg_po_line_items lin
          where lin.po_id = ord.po_id and lin.compliance_block = true
      )
),
stg_cost_components as (
    -- Unpivot monetary components; SQL UNPIVOT omits the null tax component.
    select
        po_id, vendor_id, ordered_at, region, component_name,
        cast(component_value as decimal(18,2)) as component_value
    from stg_order_scope
    unpivot (
        component_value for component_name in (subtotal, tax_amount, freight_amount)
    )
),
stg_vendor_costs as (
    -- Aggregate component economics, distinct-value diagnostics, and filtered counts.
    select
        vendor_id,
        count(distinct po_id) as po_count,
        count(*) filter (where component_name = 'tax_amount') as taxed_component_rows,
        count(*) filter (where component_name = 'freight_amount' and component_value > 0) as freight_component_rows,
        sum(case when component_name = 'subtotal' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end) as subtotal_spend,
        sum(case when component_name = 'freight_amount' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end) as freight_spend,
        round(
            cast(100 as decimal(10,2))
            * sum(case when component_name = 'freight_amount' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end)
            / nullif(sum(case when component_name = 'subtotal' then component_value else cast(0 as decimal(18,2)) end), 0),
            2
        ) as freight_pct,
        avg(distinct component_value) as avg_distinct_component_value,
        sum(distinct component_value) as sum_distinct_component_value
    from stg_cost_components
    group by vendor_id
),
stg_vendor_grades as (
    -- Pivot May scorecard strings into vendor delivery, quality, and compliance grades.
    select *
    from (
        select vendor_id, metric, metric_value
        from stg_vendor_scorecards
        where review_month = date '2025-05-01'
    ) score_src
    pivot (
        max(metric_value)
        for metric in (
            'DELIVERY' as delivery_grade,
            'QUALITY' as quality_grade,
            'COMPLIANCE' as compliance_grade
        )
    )
)
select
    ord.po_id, ord.vendor_id, ord.vendor_name, ord.region, ord.buyer_id,
    ord.ordered_at, ord.currency_code, ord.po_status, ord.budget_code,
    ord.subtotal, ord.tax_amount, ord.freight_amount, ord.gross_amount,
    ord.payment_terms_days, ord.risk_score, ord.diversity_certified,
    cost.po_count, cost.taxed_component_rows, cost.freight_component_rows,
    cost.subtotal_spend, cost.freight_spend, cost.freight_pct,
    round(cost.avg_distinct_component_value, 2) as avg_distinct_component_value,
    cost.sum_distinct_component_value,
    grades.delivery_grade, grades.quality_grade, grades.compliance_grade,
    cast(
        sum(ord.gross_amount) over (
            partition by ord.vendor_id
            order by unix_date(cast(ord.ordered_at as date))
            range between 90 preceding and current row
        ) as decimal(18,2)
    ) as trailing_90d_gross,
    round(ord.gross_amount - ord.portfolio_avg_subtotal, 2) as gross_vs_portfolio_avg,
    round(cast(ord.gross_amount as decimal(18,4)) / nullif(ord.portfolio_avg_subtotal, 0), 2) as gross_to_portfolio_avg_ratio,
    floor(ord.risk_score / 10) as risk_decile,
    ceil(cost.freight_pct / 5) * 5 as freight_pct_band
from stg_order_scope ord
join stg_vendor_costs cost on cost.vendor_id = ord.vendor_id
left join stg_vendor_grades grades on grades.vendor_id = ord.vendor_id
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by ord.vendor_id order by ord.ordered_at desc, ord.po_id desc
) = 1
order by ord.region, ord.vendor_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

vendor_json_schema = "struct<risk_score:int,diversity_certified:boolean,review_cycle:string>"
portfolio_avg = df_stg_purchase_orders.agg(
    F.avg("subtotal").cast("decimal(18,4)").alias("portfolio_avg_subtotal")
)

stg_vendor_profile = (
    df_stg_vendor_master
    .filter(F.col("active_flag") == F.lit(True))
    .crossJoin(portfolio_avg)
    .select(
        "vendor_id",
        "vendor_name",
        "region",
        "payment_terms_days",
        F.coalesce(
            F.from_json("profile_json", vendor_json_schema).getField("risk_score").cast("decimal(10,2)"),
            F.lit(50).cast("decimal(10,2)"),
        ).alias("risk_score"),
        F.from_json("profile_json", vendor_json_schema).getField("diversity_certified").alias("diversity_certified"),
        F.from_json("profile_json", vendor_json_schema).getField("review_cycle").alias("review_cycle"),
        "portfolio_avg_subtotal",
    )
)

approved_po_ids = (
    df_stg_po_approvals
    .filter(F.col("approval_status") == "APPROVED")
    .select("po_id")
    .distinct()
)
blocked_po_ids = (
    df_stg_po_line_items
    .filter(F.col("compliance_block") == F.lit(True))
    .select("po_id")
    .distinct()
)
stg_order_scope = (
    df_stg_purchase_orders.alias("ord")
    .filter(F.col("po_status").isin("APPROVED", "CLOSED"))
    .join(approved_po_ids, "po_id", "left_semi")
    .join(blocked_po_ids, "po_id", "left_anti")
    .join(stg_vendor_profile.alias("ven"), F.col("ven.vendor_id") == F.col("ord.vendor_id"))
    .select(
        "ord.*",
        "ven.vendor_name",
        "ven.region",
        "ven.payment_terms_days",
        "ven.risk_score",
        "ven.diversity_certified",
        "ven.review_cycle",
        "ven.portfolio_avg_subtotal",
        (
            F.col("ord.subtotal")
            + F.coalesce(F.col("ord.tax_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))
            + F.coalesce(F.col("ord.freight_amount"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))
        ).cast("decimal(18,2)").alias("gross_amount"),
    )
)

stg_cost_components = (
    stg_order_scope
    .unpivot(
        ["po_id", "vendor_id", "ordered_at", "region"],
        ["subtotal", "tax_amount", "freight_amount"],
        "component_name",
        "component_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("component_value").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "po_id",
        "vendor_id",
        "ordered_at",
        "region",
        "component_name",
        F.col("component_value").cast("decimal(18,2)").alias("component_value"),
    )
)

subtotal_spend = F.sum(
    F.when(F.col("component_name") == "subtotal", F.col("component_value"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(18,2)"))
)
freight_spend = F.sum(
    F.when(F.col("component_name") == "freight_amount", F.col("component_value"))
    .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(18,2)"))
)
nonzero_subtotal_spend = F.when(subtotal_spend != F.lit(0), subtotal_spend)
stg_vendor_costs = (
    stg_cost_components
    .groupBy("vendor_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("po_id").alias("po_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("component_name") == "tax_amount", F.lit(1))).alias("taxed_component_rows"),
        F.count(
            F.when(
                (F.col("component_name") == "freight_amount") & (F.col("component_value") > 0),
                F.lit(1),
            )
        ).alias("freight_component_rows"),
        subtotal_spend.alias("subtotal_spend"),
        freight_spend.alias("freight_spend"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100).cast("decimal(10,2)") * freight_spend / nonzero_subtotal_spend,
            2,
        ).alias("freight_pct"),
        F.expr("avg(distinct component_value)").alias("avg_distinct_component_value"),
        F.sumDistinct("component_value").alias("sum_distinct_component_value"),
    )
)

stg_vendor_grades = (
    df_stg_vendor_scorecards
    .filter(F.col("review_month") == F.lit("2025-05-01").cast("date"))
    .groupBy("vendor_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["DELIVERY", "QUALITY", "COMPLIANCE"])
    .agg(F.max("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "vendor_id",
        F.col("DELIVERY").alias("delivery_grade"),
        F.col("QUALITY").alias("quality_grade"),
        F.col("COMPLIANCE").alias("compliance_grade"),
    )
)

w_trailing_90d = (
    Window.partitionBy("ord.vendor_id")
    .orderBy(F.unix_date(F.col("ord.ordered_at").cast("date")))
    .rangeBetween(-90, 0)
)
w_latest_po = Window.partitionBy("ord.vendor_id").orderBy(
    F.col("ord.ordered_at").desc(), F.col("ord.po_id").desc()
)
joined = (
    stg_order_scope.alias("ord")
    .join(stg_vendor_costs.alias("cost"), F.col("cost.vendor_id") == F.col("ord.vendor_id"))
    .join(stg_vendor_grades.alias("grades"), F.col("grades.vendor_id") == F.col("ord.vendor_id"), "left")
)
prequalified = (
    joined
    .withColumn(
        "trailing_90d_gross",
        F.sum("ord.gross_amount").over(w_trailing_90d).cast("decimal(18,2)"),
    )
    .withColumn("_recency_rank", F.row_number().over(w_latest_po))
    .filter(F.col("_recency_rank") == 1)
)
result = (
    prequalified
    .select(
        "ord.po_id",
        "ord.vendor_id",
        "ord.vendor_name",
        "ord.region",
        "ord.buyer_id",
        "ord.ordered_at",
        "ord.currency_code",
        "ord.po_status",
        "ord.budget_code",
        "ord.subtotal",
        "ord.tax_amount",
        "ord.freight_amount",
        "ord.gross_amount",
        "ord.payment_terms_days",
        "ord.risk_score",
        "ord.diversity_certified",
        "cost.po_count",
        "cost.taxed_component_rows",
        "cost.freight_component_rows",
        "cost.subtotal_spend",
        "cost.freight_spend",
        "cost.freight_pct",
        F.round("cost.avg_distinct_component_value", 2).alias("avg_distinct_component_value"),
        "cost.sum_distinct_component_value",
        "grades.delivery_grade",
        "grades.quality_grade",
        "grades.compliance_grade",
        "trailing_90d_gross",
        F.round(F.col("ord.gross_amount") - F.col("ord.portfolio_avg_subtotal"), 2).alias("gross_vs_portfolio_avg"),
        F.round(
            F.col("ord.gross_amount").cast("decimal(18,4)")
            / F.when(F.col("ord.portfolio_avg_subtotal") != 0, F.col("ord.portfolio_avg_subtotal")),
            2,
        ).alias("gross_to_portfolio_avg_ratio"),
        F.floor(F.col("ord.risk_score") / 10).alias("risk_decile"),
        (F.ceil(F.col("cost.freight_pct") / 5) * 5).alias("freight_pct_band"),
    )
    .orderBy("ord.region", "ord.vendor_id")
)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_pass_recency = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("updated_at").desc(), F.col("pass_version").desc())
latest_passes = (
    df_stg_ticket_passes
    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(w_pass_recency))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "ticket_id",
        "performance_id",
        "patron_profile",
        "entitlements",
        F.element_at(F.col("reader_overrides"), F.lit("lane_hint")).alias("lane_hint"),
        F.transform(
            F.filter(F.col("entitlements"), lambda item: item["benefit_status"] == "ACTIVE"),
            lambda item: F.upper(item["benefit_code"]),
        ).alias("active_benefit_codes"),
    )
)

pass_benefits = (
    latest_passes
    .select("ticket_id", F.explode(F.col("entitlements")).alias("item"))
    .filter(F.col("item.benefit_status") == "ACTIVE")
    .groupBy("ticket_id")
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(
            F.collect_set(F.concat_ws(":", F.col("item.benefit_code"), F.col("item.seat_zone")))
        ).alias("benefit_details"),
        F.size(F.collect_set(F.col("item.benefit_code"))).alias("benefit_type_count"),
    )
)

gate_metrics = (
    df_stg_gate_incidents
    .groupBy("gate_code", "service_date")
    .pivot("metric", ["CROWD", "NETWORK"])
    .agg(F.max("metric_value"))
    .withColumnRenamed("CROWD", "crowd_state")
    .withColumnRenamed("NETWORK", "network_state")
)

scoped_scans = (
    df_fct_entry_scans.alias("s")
    .join(latest_passes.alias("lp"), F.col("s.ticket_id") == F.col("lp.ticket_id"))
    .join(
        df_dim_performances.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.performance_id") == F.col("lp.performance_id"))
        & F.col("s.scanned_at").between(
            F.col("p.doors_open_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL '30' MINUTE"),
            F.col("p.ends_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '2' HOUR"),
        ),
    )
    .select(
        F.col("s.scan_id").alias("scan_id"),
        F.col("s.ticket_id").alias("ticket_id"),

        F.col("p.performance_name").alias("performance_name"),
        F.col("p.starts_at").alias("starts_at"),
        F.col("s.scanned_at").alias("scanned_at"),
        F.col("s.gate_code").alias("gate_code"),
        F.col("s.scan_result").alias("scan_result"),
        F.col("p.access_policy.default_gate").alias("default_gate"),

        F.concat_ws(

            F.col("p.venue_code"),
            F.lpad(F.col("s.scan_id").cast("string"), 3, "0"),
            F.array_join(F.split(F.col("s.seat_label"), "-"), ""),
        ).alias("scan_ref"),
        F.col("lp.lane_hint").alias("lane_hint"),
        F.col("lp.active_benefit_codes").alias("active_benefit_codes"),
        F.unix_timestamp(F.col("s.scanned_at")).alias("scan_epoch"),
    )

w_scan_time = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("scanned_at", "scan_id")
previous_scan = F.lag("scanned_at").over(w_scan_time)
session_flags = (
    scoped_scans
    .withColumn(
        "new_session_flag",
        F.when(
            previous_scan.isNull()
            | (F.col("scanned_at") > previous_scan + F.expr("INTERVAL '45' MINUTE")),

        F.max("pb.benefit_type_count").alias("benefit_type_count"),
        F.max(F.array_join(F.col("pb.benefit_details"), "; ")).alias("benefit_details"),
        F.max("gm.network_state").alias("network_state"),
        F.max("gm.crowd_state").alias("crowd_state"),
        F.when(F.sum(F.when(F.col("ss.scan_result") == "DENIED", 1).otherwise(0)) > 0, "REVIEW")
        .when(F.max(F.when(F.col("ss.gate_code") != F.col("ss.default_gate"), 1).otherwise(0)) == 1, "OFF_LANE")
        .when(
            F.max(
                F.when(
                    F.col("ss.scanned_at") > F.col("ss.starts_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '15' MINUTE"),
                    1,
                ).otherwise(0)
            ) == 1,
            "LATE_ARRIVAL",
        )
        .otherwise("STANDARD")
        .alias("entry_disposition"),
    )
    .select(
        "session_key",
        "performance_name",
        "patron_label",
        "seat_ref",
        "session_started_at",
        "session_ended_at",
        "scan_events",
        "admitted_scans",
        "gates_used",
        "peak_scans_in_30_minutes",
        "active_perk_codes",
        "benefit_type_count",
        "benefit_details",
        "network_state",
        "crowd_state",
        "entry_disposition",
    )
    .orderBy("session_started_at", "session_key")
)
case.sql:
WITH latest_passes AS (
    -- Keep only the newest pass version and derive active benefit codes.
    SELECT ticket_id,
           performance_id,
           patron_profile,
           entitlements,
           ELEMENT_AT(reader_overrides, 'lane_hint') AS lane_hint,
           TRANSFORM(
               FILTER(entitlements, item -> item.benefit_status = 'ACTIVE'),
               item -> UPPER(item.benefit_code)
           ) AS active_benefit_codes
    FROM (
        SELECT sp.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY ticket_id
                   ORDER BY updated_at DESC, pass_version DESC
               ) AS recency_rank
        FROM stg_ticket_passes sp
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
pass_benefits AS (
    -- Flatten entitlement structs and summarize active benefits per ticket.
    SELECT lp.ticket_id,
           ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(
               CONCAT_WS(':', item.benefit_code, item.seat_zone)
           )) AS benefit_details,
           SIZE(COLLECT_SET(item.benefit_code)) AS benefit_type_count
    FROM latest_passes lp
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(lp.entitlements) AS item
    WHERE item.benefit_status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY lp.ticket_id
),
gate_metrics AS (
    -- Pivot gate observations into comparable string-valued health columns.
    SELECT gate_code, service_date, crowd_state, network_state
    FROM (
        SELECT gate_code, service_date, metric, metric_value
        FROM stg_gate_incidents
    ) observations
    PIVOT (
        MAX(metric_value)
        FOR metric IN ('CROWD' AS crowd_state, 'NETWORK' AS network_state)
    )
),
scoped_scans AS (
    -- Match scans to their performance access window and enrich ticket details.
    SELECT s.scan_id,
           s.ticket_id,
           p.performance_id,
           p.performance_name,
           p.starts_at,
           s.scanned_at,
           s.gate_code,
           s.scan_result,
           p.access_policy.default_gate AS default_gate,
           p.access_policy.late_grace_minutes AS late_grace_minutes,
           CONCAT_WS(
               ' / ', lp.patron_profile.display_name,
               CONCAT('MEMBER-', LPAD(CAST(lp.patron_profile.member_id AS STRING), 3, '0'))
           ) AS patron_label,
           ARRAY_JOIN(SPLIT(s.seat_label, '-'), '/') AS seat_ref,
           CONCAT_WS(
               '-', p.venue_code, LPAD(CAST(s.scan_id AS STRING), 3, '0'),
               ARRAY_JOIN(SPLIT(s.seat_label, '-'), '')
           ) AS scan_ref,
           lp.lane_hint,
           lp.active_benefit_codes,
           UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.scanned_at) AS scan_epoch
    FROM fct_entry_scans s
    JOIN latest_passes lp ON lp.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
    JOIN dim_performances p
      ON p.performance_id = lp.performance_id
     AND s.scanned_at BETWEEN p.doors_open_at - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
                          AND p.ends_at + INTERVAL '2' HOUR
),
session_flags AS (
    -- Start a new entry session after a forty-five minute scanning gap.
    SELECT ss.*,
           CASE
               WHEN LAG(scanned_at) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY scanned_at, scan_id
               ) IS NULL THEN 1
               WHEN scanned_at > LAG(scanned_at) OVER (
                   PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY scanned_at, scan_id
               ) + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS new_session_flag
    FROM scoped_scans ss
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Number sessions and count nearby scans with a numeric RANGE frame.
    SELECT sf.*,
           SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ticket_id
               ORDER BY scanned_at, scan_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS session_sequence,
           COUNT(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ticket_id
               ORDER BY scan_epoch
               RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS scans_in_30_minutes
    FROM session_flags sf
)
-- Build one operational summary per patron entry session.
SELECT CONCAT_WS(
           ':', ss.ticket_id, ss.performance_id,
           LPAD(CAST(MIN(ss.scan_id) AS STRING), 3, '0')
       ) AS session_key,
       MAX(ss.performance_name) AS performance_name,
       MAX(ss.patron_label) AS patron_label,
       MAX(ss.seat_ref) AS seat_ref,
       MIN(ss.scanned_at) AS session_started_at,
       MAX(ss.scanned_at) AS session_ended_at,
       COUNT(*) AS scan_events,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ss.scan_result = 'ADMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS admitted_scans,
       ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(ss.gate_code)), ',') AS gates_used,
       MAX(ss.scans_in_30_minutes) AS peak_scans_in_30_minutes,
       MAX(ARRAY_JOIN(ss.active_benefit_codes, '|')) AS active_perk_codes,
       MAX(pb.benefit_type_count) AS benefit_type_count,
       MAX(ARRAY_JOIN(pb.benefit_details, '; ')) AS benefit_details,
       MAX(gm.network_state) AS network_state,
       MAX(gm.crowd_state) AS crowd_state,
       CASE
           WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ss.scan_result = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
               THEN 'REVIEW'
           WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ss.gate_code <> ss.default_gate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
               THEN 'OFF_LANE'
           WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ss.scanned_at > ss.starts_at + INTERVAL '15' MINUTE
                         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
               THEN 'LATE_ARRIVAL'
           ELSE 'STANDARD'
       END AS entry_disposition
FROM sessionized ss
LEFT JOIN pass_benefits pb ON pb.ticket_id = ss.ticket_id
LEFT JOIN gate_metrics gm
  ON gm.gate_code = ss.gate_code
 AND gm.service_date = TO_DATE(ss.scanned_at)
GROUP BY ss.ticket_id, ss.performance_id, ss.session_sequence
ORDER BY session_started_at, session_key

/*
  Daily work-order scrap review.
  Combines output counts, defect weighting, recent scrap context, and line targets.
  Null output measures are excluded by UNPIVOT; null scrap quantities mean zero.
*/
WITH output_long AS (
    SELECT work_order_id, metric_name, metric_value
    FROM production_output_counts
    UNPIVOT (
        metric_value FOR metric_name IN (
            good_qty,
            rework_qty,
            audit_sample_qty
        )
    )
),
output_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        work_order_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'good_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS good_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'rework_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS rework_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'audit_sample_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS audit_sample_qty,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'rework_qty' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(
                SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('good_qty', 'rework_qty') THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END),
                0
            ),
            2
        ) AS rework_share_pct
    FROM output_long
    GROUP BY work_order_id
),
scrap_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.scrap_entry_id,
        s.work_order_id,
        s.event_ts,
        s.operation_seq,
        s.defect_code,
        h.routing.primary_cell,
        h.routing.shift_lead,
        COALESCE(s.scrap_qty, 0) AS scrap_qty,
        COALESCE(s.rework_qty, 0) AS rework_qty,
        s.containment_state,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(s.scrap_qty, 0)
            * (s.material_cost + s.labor_cost)
            * COALESCE(element_at(h.defect_multipliers, s.defect_code), 1.0)
            AS DECIMAL(12,2)
        ) AS weighted_scrap_cost,
        EXISTS(h.allowed_defect_codes, code -> code = s.defect_code) AS defect_allowed,
        FILTER(
            TRANSFORM(h.allowed_defect_codes, code -> upper(code)),
            code -> code <> 'LEGACY'
        ) AS active_defect_allowlist
    FROM scrap_fact_entries s
    JOIN work_order_specs h
      ON h.work_order_id = s.work_order_id
),
scrap_windowed AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        SUM(scrap_qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY work_order_id
            ORDER BY operation_seq
            RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS nearby_operation_scrap,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY work_order_id
            ORDER BY event_ts DESC, scrap_entry_id DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM scrap_enriched se
),
latest_scrap AS (
    -- One deterministic context row per work order.
    SELECT sw.*
    FROM scrap_windowed sw
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY work_order_id
        ORDER BY event_ts DESC, scrap_entry_id DESC
    ) = 1
),
scrap_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        work_order_id,
        SUM(scrap_qty) AS total_scrap_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN containment_state = 'CUSTOMER_FOUND' THEN scrap_qty ELSE 0 END) AS customer_found_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN defect_allowed THEN weighted_scrap_cost ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END) AS allowed_defect_cost,
        SUM(weighted_scrap_cost) AS total_weighted_scrap_cost,
        percentile_approx(scrap_qty, 0.5) AS median_scrap_qty,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN containment_state = 'CUSTOMER_FOUND' THEN scrap_qty ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(SUM(scrap_qty), 0),
            2
        ) AS customer_found_pct
    FROM scrap_windowed
    GROUP BY work_order_id
)
SELECT
    sr.*,
    wo.plant_code,
    wo.line_code,
    wo.product_family,
    ls.primary_cell,
    ls.shift_lead,
    ls.event_ts AS last_scrap_ts,
    ls.defect_code AS last_defect_code,
    ls.nearby_operation_scrap,
    size(ls.active_defect_allowlist) AS active_allowed_defects,
    oru.good_qty,
    oru.rework_qty,
    oru.audit_sample_qty,
    oru.rework_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * sr.total_scrap_qty
        / NULLIF(oru.good_qty + sr.total_scrap_qty, 0),
        2
    ) AS scrap_rate_pct,
    COALESCE(lsc.scrap_target_pct, CAST(5.00 AS DECIMAL(5,2))) AS scrap_target_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN 100.0 * sr.total_scrap_qty
             / NULLIF(oru.good_qty + sr.total_scrap_qty, 0)
             > COALESCE(lsc.scrap_target_pct, CAST(5.00 AS DECIMAL(5,2)))
        THEN 'ABOVE_TARGET'
        ELSE 'WITHIN_TARGET'
    END AS scrap_status
FROM scrap_rollup sr
JOIN latest_scrap ls
  ON ls.work_order_id = sr.work_order_id
JOIN output_rollup oru
  ON oru.work_order_id = sr.work_order_id
JOIN work_order_specs wo
  ON wo.work_order_id = sr.work_order_id
LEFT JOIN line_scrap_controls lsc
  ON lsc.plant_code = wo.plant_code
 AND lsc.line_code = wo.line_code
-- Ignore small jobs and lines without enough accepted output.
WHERE wo.planned_qty >= 200
  AND oru.good_qty >= 100
ORDER BY scrap_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST, sr.work_order_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

output_long = (
    df_production_output_counts
    .unpivot(
        "work_order_id",
        ["good_qty", "rework_qty", "audit_sample_qty"],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
    .select("work_order_id", "metric_name", "metric_value")
)

output_rollup = (
    output_long
    .groupBy("work_order_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("metric_name") == "good_qty", F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0)).alias("good_qty"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("metric_name") == "rework_qty", F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0)).alias("rework_qty"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("metric_name") == "audit_sample_qty", F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0)).alias("audit_sample_qty"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100.0) * F.sum(F.when(F.col("metric_name") == "rework_qty", F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0))
            / F.when(
                F.sum(F.when(F.col("metric_name").isin("good_qty", "rework_qty"), F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0)) != 0,
                F.sum(F.when(F.col("metric_name").isin("good_qty", "rework_qty"), F.col("metric_value")).otherwise(0)),
            ),
            2,
        ).alias("rework_share_pct"),
    )
)

scrap_enriched = (
    df_scrap_fact_entries.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_work_order_specs.alias("h"),
        F.col("h.work_order_id") == F.col("s.work_order_id"),
    )
    .select(
        F.col("s.scrap_entry_id").alias("scrap_entry_id"),
        F.col("s.work_order_id").alias("work_order_id"),
        F.col("s.event_ts").alias("event_ts"),
        F.col("s.operation_seq").alias("operation_seq"),
        F.col("s.defect_code").alias("defect_code"),
        F.col("h.routing.primary_cell").alias("primary_cell"),
        F.col("h.routing.shift_lead").alias("shift_lead"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("s.scrap_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("scrap_qty"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("s.rework_qty"), F.lit(0)).alias("rework_qty"),
        F.col("s.containment_state").alias("containment_state"),
        (
            F.coalesce(F.col("s.scrap_qty"), F.lit(0))
            * (F.col("s.material_cost") + F.col("s.labor_cost"))
            * F.coalesce(
                F.element_at(F.col("h.defect_multipliers"), F.col("s.defect_code")),
                F.lit(1.0),
            )
        ).cast("decimal(12,2)").alias("weighted_scrap_cost"),
        F.exists(
            F.col("h.allowed_defect_codes"),
            lambda code: code == F.col("s.defect_code"),
        ).alias("defect_allowed"),
        F.filter(
            F.transform(F.col("h.allowed_defect_codes"), lambda code: F.upper(code)),
            lambda code: code != "LEGACY",
        ).alias("active_defect_allowlist"),
    )
)

w_nearby_operations = (
    Window
    .partitionBy("work_order_id")
    .orderBy("operation_seq")
    .rangeBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
)
w_recency = (
    Window
    .partitionBy("work_order_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("event_ts").desc(), F.col("scrap_entry_id").desc())
)
scrap_windowed = (
    scrap_enriched.alias("se")
    .select(
        "se.*",
        F.sum("scrap_qty").over(w_nearby_operations).alias("nearby_operation_scrap"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recency).alias("recency_rank"),
    )
)

latest_scrap = scrap_windowed.alias("sw").filter(F.col("recency_rank") == 1)

scrap_rollup = (
    scrap_windowed
    .groupBy("work_order_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("scrap_qty").alias("total_scrap_qty"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("containment_state") == "CUSTOMER_FOUND", F.col("scrap_qty")).otherwise(0)).alias("customer_found_qty"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("defect_allowed"), F.col("weighted_scrap_cost"))
            .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))
        ).alias("allowed_defect_cost"),
        F.sum("weighted_scrap_cost").alias("total_weighted_scrap_cost"),
        F.percentile_approx(F.col("scrap_qty"), 0.5).alias("median_scrap_qty"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100.0) * F.sum(F.when(F.col("containment_state") == "CUSTOMER_FOUND", F.col("scrap_qty")).otherwise(0))
            / F.when(F.sum("scrap_qty") != 0, F.sum("scrap_qty")),
            2,
        ).alias("customer_found_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    scrap_rollup.alias("sr")
    .join(latest_scrap.alias("ls"), F.col("ls.work_order_id") == F.col("sr.work_order_id"))
    .join(output_rollup.alias("oru"), F.col("oru.work_order_id") == F.col("sr.work_order_id"))
    .join(df_work_order_specs.alias("wo"), F.col("wo.work_order_id") == F.col("sr.work_order_id"))
    .join(
        df_line_scrap_controls.alias("lsc"),
        (F.col("lsc.plant_code") == F.col("wo.plant_code"))
        & (F.col("lsc.line_code") == F.col("wo.line_code")),
        "left",
    )
    .filter((F.col("wo.planned_qty") >= 200) & (F.col("oru.good_qty") >= 100))
    .select(
        "sr.*",
        F.col("wo.plant_code").alias("plant_code"),
        F.col("wo.line_code").alias("line_code"),
        F.col("wo.product_family").alias("product_family"),
        F.col("ls.primary_cell").alias("primary_cell"),
        F.col("ls.shift_lead").alias("shift_lead"),
        F.col("ls.event_ts").alias("last_scrap_ts"),
        F.col("ls.defect_code").alias("last_defect_code"),
        F.col("ls.nearby_operation_scrap").alias("nearby_operation_scrap"),
        F.size(F.col("ls.active_defect_allowlist")).alias("active_allowed_defects"),
        F.col("oru.good_qty").alias("good_qty"),
        F.col("oru.rework_qty").alias("rework_qty"),
        F.col("oru.audit_sample_qty").alias("audit_sample_qty"),
        F.col("oru.rework_share_pct").alias("rework_share_pct"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100.0) * F.col("sr.total_scrap_qty")
            / F.when(
                (F.col("oru.good_qty") + F.col("sr.total_scrap_qty")) != 0,
                F.col("oru.good_qty") + F.col("sr.total_scrap_qty"),
            ),
            2,
        ).alias("scrap_rate_pct"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("lsc.scrap_target_pct"), F.lit(5).cast("decimal(5,2)")).alias("scrap_target_pct"),
        F.when(
            F.lit(100.0) * F.col("sr.total_scrap_qty")
            / F.when(
                (F.col("oru.good_qty") + F.col("sr.total_scrap_qty")) != 0,
                F.col("oru.good_qty") + F.col("sr.total_scrap_qty"),
            )
            > F.coalesce(F.col("lsc.scrap_target_pct"), F.lit(5).cast("decimal(5,2)")),
            "ABOVE_TARGET",
        ).otherwise("WITHIN_TARGET").alias("scrap_status"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("scrap_rate_pct").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("work_order_id"))
)

/*
  Newsletter deliverability and engagement review.
  Variant-level send facts are compared with validated open events by
  campaign and subscriber region; null device buckets mean no valid opens.
*/
with stg_subscribers as (
    select
        subscriber_id,
        region,
        lifecycle_status,
        from_json(profile_json, 'struct<timezone:string,vip:boolean>') as subscriber_profile,
        element_at(preferences, 'digest') as digest_cadence
    from dim_subscribers
),
stg_send_variants as (
    -- Exploding test variants repeats the parent send and its cost.
    select
        s.send_id,
        s.campaign_id,
        s.sent_at,
        s.delivery_status,
        s.send_cost,
        s.subscriber_id,
        sub.region,
        sub.digest_cadence,
        sub.subscriber_profile.timezone as profile_timezone,
        coalesce(sub.subscriber_profile.vip, false) as is_vip,
        item.variant_code as variant_code,
        item.subject_line as subject_line,
        item.open_count as item_open_count,
        item.click_count as item_click_count
    from fct_newsletter_sends s
    join stg_subscribers sub
      on sub.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id
     and sub.lifecycle_status <> 'CHURNED'
    lateral view explode(s.variant_results) as item
),
stg_open_events as (
    -- Exclude pre-send timestamps and non-active recipients from event KPIs.
    select
        o.open_id,
        o.send_id,
        o.opened_at,
        upper(o.device_type) as device_type,
        s.campaign_id,
        sub.region
    from fct_open_events o
    join fct_newsletter_sends s
      on s.send_id = o.send_id
    join stg_subscribers sub
      on sub.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id
    where o.opened_at >= s.sent_at
      and sub.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
),
pvt_open_devices as (
    select
        campaign_id,
        region,
        mobile_opens,
        desktop_opens,
        tablet_opens
    from (
