from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

stg_subscribers = (
    df_dim_subscribers
    .select(
        "subscriber_id",
        "region",
        "lifecycle_status",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("profile_json"),
            "struct<timezone:string,vip:boolean>",
        ).alias("subscriber_profile"),
        F.element_at(F.col("preferences"), F.lit("digest")).alias("digest_cadence"),
    )
)

stg_send_variants = (
    df_fct_newsletter_sends.alias("s")
    .join(
        stg_subscribers.alias("sub"),
        (F.col("sub.subscriber_id") == F.col("s.subscriber_id"))
        & (F.col("sub.lifecycle_status") != "CHURNED"),
    )
    .select(
        "s.send_id",
        "s.campaign_id",
        "s.sent_at",
        "s.delivery_status",
        "s.send_cost",
        "s.subscriber_id",
        "sub.region",
        "sub.digest_cadence",
        F.col("sub.subscriber_profile.timezone").alias("profile_timezone"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("sub.subscriber_profile.vip"), F.lit(False)).alias("is_vip"),
        F.explode(F.col("s.variant_results")).alias("item"),
    )
    .select(
        "send_id",
        "campaign_id",
        "sent_at",
        "delivery_status",
        "send_cost",
        "subscriber_id",
        "region",
        "digest_cadence",
        "profile_timezone",
        "is_vip",
        F.col("item.variant_code").alias("variant_code"),
        F.col("item.subject_line").alias("subject_line"),
        F.col("item.open_count").alias("item_open_count"),
        F.col("item.click_count").alias("item_click_count"),
    )
)

stg_open_events = (
    df_fct_open_events.alias("o")
    .join(
        df_fct_newsletter_sends.alias("s"),
        F.col("s.send_id") == F.col("o.send_id"),
    )
    .join(
        stg_subscribers.alias("sub"),
        F.col("sub.subscriber_id") == F.col("s.subscriber_id"),
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("o.opened_at") >= F.col("s.sent_at"))
        & (F.col("sub.lifecycle_status") == "ACTIVE")
    )
    .select(
        "o.open_id",
        "o.send_id",
        "o.opened_at",
        F.upper(F.col("o.device_type")).alias("device_type"),
        "s.campaign_id",
        "sub.region",
    )
)

pvt_open_devices = (
    stg_open_events
    .groupBy("campaign_id", "region")
    .pivot("device_type", ["MOBILE", "DESKTOP", "TABLET"])
    .agg(F.count("open_id").alias("open_count"))
    .select(
        "campaign_id",
        "region",
        F.col("MOBILE").alias("mobile_opens"),
        F.col("DESKTOP").alias("desktop_opens"),
        F.col("TABLET").alias("tablet_opens"),
    )
)

fct_campaign_metrics = (
    stg_send_variants
    .groupBy("campaign_id", "region")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("send_id").alias("send_count"),
        F.countDistinct(
            F.when(F.col("delivery_status") == "delivered", F.col("send_id"))
        ).alias("delivered_sends"),
        F.sumDistinct(
            F.when(F.col("delivery_status") == "delivered", F.col("send_cost"))
        ).alias("delivered_cost"),
        F.countDistinct("subscriber_id").alias("unique_recipients"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("delivery_status") == "delivered", F.col("item_open_count"))
        ).alias("recorded_opens"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("item_click_count") > 0, F.col("item_click_count"))
        ).alias("recorded_clicks"),
        F.count(
            F.when(F.col("variant_code") == "B", F.lit(1))
        ).alias("challenger_rows"),
        F.count(
            F.when(F.col("digest_cadence") == "weekly", F.lit(1))
        ).alias("weekly_digest_rows"),
    )
)

w_region_campaign = Window.partitionBy("m.region").orderBy(
    F.col("c.launch_date"),
    F.col("m.campaign_id"),
)

result = (
    fct_campaign_metrics.alias("m")
    .join(
        df_dim_campaigns.alias("c"),
        F.col("c.campaign_id") == F.col("m.campaign_id"),
    )
    .join(
        pvt_open_devices.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.campaign_id") == F.col("m.campaign_id"))
        & (F.col("p.region") == F.col("m.region")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "m.*",
        "c.campaign_name",
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.mobile_opens"), F.lit(0)).alias("mobile_opens"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.desktop_opens"), F.lit(0)).alias("desktop_opens"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.tablet_opens"), F.lit(0)).alias("tablet_opens"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100.0) * F.col("m.recorded_clicks")
            / F.nullif(F.col("m.recorded_opens"), F.lit(0)),
            2,
        ).alias("click_to_open_pct"),
        F.lag(F.col("m.delivered_sends"), 1, 0)
        .over(w_region_campaign)
        .alias("previous_region_delivered_sends"),
        F.lead(F.coalesce(F.col("p.mobile_opens"), F.lit(0)), 1, 0)
        .over(w_region_campaign)
        .alias("next_region_mobile_opens"),
    )
    .orderBy("m.region", "c.launch_date", "m.campaign_id")
)

with exploded_legs as (
    -- keep March posted authorizations and flatten their principal and fee legs
    select
        t.txn_id,
        t.acct_id,
        t.merchant_id,
        t.txn_ts,
        t.channel,
        t.cash_advance_flag,
        m.merchant_category,
        leg.leg_seq,
        leg.leg_type,
        cast(coalesce(leg.leg_amt, 0) as decimal(14,2)) as leg_amt,
        case
            when t.cash_advance_flag then 'CASH_ADVANCE'
            when t.channel = 'ECOM' then 'ONLINE'
            when coalesce(nullif(m.risk_tier, ''), 'STANDARD') = 'HIGH' then 'HIGH_RISK'
            else 'STANDARD'
        end as spend_class
    from card_txn t
    left join merchant_profile m
        on m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
    lateral view explode(t.legs) lv as leg
    where t.txn_ts >= timestamp '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
      and t.txn_ts < timestamp '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
      and coalesce(nullif(t.status, ''), 'UNKNOWN') = 'POSTED'
),
acct_rollup as (
    -- build account metrics, including deduplicated amounts and filtered counts
    select
        e.acct_id,
        a.segment,
        cast(sum(distinct e.leg_amt) filter (
            where e.leg_type = 'PRINCIPAL'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as principal_total,
        cast(sum(e.leg_amt) filter (
            where e.leg_type = 'FEE'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as fee_total,
        cast(count(distinct e.txn_id) as decimal(20,4)) as txn_count,
        cast(percentile_approx(e.leg_amt, 0.5) as decimal(20,4)) as median_leg,
        cast(count(*) filter (
            where e.leg_type = 'FEE'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as fee_leg_count,
        cast(count(*) filter (
            where e.spend_class = 'ONLINE'
        ) as decimal(20,4)) as online_leg_count
    from exploded_legs e
    join card_acct a
        on a.acct_id = e.acct_id
    group by e.acct_id, a.segment
),
metric_long as (
    -- turn the account measures into rows for a common pivot calculation
    select acct_id, segment, metric_name, metric_value
    from acct_rollup
    unpivot (
        metric_value for metric_name in (
            principal_total,
            fee_total,
            txn_count,
            median_leg,
            fee_leg_count,
            online_leg_count
        )
    )
),
metric_wide as (
    -- restore named decimal measures with readable output aliases
    select *
    from metric_long
    pivot (
        round(sum(metric_value), 2)
        for metric_name in (
            'principal_total' as principal_spend,
            'fee_total' as fee_spend,
            'txn_count' as txn_count,
            'median_leg' as median_leg,
            'fee_leg_count' as fee_leg_count,
            'online_leg_count' as online_leg_count
        )
    )
),
ranked as (
    -- retain the two largest spending accounts per segment with a stable tie-break
    select
        p.*,
        row_number() over (
            partition by p.segment
            order by p.principal_spend desc nulls last, p.acct_id
        ) as segment_rank
    from metric_wide p
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by p.segment
        order by p.principal_spend desc nulls last, p.acct_id
    ) <= 2
)
select
    a.*,
    b.cust_id,
    b.status as acct_status,
    round(
        coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / nullif(b.credit_limit, 0) * 100,
        2
    ) as limit_util_pct,
    case
        when b.credit_limit is null then 'LIMIT_UNKNOWN'
        when coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / nullif(b.credit_limit, 0) * 100 >= 5
            then 'HIGH_UTIL'
        when coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / nullif(b.credit_limit, 0) * 100 >= 4
            then 'MEDIUM_UTIL'
        else 'LOW_UTIL'
    end as util_band,
    cast(floor(coalesce(a.principal_spend, 0) / 100) as int) as spend_hundreds,
    cast(ceil(coalesce(a.fee_spend, 0) / 10) as int) as fee_tens,
    (
        select round(avg(src.credit_limit), 2)
        from card_acct src
        where src.status = 'ACTIVE'
    ) as active_avg_limit
from ranked a
left join card_acct b
    on b.acct_id = a.acct_id
order by a.segment, a.segment_rank, a.acct_id

        F.col("leg.leg_type").alias("leg_type"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("leg.leg_amt"), F.lit(0)).cast("decimal(14,2)").alias("leg_amt"),
        F.when(F.col("cash_advance_flag"), F.lit("CASH_ADVANCE"))
        .when(F.col("channel") == "ECOM", F.lit("ONLINE"))
        .when(F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("merchant_category"), F.lit("__never__")), F.lit("STANDARD")) == "__never__", F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .when(F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("leg.leg_type"), F.lit("")), F.lit("STANDARD")) == "__never__", F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .alias("spend_class_placeholder"),
    )
)

# Add the merchant-risk classification after selecting the exploded struct fields.
exploded_legs = (
    df_card_txn.alias("t")
    .join(df_merchant_profile.alias("m"), F.col("m.merchant_id") == F.col("t.merchant_id"), "left")
    .filter(
        (F.col("t.txn_ts") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("t.txn_ts") < F.lit("2025-04-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("t.status"), F.lit("")), F.lit("UNKNOWN")) == "POSTED")
    )
    .select(
        F.col("t.txn_id"),
        F.col("t.acct_id"),
        F.col("t.merchant_id"),
        F.col("t.txn_ts"),
        F.col("t.channel"),
        F.col("t.cash_advance_flag"),
        F.col("m.merchant_category"),
        F.col("m.risk_tier"),
        F.explode(F.col("t.legs")).alias("leg"),
    )
    .select(
        "txn_id",
        "acct_id",
        "merchant_id",
        "txn_ts",
        "channel",
        "cash_advance_flag",
        "merchant_category",
        F.col("leg.leg_seq").alias("leg_seq"),
        F.col("leg.leg_type").alias("leg_type"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("leg.leg_amt"), F.lit(0)).cast("decimal(14,2)").alias("leg_amt"),
        F.when(F.col("cash_advance_flag"), F.lit("CASH_ADVANCE"))
        .when(F.col("channel") == "ECOM", F.lit("ONLINE"))
        .when(F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("risk_tier"), F.lit("")), F.lit("STANDARD")) == "HIGH", F.lit("HIGH_RISK"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("STANDARD"))
        .alias("spend_class"),
    )
)

acct_rollup = (
    exploded_legs.alias("e")
    .join(df_card_acct.alias("a"), F.col("a.acct_id") == F.col("e.acct_id"))
    .groupBy(F.col("e.acct_id").alias("acct_id"), F.col("a.segment").alias("segment"))
    .agg(
        F.sum_distinct(F.when(F.col("leg_type") == "PRINCIPAL", F.col("leg_amt"))).cast("decimal(20,4)").alias("principal_total"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("leg_type") == "FEE", F.col("leg_amt"))).cast("decimal(20,4)").alias("fee_total"),
        F.count_distinct("txn_id").cast("decimal(20,4)").alias("txn_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("leg_amt", 0.5).cast("decimal(20,4)").alias("median_leg"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("leg_type") == "FEE", F.lit(1))).cast("decimal(20,4)").alias("fee_leg_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("spend_class") == "ONLINE", F.lit(1))).cast("decimal(20,4)").alias("online_leg_count"),
    )
)

metric_long = (
    acct_rollup
    .unpivot(
        ["acct_id", "segment"],
        ["principal_total", "fee_total", "txn_count", "median_leg", "fee_leg_count", "online_leg_count"],
        "metric_name",
        "metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
    .select("acct_id", "segment", "metric_name", "metric_value")
)

metric_wide = (
    metric_long
    .groupBy("acct_id", "segment")
    .pivot("metric_name", ["principal_total", "fee_total", "txn_count", "median_leg", "fee_leg_count", "online_leg_count"])
    .agg(F.round(F.sum("metric_value"), 2))
    .select(
        "acct_id",
        "segment",
        F.col("principal_total").alias("principal_spend"),
        F.col("fee_total").alias("fee_spend"),
        F.col("txn_count").alias("txn_count"),
        F.col("median_leg").alias("median_leg"),
        F.col("fee_leg_count").alias("fee_leg_count"),
        F.col("online_leg_count").alias("online_leg_count"),
    )
)

w_segment = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("principal_spend").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("acct_id"))
ranked = (
    metric_wide
    .withColumn("segment_rank", F.row_number().over(w_segment))
    .filter(F.col("segment_rank") <= 2)
)

active_limit_stats = (
    df_card_acct
    .filter(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE")
    .select(F.round(F.avg("credit_limit"), 2).alias("active_avg_limit"))
)

util_pct = F.coalesce(F.col("a.principal_spend"), F.lit(0)) / F.nullif(F.col("b.credit_limit"), F.lit(0)) * F.lit(100)
result = (
    ranked.alias("a")
    .join(df_card_acct.alias("b"), F.col("b.acct_id") == F.col("a.acct_id"), "left")
    .crossJoin(active_limit_stats.alias("avglim"))
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("b.cust_id"),
        F.col("b.status").alias("acct_status"),
        F.round(util_pct, 2).alias("limit_util_pct"),
        F.when(F.col("b.credit_limit").isNull(), F.lit("LIMIT_UNKNOWN"))
        .when(util_pct >= 5, F.lit("HIGH_UTIL"))
        .when(util_pct >= 4, F.lit("MEDIUM_UTIL"))
        .otherwise(F.lit("LOW_UTIL"))
        .alias("util_band"),
        F.floor(F.coalesce(F.col("a.principal_spend"), F.lit(0)) / F.lit(100)).cast("int").alias("spend_hundreds"),
        F.ceil(F.coalesce(F.col("a.fee_spend"), F.lit(0)) / F.lit(10)).cast("int").alias("fee_tens"),
        F.col("avglim.active_avg_limit").alias("active_avg_limit"),
    )
    .orderBy("segment", "segment_rank", "acct_id")
)

WITH candidate_pool AS (
    SELECT
        a.application_id,
        a.candidate_id,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.full_name, ''), 'Name pending') AS candidate_name,
        a.job_family,
        a.application_status,
        a.applied_at,
        COALESCE(c.profile.years_exp, 0) AS years_exp,
        c.profile.notice_days AS notice_days,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(c.profile.referral_source, ''), 'Unknown') AS referral_source,
        ARRAY_JOIN(
            FILTER(
                TRANSFORM(c.skills, skill -> UPPER(skill)),
                skill -> skill IN ('SQL', 'PYTHON', 'SPARK', 'JAVA', 'SCALA')
            ),
            ', '
        ) AS core_skills,
        EXISTS(c.skills, skill -> LOWER(skill) IN ('python', 'sql', 'spark')) AS has_data_stack
    FROM applications a
    JOIN candidates c
      ON c.candidate_id = a.candidate_id
    WHERE (c.profile.years_exp IS NULL OR c.profile.years_exp >= 2)
      AND a.application_status IN ('SCREEN', 'INTERVIEW', 'OFFER', 'HIRED', 'REJECTED')
),
interview_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        application_id,
        interview_id,
        interviewer_id,
        started_at,
        duration_min,
        technical_score,
        communication_score,
        ownership_score,
        -- A gap over 36 hours starts another interview session.
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL
                  OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_id
            ORDER BY started_at, interview_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS session_id,
        AVG(CAST(duration_min AS DOUBLE)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_id
            ORDER BY started_at, interview_id
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prior_avg_duration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_id
            ORDER BY started_at DESC, interview_id DESC
        ) AS recency_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i.application_id,
            i.interview_id,
            i.interviewer_id,
            i.started_at,
            i.duration_min,
            r.technical_score,
            r.communication_score,
            r.ownership_score,
            LAG(i.started_at) OVER (
                PARTITION BY i.application_id
                ORDER BY i.started_at, i.interview_id
            ) AS prev_started_at
        FROM interviews i
        JOIN interview_reviews r
          ON r.interview_id = i.interview_id
        JOIN candidate_pool cp
          ON cp.application_id = i.application_id
    ) sequenced
),
score_long AS (
    SELECT application_id, session_id, metric, score_value
    FROM interview_sessions
    UNPIVOT (
        score_value FOR metric IN (
            technical_score,
            communication_score,
            ownership_score
        )
    )
),
score_pivot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM score_long
    PIVOT (
        ROUND(AVG(score_value), 2)
        FOR metric IN (
            'technical_score' AS technical_avg,
            'communication_score' AS communication_avg,
            'ownership_score' AS ownership_avg
        )
    )
),
application_stats AS (
    SELECT
        application_id,
        COUNT(*) AS interview_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT interviewer_id) AS interviewer_count,
        ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT duration_min), 2) AS avg_distinct_duration,
        SUM(DISTINCT duration_min) AS distinct_duration_minutes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN recency_rank = 1 THEN session_id END) AS latest_session_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN recency_rank = 1 THEN ROUND(prior_avg_duration, 2) END) AS latest_prior_avg_duration,
        MAX(started_at) AS last_interview_at
    FROM interview_sessions
    GROUP BY application_id
)
SELECT
    cp.application_id,
    cp.candidate_name,
    cp.job_family,
    cp.application_status,
    cp.years_exp,
    cp.notice_days,
    cp.referral_source,
    COALESCE(cp.core_skills, 'Not listed') AS core_skills,
    cp.has_data_stack,
    COALESCE(st.interview_count, 0) AS interview_count,
    COALESCE(st.interviewer_count, 0) AS interviewer_count,
    st.avg_distinct_duration,
    COALESCE(st.distinct_duration_minutes, 0) AS distinct_duration_minutes,
    COALESCE(st.session_count, 0) AS session_count,
    st.latest_session_id,
    st.last_interview_at,
    st.latest_prior_avg_duration,
    sp.technical_avg,
    sp.communication_avg,
    sp.ownership_avg,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.application_status = 'HIRED' THEN 'Closed - hired'
        WHEN st.interview_count IS NULL THEN 'Awaiting first interview'
        WHEN COALESCE(sp.technical_avg, 0) >= 4.2
         AND sp.ownership_avg >= 4.0 THEN 'Advanced signal'
        WHEN COALESCE(sp.technical_avg, sp.communication_avg, 0) >= 3.0 THEN 'Mixed signal'
        ELSE 'At risk'
    END AS recommendation,
    CASE
        WHEN st.interviewer_count >= 4 THEN 'Large panel'
        WHEN st.interviewer_count >= 2 THEN 'Standard panel'
        WHEN st.interviewer_count = 1 THEN 'Single interviewer'
        ELSE 'No panel'
    END AS panel_label,
    CASE
        WHEN st.last_interview_at IS NULL THEN 'Schedule screen'
        WHEN st.latest_prior_avg_duration IS NULL THEN 'First session complete'
        WHEN st.session_count >= 2 THEN 'Multi-session debrief'
        ELSE 'Panel debrief'
    END AS follow_up_bucket
FROM candidate_pool cp
LEFT JOIN application_stats st
  ON st.application_id = cp.application_id
LEFT JOIN score_pivot sp
  ON sp.application_id = cp.application_id
 AND sp.session_id = st.latest_session_id
ORDER BY recommendation, application_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

candidate_pool = (
    df_applications.alias("a")
    .join(df_candidates.alias("c"), F.col("c.candidate_id") == F.col("a.candidate_id"))
    .filter(
        (F.col("c.profile.years_exp").isNull() | (F.col("c.profile.years_exp") >= 2))
        & F.col("a.application_status").isin("SCREEN", "INTERVIEW", "OFFER", "HIRED", "REJECTED")
    )
    .select(
        F.col("a.application_id").alias("application_id"),
        F.col("a.candidate_id").alias("candidate_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("c.full_name"), F.lit("")), F.lit("Name pending")).alias("candidate_name"),
        F.col("a.job_family").alias("job_family"),
        F.col("a.application_status").alias("application_status"),
        F.col("a.applied_at").alias("applied_at"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("c.profile.years_exp"), F.lit(0)).alias("years_exp"),
        F.col("c.profile.notice_days").alias("notice_days"),
        F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("c.profile.referral_source"), F.lit("")), F.lit("Unknown")).alias("referral_source"),
        F.array_join(
            F.filter(
                F.transform(F.col("c.skills"), lambda skill: F.upper(skill)),
                lambda skill: skill.isin("SQL", "PYTHON", "SPARK", "JAVA", "SCALA"),
            ),
            ", ",
        ).alias("core_skills"),
        F.exists(F.col("c.skills"), lambda skill: F.lower(skill).isin("python", "sql", "spark")).alias("has_data_stack"),
    )
)

interview_sequenced = (
    df_interviews.alias("i")
    .join(df_interview_reviews.alias("r"), F.col("r.interview_id") == F.col("i.interview_id"))
    .join(candidate_pool.alias("cp"), F.col("cp.application_id") == F.col("i.application_id"))
    .select(
        F.col("i.application_id").alias("application_id"),
        F.col("i.interview_id").alias("interview_id"),
        F.col("i.interviewer_id").alias("interviewer_id"),
        F.col("i.started_at").alias("started_at"),
        F.col("i.duration_min").alias("duration_min"),
        F.col("r.technical_score").alias("technical_score"),
        F.col("r.communication_score").alias("communication_score"),
        F.col("r.ownership_score").alias("ownership_score"),
    )
)

w_session = Window.partitionBy("application_id").orderBy("started_at", "interview_id")
w_session_running = w_session.rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_prior_two = w_session.rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("application_id").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), F.col("interview_id").desc())

interview_sequenced = interview_sequenced.withColumn(
    "prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w_session)
)
interview_sessions = (
    interview_sequenced
    .withColumn(
        "session_id",
        F.sum(
            F.when(
                F.col("prev_started_at").isNull()
                | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")),
                1,
            ).otherwise(0)
        ).over(w_session_running),
    )
    .withColumn("prior_avg_duration", F.avg(F.col("duration_min").cast("double")).over(w_prior_two))
    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(w_recent))
)

score_long = (
    interview_sessions
    .select("application_id", "session_id", "technical_score", "communication_score", "ownership_score")
    .unpivot(
        ["application_id", "session_id"],
        ["technical_score", "communication_score", "ownership_score"],
        "metric",
        "score_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("score_value").isNotNull())
)

score_pivot = (
    score_long
    .groupBy("application_id", "session_id")
    .pivot("metric", ["technical_score", "communication_score", "ownership_score"])
    .agg(F.round(F.avg("score_value"), 2))
    .select(
        "application_id",
        "session_id",
        F.col("technical_score").alias("technical_avg"),
        F.col("communication_score").alias("communication_avg"),
        F.col("ownership_score").alias("ownership_avg"),
    )
)

application_stats = (
    interview_sessions
    .groupBy("application_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("interview_count"),
        F.countDistinct("interviewer_id").alias("interviewer_count"),
        F.expr("ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT duration_min), 2)").alias("avg_distinct_duration"),
        F.sumDistinct("duration_min").alias("distinct_duration_minutes"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("session_count"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("recency_rank") == 1, F.col("session_id"))).alias("latest_session_id"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("recency_rank") == 1, F.round(F.col("prior_avg_duration"), 2))).alias("latest_prior_avg_duration"),
        F.max("started_at").alias("last_interview_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    candidate_pool.alias("cp")
    .join(application_stats.alias("st"), F.col("st.application_id") == F.col("cp.application_id"), "left")
    .join(
        score_pivot.alias("sp"),
        (F.col("sp.application_id") == F.col("cp.application_id"))
        & (F.col("sp.session_id") == F.col("st.latest_session_id")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(

        F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("p.fee_components"), "service_fee"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")).alias("service_fee"),
    )
)

    parsed_purchases.alias("pp")

        F.col("pp.checkout.risk_score").alias("risk_score"),
        F.filter(F.col("pp.normalized_tags"), lambda tag: tag.like("FRIEND%")).alias("friend_tags"),
        F.exists(F.col("pp.normalized_tags"), lambda tag: tag == "PRESALE").alias("used_presale"),
        F.aggregate(F.col("pp.normalized_tags"), F.lit(0), lambda acc, tag: acc + F.length(tag)).alias("tag_chars"),
        (
            F.col("pp.gross_paid")
            + F.col("pp.service_fee")
            + F.coalesce(F.element_at(F.col("pp.fee_components"), "facility_fee"), F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)"))
        ).alias("total_collected"),
        F.datediff(F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("ep.starts_at")), F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("pp.purchased_at"))).alias("lead_days"),
        (F.col("ep.starts_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL '2' HOUR")).alias("doors_open_at"),
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", F.col("pp.purchased_at")).alias("purchase_hour"),

WITH parsed_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        from_json(
            checkout_payload,
            'device STRING, coupon STRING, risk_score INT'
        ) AS checkout,
        transform(
            coalesce(promo_tags, array()),
            tag -> upper(tag)
        ) AS normalized_tags,
        coalesce(
            element_at(fee_components, 'service_fee'),
            CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
        ) AS service_fee
    FROM stg_ticket_purchases p
    WHERE purchased_at >= (
        SELECT date_trunc('DAY', min(sales_open_at))
        FROM stg_event_performances
        WHERE status <> 'DRAFT'
    )
),
event_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        pp.*,
        ep.venue_id,
        ep.event_name,
        ep.starts_at,
        ep.base_price,
        ep.status AS event_status,
        pp.checkout.device AS checkout_device,
        pp.checkout.coupon AS coupon,
        pp.checkout.risk_score AS risk_score,
        filter(
            normalized_tags,
            tag -> tag LIKE 'FRIEND%'
        ) AS friend_tags,
        exists(normalized_tags, tag -> tag = 'PRESALE') AS used_presale,
        aggregate(
            normalized_tags,
            0,
            (acc, tag) -> acc + length(tag)
        ) AS tag_chars,
        gross_paid + service_fee
            + coalesce(
                element_at(fee_components, 'facility_fee'),
                CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))
            ) AS total_collected,
        datediff(
            date_trunc('DAY', starts_at),
            date_trunc('DAY', purchased_at)
        ) AS lead_days,
        starts_at - INTERVAL '2' HOUR AS doors_open_at,
        date_trunc('HOUR', purchased_at) AS purchase_hour,
        timestampdiff(DAY, sales_open_at, purchased_at) AS days_since_open
    FROM parsed_purchases pp
    JOIN stg_event_performances ep
      ON ep.event_id = pp.event_id
    WHERE ep.status = 'PUBLISHED'
),
scan_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        purchase_id,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE scan_outcome = 'VALID') AS valid_scan_count,
        min(scanned_at) AS first_scan_at,
        max(scanned_at) AS last_scan_at
    FROM stg_entry_scans
    GROUP BY purchase_id
),
seat_enriched AS (
    -- Missing section mappings remain visible for manual seat-map review.
    SELECT
        ep.*,
        sr.valid_scan_count,
        sr.first_scan_at,
        sr.last_scan_at,
        ss.section_tier,
        ss.capacity
    FROM event_purchases ep
    LEFT JOIN scan_rollup sr
      ON sr.purchase_id = ep.purchase_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_seating_sections ss
      ON ss.venue_id = ep.venue_id
     AND ss.section_code = ep.seat_hold.section_code
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        se.*,
        -- A numeric RANGE frame implements a trailing 24-hour revenue window.
        sum(total_collected) OVER (
            PARTITION BY event_id
            ORDER BY unix_timestamp(purchased_at)
            RANGE BETWEEN 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS revenue_last_24h
    FROM seat_enriched se
)
SELECT
    event_id,
    event_name,
    purchase_id,
    customer_id,
    seat_hold.section_code AS section_code,
    coalesce(section_tier, 'UNMAPPED') AS section_tier,
    checkout_device,
    coupon,
    risk_score,
    friend_tags,
    used_presale,
    tag_chars,
    seat_count,
    gross_paid,
    service_fee,
    total_collected,
    lead_days,
    doors_open_at,
    days_since_open,
    coalesce(valid_scan_count, 0) AS valid_scan_count,
    last_scan_at,
    timestampdiff(
        MINUTE,
        purchased_at,
        first_scan_at
    ) AS minutes_to_first_scan,
    round(revenue_last_24h, 2) AS revenue_last_24h,
    round(total_collected / seat_count, 2) AS collected_per_seat,
    CASE
        WHEN risk_score IS NULL THEN 'UNSCORED'
        WHEN risk_score >= 60 THEN 'REVIEW'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS risk_band
FROM metrics
ORDER BY event_id, purchase_id

case.sql:
WITH policy_base AS (
    -- Keep in-force policy shells and normalize account and contact attributes.
    SELECT
        p.policy_id,
        upper(regexp_replace(trim(p.acct_ref), '^ACCT-', '')) AS acct_key,
        p.holder_name,
        p.region_code,
        p.garaging_details.state AS garaging_state,
        lower(get_json_object(p.contact_json, '$.email')) AS contact_email
    FROM policy_contracts p
    WHERE p.policy_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'BOUND')
),
claim_base AS (
    -- Retain recognizable FNOL narratives and attach the normalized policy shell.
    SELECT
        c.claim_id,
        c.policy_id,
        c.opened_at,
        c.claim_status,
        c.adjuster_ref,
        c.paid_amt,
        p.acct_key,
        p.holder_name,
        p.region_code,
        p.garaging_state,
        p.contact_email,
        regexp_extract(c.loss_narrative, 'FNOL-([A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3})', 1) AS fnol_ref
    FROM claim_txns c
    JOIN policy_base p
      ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
    WHERE c.loss_narrative RLIKE 'FNOL-[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3}'
),
line_base AS (
    -- Remove non-positive assessment lines before exploding the nested estimate.
    SELECT
        c.*,
        a.reviewed_at,
        item.line_code,
        item.qty,
        item.net_amount AS net_line_amt
    FROM claim_base c
    JOIN claim_assessments a
      ON a.claim_id = c.claim_id
    LATERAL VIEW explode(
        filter(a.line_items, x -> x.qty > 0 AND x.net_amount > 0)
    ) li AS item
),
covered_lines AS (
    -- Match estimate lines to coverage, allowing a seven-day reporting grace period,
    -- and remove adjusters on the exclusion list using an anti-join pattern.
    SELECT
        c.*,
        w.coverage_id,
        w.coverage_code,
        w.limit_amt,
        w.deductible_amt
    FROM line_base c
    JOIN coverage_windows w
      ON w.policy_id = c.policy_id
     AND w.coverage_code = c.line_code
     AND c.opened_at BETWEEN w.start_at AND w.end_at + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    LEFT JOIN excluded_adjusters x
      ON x.adjuster_ref = c.adjuster_ref
    WHERE x.adjuster_ref IS NULL
),
branch_union AS (
    -- Split material estimates and small estimates into separately labelled branches.
    SELECT
        b.*,
        'STANDARD' AS branch_name
    FROM covered_lines b
    WHERE b.qty >= 2
       OR b.net_line_amt >= b.limit_amt * 0.5

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.*,
        'MINOR_REVIEW' AS branch_name
    FROM covered_lines b
    WHERE b.qty = 1
      AND b.net_line_amt < b.limit_amt * 0.5
)
-- Publish line-level claim review facts with a portfolio benchmark.
SELECT
    b.fnol_ref,
    b.claim_id,
    b.acct_key,
    b.holder_name,
    b.garaging_state,
    b.contact_email,
    date_format(b.opened_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS loss_date,
    b.branch_name,
    b.coverage_code,
    b.line_code,
    b.qty,
    b.net_line_amt,
    round(b.net_line_amt - least(b.net_line_amt, b.deductible_amt), 2) AS net_after_deductible,
    b.claim_status,
    (
        SELECT MAX(paid_amt)
        FROM claim_txns
        WHERE claim_status = 'CLOSED'
    ) AS closed_paid_benchmark
FROM branch_union b
ORDER BY
    b.fnol_ref,
    b.coverage_code,
    b.line_code,
    b.branch_name
case.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

policy_base = (
    df_policy_contracts.alias("p")
    .filter(F.col("p.policy_status").isin("ACTIVE", "BOUND"))
    .select(
        F.col("p.policy_id").alias("policy_id"),
        F.upper(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("p.acct_ref")), "^ACCT-", "")).alias("acct_key"),
        F.col("p.holder_name").alias("holder_name"),
        F.col("p.region_code").alias("region_code"),
        F.col("p.garaging_details.state").alias("garaging_state"),
        F.lower(F.get_json_object(F.col("p.contact_json"), "$.email")).alias("contact_email"),
    )
)

claim_base = (
    df_claim_txns.alias("c")
    .join(policy_base.alias("p"), F.col("p.policy_id") == F.col("c.policy_id"))
    .filter(F.col("c.loss_narrative").rlike("FNOL-[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3}"))
    .select(
        F.col("c.claim_id").alias("claim_id"),
        F.col("c.policy_id").alias("policy_id"),
        F.col("c.opened_at").alias("opened_at"),
        F.col("c.claim_status").alias("claim_status"),
        F.col("c.adjuster_ref").alias("adjuster_ref"),
        F.col("c.paid_amt").alias("paid_amt"),
        F.col("p.acct_key").alias("acct_key"),
        F.col("p.holder_name").alias("holder_name"),
        F.col("p.region_code").alias("region_code"),
        F.col("p.garaging_state").alias("garaging_state"),
        F.col("p.contact_email").alias("contact_email"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("c.loss_narrative"), "FNOL-([A-Z]{2}[0-9]{3})", 1).alias("fnol_ref"),
    )
)

line_base = (
    claim_base.alias("c")
    .join(df_claim_assessments.alias("a"), F.col("a.claim_id") == F.col("c.claim_id"))
    .withColumn("item", F.explode(F.expr("filter(line_items, x -> x.qty > 0 AND x.net_amount > 0)")))
    .select(
        "c.*",
        F.col("a.reviewed_at").alias("reviewed_at"),
        F.col("item.line_code").alias("line_code"),
        F.col("item.qty").alias("qty"),
        F.col("item.net_amount").alias("net_line_amt"),
    )
)

covered_lines = (
    line_base.alias("c")
    .join(
        df_coverage_windows.alias("w"),
        (F.col("w.policy_id") == F.col("c.policy_id"))
        & (F.col("w.coverage_code") == F.col("c.line_code"))
        & F.col("c.opened_at").between(
            F.col("w.start_at"),
            F.col("w.end_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY"),
        ),
    )
    .join(
        df_excluded_adjusters.alias("x"),
        F.col("x.adjuster_ref") == F.col("c.adjuster_ref"),
        "left",
    )
    .filter(F.col("x.adjuster_ref").isNull())
    .select(
        "c.*",
        F.col("w.coverage_id").alias("coverage_id"),
        F.col("w.coverage_code").alias("coverage_code"),
        F.col("w.limit_amt").alias("limit_amt"),
        F.col("w.deductible_amt").alias("deductible_amt"),
    )
)

standard_branch = (
    covered_lines.alias("b")
    .filter((F.col("b.qty") >= 2) | (F.col("b.net_line_amt") >= F.col("b.limit_amt") * 0.5))
    .select("*", F.lit("STANDARD").alias("branch_name"))
)
minor_branch = (
    covered_lines.alias("b")
    .filter((F.col("b.qty") == 1) & (F.col("b.net_line_amt") < F.col("b.limit_amt") * 0.5))
    .select("*", F.lit("MINOR_REVIEW").alias("branch_name"))
)
branch_union = standard_branch.union(minor_branch)

closed_paid_benchmark = (
    df_claim_txns
    .filter(F.col("claim_status") == "CLOSED")
    .agg(F.max("paid_amt"))
    .first()[0]
)
result = (
    branch_union.alias("b")
    .select(
        F.col("b.fnol_ref").alias("fnol_ref"),
        F.col("b.claim_id").alias("claim_id"),
        F.col("b.acct_key").alias("acct_key"),
        F.col("b.holder_name").alias("holder_name"),
        F.col("b.garaging_state").alias("garaging_state"),
        F.col("b.contact_email").alias("contact_email"),
        F.date_format(F.col("b.opened_at"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("loss_date"),
        F.col("b.branch_name").alias("branch_name"),
        F.col("b.coverage_code").alias("coverage_code"),
        F.col("b.line_code").alias("line_code"),
        F.col("b.qty").alias("qty"),
        F.col("b.net_line_amt").alias("net_line_amt"),
        F.round(F.col("b.net_line_amt") - F.least(F.col("b.net_line_amt"), F.col("b.deductible_amt")), 2).alias("net_after_deductible"),
        F.col("b.claim_status").alias("claim_status"),
        F.lit(closed_paid_benchmark).alias("closed_paid_benchmark"),
    )
    .orderBy("fnol_ref", "coverage_code", "line_code", "branch_name")
)

WITH stg_parsed AS (
    SELECT
        r.*,
        from_json(
            raw_payload,
            'vehicle_soc INT, grid_voltage INT, source STRING'
        ) AS payload
    FROM stg_charger_readings r
    WHERE event_type IN ('meter', 'heartbeat')
      AND charger_id IS NOT NULL
),
stg_sequenced AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        p.payload.vehicle_soc AS vehicle_soc,
        p.payload.grid_voltage AS grid_voltage,
        p.payload.source AS payload_source,
        lag(event_id, 1, 'START') OVER charge_time AS prev_event_id,
        lag(event_ts, 1) OVER charge_time AS prev_event_ts,
        lead(measured_kw, 1, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) OVER charge_time AS next_kw,
        sum(interval_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY charge_ref
            ORDER BY unix_timestamp(event_ts)
            RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_kwh_30m
    FROM stg_parsed p
    WINDOW charge_time AS (
        PARTITION BY charge_ref
        ORDER BY event_ts, event_id
    )
),
stg_sessionized AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        -- A quiet period over 30 minutes starts another charging block.
        sum(
            CASE
                WHEN prev_event_id = 'START'
                  OR event_ts > prev_event_ts + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY charge_ref
            ORDER BY event_ts, event_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS block_seq,
        CASE
            WHEN next_kw = 0 THEN 'LAST_OR_ZERO'
            WHEN next_kw < measured_kw * 0.5 THEN 'FALLING'
            ELSE 'STEADY'
        END AS power_trend
    FROM stg_sequenced s
),
stg_txn_charges AS (
    SELECT
        t.charge_ref,
        sum(item.amount) AS listed_amount,
        -- Repeated amounts must not inflate the distinct component total.
        sum(DISTINCT item.amount) AS distinct_component_amount,
        count(DISTINCT item.component) AS component_count,
        count(DISTINCT item.tax_code) AS tax_code_count
    FROM fct_charge_transactions t
    LATERAL VIEW explode(t.line_items) exploded AS item
    GROUP BY t.charge_ref
),
fct_block_totals AS (
    SELECT
        charge_ref,
        concat(charge_ref, '-', block_seq) AS charging_block_id,
        block_seq,
        min(event_ts) AS block_started_at,
        max(event_ts) AS block_ended_at,
        sum(interval_kwh) AS block_kwh,
        round(avg(vehicle_soc), 1) AS avg_vehicle_soc,
        max(grid_voltage) AS max_grid_voltage,
        max(rolling_kwh_30m) AS peak_rolling_kwh_30m,
        count(*) AS reading_count,
        sum(CASE WHEN power_trend = 'FALLING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS falling_readings
    FROM stg_sessionized
    GROUP BY charge_ref, block_seq
),
fct_enriched_blocks AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        t.driver_id,
        t.billing_profile.country AS billing_country,
        t.billing_profile.currency AS billing_currency,
        t.billing_profile.customer_tier AS customer_tier,
        st.site_name,
        st.site_traits.grid_region AS grid_region,
        c.listed_amount,
        c.distinct_component_amount,
        c.component_count,
        c.tax_code_count
    FROM fct_block_totals b
    JOIN fct_charge_transactions t
      ON t.charge_ref = b.charge_ref
    JOIN stg_txn_charges c
      ON c.charge_ref = b.charge_ref
    JOIN dim_charging_sites st
      ON st.site_id = t.site_id
     AND st.is_active = TRUE
    WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND t.billing_profile.country = st.site_traits.country
)
SELECT
    charge_ref,
    charging_block_id,
    site_name,
    grid_region,
    customer_tier,
    block_started_at,
    block_ended_at,
    round(block_kwh, 2) AS block_kwh,
    avg_vehicle_soc,
    max_grid_voltage,
    peak_rolling_kwh_30m,
    reading_count,
    falling_readings,
    listed_amount,
    distinct_component_amount,
    component_count,
    tax_code_count,
    CASE
        WHEN driver_id IS NULL THEN 'UNASSIGNED'
        WHEN customer_tier = 'gold' THEN 'PREMIUM'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS driver_segment,
    CASE
        WHEN block_kwh >= 8 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN block_kwh >= 3 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS energy_band,
    round(block_kwh / nullif(listed_amount, 0), 4) AS kwh_per_listed_unit,
    dense_rank() OVER (
        PARTITION BY site_name
        ORDER BY block_kwh DESC, charging_block_id
    ) AS site_energy_rank
FROM fct_enriched_blocks
WHERE block_kwh >= CAST(0.50 AS DECIMAL(10,3))
ORDER BY block_started_at, charge_ref, charging_block_id

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

stg_parsed = (
    df_stg_charger_readings.alias("r")
    .filter(F.col("event_type").isin("meter", "heartbeat") & F.col("charger_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "r.*",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("raw_payload"),
            "vehicle_soc INT, grid_voltage INT, source STRING",
        ).alias("payload"),
    )
)

w_charge_time = Window.partitionBy("charge_ref").orderBy("event_ts", "event_id")
w_charge_range = (
    Window.partitionBy("charge_ref")
    .orderBy(F.unix_timestamp(F.col("event_ts")))
    .rangeBetween(-1800, 0)
)
stg_sequenced = (
    stg_parsed.alias("p")
    .select(
        "p.*",
        F.col("p.payload.vehicle_soc").alias("vehicle_soc"),
        F.col("p.payload.grid_voltage").alias("grid_voltage"),
        F.col("p.payload.source").alias("payload_source"),
        F.lag("event_id", 1, "START").over(w_charge_time).alias("prev_event_id"),
        F.lag("event_ts", 1).over(w_charge_time).alias("prev_event_ts"),
        F.lead("measured_kw", 1, 0).over(w_charge_time).alias("next_kw"),
        F.sum("interval_kwh").over(w_charge_range).alias("rolling_kwh_30m"),
    )
)

w_block = (
    Window.partitionBy("charge_ref")
    .orderBy("event_ts", "event_id")
    .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
)
stg_sessionized = (
    stg_sequenced.alias("s")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.sum(
            F.when(
                (F.col("prev_event_id") == "START")
                | (F.col("event_ts") > F.col("prev_event_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '30' MINUTE")),
                1,
            ).otherwise(0)
        ).over(w_block).alias("block_seq"),
        F.when(F.col("next_kw") == 0, "LAST_OR_ZERO")
        .when(F.col("next_kw") < F.col("measured_kw") * 0.5, "FALLING")
        .otherwise("STEADY")
        .alias("power_trend"),
    )
)

stg_txn_charges = (
    df_fct_charge_transactions.alias("t")
    .select(F.col("t.charge_ref"), F.explode(F.col("t.line_items")).alias("item"))
    .groupBy("charge_ref")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.col("item.amount")).alias("listed_amount"),
        F.sumDistinct(F.col("item.amount")).alias("distinct_component_amount"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("item.component")).alias("component_count"),
        F.countDistinct(F.col("item.tax_code")).alias("tax_code_count"),
    )
)

fct_block_totals = (
    stg_sessionized
    .groupBy("charge_ref", "block_seq")
    .agg(
        F.concat(F.col("charge_ref"), F.lit("-"), F.col("block_seq")).alias("charging_block_id"),
        F.min("event_ts").alias("block_started_at"),
        F.max("event_ts").alias("block_ended_at"),
        F.sum("interval_kwh").alias("block_kwh"),
        F.round(F.avg("vehicle_soc"), 1).alias("avg_vehicle_soc"),
        F.max("grid_voltage").alias("max_grid_voltage"),
        F.max("rolling_kwh_30m").alias("peak_rolling_kwh_30m"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("reading_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("power_trend") == "FALLING", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("falling_readings"),
    )
)

fct_enriched_blocks = (
    fct_block_totals.alias("b")
    .join(df_fct_charge_transactions.alias("t"), F.col("t.charge_ref") == F.col("b.charge_ref"))
    .join(stg_txn_charges.alias("c"), F.col("c.charge_ref") == F.col("b.charge_ref"))
    .join(
        df_dim_charging_sites.alias("st"),
        (F.col("st.site_id") == F.col("t.site_id")) & F.col("st.is_active"),
    )
    .filter(
        (F.col("t.status") == "COMPLETED")
        & (F.col("t.billing_profile.country") == F.col("st.site_traits.country"))
    )
    .select(
        "b.*",
        F.col("t.driver_id"),
        F.col("t.billing_profile.country").alias("billing_country"),
        F.col("t.billing_profile.currency").alias("billing_currency"),
        F.col("t.billing_profile.customer_tier").alias("customer_tier"),
        F.col("st.site_name"),
        F.col("st.site_traits.grid_region").alias("grid_region"),
        F.col("c.listed_amount"),
        F.col("c.distinct_component_amount"),
        F.col("c.component_count"),
        F.col("c.tax_code_count"),
    )
)

w_site_energy = Window.partitionBy("site_name").orderBy(
    F.col("block_kwh").desc(), F.col("charging_block_id")
)
result = (
    fct_enriched_blocks
    .filter(F.col("block_kwh") >= F.lit(0.50).cast("decimal(10,3)"))
    .select(
        "charge_ref",
        "charging_block_id",
        "site_name",
        "grid_region",
        "customer_tier",
        "block_started_at",
        "block_ended_at",
        F.round("block_kwh", 2).alias("block_kwh"),
        "avg_vehicle_soc",
        "max_grid_voltage",
        "peak_rolling_kwh_30m",
        "reading_count",
        "falling_readings",
        "listed_amount",
        "distinct_component_amount",
        "component_count",
        "tax_code_count",
        F.when(F.col("driver_id").isNull(), "UNASSIGNED")
        .when(F.col("customer_tier") == "gold", "PREMIUM")
        .otherwise("STANDARD")
        .alias("driver_segment"),
        F.when(F.col("block_kwh") >= 8, "HIGH")
        .when(F.col("block_kwh") >= 3, "MEDIUM")
        .otherwise("LOW")
        .alias("energy_band"),
        F.round(
            F.col("block_kwh")
            / F.when(F.col("listed_amount") != 0, F.col("listed_amount")),
            4,
        ).alias("kwh_per_listed_unit"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_site_energy).alias("site_energy_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy("block_started_at", "charge_ref", "charging_block_id")
)

WITH charge_lines AS (
    -- Normalize charge components and total only positive payment allocations.
    SELECT rc.lease_id,
           rc.charge_id,
           rc.posted_at,
           rc.due_at,
           component,
           amount,
           aggregate(
               transform(
                   filter(rc.payments, p -> p.amount > 0),
                   p -> cast(p.amount AS DOUBLE)
               ),
               CAST(0 AS DOUBLE),
               (acc, p) -> acc + p
           ) AS valid_payment_total
    FROM rent_charges rc
    UNPIVOT (
        amount FOR component IN (
            rent_amount AS rent,
            fee_amount AS fee,
            discount_amount AS discount
        )
    )
),
payment_details AS (
    -- Flatten the payment structs for method-level collection reporting.
    SELECT rc.lease_id,
           rc.charge_id,
           rc.posted_at AS payment_at,
           payment.method AS payment_method,
           payment.amount AS payment_amount
    FROM rent_charges rc
    LATERAL VIEW explode(rc.payments) p AS payment
),
lease_enriched AS (
    -- Screen leases and add property policy, tenant and lease-timing attributes.
    SELECT l.*,
           p.market,
           p.base_rent,
           t.credit_score,
           element_at(p.service_rules, 'pets') AS pet_policy,
           date_trunc('month', l.start_at) AS lease_month,
           datediff(
               coalesce(l.end_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00'),
               l.start_at
           ) AS lease_term_days,
           timestampdiff(
               MONTH,
               l.start_at,
               coalesce(l.end_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00')
           ) AS lease_term_months,
           l.start_at + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS first_reminder_at,
           CASE
               WHEN l.end_at IS NULL THEN 'open'
               WHEN l.end_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00' THEN 'expired'
               ELSE 'active'
           END AS lease_phase
    FROM leases l
    JOIN properties p ON p.property_id = l.property_id
    JOIN tenants t ON t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id
    WHERE l.status <> 'draft'
      AND (t.credit_score IS NULL OR t.credit_score >= 600)
),
lease_financials AS (
    -- Combine normalized charges with exploded payment-method summaries.
    SELECT c.lease_id,
           c.net_charges,
           c.total_paid,
           p.card_paid,
           c.charge_count,
           p.last_payment_at
    FROM (
        SELECT lease_id,
               sum(amount) AS net_charges,
               sum(
                   CASE WHEN component = 'rent'
                        THEN valid_payment_total
                        ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2))
                   END
               ) AS total_paid,
               count(DISTINCT charge_id) AS charge_count
        FROM charge_lines
        GROUP BY lease_id
    ) c
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT lease_id,
               sum(
                   CASE WHEN payment_method = 'card'
                        THEN payment_amount
                        ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2))
                   END
               ) AS card_paid,
               max(payment_at) AS last_payment_at
        FROM payment_details
        GROUP BY lease_id
    ) p ON p.lease_id = c.lease_id
),
market_stats AS (
    -- Establish a market median before selecting the leading leases.
    SELECT le.market,
           percentile_approx(lf.net_charges, 0.5) AS market_median_net,
           count(*) AS leases_scored
    FROM lease_enriched le
    JOIN lease_financials lf ON lf.lease_id = le.lease_id
    GROUP BY le.market
),
ranked AS (
    -- Calculate trailing market performance and retain two leases per market.
    SELECT le.lease_id,

           le.tenant_id,
           le.market,

           le.monthly_rent,
           le.deposit,

           lf.card_paid,
           lf.charge_count,
           lf.last_payment_at,

                   ORDER BY le.lease_month, le.lease_id

               ),
               2
           ) AS prior_market_avg_net,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY le.market
               ORDER BY lf.net_charges DESC NULLS LAST, le.lease_id
           ) AS market_rank
    FROM lease_enriched le
    JOIN lease_financials lf ON lf.lease_id = le.lease_id
    QUALIFY market_rank <= 2
)

       ms.leases_scored,
       round(r.net_charges - ms.market_median_net, 2) AS net_vs_market_median,

JOIN market_stats ms ON ms.market = r.market

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

charge_lines = (
    df_rent_charges.alias("rc")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["lease_id", "charge_id", "posted_at", "due_at", "payments"],
        values=["rent_amount", "fee_amount", "discount_amount"],
        variableColumnName="component",
        valueColumnName="amount",
    )
    .filter(F.col("amount").isNotNull())
    .withColumn(
        "component",
        F.when(F.col("component") == "rent_amount", "rent")
        .when(F.col("component") == "fee_amount", "fee")
        .otherwise("discount"),
    )
    .select(
        "lease_id",
        "charge_id",
        "posted_at",
        "due_at",
        "component",
        "amount",
        F.aggregate(
            F.transform(
                F.filter(F.col("payments"), lambda p: p.getField("amount") > 0),
                lambda p: p.getField("amount").cast("double"),
            ),
            F.lit(0.0),
            lambda acc, p: acc + p,
        ).alias("valid_payment_total"),
    )
)

payment_details = (
    df_rent_charges.alias("rc")
    .select(
        "lease_id",
        "charge_id",
        F.col("posted_at").alias("payment_at"),
        F.explode(F.col("payments")).alias("payment"),
    )
    .select(
        "lease_id",
        "charge_id",
        "payment_at",
        F.col("payment.method").alias("payment_method"),
        F.col("payment.amount").alias("payment_amount"),
    )
)

lease_enriched = (
    df_leases.alias("l")
    .join(df_properties.alias("p"), F.col("p.property_id") == F.col("l.property_id"))
    .join(df_tenants.alias("t"), F.col("t.tenant_id") == F.col("l.tenant_id"))
    .filter(
        (F.col("l.status") != "draft")
        & ((F.col("t.credit_score").isNull()) | (F.col("t.credit_score") >= 600))
    )
    .select(
        "l.*",
        "p.market",
        "p.base_rent",
        "t.credit_score",
        F.element_at(F.col("p.service_rules"), F.lit("pets")).alias("pet_policy"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("l.start_at")).alias("lease_month"),
        F.datediff(
            F.coalesce(F.col("l.end_at"), F.lit("2025-06-30 00:00:00").cast("timestamp")),
            F.col("l.start_at"),
        ).alias("lease_term_days"),
        F.expr(
            "timestampdiff(MONTH, l.start_at, coalesce(l.end_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30 00:00:00'))"
        ).alias("lease_term_months"),
        (F.col("l.start_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("first_reminder_at"),
        F.when(F.col("l.end_at").isNull(), "open")
        .when(F.col("l.end_at") < F.lit("2025-06-30 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"), "expired")
        .otherwise("active")
        .alias("lease_phase"),
    )
)

charge_summary = (
    charge_lines
    .groupBy("lease_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("amount").alias("net_charges"),
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("component") == "rent", F.col("valid_payment_total"))
            .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))
        ).alias("total_paid"),
        F.countDistinct("charge_id").alias("charge_count"),
    )
)

payment_summary = (
    payment_details
    .groupBy("lease_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(
            F.when(F.col("payment_method") == "card", F.col("payment_amount"))
            .otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"))
        ).alias("card_paid"),
        F.max("payment_at").alias("last_payment_at"),
    )
)

lease_financials = (
    charge_summary.alias("c")
    .join(payment_summary.alias("p"), F.col("p.lease_id") == F.col("c.lease_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "c.lease_id",
        "c.net_charges",
        "c.total_paid",
        "p.card_paid",
        "c.charge_count",
        "p.last_payment_at",
    )
)

market_stats = (
    lease_enriched.alias("le")
    .join(lease_financials.alias("lf"), F.col("lf.lease_id") == F.col("le.lease_id"))
    .groupBy("le.market")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("net_charges", 0.5).alias("market_median_net"),
        F.count("*").alias("leases_scored"),
    )
)

w_moving = (
    Window.partitionBy("le.market")
    .orderBy("le.lease_month", "le.lease_id")
    .rowsBetween(-2, -1)
)
w_rank = Window.partitionBy("le.market").orderBy(
    F.col("lf.net_charges").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("le.lease_id")
)

ranked = (
    lease_enriched.alias("le")
    .join(lease_financials.alias("lf"), F.col("lf.lease_id") == F.col("le.lease_id"))
    .select(
        "le.lease_id",
        "le.property_id",
        "le.tenant_id",
        "le.market",
        "le.base_rent",
        "le.monthly_rent",
        "le.deposit",
        "le.status",
        "le.start_at",
        "le.end_at",
        "le.credit_score",
        "le.pet_policy",
        "le.lease_month",
        "le.lease_term_days",
        "le.lease_term_months",
        "le.first_reminder_at",
        "le.lease_phase",
        "lf.net_charges",
        "lf.total_paid",
        "lf.card_paid",
        "lf.charge_count",
        "lf.last_payment_at",
        F.round(F.avg("lf.net_charges").over(w_moving), 2).alias("prior_market_avg_net"),
        F.row_number().over(w_rank).alias("market_rank"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("market_rank") <= 2)
)

portfolio_stats = df_tenants.agg(F.max("credit_score").alias("portfolio_best_credit"))

result = (
    ranked.alias("r")
    .join(market_stats.alias("ms"), F.col("ms.market") == F.col("r.market"))
    .crossJoin(portfolio_stats)
    .select(
        "r.*",
        "ms.market_median_net",
        "ms.leases_scored",
        F.round(F.col("r.net_charges") - F.col("ms.market_median_net"), 2).alias(
            "net_vs_market_median"
        ),
        "portfolio_best_credit",
    )
    .orderBy(
        "r.market",
        F.col("r.net_charges").desc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("r.prior_market_avg_net").asc_nulls_last(),
        "r.lease_id",
    )
)

with parsed_readings as (
    select reading_id,
           site_id,
           reading_ts,
           cast(energy_kwh as double) as energy_kwh,
           cast(expected_kwh as double) as expected_kwh,
           cast(availability_pct as double) as availability_pct,
           technician_id,
           from_json(status_json, 'struct<status_flags:array<string>,meter_factor:double>') as payload
    from generation_readings
    where reading_ts >= timestamp '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
      and reading_ts < timestamp '2025-06-04 00:00:00'
),
flagged_readings as (
    select reading_id,
           site_id,
           to_date(reading_ts) as reading_date,
           energy_kwh * coalesce(payload.meter_factor, 1.0) as adjusted_kwh,
           expected_kwh,
           availability_pct,
           technician_id,
           filter(
               transform(coalesce(payload.status_flags, array()), flag -> upper(flag)),
               flag -> flag <> 'TEST'
           ) as clean_flags,
           exists(
               coalesce(payload.status_flags, array()),
               flag -> upper(flag) = 'CURTAILED'
           ) as is_curtailed
    from parsed_readings
),
daily_generation as (
    select g.site_id,
           g.reading_date,
           sum(g.adjusted_kwh) as actual_kwh,
           sum(g.expected_kwh) as expected_kwh,
           avg(g.availability_pct) as availability_pct,
           round(
               100 * sum(case when g.is_curtailed then g.adjusted_kwh else 0.0 end)
               / nullif(sum(g.adjusted_kwh), 0),
               2
           ) as curtailment_pct,
           percentile_approx(g.availability_pct, 0.5) as median_availability,
           array_sort(collect_set(g.technician_id)) as technician_ids,
           array_sort(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(g.clean_flags)))) as status_flags,
           coalesce(o.outage_count, 0) as outage_count,
           coalesce(o.lost_kwh, 0.0) as lost_kwh
    from flagged_readings g
    left join (
        select site_id, outage_date, count(*) as outage_count, sum(lost_kwh) as lost_kwh
        from outage_events
        group by site_id, outage_date
    ) o
      on o.site_id = g.site_id
     and o.outage_date = g.reading_date
    group by g.site_id, g.reading_date, o.outage_count, o.lost_kwh
),
windowed_days as (
    select d.*,
           sum(actual_kwh) over (
               partition by site_id
               order by reading_date
               rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding
           ) as prior_2day_kwh,
           avg(actual_kwh) over (
               partition by site_id
               order by actual_kwh
               range between 100 preceding and current row
           ) as nearby_output_avg
    from daily_generation d
),
plant_days as (
    select w.*, p.plant_name, p.region, p.capacity_kw
    from windowed_days w
    join plant_registry p
      on p.site_id = w.site_id
     and p.is_active = true
),
site_rollup as (
    select region,
           site_id,
           grouping(region) as region_grouping,
           grouping(site_id) as site_grouping,
           count(distinct reading_date) as observed_days,
           round(avg(distinct availability_pct), 2) as distinct_avg_availability,
           round(avg(curtailment_pct), 2) as avg_curtailment_pct,
           round(avg(median_availability), 2) as avg_daily_median_availability,
           max(size(technician_ids)) as max_technicians,
           max(size(status_flags)) as distinct_statuses,
           round(100 * sum(case when outage_count > 0 then lost_kwh else 0.0 end)
                 / nullif(sum(expected_kwh), 0), 2) as outage_loss_pct,
           sum(actual_kwh) as total_actual_kwh,
           sum(expected_kwh) as total_expected_kwh,
           sum(case when outage_count > 0 then lost_kwh else 0.0 end) as outage_loss_kwh,
           max(prior_2day_kwh) as prior_2day_kwh
    from plant_days
    group by rollup (region, site_id)
)
-- Long-form metrics feed the operating dashboard; SQL unpivot omits null metrics.
select region,
       site_id,
       region_grouping,
       site_grouping,
       observed_days,
       distinct_avg_availability,
       avg_curtailment_pct,
       avg_daily_median_availability,
       max_technicians,
       distinct_statuses,
       outage_loss_pct,
       metric_name,
       metric_value
from site_rollup
unpivot (
    metric_value for metric_name in (
        total_actual_kwh,
        total_expected_kwh,
        outage_loss_kwh,
        prior_2day_kwh
    )
)
order by region nulls last, site_id nulls last, metric_name

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

parsed_readings = (
    df_generation_readings
    .filter(
        (F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("reading_ts") < F.lit("2025-06-04 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .select(
        "reading_id",
        "site_id",
        "reading_ts",
        F.col("energy_kwh").cast("double").alias("energy_kwh"),
        F.col("expected_kwh").cast("double").alias("expected_kwh"),
        F.col("availability_pct").cast("double").alias("availability_pct"),
        "technician_id",
        F.from_json(
            F.col("status_json"),
            "struct<status_flags:array<string>,meter_factor:double>",
        ).alias("payload"),
    )
)

normalized_flags = F.transform(
    F.coalesce(F.col("payload.status_flags"), F.array()),
    lambda flag: F.upper(flag),
)
flagged_readings = (
    parsed_readings
    .select(
        "reading_id",
        "site_id",
        F.to_date("reading_ts").alias("reading_date"),
        (F.col("energy_kwh") * F.coalesce(F.col("payload.meter_factor"), F.lit(1.0))).alias("adjusted_kwh"),
        "expected_kwh",
        "availability_pct",
        "technician_id",
        F.filter(normalized_flags, lambda flag: flag != "TEST").alias("clean_flags"),
        F.exists(
            F.coalesce(F.col("payload.status_flags"), F.array()),
            lambda flag: F.upper(flag) == "CURTAILED",
        ).alias("is_curtailed"),
    )
)

outage_daily = (
    df_outage_events
    .groupBy("site_id", "outage_date")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("outage_count"),
        F.sum("lost_kwh").alias("lost_kwh"),
    )
)

generation_totals = (
    flagged_readings
    .groupBy("site_id", "reading_date")
    .agg(
        F.sum("adjusted_kwh").alias("actual_kwh"),
        F.sum("expected_kwh").alias("expected_kwh"),
        F.avg("availability_pct").alias("availability_pct"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100)
            * F.sum(F.when(F.col("is_curtailed"), F.col("adjusted_kwh")).otherwise(F.lit(0.0)))
            / F.when(F.sum("adjusted_kwh") != 0, F.sum("adjusted_kwh")),
            2,
        ).alias("curtailment_pct"),
        F.percentile_approx("availability_pct", 0.5).alias("median_availability"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("technician_id")).alias("technician_ids"),
        F.array_sort(F.array_distinct(F.flatten(F.collect_list("clean_flags")))).alias("status_flags"),
    )
)

daily_generation = (
    generation_totals.alias("g")
    .join(
        outage_daily.alias("o"),
        (F.col("o.site_id") == F.col("g.site_id"))
        & (F.col("o.outage_date") == F.col("g.reading_date")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "g.*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("o.outage_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("outage_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("o.lost_kwh"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("lost_kwh"),
    )
)

w_prior_days = Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("reading_date").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w_nearby_output = Window.partitionBy("site_id").orderBy("actual_kwh").rangeBetween(-100, 0)
windowed_days = (
    daily_generation
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("actual_kwh").over(w_prior_days).alias("prior_2day_kwh"),
        F.avg("actual_kwh").over(w_nearby_output).alias("nearby_output_avg"),
    )
)

plant_days = (
    windowed_days.alias("w")
    .join(
        df_plant_registry.alias("p"),
        (F.col("p.site_id") == F.col("w.site_id")) & F.col("p.is_active"),
        "inner",
    )
    .select("w.*", "p.plant_name", "p.region", "p.capacity_kw")
)

outage_loss = F.when(F.col("outage_count") > 0, F.col("lost_kwh")).otherwise(F.lit(0.0))
site_rollup = (
    plant_days
    .rollup("region", "site_id")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("region").alias("region_grouping"),
        F.grouping("site_id").alias("site_grouping"),
        F.countDistinct("reading_date").alias("observed_days"),
        F.round(F.expr("avg(distinct availability_pct)"), 2).alias("distinct_avg_availability"),
        F.round(F.avg("curtailment_pct"), 2).alias("avg_curtailment_pct"),
        F.round(F.avg("median_availability"), 2).alias("avg_daily_median_availability"),
        F.max(F.size("technician_ids")).alias("max_technicians"),
        F.max(F.size("status_flags")).alias("distinct_statuses"),
        F.round(
            F.lit(100) * F.sum(outage_loss)
            / F.when(F.sum("expected_kwh") != 0, F.sum("expected_kwh")),
            2,
        ).alias("outage_loss_pct"),
        F.sum("actual_kwh").alias("total_actual_kwh"),
        F.sum("expected_kwh").alias("total_expected_kwh"),
        F.sum(outage_loss).alias("outage_loss_kwh"),
        F.max("prior_2day_kwh").alias("prior_2day_kwh"),
    )
)

metric_ids = [
    "region",
    "site_id",
    "region_grouping",
    "site_grouping",
    "observed_days",
    "distinct_avg_availability",
    "avg_curtailment_pct",
    "avg_daily_median_availability",
    "max_technicians",
    "distinct_statuses",
    "outage_loss_pct",
]
metric_values = [
    "total_actual_kwh",
    "total_expected_kwh",
    "outage_loss_kwh",
    "prior_2day_kwh",
]
result = (
    site_rollup
    .unpivot(metric_ids, metric_values, "metric_name", "metric_value")
    .dropna(subset=["metric_value"])
    .select(*metric_ids, "metric_name", "metric_value")
    .orderBy(
        F.col("region").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("site_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("metric_name"),
    )
)

WITH segment_lines AS (
    -- Explode flown coupons so each booking segment can be evaluated independently.
    SELECT b.booking_id,
           b.passenger_id,
           b.pnr,
           b.booked_at,
           b.booking_channel,
           b.fare_basis,
           b.contact.country AS contact_country,
           b.contact.email AS contact_email,
           coupon_pos,
           coupon.coupon_id AS segment_id,
           coupon.origin,
           coupon.destination,
           coupon.depart_ts,
           coupon.cabin,
           coupon.base_fare,
           b.coupons
    FROM stg_flight_bookings b
    LATERAL VIEW posexplode(b.coupons) exploded AS coupon_pos, coupon
    WHERE b.booking_status = 'CONFIRMED'
      AND b.passenger_id IS NOT NULL
      AND coupon.is_flown
),
member_lines AS (
    -- Attach active loyalty profiles and derive array-level fare indicators.
    SELECT s.*,
           m.member_no,
           m.loyalty_tier,
           m.home_airport,
           aggregate(
               s.coupons,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(12,2)),
               (acc, x) -> CAST(acc + CASE WHEN x.is_flown THEN x.base_fare ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) END AS DECIMAL(12,2))
           ) AS flown_spend,
           exists(s.coupons, x -> x.cabin = 'BUSINESS') AS has_business_cabin,
           transform(
               filter(s.coupons, x -> x.is_flown AND x.base_fare > 100),
               x -> concat_ws(':', x.origin, x.destination)
           ) AS qualified_routes
    FROM segment_lines s
    LEFT JOIN dim_loyalty_members m
      ON m.passenger_id = s.passenger_id
     AND m.is_active = TRUE
),
scored_lines AS (
    -- Build itinerary labels, fare metrics, and a deterministic first-segment choice.
    SELECT ml.*,
           concat_ws(
               ':', ml.origin, ml.destination,
               lpad(CAST(ml.coupon_pos + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0'),
               array_join(split(ml.booking_channel, '_'), '/')
           ) AS itinerary_code,
           regexp_extract(ml.pnr, '([A-Z]{2})', 1) AS pnr_prefix,
           regexp_replace(ml.pnr, '[^A-Z0-9]', '') AS clean_pnr,
           CASE
               WHEN ml.fare_basis RLIKE 'FLEX' THEN 'flexible'
               WHEN ml.fare_basis RLIKE 'SAVER' THEN 'restricted'
               ELSE 'standard'
           END AS fare_family,
           date_trunc('month', ml.depart_ts) AS travel_month,
           datediff(CAST(ml.depart_ts AS DATE), CAST(ml.booked_at AS DATE)) AS days_advance,
           timestampdiff(HOUR, ml.booked_at, ml.depart_ts) AS hours_before_departure,
           ml.depart_ts + INTERVAL '36' HOUR AS segment_cutoff,
           array_join(ml.qualified_routes, '|') AS qualified_route_list,
           sum(ml.base_fare) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ml.passenger_id
               ORDER BY ml.base_fare
               RANGE BETWEEN 150 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS nearby_fare_spend,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ml.booking_id
               ORDER BY ml.depart_ts, ml.segment_id
           ) AS first_segment_rank
    FROM member_lines ml
    QUALIFY first_segment_rank = 1
),
promo_lines AS (
    -- Allow a promotion to remain usable for five days after its stated end.
    SELECT sl.*,
           fp.promo_code,
           fp.bonus_points
    FROM scored_lines sl
    LEFT JOIN dim_fare_promotions fp
      ON fp.eligible_tier = sl.loyalty_tier
     AND sl.booked_at BETWEEN fp.starts_at AND fp.ends_at + INTERVAL '5' DAY
),
ledger_rollup AS (
    -- Summarize current-year ledger activity, excluding point reversals.
    SELECT passenger_id,
           sum(points) AS ledger_points,
           count(*) AS ledger_entries,
           max(adjusted_at) AS last_ledger_at
    FROM fct_loyalty_ledger
    WHERE adjusted_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND reason_code <> 'REVERSAL'
    GROUP BY passenger_id
)
SELECT pl.booking_id,
       pl.passenger_id,
       coalesce(pl.member_no, 'UNENROLLED') AS member_no,
       pl.itinerary_code,
       concat_ws('/', pl.pnr_prefix, pl.clean_pnr) AS display_pnr,
       pl.contact_country,
       pl.origin,
       pl.destination,
       pl.cabin,
       CAST(pl.travel_month AS DATE) AS travel_month,
       pl.days_advance,
       pl.hours_before_departure,
       pl.segment_cutoff,
       pl.base_fare,
       pl.nearby_fare_spend,
       pl.flown_spend,
       pl.has_business_cabin,
       pl.qualified_route_list,
       pl.fare_family,
       coalesce(pl.promo_code, 'NO_PROMO') AS promo_code,
       coalesce(pl.bonus_points, 0) + coalesce(lr.ledger_points, 0) AS net_loyalty_points,
       coalesce(lr.ledger_entries, 0) AS ledger_entries
FROM promo_lines pl
LEFT JOIN ledger_rollup lr
  ON lr.passenger_id = pl.passenger_id
ORDER BY pl.depart_ts, pl.booking_id
case.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

segment_lines = (
    df_stg_flight_bookings.alias("b")
    .filter(
        (F.col("b.booking_status") == "CONFIRMED")
        & F.col("b.passenger_id").isNotNull()
    )
    .select(
        F.col("b.booking_id").alias("booking_id"),
        F.col("b.passenger_id").alias("passenger_id"),
        F.col("b.pnr").alias("pnr"),
        F.col("b.booked_at").alias("booked_at"),
        F.col("b.booking_channel").alias("booking_channel"),
        F.col("b.fare_basis").alias("fare_basis"),
        F.col("b.contact.country").alias("contact_country"),
        F.col("b.contact.email").alias("contact_email"),
        F.posexplode(F.col("b.coupons")).alias("coupon_pos", "coupon"),
        F.col("b.coupons").alias("coupons"),
    )
    .select(
        "booking_id",
        "passenger_id",
        "pnr",
        "booked_at",
        "booking_channel",
        "fare_basis",
        "contact_country",
        "contact_email",
        "coupon_pos",
        F.col("coupon.coupon_id").alias("segment_id"),
        F.col("coupon.origin").alias("origin"),
        F.col("coupon.destination").alias("destination"),
        F.col("coupon.depart_ts").alias("depart_ts"),
        F.col("coupon.cabin").alias("cabin"),
        F.col("coupon.base_fare").alias("base_fare"),
        "coupons",
        F.col("coupon.is_flown").alias("is_flown"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("is_flown"))
    .drop("is_flown")
)

member_lines = (
    segment_lines.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_dim_loyalty_members.alias("m"),
        (F.col("m.passenger_id") == F.col("s.passenger_id")) & F.col("m.is_active"),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("s.*"),
        F.col("m.member_no"),
        F.col("m.loyalty_tier"),
        F.col("m.home_airport"),
        F.aggregate(
            F.col("s.coupons"),
            F.lit(0).cast("decimal(12,2)"),
            lambda acc, x: (
                acc
                + F.when(x.getField("is_flown"), x.getField("base_fare")).otherwise(
                    F.lit(0).cast("decimal(10,2)")
                )
            ).cast("decimal(12,2)"),
        ).alias("flown_spend"),
        F.exists(F.col("s.coupons"), lambda x: x.getField("cabin") == "BUSINESS").alias(
            "has_business_cabin"
        ),
        F.transform(
            F.filter(
                F.col("s.coupons"),
                lambda x: x.getField("is_flown") & (x.getField("base_fare") > 100),
            ),
            lambda x: F.concat_ws(":", x.getField("origin"), x.getField("destination")),
        ).alias("qualified_routes"),
    )
)

w_fare_range = (
    Window.partitionBy("passenger_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("base_fare"))
    .rangeBetween(-150, 0)
)
w_first_segment = Window.partitionBy("booking_id").orderBy("depart_ts", "segment_id")

scored_lines = (
    member_lines.alias("ml")
    .select(
        F.col("ml.*"),
        F.concat_ws(
            ":",
            F.col("ml.origin"),
            F.col("ml.destination"),
            F.lpad((F.col("ml.coupon_pos") + 1).cast("string"), 2, "0"),
            F.array_join(F.split(F.col("ml.booking_channel"), "_"), "/"),
        ).alias("itinerary_code"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col("ml.pnr"), "([A-Z]{2})", 1).alias("pnr_prefix"),
        F.regexp_replace(F.col("ml.pnr"), "[^A-Z0-9]", "").alias("clean_pnr"),
        F.when(F.col("ml.fare_basis").rlike("FLEX"), "flexible")
        .when(F.col("ml.fare_basis").rlike("SAVER"), "restricted")
        .otherwise("standard")
        .alias("fare_family"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("ml.depart_ts")).alias("travel_month"),
        F.datediff(F.to_date(F.col("ml.depart_ts")), F.to_date(F.col("ml.booked_at"))).alias(
            "days_advance"
        ),
        F.floor(
            (F.col("ml.depart_ts").cast("long") - F.col("ml.booked_at").cast("long")) / 3600
        ).cast("long").alias("hours_before_departure"),
        (F.col("ml.depart_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("segment_cutoff"),
        F.array_join(F.col("ml.qualified_routes"), "|").alias("qualified_route_list"),
        F.sum(F.col("ml.base_fare")).over(w_fare_range).alias("nearby_fare_spend"),
        F.row_number().over(w_first_segment).alias("first_segment_rank"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("first_segment_rank") == 1)
)

promo_lines = (
    scored_lines.alias("sl")
    .join(
        df_dim_fare_promotions.alias("fp"),
        (F.col("fp.eligible_tier") == F.col("sl.loyalty_tier"))
        & F.col("sl.booked_at").between(
            F.col("fp.starts_at"),
            F.col("fp.ends_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '5' DAY"),
        ),
        "left",
    )
    .select(F.col("sl.*"), F.col("fp.promo_code"), F.col("fp.bonus_points"))
)

ledger_rollup = (
    df_fct_loyalty_ledger
    .filter(
        (F.col("adjusted_at") >= F.lit("2025-01-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("reason_code") != "REVERSAL")
    )
    .groupBy("passenger_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("points").alias("ledger_points"),
        F.count("*").alias("ledger_entries"),
        F.max("adjusted_at").alias("last_ledger_at"),
    )
)

result = (
    promo_lines.alias("pl")
    .join(ledger_rollup.alias("lr"), F.col("lr.passenger_id") == F.col("pl.passenger_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("pl.booking_id"),
        F.col("pl.passenger_id"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("pl.member_no"), F.lit("UNENROLLED")).alias("member_no"),
        F.col("pl.itinerary_code"),
        F.concat_ws("/", F.col("pl.pnr_prefix"), F.col("pl.clean_pnr")).alias("display_pnr"),
        F.col("pl.contact_country"),
        F.col("pl.origin"),
        F.col("pl.destination"),
        F.col("pl.cabin"),
        F.col("pl.travel_month").cast("date").alias("travel_month"),
        F.col("pl.days_advance"),
        F.col("pl.hours_before_departure"),
        F.col("pl.segment_cutoff"),
        F.col("pl.base_fare"),
        F.col("pl.nearby_fare_spend"),
        F.col("pl.flown_spend"),
        F.col("pl.has_business_cabin"),
        F.col("pl.qualified_route_list"),
        F.col("pl.fare_family"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("pl.promo_code"), F.lit("NO_PROMO")).alias("promo_code"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("pl.bonus_points"), F.lit(0)) + F.coalesce(F.col("lr.ledger_points"), F.lit(0))).alias(
            "net_loyalty_points"
        ),
