from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_latest_inventory = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "sku").orderBy(
    F.col("captured_at").desc(), F.col("snapshot_id").desc()
)
latest_inventory = (
    df_stg_inventory_snapshots
    .filter(
        (F.col("snapshot_status") == "VALID")
        & (F.col("captured_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-10 00:00:00").cast("timestamp") - F.expr("INTERVAL '7' DAY"))
    )
    .select("*", F.row_number().over(w_latest_inventory).alias("recency_rank"))
    .filter(F.col("recency_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "store_id", "sku", "snapshot_id", "captured_at",
        (F.col("captured_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL '36' HOUR")).alias("count_valid_until"),
        "on_hand_units", "reserved_units", "backroom_units",
        F.col("location.storage_zone").alias("storage_zone"),
        F.col("location.aisle_code").alias("aisle_code"),
        F.element_at(F.col("quality_scores"), F.lit("source_grade")).alias("source_grade"),
        F.coalesce(F.nullif(F.col("supplier_code"), F.lit("")), F.lit("UNASSIGNED")).alias("supplier_code"),
    )
)

stock_components = (
    latest_inventory
    .unpivot(
        ["store_id", "sku", "snapshot_id", "captured_at", "count_valid_until",
         "storage_zone", "aisle_code", "source_grade", "supplier_code"],
        ["on_hand_units", "reserved_units", "backroom_units"],
        "stock_component",
        "component_units",
    )
    .filter(F.col("component_units").isNotNull())
)

stock_rollup = (
    stock_components
    .groupBy("store_id", "sku", "snapshot_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("captured_at").alias("captured_at"),
        F.max("count_valid_until").alias("count_valid_until"),
        F.max(F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("captured_at")).cast("date")).alias("snapshot_day"),
        F.max(F.expr("TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, captured_at, TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 12:00:00')")).alias("snapshot_age_hours"),
        F.max("storage_zone").alias("storage_zone"),
        F.max("aisle_code").alias("aisle_code"),
        F.max("source_grade").alias("source_grade"),
        F.max("supplier_code").alias("supplier_code"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("stock_component") == "on_hand_units", F.col("component_units")).otherwise(0)).alias("on_hand_units"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("stock_component") == "reserved_units", F.col("component_units")).otherwise(0)).alias("reserved_units"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("stock_component") == "backroom_units", F.col("component_units")).otherwise(0)).alias("backroom_units"),
    )
)

demand_by_day = (
    df_fct_demand_events
    .filter(
        (F.col("event_ts") >= F.lit("2025-03-01 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
        & (F.col("event_ts") < F.lit("2025-03-11 00:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    )
    .groupBy("store_id", "sku", F.date_trunc("DAY", F.col("event_ts")).alias("sale_day"))
    .agg(F.sum("units_sold").alias("daily_units"))
    .select(
        "store_id", "sku", "sale_day",
        F.datediff(F.col("sale_day"), F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date")).alias("day_offset"),
        "daily_units",
    )
)
w_demand_range = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "sku").orderBy("day_offset").rangeBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w_latest_demand = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "sku").orderBy(F.col("sale_day").desc())
daily_demand = (
    demand_by_day
    .select(
        "store_id", "sku", "sale_day", "day_offset", "daily_units",
        F.round(F.avg("daily_units").over(w_demand_range), 2).alias("rolling_3d_avg_units"),
        F.sum("daily_units").over(w_demand_range).alias("rolling_3d_units"),
        F.row_number().over(w_latest_demand).alias("demand_recency"),
    )
)

store_metrics = (
    df_stg_store_daily_metrics
    .groupBy("store_id", "metric_date")
    .pivot("metric", ["SPOILAGE_UNITS", "SOLD_UNITS"])
    .agg(F.first("metric_value"))
    .select(
        "store_id", "metric_date",
        F.col("SPOILAGE_UNITS").alias("spoilage_units"),
        F.col("SOLD_UNITS").alias("sold_units"),
    )
)

proposal_options = (
    df_stg_replenishment_reviews.alias("r")
    .filter(F.col("r.review_status") == "APPROVED")
    .select("r.store_id", "r.sku", F.explode(F.col("r.proposals")).alias("item"))
    .groupBy("store_id", "sku")
    .agg(
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("item.option_code")).alias("option_codes"),
        F.max("item.suggested_units").alias("max_suggested_units"),
        F.min("item.lead_hours").alias("fastest_lead_hours"),
    )
)

available_units = F.col("a.on_hand_units") + F.col("a.backroom_units") - F.col("a.reserved_units")
rolling_avg = F.coalesce(F.col("d.rolling_3d_avg_units"), F.lit(0.0))
result = (
    stock_rollup.alias("a")
    .join(df_dim_grocery_products.alias("p"), (F.col("p.sku") == F.col("a.sku")) & F.col("p.active"), "inner")
    .join(
        daily_demand.alias("d"),
        (F.col("d.store_id") == F.col("a.store_id"))
        & (F.col("d.sku") == F.col("a.sku"))
        & (F.col("d.demand_recency") == 1),
        "left",
    )
    .join(
        store_metrics.alias("m"),
        (F.col("m.store_id") == F.col("a.store_id")) & (F.col("m.metric_date") == F.col("a.snapshot_day")),
        "left",
    )
    .join(
        proposal_options.alias("po"),
        (F.col("po.store_id") == F.col("a.store_id")) & (F.col("po.sku") == F.col("a.sku")),
        "left",
    )
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("p.product_name").alias("product_name"),
        F.col("p.category").alias("category"),
        available_units.alias("available_units"),
        rolling_avg.alias("rolling_3d_avg_units"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("d.rolling_3d_units"), F.lit(0).cast("bigint")).alias("rolling_3d_units"),
        F.col("m.spoilage_units").alias("spoilage_units"),
        F.col("m.sold_units").alias("sold_units"),
        F.round(F.lit(100) * F.coalesce(F.col("m.spoilage_units"), F.lit(0)) / F.nullif(F.col("m.sold_units"), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("spoilage_pct"),
        F.col("po.option_codes").alias("option_codes"),
        F.coalesce(F.size(F.col("po.option_codes")), F.lit(0)).alias("option_count"),
        F.col("po.fastest_lead_hours").alias("fastest_lead_hours"),
        F.when(F.col("a.source_grade").isNull(), F.lit("UNRATED"))
         .when((F.col("a.source_grade") == "C") | (F.coalesce(F.col("m.spoilage_units"), F.lit(0)) > 5), F.lit("WATCH"))
         .otherwise(F.lit("NORMAL")).alias("inventory_quality_label"),
        F.when(available_units <= F.col("p.target_min"), F.lit("REORDER_NOW"))
         .when((rolling_avg >= 8) & (available_units <= F.col("p.target_min") * 1.5), F.lit("REORDER_SOON"))
         .when(available_units > F.col("p.target_max"), F.lit("OVERSTOCK"))
         .otherwise(F.lit("HEALTHY")).alias("replenishment_status"),
        F.when(
            available_units <= F.col("p.target_min"),
            F.greatest(F.coalesce(F.col("po.max_suggested_units"), F.col("p.target_max") - available_units), F.lit(0)).cast("int"),
        ).when(
            (rolling_avg >= 8) & (available_units <= F.col("p.target_min") * 1.5),
            F.greatest(F.coalesce(F.col("po.max_suggested_units"), F.col("p.target_min") * 2 - available_units), F.lit(0)).cast("int"),
        ).otherwise(F.lit(0).cast("int")).alias("recommended_order_units"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("a.store_id"), F.col("a.sku"))
)
